om namo buddhāya
yaḥ sarvathā sarva hata andhakāraḥ saṃsāra paṅkāt jagant ujjahāra tasmai namaskṛtya yathā artha śāstre śāstram pravakṣyāmi abhidharmakośam
prajñāmalā sānucarābhidharmaḥ tatprāptaye yāpi ca yacca śāstram
tasyārthato'smin samanupraveśāt sa cāśrayo 'syetyabhidharmakośam
dharmāṇāṃ pravicayamantareṇa nāsti kleśānāṃ yata upaśāntaye'bhyupāyaḥ
kleśaiśca bhramati bhavārṇave'tra lokastaddhetorata uditaḥ kilaiṣa śāstrā
sāsravānāsravā dharmāḥ saṃskṛtā mārgavarjitāḥ
sāsravāḥ āsravāsteṣu yasmāt samanuśerate
anāsravā mārgasatyaṃ trividhaṃ cāpyasaṃskṛtam
ākāśaṃ dvau nirodhau ca tatrākāśam anāvṛtiḥ
pratisaṃkhyānirodho yo visaṃyogaḥ pṛthak pṛthak
utpādātyantavighno'nyo nirodho'pratisaṃkhyayā
te punaḥ saṃskṛtā dharmā rūpādiskandhapañcakam
ta evādhvā kathāvastu saniḥsārāḥ savastukāḥ
ye sāsravā upādānaskandhāste saraṇā api
duḥkhaṃ samudayo loko dṛṣṭisthānaṃ bhavaśca te
rūpaṃ pañcendriyāṇyarthāḥ pañcāvijñaptir eva ca
tadvijñānāśrayā rūpaprasādāścakṣurādayaḥ
rūpaṃ dvidhā viṃśatidhā śabdastvaṣṭavidhaḥ rasaḥ
ṣoḍhā caturvidho gandhaḥ spṛśyamekādaśātmakam
vikṣiptācittakasyāpi yo'nubandhaḥ śubhāśubhaḥ
mahābhūtānyupādāya sa hy avijñaptir ucyate
bhūtāni pṛthividhāturaptejovāyudhātavaḥ
dhṛtyādikarmasaṃsiddhāḥ kharasnehoṣṇateraṇāḥ
pṛthivī varṇasaṃsthānamucyate lokasaṃjñayā
āpastejaśca vāyustu dhātureva tathāpi ca
indriyārthāsta eveṣṭā daśāyatanadhātavaḥ
vedanānubhavaḥ saṃjñā nimittodgrahaṇātmikā
caturbhyo'nye tu saṃskāraskandhaḥ ete punastrayaḥ
dharmāyatanadhātvākhyāḥ sahāvijñaptyasaṃskṛtaiḥ
vijñānaṃ prativijñaptiḥ mana āyatanaṃ ca tat
dhātavaḥ sapta ca matāḥ ṣaḍ vijñānānyatho manaḥ
ṣaṇṇām anantarātītaṃ vijñānaṃ yaddhi tanmanaḥ
ṣaṣṭhāśrayaprasiddhyarthaṃ dhātavo 'ṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ
sarvasaṃgraha ekena skandhenāyatanena ca
dhātunā ca svabhāvena parabhāvaviyogataḥ
jātigocaravijñānasāmānyādekadhātutā
dvitve'pi cakṣurādīnāṃ śobhārthaṃ tu dvayodbhavaḥ
rāśyāyadvāragotrārthāḥ skandhāyatanadhātavaḥ
mohendriyarucitraidhāt tisraḥ skandhādideśanāḥ
vivādamūlasaṃsārahetutvāt kramakāraṇāt
caittebhyo vedanāsaṃjñe pṛthakskandhau niveśitau
skandheṣvasaṃskṛtaṃ noktamarthāyogāt kramaḥ punaḥ
yathaudārikasaṃkleśabhājanādyarthadhātutaḥ
prāk pañca vārttamānārthyāt bhautikārthyāccatuṣṭayam
dūrāśutaravṛttyānyat yathāsthānaṃ kramo'thavā
viśeṣaṇārthaṃ prādhānyād bahudharmāgrasaṃgrahāt
ekamāyatanaṃ rūpamekaṃ dharmākhyamucyate
dharmaskandhasahasrāṇi yānyaśītiṃ jagau muniḥ
tāni vāṅnāma vetyeṣāṃ rūpasaṃskārasaṃgrahaḥ
śāstrapramāṇā ityeke skandhādīnāṃ kathaikaśaḥ
caritapratipakṣastu dharmaskandho'nuvarṇitaḥ
tathānye'pi yathāyogaṃ skandhāyatanadhātavaḥ
pratipādyā yathokteṣu sampradhārya svalakṣaṇam
chidramākāśadhātvākhyam ālokatamasī kila
vijñānadhāturvijñānaṃ sāsravaṃ janmaniśrayāḥ
sanidarśana eko'tra rūpaṃ sapratighā daśa
rūpiṇaḥ avyākṛtā aṣṭau ta evārūpaśabdakāḥ
tridhānye kāmadhātvāptāḥ sarve rūpe caturdaśa
vinā gandharasaghrāṇajihvāvijñānadhātubhiḥ
ārūpyāptā manodharmamanovijñānadhātavaḥ
sāsravānāsravā ete trayaḥ śeṣāstu sāsravāḥ
savitarkavicārā hi pañca vijñānadhātavaḥ
antyāstrayastriprakārāḥ śeṣā ubhayavarjitāḥ
nirūpaṇānusmaraṇavikalpenāvikalpakāḥ
tau prajñā mānasī vyagrā smṛtiḥ sarvaiva mānasī
sapta sālambanāścittadhātavaḥ ardhaṃ ca dharmataḥ
navānupāttās te cāṣṭau śabdaśca anye nava dvidhā
spraṣṭavyaṃ dvividhaṃ śeṣā rūpiṇo nava bhautikāḥ
dharmadhātvekadeśaśca saṃcitā daśa rūpiṇaḥ
chinatti chidyate caiva bāhyaṃ dhātucatuṣṭayam
dahyate tulayatyevaṃ vivādo dagdhṛtulyayoḥ
vipākajaupacayikāḥ pañcādhyātmaṃ vipākajaḥ
na śabdaḥ apratighā aṣṭau naiḥṣyandikavipākajāḥ
tridhānye dravyavānekaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ paścimāstrayaḥ
cakṣurvijñānadhātvoḥ syāt pṛthak lābhaḥ sahāpi ca
dvādaśādhyātmikāḥ hitvā rūpādīn dharmasaṃjñakaḥ
sabhāgaḥ tatsabhāgāśca śeṣāḥ yo na svakarmakṛt
daśa bhāvanayā heyāḥ pañca ca antyāstrayastridhā
na dṛṣṭiheyamakliṣṭaṃ na rūpaṃ nāpyaṣaṣṭhajam
cakṣuśca dharmadhātośca pradeśo dṛṣṭiḥ aṣṭadhā
pañcavijñānasahajā dhīrna dṛṣṭiratīraṇāt
cakṣuḥ paśyati rūpāṇi sabhāgaṃ na tadāśritam
vijñānaṃ dṛśyate rūpaṃ na kilāntaritaṃ yataḥ
ubhābhyāmapi cakṣurbhyāṃ paśyati vyaktadarśanāt
cakṣuḥśrotramano'prāptaviṣayaṃ trayamanyathā
tribhirghrāṇādibhistulyaviṣayagrahaṇaṃ matam
caramasyāśrayo'tītaḥ pañcānāṃ sahajaśca taiḥ
tadvikāravikāritvād āśrayāś cakṣurādayaḥ
ato'sādhāraṇatvāddhi vijñānaṃ tairnirucyate
na kāyasyādharaṃ cakṣuḥ ūrdhvaṃ rūpaṃ na cakṣuṣaḥ
vijñānaṃ ca asya rūpaṃ tu kāyasyobhe ca sarvataḥ
tathā śrotraṃ trayāṇāṃ tu sarvameva svabhūmikam
kāyavijñānamadharasvabhūmi aniyataṃ manaḥ
pañca bāhyā dvivijñeyāḥ nityā dharmā asaṃskṛtāḥ
dharmārdhamindriyaṃ ye ca dvādaśādhyātmikāḥ smṛtāḥ
abhidharmakośabhāṣye dhātunirdeśo nāma prathamaṃ kośasthānaṃ samāptamiti
caturṣvartheṣu pañcānāmādhipatyaṃ dvayoḥ kila
caturṇāṃ pañcakāṣṭānāṃ saṃkleśavyavadānayoḥ
svārthopalabdhyādhipatyāt sarvasya ca ṣaḍindriyam
strītvapuṃstvādhipatyāttu kāyāt strīpuruṣendriye
nikāyasthitisaṃkleśavyavadānādhipatyataḥ
jīvitaṃ vedanāḥ pañca śraddhādyāścendriyaṃ matāḥ
ājñāsyāmyākhyam ājñākhyam ājñātāvīndriyaṃ tathā
uttarottarasaṃprāptinirvāṇādyādhipatyataḥ
cittāśrayastadvikalpaḥ sthitiḥ saṃkleśa eva ca
saṃbhāro vyavadānaṃ ca yāvatā tāvadindriyam
pravṛtterāśrayotpattisthitipratyupabhogataḥ
caturdaśa tathānyāni nivṛtterindriyāṇi vā
duḥkhendriyam aśātā yā kāyikī vedanā sukham
śātā dhyāne tṛtīye tu caitasī sā sukhendriyam
anyatra sā saumanasyaṃ aśātā caitasī punaḥ
daurmanasyamupekṣā tu madhyā ubhayī avikalpanāt
dṛgbhāvanāśaikṣapathe nava trīṇi amalaṃ trayam
rūpīṇi jīvitaṃ duḥkhe sāsravāṇi dvidhā nava
vipāko jīvitaṃ dvedhā dvādaśa antyāṣṭakādṛte
daurmanasyācca tattvekaṃ savipākaṃ daśa dvidhā
mano'nyavittiśraddhādīni aṣṭakaṃ kuśalaṃ dvidhā
daurmanasyaṃ mano'nyā ca vittistredhā anyadekadhā
kāmāptamamalaṃ hitvā rūpāptaṃ strīpumindriye
duḥkhe ca hitvā ārūpyāptaṃ sukhe cāpohya rūpi ca
manovittitrayaṃ tredhā dviheyā durmanaskatā
nava bhāvanayā pañca tvaheyānyapi na trayam
kāmeṣvādau vipāko dve labhyate nopapādukaiḥ
taiḥ ṣaḍ vā sapta vā aṣṭau vā ṣaḍ rūpeṣu ekamuttare
nirodhayatyuparamānnārūpye jīvitaṃ manaḥ
upekṣāṃ caiva rūpe'ṣṭau kāme daśa navāṣṭau vā
kramamṛtyau tu catvāri śubhe sarvatra pañca ca
navāptirantyaphalayoḥ saptāṣṭanavabhirdvayoḥ
ekādaśabhirarhattvamuktaṃ tvekasya saṃbhavāt
upekṣājīvitamanoyukto 'vaśyaṃ trayānvitaḥ
caturbhiḥ sukhakāyābhyāṃ pañcabhiścakṣurādimān
saumanasyī ca duḥkhī tu saptabhiḥ strīndriyādimān
aṣṭābhiḥ ekādaśabhis tv ājñājñātendriyānvitaḥ
ājñāsyāmīndriyopetas trayodaśabhir anvitaḥ
sarvālpair niḥśubho 'ṣṭābhir vinmanaḥkāyajīvitaiḥ
yuktaḥ bālastathārūpye upekṣāyurmanaḥśubhaiḥ
bahubhiryukta ekānnaviṃśatyāmalavarjitaiḥ
dviliṅgaḥ āryo rāgī ekaliṅgadvayamalavarjitaiḥ
kāme'ṣṭadravyako'śabdaḥ paramāṇur anindriyaḥ
kāyendriyī navadravyaḥ daśadravyo'parendriyaḥ
cittaṃ caittāḥ sahāvaśyaṃ sarvaṃ saṃskṛtalakṣaṇaiḥ
prāptyā vā pañcadhā caittā mahābhūmyādibhedataḥ
vedanā cetanā saṃjñā chandaḥ sparśo matiḥ smṛtiḥ
manaskāro 'dhimokṣaśca samādhiḥ sarvacetasi
śraddhāpramādaḥ praśrabdhirupekṣā hrīr apatrapā
mūladvayamahiṃsā ca vīryaṃ ca kuśale sadā
tathā hi dūrād rūpaṃ paśyati akṣisthamañjanaṃ na paśyati
dūrācchabdaṃ śṛṇoti sati ca prāptaviṣayatve divyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotramiha manuṣyeṣu dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeta ghrāṇādivat
yady aprāptaviṣayaṃ cakṣuḥ kasmānna sarvam aprāptaṃ paśyati dūraṃ tiraskṛtaṃ ca kathaṃ tāvadayaskānto na sarvam aprāptam ayaḥ karṣati prāptaviṣayatve'pi caitat samānam
kasmānna sarvaṃ prāptaṃ paśyatyañjanaṃ śalākāṃ vā
yathā ca ghrāṇādīnāṃ hi prāpto viṣayo na tu sarvaḥ sahabhūgandhādyagrahaṇād evaṃ cakṣuṣo 'py aprāptaḥ syāt na tu sarvaḥ
manastvarūpitvāt prāptumevāśaktam
kecit punaḥ śrotraṃ prāptāprāptaviṣayaṃ manyante karṇābhyantare'pi śabdaśravaṇāt
śeṣaṃ tu ghrāṇajihvākāyākhyam
praṇipatyārhataḥ siddhasāṅgaśabdānuśāsanaḥ
rūḍhayaugikamiśrāṇāṃ nāmnāṃ mālāṃ tanomyaham
vyutpattirahitāḥ śabdā rūḍhā ākhaṇḍalādayaḥ
yogo 'nvayaḥ sa tu guṇakriyāsaṃbandhasaṃbhavaḥ
guṇato nīlakaṇṭhādyāḥ kriyātaḥ sraṣṭṛsaṃnibhāḥ
svasvāmitvādisaṃbandhastatrāhurnāma tadvatām
svāt pāladhanabhugnetṛpatimatvarthakādayaḥ
bhūpālo bhūdhano bhūbhugbhūnetā bhūpatistathā
bhūmāṃśceti kavirūḍhyā jñeyodāharaṇāvalī
janyāt kṛtkartṛsṛṭsraṣṭṛvidhātṛkarasūsamāḥ
janakād yonijaruhajanmabhūsūtyaṇādayaḥ
dhāryāddhvajāstrapāṇyaṅkamaulibhūṣaṇabhṛnnibhāḥ
śāliśekharamatvarthamālibhartṛdharā api
bhojyād bhugandhovrataliṭpāyipāśāśanādayaḥ
patyuḥ kāntāpriyatamāvadhūpraṇayinīnibhāḥ
kalatrād vararamaṇapraṇayīśapriyādayaḥ
sakhyuḥ sakhisamā vāhyādgāmiyānāsanādayaḥ
jñāteḥ svasṛduhitrātmajāgrajāvarajādayaḥ
āśrayātsadmaparyāyaśayavāsisadādayaḥ
vadhyād bhiddveṣijiddhātidhrugripudhvaṃsiśāsanāḥ
prākpradarśitasaṃbandhiśabdā yojyā yathocitam
dṛśyate khalu vāhyatve vṛṣasya vṛṣavāhanaḥ
ekendriyāḥ pṛthivyambutejovāyumahīruhaḥ
kṛmipīlakalūtādyāḥ syurdvitricaturindriyāḥ
pañcendriyāścebhakekimatsyādyāḥ sthalakhāmbugāḥ
pañcendriyā eva devā narā nairayikā api
nārakāḥ pañcame sāṅgāḥ ṣaṣṭhe sādhāraṇāḥ sphuṭam
prastoṣyante 'vyayāścātra tvantāthādī na pūrvagau
arhañjinaḥ pāragatas trikālavit kṣīṇāṣṭakarmāparameṣṭhyadhīśvaraḥ
śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhūr bhagavāñjagatprabhustīrthaṃkarastīrthakaro jineśvaraḥ
syādvādyabhayadasārvāḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśikevalinau
devādhidevabodhadapuruṣottamavītarāgāptāḥ
etasyāmavasarpiṇyāmṛṣabho 'jitaśaṃbhavau
abhinandanaḥ sumatistataḥ padmaprabhābhidhaḥ
supārśvaścandraprabhaśca suvidhiścātha śītalaḥ
śreyāṃso vāsupūjyaśca vimalo 'nantatīrthakṛt
dharmaḥ śāntiḥ kuṃthuraro malliśca munisuvrataḥ
namirnemiḥ pārśvo vīraścaturviṃśatirarhatām
ṛṣabho vṛṣabhaḥ śreyāñśreyāṃsaḥ syādanantajidanantaḥ
suvidhistu puṣpadanto munisuvratasuvratau tulyau
ariṣṭanemistu nemirvīraścaramatīrthakṛt
mahāvīro vardhamāno devāryo jñātanandanaḥ
gaṇā navāsyarṣisaṃghā ekādaśa gaṇādhipāḥ
indrabhūtiragnibhūtivāyubhūtiśca gautamāḥ
vyaktaḥ sudharmā maṇḍitamauryaputrāvakampitaḥ
acalabhrātā metāryaḥ prabhāsaśca pṛthakkulāḥ
kevalī caramo jambūsvāmyatha prabhavatprabhuḥ
śayyaṃbhavo yaśobhadraḥ saṃbhūtavijayastataḥ
bhadrabāhuḥ sthūlabhadraḥ śrutakevalino hi ṣaṭ
mahāgirisuhastyādyā vajrāntā daśapūrviṇaḥ
ikṣvākukulasambhūtāḥ syāddvāviṃśatir arhatām
munisuvratanemī tu harivaṃśasamudbhavau
nābhiśca jitaśatruśca jitāriratha saṃvaraḥ
megho dharaḥ pratiṣṭhaśca mahāsenanareśvaraḥ
sugrīvaśca dṛḍharatho viṣṇuśca vasupūjyarāṭ
kṛtavarmā siṃhaseno bhānuśca viśvasenarāṭ
sūraḥ sudarśanaḥ kumbhaḥ sumitro vijayastathā
samudravijayaścāśvasenaḥ siddhārtha eva ca
marudevā vijayā senā siddhārthā ca maṅgalā
tataḥ susīmā pṛthvī lakṣmaṇā rāmā tataḥ param
nandā viṣṇurjayā śyāmā suyaśāḥ suvratācirā
śrīrdevī prabhāvatī ca padmā vaprā śivā tathā
vāmā triśalā kramataḥ pitaro mātaro 'rhatām
syādgomukho mahāyakṣastrimukho yakṣanāyakaḥ
tumbaruḥ kusumaścāpi mātaṅgo vijayo 'jitaḥ
brahmā yakṣeṭ kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukhapātālakiṃnarāḥ
garuḍo gandharvo yakṣeṭ kubero varuṇo 'pi ca
bhṛkuṭir gomedhaḥ pārśvo mātaṅgo 'rhadupāsakāḥ
cakreśvaryajitabalā duritāriśca kālikā
mahākālī śyāmā śāntā bhṛkuṭiśca sutārakā
aśokā mānavī caṇḍā viditā cāṅkuśā tathā
kandarpā nirvāṇī balā dhāriṇī dharaṇapriyā
naradattātha gāndhāryambikā padmāvatī tathā
siddhāyikā ceti jainyaḥ kramācchāsanadevatāḥ
vṛṣo gajo 'śvaḥ plavagaḥ krauñco 'bjaṃ svastikaḥ śaśī
makaraḥ śrīvatsaḥ khaḍgī mahiṣaḥ sūkarastathā
śyeno vajraṃ mṛgaśchāgo nandyāvarto ghaṭo 'pi ca
kūrmo nīlotpalaṃ śaṅkhaḥ phaṇī siṃho 'rhatāṃ dhvajāḥ
raktau ca padmaprabhavāsupūjyau śuklau tu candraprabhapuṣpadantau
kṛṣṇau punarnemimunī vinīlau śrīmallipārśvau kanakatviṣo 'nye
utsarpiṇyāmatītāyāṃ caturviṃśatirarhatām
kevalajñānī nirvāṇī sāgaro 'tha mahāyaśāḥ
vimalaḥ sarvānubhūtiḥ śrīdharo dattatīrthakṛt
dāmodaraḥ sutejāśca svāmyatho munisuvrataḥ
sumatiḥ śivagatiścaivātyāgo 'tha nimīśvaraḥ
anilo yaśodharākhyaḥ kṛtārtho 'tha jineśvaraḥ
śuddhamatiḥ śivakaraḥ syandanaścātha saṃpratiḥ
bhāvinyāṃ tu padmanābhaḥ śūradevaḥ supārśvakaḥ
svayaṃprabhaśca sarvānubhūtirdevaśrutodayau
peḍhālaḥ poṭṭilaścāpi śatakīrtiśca suvrataḥ
amamo niṣkaṣāyaśca niṣpulāko 'tha nirmamaḥ
citraguptaḥ samādhiśca saṃvaraśca yaśodharaḥ
vijayo malladevau cānantavīryaśca bhadrakṛt
evaṃ sarvāvasarpiṇyutsarpiṇīṣu jinottamāḥ
teṣāṃ ca deho 'dbhutarūpagandho nirāmayaḥ svedamalojjhitaśca
śvāso 'bjagandho rudhirāmiṣaṃ tu gokṣīradhārādhavalaṃ hyavisram
āhāranīhāravidhistvadṛśyaścatvāra ete 'tiśayāḥ sahotthāḥ
kṣetre sthitiryojanamātrake 'pi nṛdevatiryagjanakoṭikoṭeḥ
vāṇī nṛtiryaksuralokabhāṣāsaṃvādinī yojanagāminī ca
bhāmaṇḍalaṃ cāru ca maulipṛṣṭhe viḍambitāharpatimaṇḍalaśrīḥ
sāgre ca gavyūtiśatadvaye rujāvairetayo māryativṛṣṭyavṛṣṭayaḥ
durbhikṣamanyasvakacakrato bhayaṃ syānnaita ekādaśa karmaghātajāḥ
khe dharmacakraṃ camarāḥ sapādapīṭhaṃ mṛgendrāsanamujjvalaṃ ca
chattratrayaṃ ratnamayadhvajo 'ṅghrinyāse ca cāmīkarapaṅkajāni
vapratrayaṃ cāru caturmukhāṅgatāś caityadrumo 'dhovadanāśca kaṇṭakāḥ
drumānatirdundubhināda uccakairvāto 'nukūlaḥ śakunāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ
gandhāmbuvarṣaṃ bahuvarṇapuṣpavṛṣṭiḥ kacaśmaśrunakhāpravṛddhiḥ
caturvidhā martyanikāyakoṭijaghanyabhāvādapi pārśvadeśe
kratūnāmindriyārthānāmanukūlatvamityamī
ekonaviṃśatidaivyāścatustriṃśacca mīlitāḥ
saṃskāravattvamaudāryamupacāraparītatā
meghanirghoṣagāmbhīryaṃ pratinādavidhāyitā
dakṣiṇatvamupanītarāgatvaṃ ca mahārthatā
avyāhatatvaṃ śiṣṭatvaṃ saṃśayānāmasaṃbhavaḥ
nirākṛtānyottaratvaṃ hṛdayaṃgamitāpi ca
mithaḥ sākāṅkṣatā prastāvaucityaṃ tattvaniṣṭhatā
aprakīrṇaprasṛtatvam asvaślāghānyaninditā
ābhijātyamatisnigdhamadhuratvaṃ praśasyatā
amarmavedhitaudāryaṃ dharmārthapratibaddhatā
kārakādyaviparyāso vibhramādiviyuktatā
citrakṛttvam adbhutatvaṃ tathānativilambitā
anekajātivaicitryam āropitaviśeṣitā
sattvapradhānatā varṇapadavākyaviviktatā
avyucchittir akheditvaṃ pañcatriṃśacca vāgguṇāḥ
antarāyā dānalābhavīryabhogopabhogagāḥ
hāso ratyaratī bhītirjugupsā śoka eva ca
kāmo mithyātvamajñānaṃ nidrā cāviratistathā
rogo dveṣaśca no doṣāsteṣāmaṣṭādaśāpyamī
mahānando 'mṛtaṃ siddhiḥ kaivalyamapunarbhavaḥ
śivaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ śreyo nirvāṇaṃ brahma nirvṛtiḥ
mahodayaḥ sarvaduḥkhakṣayo niryāṇamakṣaram
muktirmokṣo 'pavargo 'tha mumukṣuḥ śramaṇo yatiḥ
vācaṃyamo vratī sādhuranagāra ṛṣimuniḥ
nirgrantho bhikṣurasya svaṃ tapoyogaśamādayaḥ
mokṣopāyo yogo jñānaṃ śraddhānaṃ caraṇātmakaḥ
abhāṣaṇaṃ punarmaunaṃ gururdharmopadeśakaḥ
anuyogakṛdācārya upādhyāyastu pāṭhakaḥ
anūcānaḥ pravacane sāṅge 'dhītī gaṇiśca saḥ
śiṣyo vineyo 'ntevāsī śaikṣaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ
satīrthyāstvekaguravo vivekaḥ pṛthagātmatā
ekabrahmavratācārā mithaḥ sabrahmacāriṇaḥ
syātpāramparyamāmnāyaḥ saṃpradāyo gurukramaḥ
vratādānaṃ parivrajyā tapasyā niyamasthitiḥ
ahiṃsāsūnṛtāsteyabrahmākiṃcanatā yamāḥ
niyamāḥ śaucasaṃtoṣau svādhyāyatapasī api
devatāpraṇidhānaṃ ca karaṇaṃ punarāsanam
prāṇāyāmaḥ prāṇayamaḥ śvāsapraśvāsarodhanam
pratyāhārastvindriyāṇāṃ viṣayebhyaḥ samāhṛtiḥ
dhāraṇā tu kvaciddhyeye cittasya sthirabandhanam
dhyānaṃ tu viṣaye tasmin ekapratyayasaṃtatiḥ
samādhistu tadevārthamātrābhāsanarūpakam
evaṃ yogo yamādyaṅgairaṣṭabhiḥ saṃmato 'ṣṭadhā
śvaḥśreyasaṃ śubhaśive kalyāṇaṃ śvovasīyasaṃ śreyaḥ
kṣemaṃ bhāvukabhavikakuśalamaṅgalabhadramadraśastāni
svargastriviṣṭapaṃ dyodivau bhuvistaviṣatāviṣau nākaḥ
gaustridivamūrdhvalokaḥ surālayas tatsadastvamarāḥ
devāḥ suparvasuranirjaradevatarbhubarhirmukhānimiṣadaivatanākilekhāḥ
vṛndārakāḥ sumanasastridaśā amartyāḥ svāhāsvadhākratusudhābhuja āditeyāḥ
gīrvāṇā maruto 'svapnā vibudhā dānavārayaḥ
teṣāṃ yānaṃ vimāno 'ndhaḥ pīyūṣamamṛtaṃ sudhā
asurā nāgāstaḍitaḥ suparṇakā vahnayo 'nilāḥ stanitāḥ
udadhidvīpadiśo daśa bhavanādhīśāḥ kumārāntāḥ
syuḥ piśācā bhūtā yakṣā rākṣasāḥ kiṃnarā api
kiṃpuruṣā mahoragā gandharvāścāntarā amī
jyotiṣkāḥ pañca candrārkagrahanakṣatratārakāḥ
vaimānikāḥ punaḥ kalpabhavā dvādaśa te tvamī
saudharmeśānasanatkumāramāhendrabrahmalāntakajāḥ
śukrasahasrārānataprāṇatajā āraṇācyutajāḥ
kalpātītā nava graiveyakāḥ pañca tvanuttarāḥ
nikāyabhedādevaṃ syurdevāḥ kila caturvidhāḥ
ādityaḥ savitāryamā kharasahasroṣṇāṃśur aṃśū ravirmārtaṇḍastaraṇirgabhastiraruṇo bhānurnabho 'harmaṇiḥ
sūryo 'rkaḥ kiraṇo bhago grahapuṣaḥ pūṣā pataṅgaḥ khago mārtāṇḍo yamunākṛtāntajanakaḥ pradyotanastāpanaḥ
bradhno haṃsaścitrabhānurvivasvānsūrastvaṣṭā dvādaśātmā ca heliḥ
mitro dhvāntārātir abjāṃśuhastaścakrābjāharbāndhavaḥ saptasaptiḥ
divādināhardivasaprabhāvibhābhāsaḥ karaḥ syānmihiro virocanaḥ
grahābjinīgodyupatirvikartano hariḥ śucīnau gaganāhajādhvagau
haridaśvo jagatkarmasākṣī bhāsvānvibhāvasuḥ
trayītanurjagaccakṣustapano 'ruṇasārathiḥ
rocirusraruciśociraṃśugo jyotirarcirupadhṛtyabhīśavaḥ
pragrahaḥ śucimarīcidīptayo dhāmaketughṛṇiraśmipṛśnayaḥ
pādadīdhitikaradyutidyuto rugvirokakiraṇatviṣitviṣaḥ
bhāḥprabhāvasugabhastibhānavo bhā mayūkhamahasī chavirvibhā
prakāśasteja uddyota āloko varca ātapaḥ
marīcikā mṛgatṛṣṇā maṇḍalaṃ tūpasūryakam
paridhiḥ pariveṣaśca sūrasūtastu kāśyapiḥ
anūrurvinatāsūnuraruṇo garuḍāgrajaḥ
revantastvarkaretojaḥ plavago hayavāhanaḥ
aṣṭādaśa māṭharādyāḥ savituḥ paripārśvakāḥ
candramāḥ kumudabāndhavo daśaśvetavājyamṛtasūs tithipraṇīḥ
kaumudīkumudinībhadakṣajārohiṇīdvijaniśauṣadhīpatiḥ
jaivātṛko 'bjaśca kalāśaśaiṇacchāyābhṛd indur vidhur atridṛgjaḥ
rājā niśo ratnakarau ca candraḥ somo 'mṛtaśvetahimadyutir glauḥ
ṣoḍaśo 'ṃśaḥ kalā cihnaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣma lāñchanam
aṅkaḥ kalaṅko 'bhijñānaṃ candrikā candragolikā
candrātapaḥ kaumudī ca jyotsnā bimbaṃ tu maṇḍalam
nakṣatraṃ tārakā tārājyotiṣī bhamuḍu grahaḥ
dhiṣṇyamṛkṣamathāśvinyaśvakinī dasradevatā
aśvayugvālinī cātha bharaṇī yamadevatā
kṛttikā bahulāścāgnidevā brāhmī tu rohiṇī
mṛgaśīrṣaṃ mṛgaśiro mārgaścāndramasaṃ mṛgaḥ
ilvalāstu mṛgaśiraḥśirasthāḥ pañca tārakāḥ
ārdrā tu kālinī raudrī punarvasū tu yāmakau
ādityau ca puṣpastiṣyaḥ sidhyaśca gurudaivataḥ
sārpo 'śleṣā maghā pitryā phālgunī yonidevatā
sā tūttarāryamadevā hastaḥ savitṛdaivataḥ
tvāṣṭrī citrānilī svātirviśākhendrāgnidevatāḥ
rādhānurādhā tu maitrī jyeṣṭhaindrī mūla āsrapaḥ
pūrvāṣāḍhā tu sottarā syādvaiśvī śravaṇaḥ punaḥ
haridevaḥ śraviṣṭhā tu dhaniṣṭhā vasudevatā
vāruṇī tu śatabhiṣag ajāhirbudhnadevatāḥ
pūrvottarā bhādrapadā dṛśyaḥ proṣṭhapadāśca tāḥ
revatī tu pauṣṇaṃ dākṣāyaṇyaḥ sarvāḥ śaśipriyāḥ
rāśīnāmudayo lagnaṃ meṣaprabhṛtayastu te
āro vakro lohitāṅgo maṅgalo 'ṅgārakaḥ kujaḥ
āṣāḍhābhūr navārciśca budhaḥ saumyaḥ praharṣulaḥ
jñaḥ pañcārciḥ śraviṣṭhābhūḥ śyāmāṅgo rohiṇīsutaḥ
bṛhaspatiḥ surācāryo jīvaścitraśikhaṇḍijaḥ
vācaspatirdvādaśārcirdhiṣaṇaḥ phālgunībhavaḥ
gīrbṛhatyoḥ patirutathyānujāṅgirasau guruḥ
śukro maghābhavaḥ kāvya uśanā bhārgavaḥ kaviḥ
ṣoḍaśārcir daityagurur dhiṣṇyaḥ śanaiścaraḥ śaniḥ
chāyāsuto 'sitaḥ sauriḥ saptārcī revatībhavaḥ
mandaḥ kroḍo nīlavāsāḥ svarbhāṇustu vidhuṃtudaḥ
tamo rāhuḥ saiṃhikeyo bharaṇībhūrathāhikaḥ
aśleṣābhūḥ śikhī keturdhruvastūttānapādajaḥ
agastyo 'gastiḥ pītābdhir vātāpidviḍghaṭodbhavaḥ
maitrāvaruṇirāgneya aurvaśeyāgnimārutau
lopāmudrā tu tadbhāryā kauṣītakī varapradā
marīcipramukhāḥ saptarṣayaścitraśikhaṇḍinaḥ
puṣpadantau puṣpavantāvekoktyā śaśibhāskarau
rāhugrāso 'rkendvorgraha uparāga upaplavaḥ
upaliṅgaṃ tvariṣṭaṃ syādupasarga upadravaḥ
ajanyamītirutpāto vahnyutpāta upāhitaḥ
syātkālaḥ samayo diṣṭānehasau sarvabhūṣakaḥ
kālo dvividho 'vasarpiṇyutsarpiṇīvibhedataḥ
sāgarakoṭikoṭīnāṃ viṃśatyā sa samāpyate
avasarpiṇyāṃ ṣaḍarā utsarpiṇyāṃ ta eva viparītāḥ
evaṃ dvādaśabhirarairvivartate kālacakramidam
tatraikāntasuṣamāraścatasraḥ koṭikoṭayaḥ
sāgarāṇāṃ suṣamā tu tisrastūtkoṭikoṭayaḥ
suṣamaduḥṣamā te dve duḥṣamasuṣamā punaḥ
saikā sahasrairvarṣāṇāṃ dvicatvāriṃśatonitā
atha duḥṣamaikaviṃśatirabdasahasrāṇi tāvatī tu syāt
ekāntaduḥṣamāpi hyetatsaṃkhyāḥ pare 'pi viparītāḥ
prathame 'ratraye martyāstridvyekapalyajīvitāḥ
tridvyekagavyūtyucchrayāstridvyekadinabhojanāḥ
kalpadruphalasaṃtuṣṭāścaturthe tvarake narāḥ
pūrvakoṭyāyuṣaḥ pañcadhanuḥśatasamucchrayāḥ
pañcame tu varṣaśatāyuṣaḥ saptakarocchrayāḥ
ṣaṣṭhe punaḥ ṣoḍaśābdāyuṣo hastasamucchrayāḥ
ekāntaduḥkhapracitā utsarpiṇyāmapīdṛśāḥ
paścānupūrvyā vijñeyā areṣu kila ṣaṭsvapi
aṣṭādaśa nimeṣāstu kāṣṭhā kāṣṭhādvayaṃ lavaḥ
kalā taiḥ pañcadaśabhirleśastaddvitayena ca
kṣaṇastaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ kṣaṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhistu nāḍikā
sā dhārikā ca ghaṭikā muhūrtastaddvayena ca
triṃśatā tairahorātrastatrāhardivaso dinam
divaṃ dyur vāsaro ghasraḥ prabhātaṃ syādaharmukham
vyuṣṭaṃ vibhātaṃ pratyūṣaṃ kalyapratyuṣasī uṣaḥ
kālyaṃ madhyāhnastu divāmadhyaṃ madhyaṃdinaṃ ca saḥ
dināvasānamutsūro vikālasabalī api
sāyaṃ saṃdhyā tu pitṛsūstrisaṃdhyaṃ tūpavaiṇavam
śrāddhakālastu kutapo 'ṣṭamo bhāgo dinasya yaḥ
niśā niśīthinī rātriḥ śarvarī kṣaṇadā kṣapā
triyāmā yāminī bhautī tamī tamā vibhāvarī
rajanī vasatiḥ śyāmā vāsateyī tamasvinī
uṣā doṣendukāntātha tamisrā darśayāminī
jyautsnī tu pūrṇimārātrirgaṇarātro niśāgaṇaḥ
pakṣiṇī pakṣatulyābhyām ahobhyāṃ veṣṭitā niśā
garbhakaṃ rajanīdvandvaṃ pradoṣo rajanīmukham
yāmaḥ praharo niśīthastvardharātro mahāniśā
uccandrastvapararātrastamisraṃ timiraṃ tamaḥ
dhvāntaṃ bhūchāyāndhakāraṃ tamasaṃ samavāndhataḥ
tulyanaktaṃdine kāle viṣuvadviṣuvaṃ ca tat
pañcadaśāhorātraḥ syātpakṣaḥ sa bahulo 'sitaḥ
tithiḥ punaḥ karmavāṭī pratipatpakṣatiḥ same
pañcadaśyau yajñakālau pakṣāntau parvaṇī api
tatparvamūlaṃ bhūteṣṭāpañcadaśyoryadantaram
sa parva saṃdhiḥ pratipatpañcadaśyoryadantaram
pūrṇimā paurṇamāsī sā rākā pūrṇe niśākare
kalāhīne tvanumatirmārgaśīrṣyāgrahāyaṇī
amāmāvasyamāvasyā darśasūryendusaṃgamaḥ
amāvāsyāmāvāsī ca sā naṣṭenduḥ kuhuḥ kuhūḥ
dṛṣṭendustu sinīvālī bhūteṣṭā tu caturdaśī
pakṣo māso vatsarādirmārgaśīrṣaḥ sahaḥ sahāḥ
āgrahāyaṇikaścātha pauṣastaiṣaḥ sahasyavat
māghastapāḥ phālgunastu phālgunikastapasyavat
caitro madhuścaitrikaśca vaiśākhe rādhamādhavau
jyeṣṭhastu śukro 'thāṣāḍhaḥ śuciḥ syācchrāvaṇo nabhāḥ
śrāvaṇiko 'tha nabhasyaḥ proṣṭhabhādraparaḥ padaḥ
bhādraścāpyāśvine tvāśvayujeṣāvatha kārtikaḥ
kārtikiko bāhulorjau dvau dvau mārgādikāvṛtuḥ
hemantaḥ praśalo raudro 'tha śaiṣaśiśirau samau
vasanta iṣyaḥ surabhiḥ puṣpakālo balāṅgakaḥ
uṣṇa uṣṇāgamo grīṣmo nidāghastapa ūṣmakaḥ
varṣāstapātyayaḥ prāvṛṇmeghakālāgamau kṣarī
śaradghanātyayo 'yanaṃ śiśirādyaistribhistribhiḥ
ayane dve gatirudagdakṣiṇārkasya vatsaraḥ
sa saṃparyanūdbhyo varṣaṃ hāyano 'bdaṃ samāḥ śarat
bhavetpaitraṃ tvahorātraṃ māsenābdena daivatam
daive yugasahasre dve brāhmaṃ kalpau tu tau nṛṇām
manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ
kalpo guṇāntaḥ kalpāntaḥ saṃhāraḥ pralayaḥ kṣayaḥ
saṃvartaḥ parivartaśca samasuptirjihānakaḥ
tatkālastu tadātvaṃ syāttajjaṃ sāṃdṛṣṭikaṃ phalam
āyatistūttaraḥ kāla udarkastadbhavaṃ phalam
vyomāntarikṣaṃ gaganaṃ ghanāśrayo vihāya ākāśamanantapuṣkare
abhraṃ surābhroḍumarutpatho 'mbaraṃ khaṃ dyodivau viṣṇupadaṃ viyannabhaḥ
nabhrāṭtaḍitvānmudiro ghanāghano 'bhraṃ dhūmayonistanayitnumeghāḥ
jīmūtaparjanyabalāhakā ghano dhārādharo vāhadamugdharā jalāt
kādambinī meghamālā durdinaṃ meghajaṃ tamaḥ
āsāro vegavānvarṣo vātāstaṃ vāri śīkaraḥ
vṛṣṭyā varṣaṇavarṣe tadvighne grāhagrahāvavāt
ghanopalastu karakaḥ kāṣṭhāśā digdharitkakup
pūrvā prācī dakṣiṇāpācī pratīcī tu paścimā
aparāthottarodīcī vidikcopadiśaṃ pradik
diśyaṃ digbhavavastunyapāgapācīnamudagudīcīnam
prākprācīnaṃ ca same pratyak syātpratīcīnam
tiryagdiśāṃ tu pataya indrāgniyamanairṛtāḥ
varuṇo vāyukuberāvīśānaśca yathākramam
airāvataḥ puṇḍarīko vāmanaḥ kumudo 'ñjanaḥ
puṣpadantaḥ sārvabhaumaḥ supratīkaśca diggajāḥ
indro harirduścyavano 'cyutāgrajo vajrī viḍaujā maghavānpuraṃdaraḥ
prācīnabarhiḥ puruhūtavāsavau saṃkrandanākhaṇḍalameghavāhanāḥ
sutrāmavāstoṣpatidalmiśakrā vṛṣā śunāsīrasahasranetrau
parjanyaharyaśvarbhukṣibāhudanteyavṛddhaśravasas turāṣāṭ
surarṣabhastapastakṣo jiṣṇurvaraśatakratuḥ
kauśikaḥ pūrvadigdevāpsaraḥsvargaśacīpatiḥ
pṛtanāṣāḍugradhanvā marutvānmaghavāsya tu
dviṣaḥ pāko 'drayo vṛtraḥ pulomā namucirbalaḥ
jambhaḥ priyā śacīndrāṇī paulomī jayavāhinī
tanayastu jayantaḥ syājjayadatto jayaśca saḥ
sutā jayantī tavīṣī tāviṣyuccaiḥśravā hayaḥ
mātaliḥ sārathirdevanandī dvāḥstho gajaḥ punaḥ
airāvaṇo 'bhramātaṅgaścaturdanto 'rkasodaraḥ
airāvato hastimallaḥ śvetagajo 'bhramupriyaḥ
vaijayantau tu prāsādadhvajau puryamarāvatī
saro nandīsaraḥ parṣatsudharmā nandanaṃ vanam
vṛkṣaḥ kalpaḥ pārijāto mandāro haricandanaḥ
saṃtānaśca dhanurdevāyudhaṃ tadṛju rohitam
dīrgharjvairāvataṃ vajraṃ tvaśanirhrādinī svaruḥ
śatakoṭiḥ paviḥ śambo dambholirbhiduraṃ bhiduḥ
vyādhāmaḥ kuliśo 'syārciratibhīḥ sphūrjathurdhvaniḥ
svarvaidyāvaśvinīputrāvaśvinau vaḍavāsutau
nāsikyāvarkajau dasrau nāsatyāvabdhijau yamau
viśvakarmā punastvaṣṭā viśvakṛddevavardhakiḥ
svaḥsvargivadhvo 'psarasaḥ svarveśyā urvaśīmukhāḥ
hāhādayastu gandharvā gāndharvā devagāyanāḥ
yamaḥ kṛtāntaḥ pitṛdakṣiṇāśāpretātpatirdaṇḍadharo 'rkasūnuḥ
kīnāśamṛtyū samavartikālau śīrṇāṅgiharyantakadharmarājāḥ
yamarājaḥ śrāddhadevaḥ śamano mahiṣadhvajaḥ
kālindīsodaraścāpi dhūmorṇā tasya vallabhā
purī punaḥ saṃyamanī pratīhārastu vaidhyataḥ
dāsau caṇḍamahācaṇḍau citraguptaśca lekhakaḥ
syādrākṣasaḥ puṇyajano nṛcakṣā yātvāśaraḥ kauṇapayātudhānau
rātriṃcaro rātricaraḥ palādaḥ kīnāśarakṣonikasātmajāśca
kavyāt karburanairṛtāksṛkpo varuṇastvarṇavamandiraḥ pracetāḥ
jalayādaḥpatipāśimeghanādā jalakāntāraḥ syāt paraṃjanaśca
śrīdaḥ sitodarakuheśasakhāḥ piśācakīchāvasus triśira ailabilaikapiṅgāḥ
paulastyavaiśravaṇaratnakarāḥ kuberayakṣau nṛdharmadhanadau naravāhanaśca
kailāsaukā yakṣadhananidhikiṃpuruṣeśvarāḥ
vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ caitrarathaṃ vanaṃ purī prabhā
alakā vasvokasārā suto 'sya nalakūvaraḥ
vittaṃ rikthaṃ svāpateyaṃ rāḥ sāraṃ vibhavo vasu
dyumnaṃ dravyaṃ pṛkthamṛkthaṃ svamṛṇaṃ draviṇaṃ dhanam
hiraṇyārtho nidhānaṃ tu kunābhiḥ śevadhirnidhiḥ
mahāpadmaśca padmaśca śaṅkho makarakacchapau
mukundakundanīlāśca kharvaśca nidhayo nava
yakṣaḥ puṇyajano rājā guhyako vaṭavāsyapi
kiṃnarastu kiṃpuruṣasturaṃgavadano mayuḥ
śaṃbhuḥ śarvaḥ sthāṇurīśāna īśo rudroḍḍīśau vāmadevo vṛṣāṅkaḥ
kaṇṭhekālaḥ śaṃkaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ śrīkaṇṭhograu dhūrjaṭirbhīmabhargau
mṛtyuṃjayaḥ pañcamukho 'ṣṭamūrtiḥ śmaśānaveśmā giriśo girīśaḥ
ṣaṇḍhaḥ kapardīśvara ūrdhvaliṅga ekatridṛgbhāladṛgekapādaḥ
mṛḍo 'ṭṭahāsī ghanavāhano 'hirbudhno virūpākṣaviṣāntakau ca
mahāvratī vahnihiraṇyaretāḥ śivo 'sthidhanvā puruṣāsthimālī
syādvyomakeśaḥ śipiviṣṭabhairavau dikkṛttivāsā bhavanīlalohitau
sarvajñanāṭyapriyakhaṇḍapaśavo mahāparā devanaṭeśvarā haraḥ
paśupramathabhūtomāpatiḥ piṅgajaṭekṣaṇaḥ
pinākaśūlakhaṭvāṅgagaṅgāhīndukapālabhṛt
gajapūṣapurānaṅgakālāndhakamakhāsuhṛt
kapardo 'sya jaṭājūṭaḥ khaṭvāṅgastu sukhaṃsuṇaḥ
pinākaṃ syādājagavamajakāvaṃ ca taddhanuḥ
brāhmyādyā mātaraḥ sapta pramathāḥ pārṣadā gaṇāḥ
laghimā vaśiteśitvaṃ prākāmyaṃ mahimāṇimā
yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ prāptiraiśvaryamaṣṭadhā
gaurī kālī pārvatī mātṛmātāparṇā rudrāṇyambikā tryambakomā
durgā caṇḍī siṃhayānā mṛḍānīkātyāyanyau dakṣajāryā kumārī
satī śivā mahādevī śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā
bhavānī kṛṣṇamainākasvasā menādrijeśvarā
niśumbhaśumbhamahiṣamardinī bhūtanāyikā
tasyāḥ siṃho manastātnaḥ sakhyau tu vijayā jayā
cāmuṇḍā carcikā carmamuṇḍā mārjārakarṇikā
karṇamoṭī mahāgandhā bhairavī ca kapālinī
herambo gaṇavighneśaḥ parśupāṇirvināyakaḥ
dvaimāturo gajāsyaikadantau lambodarākhugau
skandaḥ svāmī mahāsenaḥ senānīḥ śikhivāhanaḥ
ṣāṇmāturo brahmacārī gaṅgomākṛttikāsutaḥ
dvādaśākṣo mahātejāḥ kumāraḥ ṣaṇmukho guhaḥ
viśākhaḥ śaktibhṛtkrauñcatārakāriḥ śarāgnibhūḥ
bhṛṅgī bhṛṅgiriṭir bhṛṅgirīṭir nāḍyasthivigrahaḥ
kuṣmāṇḍake kelikilo nandīśe taṇḍunandinau
druhiṇo viriñcirdrughaṇo viriñcaḥ parameṣṭhyajo 'ṣṭaśravaṇaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ
kamanaḥ kaviḥ sāttvikavedagarbhau sthaviraḥ śatānandapitāmahau kaḥ
dhātā vidhātā vidhivedhasau dhruvaḥ purāṇago haṃsagaviśvaretasau
prajāpatirbrahmacaturmukhau bhavāntakṛjjagatkartṛsaroruhāsanau
śaṃbhuḥ śatadhṛtiḥ sraṣṭā surajyeṣṭho viriñcanaḥ
hiraṇyagarbho lokeśo nābhipadmātmabhūrapi
viṣṇurjiṣṇujanārdanau harihṛṣīkeśācyutāḥ keśavo dāśārhaḥ puruṣottamo 'bdhiśayanopendrāvajendrānujau
viṣvaksenanarāyaṇau jalaśayo nārāyaṇaḥ śrīpatidaityāriśca purāṇayajñapuruṣastārkṣyadhvajo 'dhokṣajaḥ
govindaṣaḍbindumukundakṛṣṇā vaikuṇṭhapadmeśayapadmanābhāḥ
vṛṣākapirmādhavavāsudevau viśvaṃbharaḥ śrīdharaviśvarūpau
dāmodaraḥ śaurisanātanau vibhuḥ pītāmbaro mārjajinau kumodakaḥ
trivikramo jahnucaturbhujau punarvasuḥ śatāvartagadāgrajau svabhūḥ
muñjakeśivanamālipuṇḍarīkākṣababhruśaśabinduvedhasaḥ
pṛśniśṛṅgadharaṇīdharātmabhūḥ pāṇḍavāyanasuvarṇabindavaḥ
śrīvatso devakīsūnur gopendro viṣṭaraśravāḥ
somasindhurjagannātho govardhanadharo 'pi ca
yadunātho gadāśārṅgacakraśrīvatsaśaṅkhabhṛt
madhudhenukacāṇūrapūtanāyamalārjunāḥ
kālanemihayagrīvaśakaṭāriṣṭakaiṭabhāḥ
kaṃsaḥ keśimurau sālvamaindadvividarāhavaḥ
hiraṇyakaśipurvāṇaḥ kāliyo narako baliḥ
śiśupālaścāsya vadhyā vainateyastu vāhanam
śaṅkho 'sya pāñcajanyo 'ṅkaḥ śrīvatso 'sistu nandakaḥ
gadā kaumodakī cāpaṃ śārṅgaṃ cakraṃ sudarśanaḥ
maṇiḥ syamantako haste bhujamadhye tu kaustubhaḥ
vasudevo bhūkaśyapo dundurānakadundubhiḥ
rāmo halī musalisāttvatakāmapālāḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ priyamadhurbalarauhiṇeyau
baladevo balabhadro nīlavastro 'cyutāgrajaḥ
musalaṃ tvasya saunandaṃ halaṃ saṃvartakāhvayam
lakṣmīḥ padmā ramā yā mā tā sā śrīḥ kamalendirā
haripriyā padmavāsā kṣīrodatanayāpi ca
madano jarābhīruranaṅgamanmathau kamanaḥ kalākelirananyajo 'ṅgajaḥ
madhudīpamārau madhusārathiḥ smaro viṣamāyudho darpakakāmahṛcchayāḥ
pradyumnaḥ śrīnandanaśca kaṃdarpaḥ puṣpaketanaḥ
puṣpāṇyasyeṣucāpāstrāṇyarī śambaraśūrpakau
ketanaṃ mīnamakarau bāṇāḥ pañca ratiḥ priyā
manaḥśṛṅgārasaṃkalpātmāno yoniḥ suhṛnmadhuḥ
suto 'niruddho jhaṣāṅka uṣeśo brahmasūśca saḥ
garuḍaḥ śālmalyaruṇāvarajo viṣṇuvāhanaḥ
sauparṇeyo vainateyaḥ suparṇasarpārātir vajrajidvajratuṇḍaḥ
pakṣisvāmī kāśyapiḥ svarṇakāyastārkṣyaḥ kāmāyurgarutmānsudhāhṛt
buddhastu sugato dharmadhātustrikālavijjinaḥ
bodhisattvo mahābodhirāryaḥ śāstā tathāgataḥ
pañcajñānaḥ ṣaḍabhijño daśārho daśabhūmigaḥ
catustriṃśajjātakajño daśapāramitādharaḥ
dvādaśākṣo daśabalastrikāyaḥ śrīghanādvayau
samantabhadraḥ saṃgupto dayākūrco vināyakaḥ
māralokakhajiddharmarājo vijñānamātṛkaḥ
mahāmaitro munīndraśca buddhāḥ syuḥ sapta te tvamī
vipaśyī śikhī viśvabhūḥ kakucchandaśca kāñcanaḥ
kāśyapaśca saptamastu śākyasiṃho 'rkabāndhavaḥ
tathā rāhulasūḥ sarvārthasiddho gautamānvayaḥ
māyāśuddhodanasuto devadattāprajaśca saḥ
asurā ditidanujāḥ pātālaukaḥsurārayaḥ
pūrvadevāḥ śukraśiṣyā vidyādevyastu ṣoḍaśa
rohiṇī prajñaptī vajraśṛṅkhalā kuliśāṅkuśā
cakreśvarī naradattā kālyathāsau mahāparā
gaurī gāndhārī sarvāstramahājvālā ca mānavī
vairoṭyāchuptā mānasī mahāmānasiketi tāḥ
vāgbrāhmī bhāratī gaur gīrvāṇī bhāṣā sarasvatī
śrutadevī vacanaṃ tu vyāhāro bhāṣitaṃ vacaḥ
saviśeṣaṇamākhyātaṃ vākyaṃ syādyantakaṃ padam
rāddhasiddhakutebhyo 'nte āptoktiḥ samayāgamau
ācārāṅgaṃ sūtrakṛtaṃ sthānāṅgaṃ samavāyayuk
pañcamaṃ bhagavatyaṅgaṃ jñātadharmakathāpi ca
upāsakāntakṛdanuttaropapātakāddaśāḥ
praśnavyākaraṇaṃ caiva vipākaśrutameva ca
ityekādaśa sopāṅgānyaṅgāni dvādaśa punaḥ
dṛṣṭivādo dvādaśāṅgī syādgaṇipiṭakāhvayā
parikarmasūtrapūrvānuyogaparvagatacūlikāḥ pañca
syurdṛṣṭivādabhedāḥ pūrvāṇi caturdaśāpi pūrvagate
utpādapūrvamagrāyaṇīyamatha vīryataḥ pravādaṃ syāt
asterjñānātsatyāttadātmanaḥ karmaṇaśca param
pratyākhyānaṃ vidyāpravādakalyāṇanāmadheye ca
prāṇāvāyaṃ ca kriyāviśālamatha lokabindusāramiti
svādhyāyaḥ śrutirāmnāyaśchando vedastrayī punaḥ
ṛgyajuḥsāmavedāḥ syuratharvā tu taduddhṛtiḥ
vedāntaḥ syādupaniṣadoṅkārapraṇavau samau
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ chando jyotirniruktayaḥ
ṣaḍaṅgāni dharmaśāstraṃ syātsmṛtirdharmasaṃhitā
ānvīkṣikī tarkavidyā mīmāṃsā tu vicāraṇā
sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca
vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam
ṣaḍaṅgā vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsānvīkṣikī tathā
dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇaṃ ca vidyā etāścaturdaśa
sūtraṃ sūcanakṛdbhāṣyaṃ sūtroktārthaprapañcakam
prastāvastu prakaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ padabhañjanam
avāntaraprakaraṇaviśrāme śīghrapāṭhataḥ
āhnikamadhikaraṇaṃ tvekanyāyopapādanam
uktānuktaduruktārthacintākāri tu vārttikam
ṭīkā nirantaravyākhyā pañjikā padabhañjikā
nibandhavṛttī anvarthe saṃgrahastu samāhṛtiḥ
pariśiṣṭapaddhatyādīn pathānena samunnayet
kārikā tu svalpavṛttau bahorarthasya sūcanī
kalindikā sarvavidyā nighaṇṭurnāmasaṃgrahaḥ
itihāsaḥ purāvṛttaṃ prabahlikā prahelikā
janaśrutiḥ kiṃvadantī vārtaitihyaṃ purātanī
vārtā pravṛttirvṛttānta udanto 'thāhvayo 'bhidhā
gotrasaṃjñānāmadheyākhyāhvābhikhyāśca nāma ca
saṃbodhanamāmantraṇamāhvānaṃ tvabhimantraṇam
ākāraṇaṃ havo hūtiḥ saṃhūtirbahubhiḥ kṛtā
udāhāra upodghāta upanyāsaśca vāṅmukham
vyavahāro vivādaḥ syācchapathaḥ śapanaṃ śapaḥ
uttaraṃ tu prativacaḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchānuyojanam
kathaṃkathikatā cātha devapraśna upaśrutiḥ
caṭu cāṭu priyaprāyaṃ priyasatyaṃ tu sūnṛtam
satyaṃ samyaksamīcīnamṛtaṃ tathyaṃ yathātatham
yathāsthitaṃ ca sadbhūte 'līke tu vitathānṛte
atha kliṣṭaṃ saṃkulaṃ ca parasparaparāhatam
sāntvaṃ sumadhuraṃ grāmyamaślīlaṃ mliṣṭamasphuṭam
luptavarṇapadaṃ grastamavācyaṃ syādanakṣaram
ambūkṛtaṃ sathūtkāraṃ nirastaṃ tvarayoditam
āmreḍitaṃ dvistriruktamabaddhaṃ tu nirarthakam
pṛṣṭhamāṃsādanaṃ tadyatparokṣe doṣakīrtanam
mithyābhiyogo 'bhyākhyānaṃ saṃgataṃ hṛdayaṃgamam
paruṣaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ rūkṣaṃ vikruṣṭamatha ghoṣaṇā
uccairghuṣṭaṃ varṇaneḍā stavaḥ stotraṃ stutirnutiḥ
ślāghā praśaṃsārthavādaḥ sā tu mithyā vikatthanam
janapravādaḥ kaulīnaṃ vigānaṃ vacanīyatā
syādavarṇa upakrośo vādo niḥparyapāt paraḥ
garhaṇā dhikkriyā nindā kutsākṣepo jugupsanam
ākrośābhīṣaṅgākṣepāḥ śāpaḥ sa kṣāraṇā rate
viruddhaśaṃsanaṃ gālir āśīrmaṅgalaśaṃsanam
ślokaḥ kīrtiryaśo 'bhikhyā samājñā ruśatī punaḥ
aśubhā vākśubhā kalyā carcarī carbhaṭī same
yaḥ saninda upālambhastatra syātparibhāṣaṇam
āpṛcchālāpaḥ saṃbhāṣo 'nulāpaḥ syānmuhurvacaḥ
anarthakaṃ tu pralāpo vilāpaḥ paridevanam
ullāpaḥ kākuvāg anyonyoktiḥ saṃlāpasaṃkathe
vipralāpo viruddhoktirapalāpastu nihnavaḥ
supralāpaḥ suvacanaṃ saṃdeśavāktu vācikam
ājñā śiṣṭir nirāṅnibhyo deśo niyogaśāsane
avavādo 'pyathāhūya preṣaṇaṃ pratiśāsanam
saṃvitsaṃdhāsthābhyupāyaḥ saṃpratyāṅbhyaḥ paraḥ śravaḥ
aṅgīkāro 'bhyupagamaḥ pratijñāgūśca saṃgaraḥ
gītanṛttavādyatrayaṃ nāṭyaṃ tauryatrikaṃ ca tat
saṃgītaṃ prekṣaṇārthe 'smiñśāstrokte nāṭyadharmikā
gītaṃ gānaṃ geyaṃ gītirgāndharvamatha nartanam
naṭanaṃ nṛtyaṃ nṛttaṃ ca lāsyaṃ nāṭyaṃ ca tāṇḍavam
maṇḍalena tu yannṛtyaṃ strīṇāṃ hallīsakaṃ tu tat
pānagoṣṭhyāmuccatālaṃ raṇe vīrajayantikā
sthānaṃ nāṭyasya raṅgaḥ syātpūrvaraṅga upakramaḥ
aṅgahāro 'ṅgavikṣepo vyañjako 'bhinayaḥ samau
sa caturvidha āhāryo racito bhūṣaṇādinā
vacasā vāciko 'ṅgenāṅgikaḥ sattvena sāttvikaḥ
syānnāṭakaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhāṇaḥ prahasanaṃ ḍimaḥ
vyāyogaḥ samavākāro vithyaṅkehāmṛgā iti
abhineyaprakārāḥ syurbhāṣāḥ ṣaṭsaṃskṛtādikāḥ
bhāratī sāttvatī kaiśikyārabhaṭyau ca vṛttayaḥ
vādyaṃ vāditramātodyaṃ tūryaṃ tūraṃ smaradhvajaḥ
tataṃ vīṇāprabhṛtikaṃ tālaprabhṛtikaṃ ghanam
vaṃśādikaṃ tu śuṣiramānaddhaṃ murajādikam
vīṇā punarghoṣavatī vipañcī kaṇṭhakūṇikā
vallakī sātha tantrībhiḥ saptabhiḥ parivādinī
śivasya vīṇā nālambī sarasvatyāstu kacchapī
nāradasya tu mahatī gaṇānāṃ tu prabhāvatī
viśvāvasostu bṛhatī tumbarostu kalāvatī
cāṇḍālānāṃ tu kaṇḍolavīṇā cāṇḍālikā ca sā
kāyaḥ kolambakastasyā upanāho nibandhanam
daṇḍaḥ punaḥ pravālaḥ syātkakubhastu prasevakaḥ
mūle vaṃśaśalākā syātkalikā kūṇikāpi ca
kālasya kriyayā mānaṃ tālaḥ sāmyaṃ punarlayaḥ
drutaṃ vilambitaṃ madhyamoghastattvaṃ ghanaṃ kramāt
mṛdaṅgo murajaḥ soṅkyāliṅgyūrdhvaka iti tridhā
syādyaśaḥpaṭaho ḍhakkā bherī dundubhirānakaḥ
paṭaho 'tha śārikā syātkoṇo vīṇādivādanam
śṛṅgārahāsyakaruṇāraudravīrabhayānakāḥ
bībhatsādbhutaśāntāśca rasā bhāvāḥ punastridhā
sthāyisāttvikasaṃcāriprabhedaiḥ syādratiḥ punaḥ
rāgo'nurāgo 'nuratirhāsastu hasanaṃ hasaḥ
ghargharo hāsikā hāsyaṃ tatrādṛṣṭarade smitam
vakroṣṭikātha hasitaṃ kiṃciddṛṣṭaradāṅkure
kiṃcicchrute vihasitamaṭṭahāso mahīyasi
atihāsastvanusyūte 'pahāso 'kāraṇātkṛte
sotprāse tvāchuritakaṃ hasanaṃ sphuradoṣṭhake
śokaḥ śukśocanaṃ khedaḥ krodho manyuḥ krudhā ruṣā
krutkopaḥ pratigho roṣo ruṭ cotsāhaḥ pragalbhatā
abhiyogodyamau prauḍhirudyogaḥ kiyadetikā
adhyavasāya ūrjo 'tha vīryaṃ so 'tiśayānvitaḥ
bhayaṃ bhīrbhītirātaṅka āśaṅkā sādhvasaṃ daraḥ
bhiyā ca taccāhibhayaṃ bhūpatīnāṃ svapakṣajam
adṛṣṭaṃ vahnitoyāderdṛṣṭaṃ svaparacakrajam
bhayaṃkaraṃ pratibhayaṃ bhīmaṃ bhīṣmaṃ bhayānakam
bhīṣaṇaṃ bhairavaṃ ghoraṃ dāruṇaṃ ca bhayāvaham
jugupsā tu ghṛṇātha syādvismayaścitramadbhutam
codyāścarye śamaḥ śāntiḥ śamathopaśamāvapi
tṛṣṇākṣayaḥ sthāyino 'mī rasānāṃ kāraṇaṃ kramāt
stambho jāḍyaṃ svedo gharmanidāghau pulakaḥ punaḥ
romāñcaḥ kaṇṭako romavikāro romaharṣaṇam
romodgama uddhuṣaṇam ullukasanamityapi
svarabhedastu kallatvaṃ svare kampastu vepathuḥ
vaivarṇyaṃ kālikāthāśru bāṣpo netrāmbu rodanam
asramasru pralayastvaceṣṭatetyaṣṭa sāttvikāḥ
dhṛtiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ svāsthyaṃ syādādhyānaṃ smaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ
matirmanīṣā buddhirdhīrdhiṣaṇājñapticetanāḥ
pratibhāpratipatprajñāprekṣācidupalabdhayaḥ
saṃvittiḥ śemuṣī dṛṣṭiḥ sā medhā dhāraṇakṣamā
paṇḍā tattvānugā mokṣe jñānaṃ vijñānamanyataḥ
śuśrūṣā śravaṇaṃ caiva grahaṇaṃ dhāraṇaṃ tathā
ūhāpoho 'rthavijñānaṃ tattvajñānaṃ ca dhīguṇāḥ
vrīḍā lajjā mandākṣaṃ hrīstrapā sāpatrapānyataḥ
jāḍyaṃ maurkhyaṃ viṣādo 'vasādaḥ sādo viṣaṇṇatā
mado munmohasaṃbhedo vyādhistvādhī rujākaraḥ
nidrā pramīlā śayanaṃ saṃveśasvāpasaṃlayāḥ
nandīmukhī śvāsahetistandrā suptaṃ tu sādhikā
autsukyaṃ raṇaraṇakotkaṇṭhe āyallakāratī
hṛllekhotkalike cāthāvahitthākāragopanam
śaṅkāniṣṭhotprekṣaṇaṃ syāccāpalaṃ tvanavasthitiḥ
ālasyaṃ tandrā kausīdyaṃ harṣaścittaprasannatā
hlādaḥ pramodaḥ pramado mutprītyāmodasaṃmadāḥ
ānandānandathū garvastvahaṃkāro 'vilaptatā
darpo 'bhimāno mamatā mānaścittonnatiḥ smayaḥ
sā mitho 'hamahamikā yā tu saṃbhāvanātmani
darpātsāhopuruṣikā syādahaṃpūrvikā punaḥ
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamityugratvaṃ tu caṇḍatā
prabodhastu vinidratvaṃ glānistu baladīnatā
dainyaṃ kārpaṇyaṃ śramastu klamaḥ kleśaḥ pariśramaḥ
prayāsāyāsavyāyāmā unmādaścittaviplavaḥ
moho mauḍhyaṃ cintā dhyānamamarṣaḥ krodhasaṃbhavaḥ
guṇo jigīṣotsāhavāṃstrāsastvākasmikaṃ bhayam
apasmāraḥ syādāveśo nirvedaḥ svāvamānanam
āvegastu tvaristūrṇiḥ saṃvegaḥ saṃbhramastvarā
vitarkaḥ syādunnayanaṃ parāmarśo vimarśanam
adhyāhārastarka ūho 'sūyānyaguṇadūṣaṇam
mṛtiḥ saṃsthā mṛtyukālau paralokagamo 'tyayaḥ
pañcatvaṃ nidhanaṃ nāśo dīrghanidrā nimīlanam
diṣṭānto 'staṃ kāladharmo 'vasānaṃ sā tu sarvagā
marako māristrayastriṃśadamī syurvyabhicāriṇaḥ
syuḥ kāraṇāni kāryāṇi sahacārīṇi yāni ca
ratyādeḥ sthāyino loke tāni cennāṭyakāvyayoḥ
vibhāvā anubhāvāśca vyabhicāriṇa eva ca
vyaktaḥ sa tairvibhāvādyaiḥ sthāyī bhāvo bhavedrasaḥ
pātrāṇi nāṭye 'dhikṛtāstattadveṣastu bhūmikā
śailūṣo bharataḥ sarvakeśī bharataputrakaḥ
dhātrīputro raṅgājāyājīvo raṅgāvatārakaḥ
naṭaḥ kṛśāśvī śailālī cāraṇastu kuśīlavaḥ
bhrabhrubhrūbhṛparaḥ kuṃso naṭaḥ strīveṣadhārakaḥ
veśyācāryaḥ pīṭhamardaḥ sūtradhārastu sūcakaḥ
nandī tu pāṭhako nāndyāḥ pārśvasthaḥ pāripārśvikaḥ
vāsantikaḥ kelikilo vaihāsiko vidūṣakaḥ
prahāsī prītidaścātha ṣiṅgaḥ pallavako viṭaḥ
pitā tvāvuka āvuttabhāvukau bhaginīpatau
bhāvo vidvānyuvarājaḥ kumāro bhartṛdārakaḥ
bālā vāsūrmārṣa āryo devo bhaṭṭārako nṛpaḥ
rāṣṭrīyo nṛpateḥ śyālo duhitā bhartṛdārikā
devī kṛtābhiṣekānyā bhaṭṭinī gaṇikājjukā
nīcāceṭīsakhīhūtau haṇḍehañjehalāḥ kramāt
abrahmaṇyam avadhyoktau jyāyasī tu svasāttikā
bhartāryaputro mātāmbā bhadantāḥ saugatādayaḥ
pūjye tatrabhavānatrabhavāṃśca bhagavānapi
pādā bhaṭṭārako devaḥ prayojyāḥ pūjyanāmataḥ
martyaḥ pañcajano bhūspṛkpuruṣaḥ pūruṣo naraḥ
mānuṣo nā viṭ manujo mānavaḥ pumān
bālaḥ pākaḥ śiśurḍimbhaḥ potaḥ śāvaḥ stanaṃdhayaḥ
pṛthukārbhottānaśayāḥ kṣīrakaṇṭhaḥ kumārakaḥ
śiśutvaṃ śaiśavaṃ bālyaṃ vayasthastaruṇo yuvā
tāruṇyaṃ yauvanaṃ vṛddhaḥ pravayāḥ sthaviro jaran
jarī jīrṇo yātayāmo jīno 'tha visrasā jarā
vārdhakaṃ sthāviraṃ jyāyānvarṣīyāndaśamītyapi
vidvānsudhīḥ kavivicakṣaṇalabdhavarṇā jñaḥ prāptarūpakṛtikṛṣṭyabhirūpadhīrāḥ
medhāvikovidaviśāradasūridoṣajñāḥ prājñapaṇḍitamanīṣibudhaprabuddhāḥ
vyakto vipaścitsaṃkhyāvānsanpravīṇe tu śikṣitaḥ
niṣṇāto nipuṇo dakṣaḥ karmahastamukhāḥ kṛtāt
kuśalaścaturo 'bhijñavijñavaijñānikāḥ paṭuḥ
cheko vidagdhe prauḍhastu pragalbhaḥ pratibhāmukhaḥ
kuśāgrīyamatiḥ sūkṣmadarśī tatkāladhīḥ punaḥ
pratyutpannamatirdūrādyaḥ paśyeddīrghadarśyasau
hṛdayāluḥ sahṛdayaścidrūpo 'pyatha saṃskṛte
vyutpannaprahatakṣuṇṇā antarvāṇistu śāstravit
vāgīśo vākpatau vāgmī vācoyuktipaṭuḥ pravāk
samukho vāvadūko 'tha vado vaktā vadāvadaḥ
syājjalpākastu vācālo vācāṭo bahugarhyavāk
yadvado 'nuttare durvākadvade syādathādharaḥ
hīnavādiny eḍamūkāneḍamūkau tv avākśrutau
ravaṇaḥ śabdanastulyau kuvādakucarau samau
ambhodhiḥ sthalatāṃ sthalaṃ jaladhitāṃ dhūler lavaṃ śailatām
śailo mṛtkaṇatāṃ tṛṇaṃ dahanatāṃ vajraṃ tṛṇakṣīṇatām
vahniḥ śītalatāṃ himaṃ dahanatām āyāti yasyecchayā
līlānāṭyakṛte bhuvo bhagavate kṛṣṇāya tubhyaṃ namaḥ
abhinavajaladaśyāmaṃ pītadukūlaṃ videhajārāmam
vilasitakaustubhadāmaṃ maṅgalamūrtiṃ bhaje rāmam
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇām ārogyaṃ mūlam ucyate
ataḥ pravṛttir ucitā śāstre sadvaidyasaṃmataiḥ
mādyantaṃ suvicārya mādhavakaraṃ samyakcikitsārṇavam
pathyāpathyam atho vipākam akhilaṃ tāvan nṛṇāṃ karmaṇaḥ
sāṅgatvena mahārṇavādividitāṃ tanniṣkriyāṃ sāmpratam
bhūyastvādibhayena nūtanataraś cintāmaṇiḥ procyate
sadyollasan mādhavalakṣaṇānāṃ kramaṃ vihāyāśu vibodhanārtham
gadasya sāmānyaviśeṣatattvair yuktāni kurve kati lakṣaṇāni
śabdārthāvagame bhajanti sakalā devā sadā mūkatāṃ manye kiṃtu viśanti pāram paraṃ duṣpāraśāstrāmbudheḥ
kartuṃ yady api śakyate laghutayā sāraś cikitsārṇavo doṣo jātu bhaviṣyatīti manasā nyūnādhiko na kṛtaḥ
cintāmaṇeḥ prathamataḥ kiraṇaiś caturbhiḥ dravyasya mānam akhilasya rasasya śuddhiḥ
kālāditattvakathanaṃ tv atha nāḍikādes tattvaṃ tato 'nyakiraṇair upacāraṇāya
śāstreṣu śramavān kriyāsu kuśalaḥ prājñaḥ sudhīḥ satyavāk dhīro roganirūpaṇaikakuśalaḥ pīyūṣahastaḥ śuciḥ
dravyāṇāṃ rasavīryakāryam akhilaṃ jñātā dayāluḥ sadā nirṇetā ṛtukāladeśavayasāṃ mātrādhikārī bhiṣak
rasavaidyo bhaved daivo mānuṣo mūlakādibhiḥ
āsuraḥ śastradāhāḍhyaḥ siddhavaidyas tu māntrikaḥ
adhamā mūlikākhyātāḥ kvāthakhyātāś ca madhyamā
uttamārasam ākhyātās trividho vaidyanirṇaya
padmāṅkuśalasatpādo matsyacāpalasatkaraḥ
raktarekhāṅkuro yas tu sa vaidyo 'mṛtahastakaḥ
ādau vikatthanārakto lubdho guruvivarjitaḥ
kṛṣṇarekhāṅkuro yas tu dagdhahastaḥ sa ucyate
avijñāya tu śāstrārthaṃ prayogaṃ kārayed bhiṣak
yamopamaḥ sa vijñeyo martyānāṃ mṛtyurūpadhṛk
vinā śāstro yo brūyāt tam āhuḥ brahmaghātakaḥ
naro narakapātī syāt tasya sambhāṣaṇād api
na jānāti ca śāstrāṇi lakṣaṇaṃ yo na vidyate
mārayaty āśu jantūnāṃ sa vaidyo yamakiṃkaraḥ
paṅgukubjakuṭilamaṇḍitaśiro nāḍyopakarṇāvadhiḥ
eko netra rujāvabhakṣitatanu kṛṣṭī bhavet ślīpadī
āyurvedahīnā kapilasvarūpā unmattavanitāratāḥ
vaidyaṃ rasam auṣadham anahitaṃ rogī akāle mriyaḥ
vyādhes tattvaparijñānaṃ vedanāyāś ca nigrahaḥ
etad vaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhur āyuṣaḥ
kucelaḥ karkaśo lubdhaḥ kugrāmī svayam āgataḥ
pañca vaidyā na pūjyante dhanvantarisamā yadi
na mānena vinā yuktir dravyāṇāṃ jāyate kvacit
ataḥ prayogasiddhyarthaṃ māgadhaṃ mānam ucyate
jālāntaragatacaṇḍabhānukiraṇair yad vīkṣyate kumārajaḥ
tataḥ prāhus trasareṇu tatra ṣaḍbhir ājāhvayā sarṣapaḥ
syād ebhis tribhir eva toḍitatanu gaurāhvayaḥ sarṣapaḥ ṣaḍbhis taiś ca yavo bhaved atha yavair etais tribhī raktikā
guñjaḥ syāt triyavaiś ca raktiyugalaṃ vallaś ca tatpañcakair māṣomāṣacatuṣṭyam nigaditaṃ śāṇaś ca śānadvayam
kolaṃ draṃkṣaṇakaṃ tathaiva vaṭakaṃ koladvayaṃ karṣakaṃ cākṣaḥ pāṇitalaṃ viḍālapadakaṃ tadvat suvarṇaṃ picuḥ
karṣābhyām api śuktikā nigaditā karṣaiś caturbhiḥ palam bilvaṃ muṣṭir athāpi śuktiyugalaṃ syāt kuñcikā ṣoḍaśī
bilve dve 'pi mānika ca prasṛtaṃ nāmnā caturbhiḥ palaiḥ yuktaḥ syāt kuḍavo 'ñjaliś ca palikāny aṣṭau śarāvo bhavet
tanmānaṃ dharaṇaṃ palasya daśamo bhāgo bhavet yatsthitaṃ vidyāc cāpi śataṃ palāni ca tulā bhāras tulāviṃśatiḥ
prasthaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ palair atha catuḥ prasthaṃ bhaved āḍhakaṃ kaṃsaḥ pātram athāḍhakāni ca punaś catvāri saṃjāyate
droṇoralvaṇavyarmaṇaṃ ca kalaśo droṇadvayaṃ syāt punaḥ sūrpaḥ kumbham ihollikhanti ca catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śarābā śubhāḥ
droṇī droṇacatuṣṭayena tulikā tasyāḥ śarāvāḥ śatam aṣṭaviṃśatisaṃyutaṃ ca bharikā syur mānasaṃpratyaye
māṣaḥ śāṇapicuḥ palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prasthas tathā cāḍhako droṇo goṇyapitāś caturguṇatayā nirdhāritāḥ syuḥ kramāt
yavaḥ syāt sarṣapaiḥ ṣaḍbhir guñjā tu syāt tribhir yavaiḥ
guñjābhiḥ pañcabhiś caikamāṣakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
bhavet ṣoḍaśabhir māṣaiḥ suvarṇas tat punaḥ smṛtaḥ
caturbhiḥ palam etasya daśamo dharaṇo viduḥ
daśapalāni dharaṇaṃ catvāri suvarṇāni niṣkaḥ
śuṣkaṃ navīnaṃ sakaleṣu yojyam dravyaṃ tathārdraṃ dviguṇaṃ prayojyam
śuṣkasya tāvad guru tīkṣṇasattvāt tadarddhabhāgaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ
guñjādimānam ārabhya yāvat syāt kuḍavasthitiḥ
dravārdraśuṣkadravyāṇāṃ tāvanmānaṃ samaṃ matam
prasthādimānam ārabhya dviguṇaṃ tad dravārdrayoḥ
kuḍave 'pi kvacid dvitvaṃ yathādantīghṛtaṃ smṛtam
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prasthaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ ca tato viduḥ
dviguṇaṃ svarasārdrāṇāṃ tailakṣīraguḍābhasām
kiñca lājāpāyasanārikelasalilaṃ mūtraṃ jalaṃ kāñjikam
dvātriṃśatpalakaṃ tadarddham uditaṃ prasthaṃ rasaṃ cauṣadham
kṣaudraṃ tailaghṛte ca viṃśatipalaṃ kṣīrasya triṃśatpalam
dadhnaḥ pañcakapañcakaṃ guḍapalaṃ saptadaśaḥ procyate
kecid dvādaśabhiḥ prāhuḥ palair lohamṛdaśmanām
kṣārapāradakastūrīśaśikāśmīrajanmanām
eteṣu prasthabhedeṣu palaṃ ṣoḍaśaniṣkakam
mūlatvak dārupattrāṇāṃ puṣpasya ca phalasya ca
śilālavaṇamṛlloṣṭralauhāṇāṃ gomayasya ca
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prasthaṃ lākṣā karpūragugguluḥ
ekaviṃśapalaṃ prastham iti prasthasya lakṣaṇam
navāny anyāni yojyāni dravyāṇy akhilakarmasu
vinā viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ guḍadhānyājyamakṣikaiḥ guḍūcī kuṭajo vāsā kuṣmāṇḍaś ca śatāvarī
aśvagandhā sahacarau śatapuṣpī prasāriṇī
prayoktavyā sadaivārdrā dviguṇā naiva kārayet
vāsā nimbapaṭolaketakībalā kuṣmāṇḍakendīvarī varṣābhūkuṭajāśvagandhasahitās tāḥ pūtigandhāmṛtāḥ
māṃsaṃ nāgabalā sahacarapūgahiṅgvārdrake nityaśo grāhyas tat pala eva na dviguṇitāṃ ye cekṣujātāghanāḥ
ekasya cauṣadher yogo yat tatra punar ucyate
mānato dviguṇaṃ proktaṃ taddravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ
dravyābhāve dravyam anyad dviguṇaṃ vihitaṃ hitam
yogayuktaṃ yadā prāpyaṃ yuktitulyaṃ ca nikṣipet
mahatāṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ mūlavalkaṃ pradāpayet
latikā hrasvavṛkṣāṇāṃ sarvāṅgaṃ parikalpayet
sāras tu khadirādīnāṃ nimbādīnāṃ tvacaṃ tathā
phalaṃ tu dāḍimādīnāṃ paṭolādeś chadas tathā
madhvabhāve jīrṇaguḍaḥ kṣīrābhāve ca mudgakaḥ
sitābhāve bhavet khaṇḍaḥ śālyabhāve ca ṣaṣṭikam
suvarṇasyāpi raupyasyābhāve lauhena kalpayet
drākṣābhāve tu kāśmīryaṃ vṛkṣāmlaṃ dāḍime 'sati
drave 'py anukte jalam atra deyaṃ kāle 'py anukte divasasya pūrvam
bhāge 'py anukte samatā vidhānam 'ṅge 'py anukte vihitaṃ tu mūlam
cūrṇe snehe tathā lehe prāyaś candanāni ca
kaṣāye lepane prāyo yujyate raktacandanam
lavaṇe saindhavaṃ dadyān mūtre gomūtram iṣyate
payaḥ sarpiprayogeṣu gavyam eva vidhīyate
pātre 'nukte ca mṛtpātraṃ snehe 'nukte tilodbhavam
viśeṣo yatra noktaḥ syād eṣas tatra vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
anirdiṣṭaḥ pramāṇānāṃ pramāṇam idam īritam
karṣādau tu palaṃ yāvad dadyāt ṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam
tatas tu kuḍavo yāvat toyam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet
caturguṇaparaś cordhvaṃ yāvat prasthādikaṃ jalam
mṛdau caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ kaṭhine 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet
tato 'tikaṭhine śastaṃ deyaṃ ṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam
draveṇa yāvad vā dravyam ekībhūyārdratāṃ vrajet
tāvatpramāṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhiṣagbhir bhāvanāvidhau
śuṣkadravyam upādāya svarasānām asaṃbhave
jale 'ṣṭaguṇite sādhyaṃ pādaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhyate
vālmīkasikatānūpaśmaśānakharamārgajāḥ
jantuvahnihimavyāptā nauṣadhyaḥ kāryasādhikāḥ
vālmīkakūparathyātarutaladevālayaśmaśāneṣu
jātā vidhināpihṛtā auṣadhyaḥ siddhidā na syuḥ
jalajīrṇām agnikavalitam akālarūkṣakṛmi ca śarīram
nyūnaṃ samadhikaṃ dravyaṃ na siddhidam iti jalpur bhiṣajaḥ
phalapatrādikaṃ varṣaṃ dārukāṇḍau dvivarṣakau
mūlaṃ trivarṣaṃ bījaṃ tu syāt saṃvatsarapañcakam
niryāso daśamaṃ varṣaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ na praśasyate
lehaṃ pāṇiṃ talaṃ tathaiva guṭikā cākṣapramāṇaṃ rajaḥ
mārjārasya padaṃ vadanti munayo mudgapramāṇāñjanam
toyaṃ binducatuṣṭayaṃ nayanayoḥ ṣaḍbindavo nāsikā
randhre pūrṇatamaṃ ca karṇayugale gaṇḍūṣamāsye rasaḥ
karṣapramāṇaṃ kalkaṃ syād guñjāmātraṃ rasauṣadham
kaṣāyaḥ palaṃmātraṃ syād iti bhojamatam viduḥ
yāmaṃ kalkaṃ kaṣāyavīryam akhilaṃ cūrṇaṃ ca pakṣatrayaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ ghṛtalehayo sapurayor māsatrayaṃ modakaḥ
siddhānāṃ rasabhasmanāṃ suvipulaṃ vīryaṃ ca varṣatrayaṃ kiṃcid gandhavivarjitaṃ guṇakaraṃ tailaṃ purāṇaṃ mahat
kvāthaś ca kalkaś ca rasaś ca yāmaṃ yāmatrayaṃ modakavarticūrṇam
ṣaṇmāsalehyaṃ ghṛtaguggulubhyām abdāt paraṃ tailakṛtaṃ ca vīryam
śītaṃ jalaṃ jīryati yāmamātre yāmārdhake jīryati taptatoyam
kalkaś ca cūrṇaṃ ca ghaṭī tṛtīye kaṣāyakaṃ jīryati yāmamātre
yāmadvaye tu svarasā vasāś ca jīryanti te saptaghaṭīṣu sadyaḥ
jīryanti lehyāny api pañcaghaṭyāṃ yāmatraye jīryati dugdhajātam
yāmadvaye jīryati vā ghṛtānnaṃ piṣṭaṃ tathā jīryati pañcayāme
sārddhe triyāmā dadhi śuktam annaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā jīryati tāvad eva
annaṃ tadā jīryati pañcarātre kṣīraṃ tathā saptaniśīthinīṣu
khanetrarātrau dadhi jīrṇamāse māsārdhike jīryati dugdhasāram
ghṛtaṃ gate māsi sujīrṇam āste māsadvaye jīryati māṃsam eva ca
ajīrṇabhāvaprabhavāmayeṣu hitāhitaṃ tatra vicāraṇīyam
dvibhāgaṃ pūrayed annaṃ toyaṃ bhāgaṃ prapūrayet
pavanapracalārthāya śeṣabhāgaṃ parityajet
yāmamadhyena bhoktavyaṃ yāmayugmaṃ na laghayet
yāmamadhye rasotpattir yāmayugmāt balakṣayaḥ
athātaḥ svarasaḥ kalkaḥ kvāthaś ca himaphāṇṭakau
kaṣāyaḥ pañcadhā proktas tadbhedau yūṣamanthakau
vastraniṣpīḍitaṃ yat tu cūrṇitaṃ dviguṇe jale
ahorātraṃ sthitaṃ vāpi svaraso dvividho mataḥ
sitāmadhuguḍakṣāraṃ jīrakaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca cūrṇādi kolamātraṃ rase kṣipet
dravyam ādyaṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ vā sajalaṃ bhavet
karṣamānena kalkaḥ syān madhvādidviguṇaṃ kṣipet
sitā guḍaṃ samaṃ dadyāt dravād deyāś caturguṇāḥ
pānīye ṣoḍaśapale kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ kṣipet
śṛtaṃ tad dvipalaṃ grāhyaṃ kvātho niryūha ucyate
kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyaṃ palaṃ samyak ṣaḍbhir nīrapalaiḥ plutam
viśoṣitaṃ himaḥ sa syāt tathā śītakaṣāyakaḥ
kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ samyak taptanīre caturguṇe
kṣiptvā niṣpīḍya vastreṇa taddravo pāṇṭha ucyate
kalkadravyapalaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī
vāriprasthe ca vipacet taddravo yūṣa ucyate
jale catuṣpale śīte kṣuṇṇadravyapalaṃ kṣipet
mṛtpātre manthayet samyak mantha ity abhidhīyate
kvāthaṃ caturguṇaṃ vāri kalkam aṣṭaguṇaṃ tathā
kaṣāyaṃ ca daśaguṇaṃ pācanaṃ dvādaśam bhavet
śuṣkaṃ piṣṭaṃ vastrapūtaṃ cūrṇaṃ tat parikīrtitam
karṣamānena taccūrṇaṃ ghṛtādi dviguṇaṃ kṣipet
sikthakai rahito maṇḍaḥ peyā sikthasamanvitā
yavāgū bahusikthā syāt vilepī viraladravā
annaṃ pañcaguṇe sādhyaṃ vilepī tu caturguṇe
maṇḍaś ca caturguṇe yavāgūḥ ṣaḍguṇe 'mbhasi
aṣṭādaśaguṇe toye yūṣaḥ śārṅgadhareritam
palaṃ kaṣāye dravaṃ syāt yavāgvāṃ ca tadardhakam
pānīyeṣu tadarddhaṃ syād iti dravyasya niścayaḥ
kvāthyamānaṃ tu yat toyaṃ niṣphenaṃ nirmalīkṛtam
bhavaty ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca tad uṣṇodakam ucyate
dravyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrāt toyaṃ caturguṇam
kṣīrāvaśeṣakartavyaḥ kṣīrapāke tv ayaṃ vidhiḥ
toyaṃ kṣīraṃ cāṣṭabhāgaṃ madhunā trividhīyate
madhu śeṣe bhaved yāvat tāvat paktvāvatārayet
kāñjikā mānato droṇaṃ śuktenātra vidhīyate
atra śuktavidhau maṇḍaṃ prasthaṃ pañcāḍhako 'nvitam
kāñjikaṃ kuḍavo dadhno guḍaprastho 'mlamūlakāt
palāny aṣṭau śodhitārdrāt palaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ tathā
kaṇājīrakasindhūtthaṃ haridrāmaricaṃ pṛthak
dvipalaṃ bhāvitaṃ bhāṇḍe dhānyenāṣṭadinaṃ sthitam
siddhaṃ bhavati tacchuktaṃ yadāvatarya gṛhyate
cāturjātaṃ tathā deyaṃ pṛthak karṣakriyānvitam
pañcapallavatoyena gandhānāṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā
śoṣaṇaṃ cāpi saṃskāro viśeṣaś cātra kathyate
caturyāmalakāny eva triphalā sā prakīrtitā
māghe harītakī grāhyā phālgune ca vibhītakī
caitre cāmalakī grāhyā triphalā saphalā bhavet
harītakī pañcarasā ca recanī koṣṭhāmayaghnī lavaṇena varjitā
rasāyanī netrarujāpahāriṇī tvagāmayaghnī kila yogavāhinī
unmīlanī buddhibalendriyāṇāṃ vināśinī pittakaphānilānām
saṃjīvanī sarvarasāyanānāṃ somo yathā sarvavanaspatīnām
bhukte pathyābhukte pathyā bhuktābhukte pathyāpathyā
jīrṇe pathyājīrṇe pathyā jīrṇājīrṇe pathyāpathyā
bhuktābhuktaṃ tu vamanaṃ jīrṇājīrṇaṃ virecanam
vibhītakaḥ kaṭus tiktaḥ kaṣāyoṣṇaḥ kaphāpahaḥ
cakṣuṣyaḥ palitaghnaś ca vipāke madhuro laghuḥ
tadvad āmalakam amlam uttamaṃ śītavīryaṃ kaphapittanāśanam
keśyam akṣogadaghātīśītalaṃ vṛṣyam āśu vinihanti ṣaṇḍatām
pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī tryūṣaṇam ucyate
pippalī jvarahā vṛṣyā snigdhoṣṇā kaṭutiktakā
dīpanī mārutaṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ śleṣmakṣayāpahā
maricaṃ laghu tiktarasaṃ kaṭukaṃ ghāti ca hṛdrogasaṃśamanam
kṛmivātaharaṃ rucisaṃjananaṃ svaraśuddhikaraṃ galadoṣaharam
śuṇṭhī snigdhā śothaśūlānilaghnī coṣṇā kaṭvī śleṣmadoṣān nihanti
hikkākāsādhmānabaddhodarāṇi śvāsaṃ vahner māndyam āmādidoṣān
svarjikā yavaśūkaś ca kṣārayugmam udāhṛtam
tṛtīyaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kṣāraṃ gulmāśmaryādināśanam
trigandhamelā tvak patraṃ cāturjātaṃ sakeśaram
madhuraṃ malinahṛt syāt tiktam īṣat kaṭūṣṇam
balakaram arucighnaṃ śītavīryaṃ vipāke
viṣagadagudakīlaṃ sthaulyavidhvaṃsī cailam
pradaragalabalāsaśvāsakāsān nihanti
kaṭukaṃ śītaṃ kaphakāsavināśanaṃ svaryam
śukrapramehaśamanaṃ laghu kaṇṭhaviśuddhijananaṃ ca
patrakaṃ laghutiktoṣṇaṃ viṣānilakaphāpaham
vastikaṇṭhatridoṣaghnaṃ mukhamastakaśodhanam
nāgakeśaram atīva śītalaṃ pittadāhaśamanaṃ ca tiktakam
vastikaṇṭhabhavasṛk kaphāpahaṃ kiṃcid uṣṇalaghupākivṛṣyakam
jīrakaṃ kṛṣṇajīraṃ ca kaṇajīraṃ tṛtīyakam
jīrakaḥ kaṭur udīrito himo dīpanaṃ kṛmiharo 'rśasāṃ hitaḥ
saṃgrahānilarujātisāranudgulmaśūlaviṣamajvarāpahaḥ
karpūrāditrikaṃ prāhuḥ karpūramadakuṅkumam
karpūro madhuraḥ satiktaḥ kaṭukaś chardividāhāpahaḥ
śītapittaharaḥ karoti na kapha,ṛṣṭo nidāghe hito
dagdhāṅge śiśire ca pīnasagare pathyo 'lpa uṣṇaḥ kaṭuḥ
gandhāḍhyā kṛmināśinī kaphaharā saṃśodhinī srotasām
kāmāhlādavisāriṇī śramaharā tiktātivahnipradā
kaṭukledaviṣāpahā sakaṭukā puṇyāṅgarāge hitā
ity evaṃ kathitāś caturdaśa guṇāḥ kastūrikāyāḥ punaḥ
yā gandhaḥ ketakīnāṃ harati parimalair varṇataḥ piṅgalābhā
svāde tiktā kaṭvī laghur atha tulitā marditā cikkaṇā syāt
kṣiptāgnau bhasma na syāc cimicimi kurute carmagandhā hutāśe
sā śuddhā śobhanāsyā varamṛgatanujā rājayogyā prasiddhā
karatalajalamadhye sthāpayitvā muhūrtaṃ punar api yadi paśyed daṇḍamātraṃ nirīkṣya
yadi bhavati ca raktaṃ tajjalaṃ pītavarṇaṃ na bhavati mṛganābhiḥ kṛtrimo 'sau vikāraḥ
kuṅkumam surabhi tiktaṃ kaṭūṣṇakāsapittakaphakaṇṭharujāghnam
ūrdhvaṃ śūlaviṣadoṣaharaṃ tadrocanaṃ tu tanukāntikaraṃ ca
sauvarcalaṃ saindhavaṃ ca viḍam audbhidam eva ca
sāmudreṇa sahaitāni pañca syur lavaṇāni ca
teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syāt sarvabhāveṣu kṣepayet
sindhūdbhavaṃ netrarujāpahaṃ ca saṃdīpanīyaṃ rucivṛṣyam uktam
pūtaṃ tridoṣopaśamaṃ karoti viḍbandhanaṃ svādurasaṃ vraṇaghnam
kākolīkṣīrakākolī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā
medaś cāpi mahāmedo jīvantī madhukaṃ tathā
mudgaparṇīmāṣaparṇī jīvanīyagaṇas tv ayam
stanyakṛd bṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyo garbhasandhānakṛd guru
dvau medau dvau ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā
ṛddhir vṛddhiś cāṣṭavargo jīvanīyasamo guṇaḥ
medābhāve 'śvagandhā ca mahāmede ca sārivā
ṛddhyabhāve balā grāhyā vṛddhau tv atibalā tathā
kākolīyugalābhāve nikṣipec ca śatāvarī
jīvakarṣabhakābhāve guḍūcī vaṃśalocane
vāte 'tyuṣṇaṃ kaphe coṣṇaṃ pitte rakte 'tiśītalam
saṃsarge tat samoṣṇaṃ syāt sannipāte tv aśītalam
divālpatvena doṣāṇāṃ kvāthasya prasṛtārdhakam
rātrau śītāṃśukiraṇair dhātūn puṣyanti te malāḥ
rātrau doṣaprabāhulyāt prasṛtaṃ pānato hitaḥ
tṛṣite gaṇḍūṣatoyasya pāne kvātheṣv ayaṃ kramaḥ
aśodhite dhāturase jīvanāntaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
mṛtāś cāmṛtatulyā hi bhavanti sarvadhātavaḥ
antaḥ sunīlo bahir ujjvalo yo madhyāhnasūryapratimaprakāśaḥ
śasto 'tha dhūmraḥ paripāṇḍuraś ca sūto na yojyo rasakarmasiddhau
khalle niśeṣṭakacūrṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśaiḥ rasādīnām
jambīradravaiś cāpi mardayet sa viśudhyati
kumāryā ca niśācūrṇayutaṃ sūtaṃ vimardayet
pātayet pātanayantre samyak śuddho raso bhavet
nāgavaṅgamalo vahniś cāñcalyaṃ ca viṣaṃ giriḥ
atyagniś cāṣṭadoṣāś ca nisargāt pārade sthitāḥ
saurṇai niśeṣṭakā dhūmra jambīrāmbubhir ā dinam
marditaḥ kāṃjikair dhauto nāgadoṣaṃ rasas tyajet
viśālāṅkoṭhacūrṇena vaṃgadoṣaṃ vimuñcati
rājavṛkṣo malaṃ hanti citrako vahnidūṣaṇam
cāñcalyaṃ kṛṣṇadhustūras triphalā viṣanāśinī
kaṭutrayaṃ giriṃ hanti atyagniṃ ca trikaṇṭakaḥ
pratidoṣaṃ kalāṃśena tattaccūrṇaṃ sacānyakam
uddhṛtoṣṇāranālena mṛtpātre kṣālayet sudhīḥ
evaṃ saṃśodhitaḥ sūtaḥ saptakañcukavarjitaḥ
aṣṭadoṣavinirmuktaḥ saptakañcukavarjitaḥ
viśuddho jāyate sūtaḥ tataḥ karmaṇi yajayet
amladāḍimatoyena gandhapādāṃśasaṃyutaḥ
vandhyākarkoṭikāmūlapiṇḍena mriyate rasaḥ
eraṇḍamūlaṃ vaḍavāgnimūlaṃ dhustūramūlaṃ lavaṇasyapūre
saṃghaṭṭayet bhāṇḍayugme rasas tu bhasmibhavec candrasamānakāntiḥ
śvetāṅkoṭhajaṭākārā sūto mardyo dinatrayam
puṭitaṃ cāndhamūṣāyāṃ sūto bhasmatvam āpnuyāt
dvipalaṃ śuddhasūtaṃ tu tadarddhaśuddhagandhakam
kanyānīreṇa saṃmardya radhvā tu bhūdhare pacet
mriyate nāsti sandehaḥ sarvarogeṣu yojayet
śvetāṅkoṭhaśirīṣāmbupiṇṭo khalle dinatrayam
marditaś cāndhamūṣāyāṃ sūto bhasmatvam āpnuyāt
pāradaḥ sakalaroganāśanaḥ ṣaḍraso nikhilarogavāhakaḥ
pañcabhūtamayayogarājako dehalauhakaraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ
pāradaḥ kṛmikuṣṭhaghnaś cakṣuṣyaś ca rasāyanaḥ
yogavāhī mahāvīryo jarāmṛtyunivāraṇaḥ
tāre guṇāśīti tadarddhakānte vaṃge catuṣṣaṣṭi raje tadarddham
svarṇe sahasraṃ gagane śatekaṃ vajre guṇākoṭiś cānanta sūte
harabījaṃ śatapalaṃ khallamadhye vinikṣipet
tadarddhena tadarddhena tadarddhenāthavā punaḥ
pāradaṃ palamātraṃ syād anyūnaṃ kurute bhiṣak
aghoramantroccāraiś ca ṣoḍaśena prapūjayet
khallamadhye tataḥ sthāpya śodhayec ca bhiṣagvaraḥ
haridrācūrṇāsaṃyuktam mardayed ghaṭikādvayam
gṛhadhūmasamāyuktam ātapena vibhāvayet
śuklavastrāntare kṣiptvā rasena bhāvayed budhaḥ
śikhaṇḍī pūtikāṣṭhaṃ ca eṣikā phaṇī vallikā
kakkolamusalītuṇḍī kanyāpalāśacitrakam
aṅkolaṃ rājavṛkṣaś ca kāñcanasya dravair api
bhṛṅgarājasya varṣābhūdravaṃ dattvā vimardayet
nirdravaṃ marditaḥ patrarasaiḥ śuddhi bhaved rasaḥ
harabījaṃ rasaḥ sūtaḥ pāradaś capalo 'mṛtaḥ
etāṇi sūtanāmāni sarvarogeṣu yojayet
sadugdhabhāṇḍārddhapurasthito 'yaṃ śuddho bhavet kūrmapuṭena gandhaḥ
kṣudrīkṛtaḥ sājya caṭusthito 'gnau dravīkṛto dugdhanipātito vā
śuddhagandho hared rogān kuṣṭhamṛtyujvarāpahaḥ
agnikārī mahān uṣṇo vīryavṛddhiṃ karoti ca
palamātraṃ rasaṃ śuddhaṃ tāvanmānaṃ ca gandhakam
vidhivat kajjalīkṛtvā nyagrodhāṅkuravāribhiḥ
bhāvanātritayaṃ dattvā kācakūpyāṃ nidhāpayet
kramād agniṃ tato dadyād bhiṣag yāmacatuṣṭayam
jāyate rasasindūraṃ tarūṇāruṇasannibham
anupānaviṣeṣeṇa karoti vividhān guṇām
pratītyajānāṃ bhāvānāṃ naiḥsvābhāvyaṃ jagāda yaḥ
taṃ namāmy asamajñānam acintyam anidarśanam
yathā tvayā mahāyāne dharmanairātmyam ātmanā
viditaṃ deśitaṃ tadvad dhīmadbhyaḥ karuṇāvaśāt
pratyayebhyaḥ samutpannam anutpannaṃ tvayoditam
svabhāvena na taj jātam iti śūnyaṃ prakāśitam
yadvacchabdaṃ pratītyeha pratiśabdasamudbhavaḥ
māyāmarīcivac cāpi tathā bhavasamudbhavaḥ
māyāmarīcigandharvanagarapratibimbakāḥ
yady ajātāḥ saha svapnair na syāt taddarśanādikam
hetupratyayasambhūtā yathaite kṛtakāḥ smṛtāḥ
tadvat pratyayajaṃ viśvaṃ tvayoktaṃ nātha sāṃvṛtam
asty etat kṛtakaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiṃcid bālalāpanam
riktamuṣṭipratīkāśam ayathārthaprakāśitam
kṛtakaṃ vastu no jātaṃ tadā kiṃ vārtamānikam
kasya nāśād atītaṃ syād utpitsuḥ kim apekṣate
svasmān na jāyate bhāvaḥ parasmān nobhayād api
na san nāsan na sadasan kutaḥ kasyodayas tadā
ajāte na svabhāvo 'sti kutaḥ svasmāt samudbhavaḥ
svabhāvābhāvasiddhyaiva parasmād apy asaṃbhavaḥ
svatve sati paratvaṃ syāt paratve svatvam iṣyate
āpekṣikī tayoḥ siddhiḥ pārāvāram ivoditā
yadā nāpekṣate kiṃcit kutaḥ kiṃcit tadā bhavet
yadā nāpekṣate dīrghaṃ kuto hrasvādikaṃ tadā
astitve sati nāstitvaṃ dīrghe hrasvaṃ tathā sati
nāstitve sati cāstitvaṃ yat tasmād ubhayaṃ na sat
ekatvaṃ ca tathānekam atītānāgatādi ca
saṃkleśo vyavadānaṃ ca samyaṅmithyā svataḥ kutaḥ
svata eva hi yo nāsti bhāvaḥ sarvo 'sti kas tadā
para ity ucyate yo 'yaṃ na vinā svasvabhāvataḥ
na svabhāvo 'sti bhāvānāṃ parabhāvo 'sti no yadā
bhāvagrahagrahāveśaḥ paratantro 'sti kas tadā
ādāv eva samaṃ jātāḥ svabhāvena ca nirvṛtāḥ
anutpannāś ca tattvena tasmād dharmās tvayoditāḥ
niḥsvabhāvās tvayā dhīman rūpādyāḥ saṃprakāśitāḥ
phenabudbudamāyābhramarīcikadalīsamāḥ
indriyair upalabdhaṃ yat tat tattvena bhaved yadi
jātās tattvavido bālās tattvajñānena kiṃ tadā
jaḍatvam apramāṇatvam athāvyākṛtatām api
viparītaparijñānam indriyānāṃ tvam ūcivān
ajñānenāvṛto yena yathāvan na prapadyate
lokas tena yathābhūtam iti matvā tvayoditam
astīti śāśvatī dṛṣṭir nāstīty ucchedadarśanam
tenāntadvayanirmukto dharmo 'yaṃ deśitas tvayā
catuṣkoṭivinirmuktās tena dharmās tvayoditāḥ
vijñānasyāpy avijñeyā vācāṃ kimuta gocarāḥ
svapnendrajālikodbhūtaṃ dvicandrodvīkṣaṇaṃ yathā
bhūtaṃ tadvastu no bhūtaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaṃ jagat tvayā
utpannaś ca sthito naṣṭaḥ svapne yadvat sutas tathā
na cotpannaḥ sthito naṣṭa ukto loko 'rthatas tvayā
kāraṇāt saṃbhavo dṛṣṭo yathā svapne tathetaraḥ
saṃbhavaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ vibhavo 'pi matas tathā
rāgādijaṃ yathā duḥkhaṃ saṃkleśasaṃsṛtī tathā
saṃbhārapūraṇān muktiḥ svapnavad bhāṣitā tvayā
jātaṃ tathaiva no jātam āgataṃ gatam ity api
baddho muktas tathā jñānī dvayam icchen na tattvavit
utpattir yasya naivāsti tasya kā nirvṛtir bhavet
māyāgajaprakāśatvād ādiśāntatvam arthataḥ
utpanno 'pi na cotpanno yadvan māyāgajo mataḥ
utpannaṃ ca tathā viśvam anutpannaṃ ca tattvataḥ
ameyair aprameyānāṃ pratyekaṃ nirvṛtiḥ kṛtā
lokanāthair hi sattvānāṃ na kaścin mocitaś ca taiḥ
te ca sattvāś ca no jātā ye nirvānti na te sphuṭam
na kaścin mocitaḥ kaiścid iti proktaṃ mahāmune
māyākārakṛtaṃ yadvad vastu śūnyaṃ tathetarat
vastuśūnyaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvayoktaṃ kārakas tathā
kārako 'pi kṛto 'nyena kṛtatvaṃ nātivartate
athavā tatkriyākartṛkārakasya prasajyate
nāmamātraṃ jagat sarvam ity uccair bhāṣitaṃ tvayā
abhidhānāt pṛthagbhūtam abhidheyaṃ na vidyate
kalpanāmātram ity asmāt sarvadharmāḥ prakāśitāḥ
kalpanāpy asatī proktā yayā śūnyaṃ vikalpyate
bhāvābhāvadvayātītam anatītaṃ ca kutracit
na ca jñānaṃ na ca jñeyaṃ na cāsti na ca nāsti yat
yan na caikaṃ na cānekaṃ nobhayaṃ na ca nobhayam
anālayam athāvyaktam acintyam anidarśanam
yan nodeti na ca vyeti nocchedi na ca śāśvatam
tad ākāśapratīkāśaṃ nākṣarajñānagocaram
yaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ śūnyatā saiva te matā
tathāvidhaś ca saddharmas tatsamaś ca tathāgataḥ
tat tattvaṃ paramārtho 'pi tathatā dravyam iṣyate
bhūtaṃ tad avisaṃvādi tadbodhād buddha ucyate
buddhānāṃ sattvadhātoś ca tenābhinnatvam arthataḥ
ātmanaś ca pareṣāṃ ca samatā tena te matā
bhāvebhyaḥ śūnyatā nānyā na ca bhāvo 'sti tāṃ vinā
tasmāt pratītyajā bhāvās tvayā śūnyāḥ prakāśitāḥ
hetupratyayasambhūtā paratantrā ca saṃvṛtiḥ
paratantra iti proktaḥ paramārthas tv akṛtrimaḥ
svabhāvaḥ prakṛtis tattvaṃ dravyaṃ vastu sad ity api
nāsti vai kapito bhāvo paratantras tu vidyate
astīti kalpite bhāve samāropas tvayoditaḥ
nāstīti kṛtakocchedād ucchedaś ca prakāśitaḥ
tattvajñānena nocchedo na ca śāśvatatā matā
vastuśūnyaṃ jagat sarvaṃ marīcipratimaṃ matam
mṛgatṛṣṇājalaṃ yadvan nocchedi na ca śāśvatam
tadvat sarvaṃ jagat proktaṃ nocchedi na ca śāśvatam
dravyam utpadyate yasya tasyocchedādikaṃ bhavet
antavān nāntavāṃś cāpi lokas tasya prasajyate
jñāne sati yathā jñeyaṃ jñeye jñānaṃ tathā sati
yatrobhayam anutpannam iti buddhaṃ tadāsti kim
iti māyādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ sphuṭam uktvā bhiṣagvaraḥ
deśayāmāsa saddharmaṃ sarvadṛṣṭicikitsakam
etat tat paramaṃ tattvaṃ niḥsvabhāvārthadeśanā
bhāvagrahagṛhītānāṃ cikitseyam anuttarā
dharmayājñika tenaiva dharmayajño niruttaraḥ
abhīkṣṇam iṣṭas trailokye niṣkapāṭo nirargalaḥ
vastugrāhabhayocchedī kutīrthyamṛgabhīkaraḥ
nairātmyasiṃhanādo 'yam adbhuto naditas tvayā
śūnyatādharmagambhīrā dharmabherī parāhatā
naiḥsvābhāvyamahānādo dharmaśaṅkhaḥ prapūritaḥ
dharmayautukam ākhyātaṃ buddhānāṃ śāsanāmṛtam
nītārtham iti nirdiṣṭaṃ dharmāṇāṃ śūnyataiva hi
