vātapittaśleṣmāṇa iti prakṛtitrayam
vātaḥ prāṇaprakṛtiḥ pittaṃ hutāśanodbhūtaṃ śleṣmā nirodhāt bhavati
tvak asṛk māṃsaṃ medaḥ asthi majjā śukraṃ prāṇo jīvaḥ śaktiḥ iti daśa dhātavaḥ
prāṇarandhradvayaṃ locanarandhradvayaṃ karṇarandhradvayaṃ mukharandhradvayam utsargarandhradvayam iti daśa dvārāṇi
atha daśamadvāraṃ dvividhaṃ śukramārgam amṛtaṃ kālamārgaś ceti brahmadaṇḍamūle raviśaśimadhye bhagākāram asti tasmād āgatabrahmadaṇḍāśritaṃ paścimaliṅgam asti paścimaśabdena sthānam asti tasya madhye liṅgākāram asti
puruṣāṇāṃ retomārgaḥ strīṇāṃ rajomārgaḥ sahaiva tena brahmadaṇḍarekhāśritapuṣpasamaye sarvavyāpakanāḍīsamūhāgataṃ kāminīrajaḥ sravati
tatraiva kāmaviṣaharanirañjanānāṃ saṃyogaṃ bījapātāt ānandāgamaḥ pralayakālaviṣakālayoḥ kartā nirañjanaś ca iti
śaktitrayavinirbhinne citte bījanirañjanāt
vajrapūjāpadānandaṃ yaḥ karoti sa manmathaḥ
citte tṛpte manomuktir ūrdhvamārgāśrite 'nale
udānacalitaṃ reto mṛtyurekhāviṣaṃ viduḥ
cittamadhye bhaved yas tu bālāgraśatadhāśraye
nānābhāvavinirmuktaḥ sa ca prokto nirañjanaḥ
nirañjanāśritā śaktiḥ sūkṣmaśaktyā tayāśritam
manasy āśrayatāmeti jñeyaṃ śaktitrayaṃ tu tat
śaktitrayodbhavaṃ bījaṃ bījāt kāmo viṣaṃ tataḥ
kāmaḥ sṛṣṭitayā prokto viṣaṃ mṛtyupadaṃ bhavet
kiṃ bahunā kāmaviṣaharanirañjanānāṃ brahmadaṇḍamūlāṅkure nivāsaḥ ebhir yad amukho mokṣaḥ bhasmībhūtasya dehasya punarāgamanakāryaṃ nāsti
aho mūrkhatā lokasya kecid vadanti śubhāśubhakarmavicchedanaṃ mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti vedapāṭhāśrito mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti nirālambanalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti dhyānakalākaraṇasambaddhaprayogasambhavena rūpabindunādacaitanyapiṇḍākāśalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti pūjāpūjakamadyamāṃsādisurataprasaṅgasānandalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti
mūlakandollāsitakuṇḍalinīsaṃcāralakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ
kecid vadanti susamadṛṣṭinipātalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ ity evaṃvidhabhāvanāśritalakṣaṇo mokṣo na bhavati
atha mokṣapadaṃ kathyate yatra sahajasamādhikrameṇa manasā manaḥ samālokyate sa eva mokṣaḥ
kāmaviṣaharasthānaṃ mānasodbhavaḥ manomadhye kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāt utpattisthitipralayāḥ pravartante
uktaṃ ca bhagavatā maheśvareṇa
jīvanmuktipade devi cittaṃ bījanirañjanam
mṛtyumārgasthito yogī jñātvā karma samabhyaset
iti jīvanmuktipadam anena mārgeṇa sthiratvaṃ bhavati
athādhāraṇakarmoditaśaṅkhinībhedavyavasthāvyākhyā gudameḍhrāntare trikoṇatridhāvartabhagamaṇḍalam ucyate tatra ādhāragranthaya ekadvitrayaś ceti ekadvitrayāṇāṃ madhye granthīnām upāntare catuṣpattraṃ padmam adhomukhaṃ tiṣṭhati tatra karṇikāmadhye mṛṇālasūtraparimāṇā śaṅkhāvartā tatra pravālāṅkurasannibhā dvitrināḍībhūtā kuṇḍalinī śaktiḥ caitanyabījamukhaṃ gatvā suptā
tatra tripathamadhye tu sūkṣmībhūtā vyavasthitā
ūrṇātantunibhākārā gatā sā nābhimaṇḍalam
caturaṅgulamānenāpy aṣṭadhā kuṭilākṛtiḥ
sphuritā nābhimadhye tu śākhāśākham anekadhā
daśanāḍyāśritaṃ cakraṃ nābhimadhye prakīrtitam
iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tṛtīyakā
ūrdhvamārgasthitā hy etā bṛhacchākhāvalambitāḥ
jayanty alambusā caikā bṛhacchākhāvalambinī
praṇītā sā hy anekais tu brahmāvartena saṃsthitā
brahmadaṇḍacakreṇāsau kapālakarparaṃ yāvat tasmin kapālakarpare candramaṇḍalāntargataṃ kapālaliṅgaṃ lampikāsthānordhve 'mṛtadhārām abhisravati mastakamadhye garbhe tiṣṭhati tad evāmṛtaṃ rājadantamaye śaṅkhinī brahmadaṇḍatale damayitvā sravati
ekaṃ mukharandhraṃ rājadantāntare etad eva śaṅkhinīmukhaṃ daśamadvāram ity ucyate
yatra ca mūlabhagamaṇḍalānte kuṇḍalinī śaktir vinirgatā tatra vāmabhāgodbhavasomanāḍikā dakṣiṇabhāgodbhavasūryanāḍikā candro vāmāṅgavyāpakaḥ sūryo dakṣiṇāṅgavyāpakaḥ candro vāmāṅge vāmanāsāpuṭaṃ sūryo dakṣiṇāṅge dakṣiṇanāsāpuṭam ity evaṃ sūryacandrau vyavasthitau
yatra mūlakande pavanodayaḥ manasa udayaḥ tapanodayaḥ jīvodayaḥ śabdodayaḥ mātṛkākṣarodayaś ceti
manomadhye nidrāviṣayam icchākāryo nirañjanaḥ paramātmā
mūlakandodyato vāyuḥ somasūryapathodbhavaḥ
śaktyādhārasthito yāti brahmadaṇḍakabhedakaḥ
mūlakande tu yā śaktiḥ kuṇḍalākārarūpiṇī
udgamāvartavāto 'yaṃ prāṇa ity ucyate budhaiḥ
kandadaṇḍena coddaṇḍair bhrāmitā yā bhujaṅginī
mūrchitā sā śivaṃ vetti prāṇair evaṃ vyavasthitā
janmāvasthānād adho liṅgaḥ sa cādhārakandajātimadhyasthito guhya ūrdhve bhavati tasyordhve liṅgasthānaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ nābhimaṇḍale maṇipūrakasyordhvabhāge 'nalakaḥ tenoddaṇḍakādyaṃ samāgacchati adhaḥpradeśe maṇipūrakasya dakṣiṇapaścimavarti amedhyasthānam madhye nābheḥ kandaḥ tatra padmākṛtiḥ tatra śarīranāḍīnām ādhāraḥ kathyate hṛdaye pṛthivītattvaṃ pītavarṇaṃ madhye kadambagolakākṛti tatra cittaviśrāntisthānaṃ tad eva analacakram kaṇṭhe codakapravāhapūrṇam ātmatattvaṃ tad viśuddhisthānam tālumadhye dīpaśikhākāraḥ sadoddyotaḥ tat tejastattvam kapālakandarāṅkure vāyutattvam nāsāgre ākāśatattvam tasyordhve ājñāsthānam ājñāsthānāntare granthiṣoḍaśāntare amṛtā ṣoḍaśī kalā tadantare vālāgraśatadhāśrayā ante tasyordhve kalānte binduḥ bindubhedād anantaraṃ śṛṅgāṭakākṛtir mastakasyoddeśas tasmin cittalayasthānam cittasya śarīrabandhanādvayopetas trailokyavihāraḥ tasyāśritā jñānaśaktiḥ evaṃ śaktitrayālaṃkṛtaś ciddarpaṇapratibimbaḥ samo vividhabhāvakalākalitaḥ saṃsāraceṣṭāvalokanakuśalaḥ suptāvasthāyāṃ rūpī jalacandravat dṛśyate yaḥ sa paramātmā sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ caturdaśavidhabhūtagrāmakartā ca iti so 'yaṃ paramātmā
jyākṛṣṭibaddhakhaṭakāmukhapāṇipṛṣṭhapreṅkhannakhāṃśucayasaṃvalito 'mbikāyāḥ
tvāṃ pātu mañjaritapallavakarṇapūralobhabhramadbhramaravibhramabhṛt kaṭākṣaḥ
kṣipto hastāvalagnaḥ prasabham abhihato 'py ādadāno 'ṃśukāntaṃ gṛhṇan keśeṣvapāstaścaraṇanipatito nekṣitaḥ sambhrameṇa
āliṅgan yo 'vadhūtas tripurayuvatibhiḥ sāśrunetrotpalābhiḥ kāmīvārdrāparādhaḥ sa dahatu duritaṃ śāmbhavo vaḥ śarāgniḥ
ālolām alakāvalīṃ vilulitāṃ bibhraccalatkuṇḍalaṃ kiṃcin mṛṣṭaviśeṣakaṃ tanutaraiḥ khedāmbhasāṃ śīkaraiḥ
tanvyā yat suratāntatāntanayanaṃ vaktraṃ rativyatyaye tattvāṃ pātu cirāya kiṃ hariharabrahmādibhirdaivataiḥ
alasavalitaiḥ premārdrārdrair muhurmukulīkṛtaiḥ kṣaṇam abhimukhair lajjālolair nimeṣaparāṅmukhaiḥ
hṛdayanihitaṃ bhāvākūtaṃ vamadbhirivekṣaṇaiḥ kathaya sukṛtī ko 'yaṃ mugdhe tvayādya vilokyate
datto'syāḥ praṇayastvayaiva bhavatā ceyaṃ ciraṃ lālitā daivād adya kila tvameva kṛtavān asyā navaṃ vipriyam
manyurduḥsaha eṣa yātyupaśamaṃ no sāntvavādaiḥ sphuṭaṃ he nistraṃśa vimuktakaṇṭhakaruṇaṃ tāvatsakhī roditu
likhannāste bhūmiṃ bahiravanataḥ prāṇadayito nirāhārāḥ sakhyaḥ satataruditocchūnanayanāḥ
parityaktaṃ sarvaṃ hasitapaṭhitaṃ pañjaraśukais tavāvasthā ceyaṃ visṛja kaṭhine mānamadhunā
nāryastanvi haṭhāddharanti ramaṇaṃ tiṣṭhanti no vāritās tatkiṃ tāmyasi kiṃ ca rodiṣi mudhā tāsāṃ priyaṃ mā kṛthāḥ
kāntaḥ keliruciryuvā sahṛdayastādṛkpatiḥ kātare kiṃ no barkarakarkaraiḥ priyaśatairākramya vikrīyate
kopāt komalalolabāhulatikāpāśena baddhā dṛḍhaṃ nītvā keliniketanaṃ dayitayā sāyaṃ sakhīnāṃ puraḥ
bhūyo'pyevamiti skhalan mṛdugirā saṃsūcya duśceṣṭitaṃ dhanyo hanyata eva nihnutiparaḥ preyān rudatyā hasan
praharaviratau madhye vāhnastato'pi pare'thavā kimuta sakale jāte vāhṇi priya tvamihaiṣyasi
iti dinaśataprāpyaṃ deśaṃ priyasya yiyāsato harati gamanaṃ bālālāpaiḥ sabāṣpagalajjalaiḥ
yātāḥ kiṃ na milanti sundari punaścintā tvayā matkṛte no kāryā nitarāṃ kṛśāmi kathayatyevaṃ sabāṣpe mayi
lajjāmantharatārakeṇa nipataddhārāśruṇā cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā māṃ hasitena bhāvimaraṇotsāhastayā sūcitaḥ
dhīraṃ vāridharasya vāri kirataḥ śrutvā niśīthe dhvaniṃ dīrghocchvāsamudaśruṇā virahiṇīṃ bālāṃ ciraṃ dhyāyatā

kathamapi sakhi krīḍākopād vrajeti mayodite kaṭhinahṛdayastyaktvā śayyāṃ balād gata eva saḥ
iti sarabhasaṃ dhvastapremṇi vyapetaghṛṇe jane punarapi hatavrīḍaṃ cetaḥ prayāti karomi kim
dampatyorniśi jalpatorgṛhaśukenākarṇitaṃ yadvacas tatprātargurusaṃnidhau nigadatastasyopahāraṃ vadhūḥ
karṇālaṃkṛtipadmarāgaśakalaṃ vinyasya cañcūpuṭe vrīḍārtā prakaroti dāḍimaphalavyājena vāgbandhanam
ajñānena parāṅmukhīṃ paribhavād āśliṣya māṃ duḥkhitāṃ kiṃ labdhaṃ caṭula tvayeha nayatā saubhāgyametāṃ daśām
paśyaitad dayitākucavyatikaronmṛṣṭāṅgarāgāruṇaṃ vakṣaste malatailapaṅkaśabalair veṇīpadairaṅkitam
ekatrāsanasaṃsthitiḥ parihatā pratyudgamād dūratas tāmbūlānayanacchalena rabhasāśleṣo'pi saṃvighnitaḥ
ālāpo'pi na miśritaḥ parijanaṃ vyāpārayantyāntike kāntaṃ pratyupacārataścaturayā kopaḥ kṛtārthīkṛtaḥ
dṛṣṭvaikāsanasaṃsthite priyatame paścād upetyādarād ekasyā nayane pidhāya vihitakrīḍānubandhacchalaḥ
īṣadvakrimakaṃdharaḥ sapulakaḥ premollasanmānasām antarhāsalasatkapolaphalakāṃ dhūrto'parāṃ cumbati
caraṇapatanapratyākhyānātprasādaparāṅmukhe nibhṛtakitavācāretyuktvā ruṣā paruṣīkṛte

mātaḥ svaptumapīha vārayati māmityāhitakrodhayā paryasya svapiticchalena śayane datto'vakāśastayā
ekasmiñśayane parāṅmukhatayā vītottaraṃ tāmyator anyonyasya hṛdi sthite'pyanunaye saṃrakṣatorgauravam
dampatyoḥ śanakairapāṅgavalanān miśrībhavaccakṣuṣor bhagno mānakaliḥ sahāsarabhasaṃ vyāsaktakaṇṭhagraham
paśyāmo mayi kiṃ prapadyata iti sthairyaṃ mayālambitaṃ kiṃ māmālapatītyayaṃ khalu śaṭhaḥ kopastayāpyāśritaḥ
ityanyonyavilakṣadṛṣṭicature tasminnavasthāntare savyājaṃ hasitaṃ mayā dhṛtiharo bāṣpastu muktastayā
parimlāne māne mukhaśaśini tasyāḥ karadhṛte mayi kṣīṇopāye praṇipatanamātraikaśaraṇe
tayā pakṣmaprāntavrajapuṭaniruddhena sahasā prasādo bāṣpena stanataṭaviśīrṇena kathitaḥ
tasyāḥ sāndravilepanastanataṭapraśleṣamudrāṅkitaṃ kiṃ vakṣaścaraṇānativyatikaravyājena gopāyate
ityukte kva tad ityudīrya sahasā tatsampramārṣṭuṃ mayā sāśliṣṭā rabhasena tatsukhavaśāttanvyāpi tad vismṛtam
tvaṃ mugdhākṣi vinaiva kañculikayā dhatse manohāriṇīṃ lakṣmīmityabhidhāyini priyatame tadvīṭikāṃ saṃspṛśi

tābhir dharmārthau yad vidyāt tad vidyānāṃ vidyātvam
sāṃkhyaṃ yogo lokāyataṃ cetyānvīkṣikī
dharmādharmau trayyām arthānarthau vārttāyāṃ nayānayau daṇḍanītyāṃ balābale ca etāsāṃ hetubhir anvīkṣamāṇā lokasya upakaroti vyasane 'bhyudaye ca buddhim avasthāpayati prajñāvākyakriyāvaiśāradyaṃ ca karoti
pradīpaḥ sarvavidyānām upāyaḥ sarvakarmaṇām
āśrayaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ śaśvad ānvīkṣikī matā
sāma ṛc yajurvedāḥ trayaḥ trayī
atharvaveda itihāsavedau ca vedāḥ
śikṣā kalpaḥ vyākaraṇam niruktam chandovicitiḥ jyotiṣam iti ca aṅgāni
eṣa trayī dharmaḥ caturṇām varṇānām āśramāṇām ca svadharma sthāpanāt aupakārikaḥ
svadharmaḥ brāhmaṇasya adhyayanam adhyāpanam yajanam yājanam dānam pratigrahaḥ ca kṣatriyasya adhyayanam yajanam dānam śastra ājīvaḥ bhūta rakṣaṇam ca vaiśyasya adhyayanam yajanam dānam kṛṣi pāśupālye vaṇijyā ca śūdrasya dvijāti śuśrūṣā vārttā kāru kuśīlava karma ca
gṛhasthasya svadharma ājīvaḥ tulyaiḥ asamāna ṛṣibhiḥ vaivāhyam ṛtugāmi tvam deva pitṛ atithi pūjā bhṛtyeṣu tyāgaḥ śeṣa bhojanam ca
brahmacāriṇaḥ svādhyāyaḥ agni kārya abhiṣekau bhaikṣa vrati tvam ācārye prāṇāntikā vṛttiḥ tad abhāve guru putre sabrahmacāriṇi _
vānaprasthasya brahmacaryam bhūmau śayyā jaṭā ajina dhāraṇam agni hotra abhiṣekau devatā pitṛ atithi pūjā vanyaḥ ca āhāraḥ
parivrājakasya jita indriya tvam anārambhaḥ niṣkiṃcana tvam saṅga tyāgaḥ bhaikṣa vratam anekatra araṇye ca vāsaḥ bāhya abhyantaram ca śaucam
sarveṣām ahiṃsā satyam śaucam anasūyā ānṛśaṃsyam kṣamā ca
svadharmaḥ svargāya ānantyāya ca
tasya atikrame lokaḥ saṃkarāt ucchidyeta
tasmāt svadharmam bhūtānām rājā na vyabhicārayet
svadharmam saṃdadhānaḥ hi pretya ca iha ca nandati
vyavasthita ārya maryādaḥ kṛta varṇa āśrama sthitiḥ trayyā abhirakṣitaḥ lokaḥ prasīdati na sīdati
kṛṣi pāśupālye vaṇijyā ca vārttā
dhānya paśu hiraṇya kupya viṣṭi pradānāt aupakārikā
tayā sva pakṣam para pakṣam ca vaśīkaroti kośa daṇḍābhyām
ānvīkṣikī trayī vārttānām yogakṣema sādhanaḥ daṇḍaḥ
tasya nītiḥ daṇḍanītiḥ a labdha lābha arthā labdha parirakṣaṇā rakṣita vivardhanā vṛddhasya tīrthe pratipādanā ca
tasyām āyattā lokayātrā
tasmāt lokayātrā arthī nityam udyata daṇḍaḥ syāt
na hi evaṃvidham vaśa upanayanam asti bhūtānām yathā daṇḍaḥ iti ācāryāḥ
na iti kauṭilyaḥ
tīkṣṇa daṇḍaḥ hi bhūtānām udvejanīyaḥ bhavati
mṛdu daṇḍaḥ paribhūyate
yathārha daṇḍaḥ pūjyate
su vijñāta praṇītaḥ daṇḍaḥ prajāḥ dharma artha kāmaiḥ yojayati
duṣpraṇītaḥ kāma krodhābhyām avajñānāt _ vānaprastha parivrājakān api kopayati kim aṅga punar gṛhasthān
a praṇītaḥ tu mātsya nyāyam udbhāvayati
balīyāḥ abalam hi grasate daṇḍadhara abhāve
saḥ tena guptaḥ prabhavati iti
catur varṇa āśramaḥ lokaḥ rājñā daṇḍena pālitaḥ svadharma karma abhirataḥ vartate sveṣu vartmasu
tasmāt daṇḍa mūlāḥ tisraḥ vidyāḥ
vinaya mūlaḥ daṇḍaḥ prāṇabhṛtām yogakṣema āvahaḥ
kṛtakaḥ svābhāvikaḥ ca vinayaḥ
kriyā hi dravyam vinayati na adravyam
śuśrūṣā śravaṇa grahaṇa dhāraṇa vijñāna ūha apoha tattva abhiniviṣṭa buddhim vidyā vinayati na itaram
vidyānām tu yathāsvam ācārya prāmāṇyāt vinayaḥ niyamaḥ ca
vṛtta caula karmā lipim saṃkhyānam ca upayuñjīta vṛtta upanayanaḥ trayīm ānvīkṣikīm ca śiṣṭebhyaḥ vārttām adhyakṣebhyaḥ daṇḍanītim vaktṛ prayoktṛbhyaḥ
brahmacaryam ca ṣoḍaśāt varṣāt
atas godānam dārakarma ca asya
nityaḥ ca vidyā vṛddha saṃyogaḥ vinaya vṛddhi artham tad mūla tvāt vinayasya
pūrvam ahar bhāgam hasti aśva ratha praharaṇa vidyāsu vinayam gacchet paścimam itihāsa śravaṇe
purāṇam itivṛttam ākhyāyikā udāharaṇam dharmaśāstram arthaśāstram ca iti itihāsaḥ
śeṣam ahorātra bhāgam apūrva grahaṇam gṛhīta paricayam ca kuryāt a gṛhītānām ābhīkṣṇya śravaṇam ca
śrutāt hi prajñā upajāyate prajñāyāḥ yogaḥ yogāt ātmavat tā iti vidyānām sāmarthyam
vidyā vinītaḥ rājā hi prajānām vinaye rataḥ
ananyām pṛthivīm bhuṅkte sarva bhūta hite rataḥ
vidyā vinayahetur indriyajayaḥ kāmakrodhalobhamānamadaharṣatyāgāt kāryaḥ
karṇatvagakṣijihvāghrāṇendriyāṇāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandheṣvavipratipattir indriyajayaḥ śāstrānuṣṭhānaṃ vā
kṛtsnaṃ hi śāstram idam indriyajayaḥ
tadviruddhavṛttir avaśyendriyaś cāturanto api rājā sadyo vinaśyati
yathā dāṇḍakyo nāma bhojaḥ kāmād brāhmaṇakanyām abhimanyamānaḥ sabandhurāṣṭro vinanāśa karālaśca vaidehaḥ
kopājjanamejayo brāhmaṇeṣu vikrāntaḥ tālajaṅghaśca bhṛguṣu
lobhād ailaścāturvarṇyam atyāhārayamāṇaḥ sauvīraścājabinduḥ
mānād rāvaṇaḥ paradārān aprayacchan duryodhano rājyād aṃśaṃ ca
madād dambhodbhavo bhūtāvamānī haihayaścārjunaḥ
harṣād vātāpir agastyam atyāsādayan vṛṣṇisaṃghaśca dvaipāyanam iti
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ śatruṣaḍvargam āśritāḥ
sabandhurāṣṭrā rājāno vineśur ajitendriyāḥ
śatruṣaḍvargam utsṛjya jāmadagnyo jitendriyaḥ
ambarīṣaśca nābhāgo bubhujāte ciraṃ mahīm
tasmāt ari ṣaḍvarga tyāgena indriya jayam kurvīta vṛddha saṃyogena prajñām cāreṇa cakṣuḥ utthānena yogakṣema sādhanam kārya anuśāsanena svadharma sthāpanam vinayam vidyā upadeśena loka priya tvam artha saṃyogena hitena vṛttim
evam vaśya indriyaḥ para strī dravya hiṃsāḥ ca varjayet svapnam laulyam anṛtam uddhata veṣa tvam anarthya saṃyogam adharma saṃyuktam anartha saṃyuktam ca vyavahāram
dharma artha avirodhena kāmam seveta
na niḥsukhaḥ syāt
samam _ trivargam anyonya anubaddham
ekaḥ hi _ āsevitaḥ dharma artha kāmānām ātmānam itarau ca pīḍayati
arthaḥ eva pradhānaḥ iti kauṭilyaḥ artha mūlau hi dharma kāmau iti
maryādām sthāpayet ācāryān amātyān _ ye enam apāya sthānebhyaḥ vārayeyuḥ chāyā nālikā pratodena _ rahasi pramādyantam abhitudeyuḥ
sahāya sādhyam rāja tvam
cakram ekam na vartate
kurvīta sacivān tasmāt
teṣām ca śṛṇuyāt matam
sahādhyāyinaḥ amātyān kurvīta dṛṣṭa śauca sāmarthya tvāt iti bhāradvājaḥ te hi asya viśvāsyāḥ bhavanti iti
na iti viśālākṣaḥ saha krīḍita tvāt paribhavanti enam ye hi asya guhya sadharmāṇaḥ tān amātyān kurvīta samāna śīla vyasana tvāt te hi asya marma jña bhayāt na aparādhyanti iti
sādhāraṇaḥ eṣa doṣaḥ iti pārāśarāḥ
teṣām api marma jña bhayāt kṛta a kṛtāni anuvarteta
yāvadbhyaḥ guhyam ācaṣṭe janebhyaḥ puruṣa adhipaḥ avaśaḥ karmaṇā tena vaśyaḥ bhavati tāvatām
ye enam āpatsu prāṇa ābādha yuktāsu anugṛhṇīyuḥ tān amātyān kurvīta dṛṣṭa anurāga tvāt iti
na iti piśunaḥ bhaktiḥ eṣā na buddhi guṇaḥ saṃkhyāta artheṣu karmasu niyuktāḥ ye yathā ādiṣṭam artham sa viśeṣam _ kuryuḥ tān amātyān kurvīta dṛṣṭa guṇa tvāt iti
na iti kauṇapadantaḥ
anyaiḥ amātya guṇaiḥ a yuktāḥ hi ete
pitṛpaitāmahān amātyān kurvīta dṛṣṭa avadāna tvāt te hi enam apacarantam api na tyajanti sagandha tvāt a mānuṣeṣu api ca etat dṛśyate gāvaḥ hi a sagandham go gaṇam atikramya sagandheṣu eva avatiṣṭhante iti
na iti vātavyādhiḥ te hi asya sarvam avagṛhya svāmi vat pracaranti tasmāt nīti vidaḥ navān amātyān kurvīta navāḥ tu yama sthāne daṇḍadharam manyamānāḥ na aparādhyanti iti
na iti bāhudanti putraḥ śāstra vid a dṛṣṭa karmā karmasu viṣādam gacchet tasmāt abhijana prajñā śauca śaurya anurāga yuktān amātyān kurvīta guṇa prādhānyāt iti
sarvam upapannam iti kauṭilyaḥ
kārya sāmarthyāt hi puruṣa sāmarthyam kalpyate
sāmarthyāt ca vibhajya amātya vibhavam deśa kālau ca karma ca amātyāḥ sarve eva ete kāryāḥ syuḥ na tu mantriṇaḥ
jānapado 'bhijātaḥ svavagrahaḥ kṛtaśilpaścakṣuṣmān prājño dhārayiṣṇur dakṣo vāgmī pragalbhaḥ pratipattimān utsāhaprabhāvayuktaḥ kleśasahaḥ śucir maitro dṛḍhabhaktiḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayuktaḥ stambhacāpalahīnaḥ sampriyo vairāṇām akartetyamātyasampat
ataḥ pādārdhaguṇahīnau madhyamāvarau
teṣāṃ janapadabhijanam avagrahaṃ cāptataḥ parīkṣeta samānavidyebhyaḥ śilpaṃ śāstracakṣuṣmattāṃ ca karmārambheṣu prajñāṃ dhārayiṣṇutāṃ dākṣyaṃ ca kathāyogeṣu vāgmitvaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ pratibhānavattvaṃ ca saṃvāsibhyaḥ śīlabalārogyasattvayogam astambham acāpalaṃ ca pratyakṣataḥ sampriyatvam avairatvaṃ ca
pratyakṣaparokṣānumeyā hi rājavṛttiḥ
svayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣam
paropadiṣṭaṃ parokṣam
karmasu kṛtenākṛtāvekṣaṇam anumeyam
yaugapadyāt tu karmaṇām anekatvād anekasthatvācca deśakālātyayo mā bhūd iti parokṣam amātyaiḥ kārayedityamātyakarma
purohitam uditoditakulaśīlaṃ sāṅge vede daive nimitte daṇḍanītyāṃ cābhivinītam āpadāṃ daivamānuṣīṇām atharvabhir upāyaiśca pratikartāraṃ kurvīta
tam ācāryaṃ śiṣyaḥ pitaraṃ putro bhṛtyaḥ svāminam iva cānuvarteta
brāhmaṇenaidhitaṃ kṣatraṃ mantrimantrābhimantritam
jayatyajitam atyantaṃ śāstrānugamaśastritam
mantripurohitasakhaḥ sāmānyeṣvadhikaraṇeṣu sthāpayitvāmātyān upadhābhiḥ śodhayet
purohitam ayājyayājanādhyāpane niyuktam amṛṣyamāṇaṃ rājāvakṣipet
sa sattribhiḥ śapathapūrvam ekaikam amātyam upajāpayet adhārmiko 'yaṃ rājā sādhu dhārmikam anyam asya tatkulīnam aparuddhaṃ kulyam ekapragrahaṃ sāmantam āṭavikam aupapādikaṃ vā pratipādayāmaḥ sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti
pratyākhyāne śuciḥ
iti dharmopadhā
senāpatir asatpragraheṇāvakṣiptaḥ sattribhir ekaikam amātyam upajāpayet lobhanīyenārthena rājavināśāya sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti
ityarthopadhā
parivrājikā labdhaviśvāsāntaḥpure kṛtasatkārā mahāmātram ekaikam upajapet rājamahiṣī tvāṃ kāmayate kṛtasamāgamopāyā mahān arthaśca te bhaviṣyati iti
iti kāmopadhā
prahavaṇanimittam eko 'mātyaḥ sarvān amātyān āvāhayet
tenodvegena rājā tān avarundhyāt
kāpaṭikaścātra pūrvāvaruddhasteṣām arthamānāvakṣiptam ekaikam amātyam upajapet asatpravṛtto 'yaṃ rājā sādhvenaṃ hatvānyaṃ pratipādayāmaḥ sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti
iti bhayopadhā
tatra dharmopadhāśuddhān dharmasthīyakaṇṭakaśodhaneṣu karmasu sthāpayet arthopadhāśuddhān samāhartṛsaṃnidhātṛnicayakarmasu kāmopadhāśuddhān bāhyābhyantaravihārarakṣāsu bhayopadhāśuddhān āsannakāryeṣu rājñaḥ
sarvopadhāśuddhān mantriṇaḥ kuryāt
sarvatrāśucīn khanidravyahastivanakarmānteṣu upayojayet
trivargabhayasaṃśuddhān amātyān sveṣu karmasu
adhikuryād yathā śaucam ityācāryā vyavasthitāḥ
na tveva kuryād ātmānaṃ devīṃ vā lakṣyam īśvaraḥ
śaucahetor amātyānām etat kauṭilyadarśanam
na dūṣaṇam aduṣṭasya viṣeṇevāmbhasaścaret
kadāciddhi praduṣṭasya nādhigamyeta bheṣajam
kṛtā ca kaluṣā buddhir upadhābhiścaturvidhā
nāgatvāntaṃ nivarteta sthitā sattvavatāṃ dhṛtau
tasmād bāhyam adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtvā kārye caturvidhe
śaucāśaucam amātyānāṃ rājā mārgeta sattribhiḥ
upadhābhiḥ śuddhāmātyavargo gūḍhapuruṣān utpādayet kāpaṭikodāsthitagṛhapatikavaidehakatāpasavyañjanān sattritīkṣṇarasadabhikṣukīśca
paramarmajñaḥ pragalbhaśchāttraḥ kāpaṭikaḥ
tam arthamānābhyāṃ protsāhya mantrī brūyāt rājānaṃ māṃ ca pramāṇaṃ kṛtvā yasya yad akuśalaṃ paśyasi tat tadānīm eva pratyādiśa iti
pravrajyāpratyavasitaḥ prajñāśaucayukta udāsthitaḥ
sa vārttākarmapradiṣṭāyāṃ bhūmau prabhūtahiraṇyāntevāsī karma kārayet
karmaphalācca sarvapravrajitānāṃ grāsācchādanāvasathān pratividadhyāt
vṛttikāmāṃścopajapet etenaiva veṣeṇa rājārthaścaritavyo bhaktavetanakāle copasthātavyam iti
sarvapravrajitāśca svaṃ svaṃ vargam evam upajapeyuḥ
karṣako vṛttikṣīṇaḥ prajñāśaucayukto gṛhapatikavyañjanaḥ
sa kṛṣikarmapradiṣṭāyāṃ bhūmau iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
vāṇijako vṛttikṣīṇaḥ prajñāśaucayukto vaidehakavyañjanaḥ
sa vaṇikkarmapradiṣṭāyāṃ bhūmau iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
muṇḍo jaṭilo vā vṛttikāmastāpasavyañjanaḥ
sa nagarābhyāśe prabhūtamuṇḍajaṭilāntevāsī śākaṃ yavamuṣṭiṃ vā māsadvimāsāntaraṃ prakāśam aśnīyāt gūḍham iṣṭam āhāram
vaidehakāntevāsinaścainaṃ samiddhayogair arcayeyuḥ
śiṣyāścāsyāvedayeyuḥ asau siddhaḥ sāmedhikaḥ iti
samedhāśāstibhiścābhigatānām aṅgavidyayā śiṣyasaṃjñābhiśca karmāṇyabhijane avasitānyādiśet alpalābham agnidāhaṃ corabhayaṃ dūṣyavadhaṃ tuṣṭidānaṃ videśapravṛttijñānam idam adya śvo vā bhaviṣyati idaṃ vā rājā kariṣyati iti
tad asya gūḍhāḥ sattriṇaśca sampādayeyuḥ
sattvaprajñāvākyaśaktisampannānāṃ rājabhāgyam anuvyāharenmantrisaṃyogaṃ ca brūyāt
mantrī caiṣāṃ vṛttikarmabhyāṃ viyateta
ye ca kāraṇād abhikruddhāstān arthamānābhyāṃ śamayet akāraṇakruddhāṃstūṣṇīṃ daṇḍena rājadviṣṭakāriṇaśca
pūjitāścārthamānābhyāṃ rājñā rājopajīvinām
jānīyuḥ śaucam ityetāḥ pañcasaṃsthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
ye cāpy asaṃbandhino 'vaśyabhartavyāste lakṣaṇam aṅgavidyāṃ jambhakavidyāṃ māyāgatam āśramadharmaṃ nimittam antaracakram ityadhīyānāḥ sattriṇaḥ saṃsargavidyāṃ ca
ye janapade śūrāstyaktātmāno hastinaṃ vyālaṃ vā dravyahetoḥ pratiyodhayeyuste tīkṣṇāḥ
ye bandhuṣu niḥsnehāḥ krūrā alasāśca te rasadāḥ
parivrājikā vṛttikāmā daridrā vidhavā pragalbhā brāhmaṇyantaḥpure kṛtasatkārā mahāmātrakulānyabhigacchet
etayā muṇḍā vṛṣalyo vyākhyātāḥ
tān rājā svaviṣaye mantripurohitasenāpatiyuvarājadauvārikāntarvaṃśikapraśāstṛsamāhartṛsaṃnidhātṛpradeṣṭṛnāyakapauravyāvahārikakārmāntikamantripariṣadadhyakṣadaṇḍadurgāntapālāṭavikeṣu śraddheyadeśaveṣaśilpabhāṣābhijanāpadeśān bhaktitaḥ sāmarthyayogāccāpasarpayet
teṣāṃ bāhyaṃ cāraṃ chattrabhṛṅgāravyajanapādukāsanayānavāhanopagrāhiṇas tīkṣṇā vidyuḥ
taṃ sattriṇaḥ saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ
sūdārālikasnāpakasaṃvāhakāstarakakalpakaprasādhakodakaparicārakā rasadāḥ kubjavāmanakirātamūkabadhirajaḍāndhacchadmāno naṭanartakagāyanavādakavāgjīvanakuśīlavāḥ striyaścābhyantaraṃ cāraṃ vidyuḥ
taṃ bhikṣukyaḥ saṃsthāsvarpayeyuḥ
saṃsthānām antevāsinaḥ saṃjñālipibhiścārasaṃcāraṃ kuryuḥ
na cānyonyaṃ saṃsthāste vā vidyuḥ
bhikṣukīpratiṣedhe dvāḥsthaparamparā mātāpitṛvyañjanāḥ śilpakārikāḥ kuśīlavā dāsyo vā gītapāṭhyavādyabhāṇḍagūḍhalekhyasaṃjñābhir vā cāraṃ nirhareyuḥ
dīrgharogonmādāgnirasavisargeṇa vā gūḍhanirgamanam
trayāṇām ekavākye sampratyayaḥ
teṣām abhīkṣṇavinipāte tūṣṇīṃdaṇḍaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
kaṇṭakaśodhanoktāścāpasarpāḥ pareṣu kṛtavetanā vaseyur asaṃpātinaścārārtham
ta ubhayavetanāḥ
gṛhītaputradārāṃśca kuryād ubhayavetanān
tāṃścāriprahitān vidyāt teṣāṃ śaucaṃ ca tadvidhaiḥ
evaṃ śatrau ca mitre ca madhyame cāvapeccarān
udāsīne ca teṣāṃ ca tīrtheṣvaṣṭādaśasvapi
antargṛhacarāsteṣāṃ kubjavāmanapaṇḍakāḥ
śilpavatyaḥ striyo mūkāścitrāśca mlecchajātayaḥ
durgeṣu vaṇijaḥ saṃsthā durgānte siddhatāpasāḥ
karṣakodāsthitā rāṣṭre rāṣṭrānte vrajavāsinaḥ
vane vanacarāḥ kāryāḥ śramaṇāṭavikādayaḥ
parapravṛttijñānārthāḥ śīghrāścāraparamparāḥ
parasya caite boddhavyāstādṛśair eva tādṛśāḥ
cārasaṃcāriṇaḥ saṃsthā gūḍhāścāgūḍhasaṃjñitāḥ
akṛtyān kṛtyapakṣīyair darśitān kāryahetubhiḥ
parāpasarpajñānārthaṃ mukhyān anteṣu vāsayet
kṛtamahāmātrāpasarpaḥ paurajānapadān apasarpayet
sattriṇo dvaṃdvinas tīrthasabhāpūgajanasamavāyeṣu vivādaṃ kuryuḥ
sarvaguṇasampannaścāyaṃ rājā śrūyate na cāsya kaścid guṇo dṛśyate yaḥ paurajānapadān daṇḍakarābhyāṃ pīḍayati iti
tatra ye 'nupraśaṃseyustān itarastaṃ ca pratiṣedhayet
mātsyanyāyābhibhūtāḥ prajā manuṃ vaivasvataṃ rājānaṃ cakrire
dhānyaṣaḍbhāgaṃ paṇyadaśabhāgaṃ hiraṇyaṃ cāsya bhāgadheyaṃ prakalpayāmāsuḥ
tena bhṛtā rājānaḥ prajānāṃ yogakṣemāvahāḥ
teṣāṃ kilbiṣam adaṇḍakarā harantyayogakṣemāvahāśca prajānām
tasmād uñchaṣaḍbhāgam āraṇyakāpi nirvapanti tasyaitad bhāgadheyaṃ yo 'smān gopāyati iti
indrayamasthānam etad rājānaḥ pratyakṣaheḍaprasādāḥ
tān avamanyamānān daivo 'pi daṇḍaḥ spṛśati
tasmād rājāno nāvamantavyāḥ
ityevaṃ kṣudrakān pratiṣedhayet
kiṃvadantīṃ ca vidyuḥ
ye cāsya dhānyapaśuhiraṇyānyājīvanti tair upakurvanti vyasane 'bhyudaye vā kupitaṃ bandhuṃ rāṣṭraṃ vā vyāvartayanti amitram āṭavikaṃ vā pratiṣedhayanti teṣāṃ muṇḍajaṭilavyañjanāstuṣṭātuṣṭatvaṃ vidyuḥ
tuṣṭān bhūyo 'rthamānābhyāṃ pūjayet
atuṣṭāṃstuṣṭihetostyāgena sāmnā ca prasādayet
parasparād vā bhedayed enān sāmantāṭavikatatkulīnāparuddhebhyaśca
tathāpyatuṣyato daṇḍakarasādhanādhikāreṇa janapadavidveṣaṃ grāhayet
vidviṣṭān upāṃśudaṇḍena janapadakopena vā sādhayet
guptaputradārān ākarakarmānteṣu vā vāsayet pareṣām āspadabhayāt
kruddhalubdhabhītamāninastu pareṣāṃ kṛtyāḥ
teṣāṃ kārtāntikanaimittikamauhūrtikavyañjanāḥ parasparābhisambandham amitrāṭavikasambandhaṃ vā vidyuḥ
tuṣṭān arthamānābhyāṃ pūjayet
atuṣṭān sāmadānabhedadaṇḍaiḥ sādhayet
evaṃ svaviṣaye kṛtyān akṛtyāṃśca vicakṣaṇaḥ
paropajāpāt saṃrakṣet pradhānān kṣudrakān api
kṛtyākṛtyapakṣopagrahaḥ svaviṣaye vyākhyātaḥ paraviṣaye vācyaḥ
saṃśrutyārthān vipralabdhaḥ tulyakāriṇoḥ śilpe vopakāre vā vimānitaḥ vallabhāvaruddhaḥ samāhūya parājitaḥ pravāsopataptaḥ kṛtvā vyayam alabdhakāryaḥ svadharmād dāyādyād voparuddhaḥ mānādhikārābhyāṃ bhraṣṭaḥ kulyair antarhitaḥ prasabhābhimṛṣṭastrīkaḥ kārābhinyastaḥ paroktadaṇḍitaḥ mithyācāravāritaḥ sarvasvam āhāritaḥ bandhanaparikliṣṭaḥ pravāsitabandhuḥ iti kruddhavargaḥ
svayam upahataḥ viprakṛtaḥ pāpakarmābhikhyātaḥ tulyadoṣadaṇḍenodvignaḥ paryāttabhūmiḥ daṇḍenopanataḥ sarvādhikaraṇasthaḥ sahasopacitārthaḥ tatkulīno vāśaṃsuḥ pradviṣṭo rājñā rājadveṣī ca iti bhītavargaḥ
parikṣīṇaḥ anyāttasvaḥ kadaryaḥ vyasanī atyāhitavyavahāraśca iti lubdhavargaḥ
ātmasaṃbhāvitaḥ mānakāmaḥ śatrupūjāmarṣitaḥ nīcair upahitaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ sāhasikaḥ bhogenāsaṃtuṣṭaḥ iti mānivargaḥ
teṣāṃ muṇḍajaṭilavyañjanair yo yadbhaktiḥ kṛtyapakṣīyastaṃ tenopajāpayet
yathā madāndho hastī mattenādhiṣṭhito yad yad āsādayati tat sarvaṃ pramṛdnāti evam ayam aśāstracakṣur andho rājā paurajānapadavadhāyābhyutthitaḥ śakyam asya pratihastiprotsāhanenāpakartum amarṣaḥ kriyatām iti kruddhavargam upajāpayet
yathā līnaḥ sarpo yasmād bhayaṃ paśyati tatra viṣam utsṛjati evam ayaṃ rājā jātadoṣāśaṅkastvayi purā krodhaviṣam utsṛjati anyatra gamyatām iti bhītavargam upajāpayet
yathā śvagaṇināṃ dhenuḥ śvabhyo duhyate na brāhmaṇebhyaḥ evam ayaṃ rājā sattvaprajñāvākyaśaktihīnebhyo duhyate nātmaguṇasampannebhyaḥ asau rājā puruṣaviśeṣajñaḥ tatra gamyatām iti lubdhavargam upajāpayet
yathā caṇḍālodapānaścaṇḍālānām evopabhogyo nānyeṣām evam ayaṃ rājā nīco nīcānām evopabhogyo na tvadvidhānām āryāṇām asau rājā puruṣaviśeṣajñaḥ tatra gamyatām iti mānivargam upajāpayet
tatheti pratipannāṃstān saṃhitān paṇakarmaṇā
yojayeta yathāśakti sāpasarpān svakarmasu
labheta sāmadānābhyāṃ kṛtyāṃśca parabhūmiṣu
akṛtyān bhedadaṇḍābhyāṃ paradoṣāṃśca darśayan
kṛtasvapakṣaparapakṣopagrahaḥ kāryārambhāṃścintayet
mantrapūrvāḥ sarvārambhāḥ
taduddeśaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ kathānām aniḥśrāvī pakṣibhir apyanālokyaḥ syāt
śrūyate hi śukasārikābhir mantro bhinnaḥ śvabhir apyanyaiśca tiryagyonibhir iti
tasmān mantroddeśam anāyukto nopagacchet
ucchidyeta mantrabhedī
mantrabhedo hi dūtāmātyasvāminām iṅgitākārābhyām
iṅgitam anyathāvṛttiḥ
ākṛtigrahaṇam ākāraḥ
tasya saṃvaraṇam āyuktapuruṣarakṣaṇam ā kāryakālād iti
teṣāṃ hi pramādamadasuptapralāpāḥ kāmādir utsekaḥ pracchanno 'vamato vā mantraṃ bhinatti
tasmād rakṣen mantram
mantrabhedo hyayogakṣemakaro rājñastadāyuktapuruṣāṇāṃ ca
tasmād guhyam eko mantrayeta iti bhāradvājaḥ
mantriṇām api hi mantriṇo bhavanti teṣām apyanye
saiṣā mantriparamparā mantraṃ bhinatti
tasmān nāsya pare vidyuḥ karma kiṃciccikīrṣitam
ārabdhārastu jānīyur ārabdhaṃ kṛtam eva vā
naikasya mantrasiddhir asti iti viśālākṣaḥ
anupalabdhasya jñānam upalabdhasya niścitabalādhānam arthadvaidhasya saṃśayacchedanam ekadeśadṛṣṭasya śeṣopalabdhir iti mantrisādhyam etat
tasmād buddhivṛddhaiḥ sārdham adhyāsīta mantram
na kaṃcid avamanyeta sarvasya śṛṇuyān matam
bālasyāpyarthavadvākyam upayuñjīta paṇḍitaḥ
etan mantrajñānam naitan mantrarakṣaṇam iti pārāśarāḥ
yad asya kāryam abhipretaṃ tatpratirūpakaṃ mantriṇaḥ pṛcchet kāryam idam evam āsīt evaṃ vā yadi bhavet tat kathaṃ kartavyam iti
te yathā brūyustat kuryāt
evaṃ mantropalabdhiḥ saṃvṛtiśca bhavati iti
neti piśunaḥ
mantriṇo hi vyavahitam arthaṃ vṛttam avṛttaṃ vā pṛṣṭā anādareṇa bruvanti prakāśayanti vā
sa doṣaḥ
tasmāt karmasu ye yeṣvabhipretāstaiḥ saha mantrayeta
tair mantrayamāṇo hi mantrasiddhiṃ guptiṃ ca labhate iti
neti kauṭilyaḥ
anavasthā hyeṣā
mantribhistribhiścaturbhir vā saha mantrayeta
mantrayamāṇo hyekenārthakṛcchreṣu niścayaṃ nādhigacchet
ekaśca mantrī yatheṣṭam anavagrahaścarati
dvābhyāṃ mantrayamāṇo dvābhyāṃ saṃhatābhyām avagṛhyate vigṛhītābhyāṃ vināśyate
tat triṣu caturṣu vā kṛcchreṇopapadyate
mahādoṣam upapannaṃ tu bhavati
tataḥ pareṣu kṛcchreṇārthaniścayo gamyate mantro vā rakṣyate
deśakālakāryavaśena tvekena saha dvābhyām eko vā yathāsāmarthyaṃ mantrayeta
karmaṇām ārambhopāyaḥ puruṣadravyasampad deśakālavibhāgo vinipātapratīkāraḥ kāryasiddhir iti pañcāṅgo mantraḥ
tān ekaikaśaḥ pṛcchet samastāṃśca
hetubhiścaiṣāṃ matipravivekān vidyāt
avāptārthaḥ kālaṃ nātikrāmayet
na dīrghakālaṃ mantrayeta na teṣāṃ pakṣīyair yeṣām apakuryāt
mantripariṣadaṃ dvādaśāmātyān kurvīta iti mānavāḥ
ṣoḍaśa iti bārhaspatyāḥ
viṃśatim ityauśanasāḥ
yathāsāmarthyam iti kauṭilyaḥ
te hyasya svapakṣaṃ parapakṣaṃ ca cintayeyuḥ
akṛtārambham ārabdhānuṣṭhānam anuṣṭhitaviśeṣaṃ niyogasampadaṃ ca karmaṇāṃ kuryuḥ
āsannaiḥ saha karmāṇi paśyet
anāsannaiḥ saha pattrasampreṣaṇena mantrayeta
indrasya hi mantripariṣadṛṣīṇāṃ sahasram
sa taccakṣuḥ
tasmād imaṃ dvyakṣaṃ sahasrākṣam āhuḥ
ātyayike kārye mantriṇo mantripariṣadaṃ cāhūya brūyāt
tatra yadbhūyiṣṭhā brūyuḥ kāryasiddhikaraṃ vā tat kuryāt
kurvataśca
nāsya guhyaṃ pare vidyuśchidraṃ vidyāt parasya ca
gūhet kūrmevāṅgāni yat syād vivṛtam ātmanaḥ
yathā hyaśrotriyaḥ śrāddhaṃ na satāṃ bhoktum arhati
evam aśrutaśāstrārtho na mantraṃ śrotum arhati
udvṛttamantro dūtapraṇidhiḥ
amātyasampadopeto nisṛṣṭārthaḥ
pādaguṇahīnaḥ parimitārthaḥ
ardhaguṇahīnaḥ śāsanaharaḥ
suprativihitayānavāhanapuruṣaparivāpaḥ pratiṣṭheta
śāsanam evaṃ vācyaḥ paraḥ sa vakṣyatyevam tasyedaṃ prativākyam evam atisaṃdhātavyam ityadhīyāno gacchet
aṭavyantapālapurarāṣṭramukhyaiśca pratisaṃsargaṃ gacchet
anīkasthānayuddhapratigrahāpasārabhūmīr ātmanaḥ parasya cāvekṣeta
durgarāṣṭrapramāṇaṃ sāravṛttigupticchidrāṇi copalabheta
parādhiṣṭhānam anujñātaḥ praviśet
śāsanaṃ ca yathoktaṃ brūyāt prāṇābādhe 'pi dṛṣṭe
parasya vāci vaktre dṛṣṭyāṃ ca prasādaṃ vākyapūjanam iṣṭaparipraśnaṃ guṇakathāsaṅgam āsannam āsanaṃ satkāram iṣṭeṣu smaraṇaṃ viśvāsagamanaṃ ca lakṣayet tuṣṭasya viparītam atuṣṭasya
taṃ brūyāt dūtamukhā hi rājānaḥ tvaṃ cānye ca
tasmād udyateṣvapi śastreṣu yathoktaṃ vaktāro dūtāḥ
teṣām antāvasāyino 'py avadhyāḥ kim aṅga punar brāhmaṇāḥ
parasyaitad vākyam
eṣa dūtadharmaḥ iti
vased avisṛṣṭaḥ pūjayā notsiktaḥ
pareṣu balitvaṃ na manyeta
vākyam aniṣṭaṃ saheta
striyaḥ pānaṃ ca varjayet
ekaḥ śayīta
suptamattayor hi bhāvajñānaṃ dṛṣṭam
kṛtyapakṣopajāpam akṛtyapakṣe gūḍhapraṇidhānaṃ rāgāparāgau bhartari randhraṃ ca prakṛtīnāṃ tāpasavaidehakavyañjanābhyām upalabheta tayor antevāsibhiścikitsakapāṣaṇḍavyañjanobhayavetanair vā
teṣām asaṃbhāṣāyāṃ yācakamattonmattasuptapralāpaiḥ puṇyasthānadevagṛhacitralekhyasaṃjñābhir vā cāram upalabheta
upalabdhasyopajāpam upeyāt
pareṇa coktaḥ svāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ nācakṣīta
sarvaṃ veda bhavān iti brūyāt kāryasiddhikaraṃ vā
kāryasyāsiddhāv uparudhyamānastarkayet kiṃ bhartur me vyasanam āsannaṃ paśyan svaṃ vā vyasanaṃ pratikartukāmaḥ pārṣṇigrāham āsāram antaḥkopam āṭavikaṃ vā samutthāpayitukāmaḥ mitram ākrandaṃ vā vyāghātayitukāmaḥ svaṃ vā parato vigraham antaḥkopam āṭavikaṃ vā pratikartukāmaḥ saṃsiddhaṃ vā me bhartur yātrākālam abhihantukāmaḥ sasyapaṇyakupyasaṃgrahaṃ durgakarma balasamuddhānaṃ vā kartukāmaḥ svasainyānāṃ vā vyāyāmasya deśakālāvākāṅkṣamāṇaḥ paribhavapramādābhyāṃ vā saṃsargānubandhārthī vā mām uparuṇaddhi iti
jñātvā vased apasared vā
prayojanam iṣṭam avekṣeta vā
śāsanam aniṣṭam uktvā bandhavadhabhayād avisṛṣṭo 'pyapagacchet anyathā niyamyeta
preṣaṇaṃ saṃdhipālatvaṃ pratāpo mitrasaṃgrahaḥ
upajāpaḥ suhṛdbhedo gūḍhadaṇḍātisāraṇam
bandhuratnāpaharaṇaṃ cārajñānaṃ parākramaḥ
samādhimokṣo dūtasya karma yogasya cāśrayaḥ
svadūtaiḥ kārayed etat paradūtāṃśca rakṣayet
pratidūtāpasarpābhyāṃ dṛśyādṛśyaiśca rakṣibhiḥ
rakṣito rājā rājyaṃ rakṣatyāsannebhyaḥ parebhyaśca pūrvaṃ dārebhyaḥ putrebhyaśca
dārarakṣaṇaṃ niśāntapraṇidhau vakṣyāmaḥ
putrarakṣaṇaṃ tu
janmaprabhṛti rājaputrān rakṣet
karkaṭakasadharmāṇo hi janakabhakṣā rājaputrāḥ
teṣām ajātasnehe pitaryupāṃśudaṇḍaḥ śreyān iti bhāradvājaḥ
nṛśaṃsam aduṣṭavadhaḥ kṣatrabījavināśaśca iti viśālākṣaḥ
tasmād ekasthānāvarodhaḥ śreyān iti
ahibhayam etad iti pārāśarāḥ
kumāro hi vikramabhayān māṃ pitāvaruṇaddhi iti jñātvā tam evāṅke kuryāt
tasmād antapāladurge vāsaḥ śreyān iti
aurabhraṃ bhayam etad iti piśunaḥ
pratyāpatter hi tad eva kāraṇaṃ jñātvāntapālasakhaḥ syāt
tasmāt svaviṣayād apakṛṣṭe sāmantadurge vāsaḥ śreyān iti
vatsasthānam etad iti kauṇapadantaḥ
vatseneva hi dhenuṃ pitaram asya sāmanto duhyāt
tasmān mātṛbandhuṣu vāsaḥ śreyān iti
dhvajasthānam etad iti vātavyādhiḥ
tena hi dhvajenāditikauśikavad asya mātṛbāndhavā bhikṣeran
tasmād grāmyasukheṣvenam avasṛjet
sukhoparuddhā hi putrāḥ pitaraṃ nābhidruhyanti iti
jīvanmaraṇam etad iti kauṭilyaḥ
kāṣṭham iva ghuṇajagdhaṃ rājakulam avinītaputram abhiyuktamātraṃ bhajyeta
tasmād ṛtumatyāṃ mahiṣyām ṛtvijaścarum aindrābārhaspatyaṃ nirvapeyuḥ
āpannasattvāyāḥ kaumārabhṛtyo garbhabharmaṇi prasave ca viyateta
prajātāyāḥ putrasaṃskāraṃ purohitaḥ kuryāt
samarthaṃ tadvido vinayeyuḥ
sattriṇām ekaścainaṃ mṛgayādyūtamadyastrībhiḥ pralobhayet pitari vikramya rājyaṃ gṛhāṇa iti
tam anyaḥ sattrī pratiṣedhayet ityāmbhīyāḥ
mahādoṣam abuddhabodhanam iti kauṭilyaḥ
navaṃ hi dravyaṃ yena yenārthajātenopadihyate tat tad ācūṣati
evam ayaṃ navabuddhir yad yad ucyate tat tatśāstropadeśam ivābhijānāti
tasmād dharmyam arthyaṃ cāsyopadiśen nādharmyam anarthyaṃ ca
sattriṇastvenaṃ tava smaḥ iti vadantaḥ pālayeyuḥ
yauvanotsekāt parastrīṣu manaḥ kurvāṇam āryāvyañjanābhiḥ strībhir amedhyābhiḥ śūnyāgāreṣu rātrāv udvejayeyuḥ
madyakāmaṃ yogapānenodvejayeyuḥ
dyūtakāmaṃ kāpaṭikair udvejayeyuḥ
mṛgayākāmaṃ pratirodhakavyañjanaistrāsayeyuḥ
pitari vikramabuddhiṃ tathā ityanupraviśya bhedayeyuḥ aprārthanīyo rājā vipanne ghātaḥ sampanne narakapātaḥ saṃkrośaḥ prajābhir ekaloṣṭavadhaśca iti
virāgaṃ vedayeyuḥ
priyam ekaputraṃ badhnīyāt
bahuputraḥ pratyantam anyaviṣayaṃ vā preṣayed yatra garbhaḥ paṇyaṃ ḍimbo vā na bhavet
ātmasampannaṃ saināpatye yauvarājye vā sthāpayet
buddhimānāhāryabuddhir durbuddhir iti putraviśeṣāḥ
śiṣyamāṇo dharmārthāv upalabhate cānutiṣṭhati ca buddhimān
upalabhamāno nānutiṣṭhatyāhāryabuddhiḥ
apāyanityo dharmārthadveṣī ceti durbuddhiḥ
sa yadyekaputraḥ putrotpattāvasya prayateta
putrikāputrān utpādayed vā
vṛddhastu vyādhito vā rājā mātṛbandhukulyaguṇavatsāmantānām anyatamena kṣetre bījam utpādayet
na caikaputram avinītaṃ rājye sthāpayet
bahūnām ekasaṃrodhaḥ pitā putrahito bhavet
anyatrāpada aiśvaryaṃ jyeṣṭhabhāgi tu pūjyate
kulasya vā bhaved rājyaṃ kulasaṃgho hi durjayaḥ
arājavyasanābādhaḥ śaśvad āvasati kṣitim
vinīto rājaputraḥ kṛcchravṛttir asadṛśe karmaṇi niyuktaḥ pitaram anuvarteta anyatra prāṇabādhakaprakṛtikopakapātakebhyaḥ
puṇye karmaṇi niyuktaḥ puruṣam adhiṣṭhātāraṃ yācet
puruṣādhiṣṭhitaśca saviśeṣam ādeśam anutiṣṭhet
abhirūpaṃ ca karmaphalam aupāyanikaṃ ca lābhaṃ pitur upanāyayet
tathāpyatuṣyantam anyasmin putre dāreṣu vā snihyantam araṇyāyāpṛccheta
bandhavadhabhayād vā yaḥ sāmanto nyāyavṛttir dhārmikaḥ satyavāgavisaṃvādakaḥ pratigrahītā mānayitā cābhipannānāṃ tam āśrayeta
tatrasthaḥ kośadaṇḍasampannaḥ pravīrapuruṣakanyāsambandham aṭavīsambandhaṃ kṛtyapakṣopagrahaṃ ca kuryāt
ekacaraḥ suvarṇapākamaṇirāgahemarūpyapaṇyākarakarmāntān ājīvet
pāṣaṇḍasaṃghadravyam aśrotriyopabhogyaṃ vā devadravyam āḍhyavidhavādravyaṃ vā gūḍham anupraviśya sārthayānapātrāṇi ca madanarasayogenātisaṃdhāyāpaharet
pāragrāmikaṃ vā yogam ātiṣṭhet
mātuḥ parijanopagraheṇa vā ceṣṭeta
kāruśilpikuśīlavacikitsakavāgjīvanapāṣaṇḍacchadmabhir vā naṣṭarūpastadvyañjanasakhaśchidreṣu praviśya rājñaḥ śastrarasābhyāṃ prahṛtya brūyāt aham asau kumāraḥ sahabhogyam idaṃ rājyam eko nārhati bhoktum ye kāmayante māṃ bhartuṃ tān ahaṃ dviguṇena bhaktavetanenopasthāsyāmi iti
ityaparuddhavṛttam
aparuddhaṃ tu mukhyaputrāpasarpāḥ pratipādyānayeyuḥ mātā vā pratigṛhītā
tyaktaṃ gūḍhapuruṣāḥ śastrarasābhyāṃ hanyuḥ
atyaktaṃ tulyaśīlābhiḥ strībhiḥ pānena mṛgayayā vā prasañjayitvā rātrāv upagṛhyānayeyuḥ
upasthitaṃ ca rājyena madūrdhvam iti sāntvayet
ekastham atha saṃrundhyāt putravāṃstu pravāsayet
rājānam utthitam anūttiṣṭhante bhṛtyāḥ
pramādyantam anupramādyanti
karmāṇi cāsya bhakṣayanti
dviṣadbhiścātisaṃdhīyate
tasmād utthānam ātmanaḥ kurvīta
nālikābhir ahar aṣṭadhā rātriṃ ca vibhajet chāyāpramāṇena vā
tripauruṣī pauruṣī caturaṅgulā naṣṭacchāyo madhyāhneti catvāraḥ pūrve divasasyāṣṭabhāgāḥ
taiḥ paścimā vyākhyātāḥ
tatra pūrve divasasyāṣṭabhāge rakṣāvidhānam āyavyayau ca śṛṇuyāt
dvitīye paurajānapadānāṃ kāryāṇi paśyet
tṛtīye snānabhojanaṃ seveta svādhyāyaṃ ca kurvīta
caturthe hiraṇyapratigraham adhyakṣāṃśca kurvīta
pañcame mantripariṣadā pattrasampreṣaṇena mantrayeta cāraguhyabodhanīyāni ca budhyeta
ṣaṣṭhe svairavihāraṃ mantraṃ vā seveta
saptame hastyaśvarathāyudhīyān paśyet
aṣṭame senāpatisakho vikramaṃ cintayet
pratiṣṭhite 'hani saṃdhyām upāsīta
prathame rātribhāge gūḍhapuruṣān paśyet
dvitīye snānabhojanaṃ kurvīta svādhyāyaṃ ca
tṛtīye tūryaghoṣeṇa saṃviṣṭaścaturthapañcamau śayīta
ṣaṣṭhe tūryaghoṣeṇa pratibuddhaḥ śāstram itikartavyatāṃ ca cintayet
saptame mantram adhyāsīta gūḍhapuruṣāṃśca preṣayet
aṣṭame ṛtvigācāryapurohitasvastyayanāni pratigṛhṇīyāt cikitsakamāhānasikamauhūrtikāṃśca paśyet
savatsāṃ dhenuṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca pradakṣiṇīkṛtyopasthānaṃ gacchet
ātmabalānukūlyena vā niśāharbhāgān pravibhajya kāryāṇi seveta
upasthānagataḥ kāryārthinām advārāsaṅgaṃ kārayet
durdarśo hi rājā kāryākāryaviparyāsam āsannaiḥ kāryate
tena prakṛtikopam arivaśaṃ vā gacchet
tasmād devatāśramapāṣaṇḍaśrotriyapaśupuṇyasthānānāṃ bālavṛddhavyādhitavyasanyanāthānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca krameṇa kāryāṇi paśyet kāryagauravād ātyayikavaśena vā
sarvam ātyayikaṃ kāryaṃ śṛṇuyān nātipātayet
kṛcchrasādhyam atikrāntam asādhyaṃ vāpi jāyate
agnyagāragataḥ kāryaṃ paśyed vaidyatapasvinām
purohitācāryasakhaḥ pratyutthāyābhivādya ca
tapasvināṃ tu kāryāṇi traividyaiḥ saha kārayet
māyāyogavidāṃ caiva na svayaṃ kopakāraṇāt
rājño hi vratam utthānaṃ yajñaḥ kāryānuśāsanam
dakṣiṇā vṛttisāmyaṃ tu dīkṣā tasyābhiṣecanam
prajāsukhe sukhaṃ rājñaḥ prajānāṃ ca hite hitam
nātmapriyaṃ hitaṃ rājñaḥ prajānāṃ tu priyaṃ hitam
tasmān nityotthito rājā kuryād arthānuśāsanam
arthasya mūlam utthānam anarthasya viparyayaḥ
anutthāne dhruvo nāśaḥ prāptasyānāgatasya ca
prāpyate phalam utthānāllabhate cārthasampadam
vāstukapraśaste deśe saprākāraparikhādvāram anekakakṣyāparigatam antaḥpuraṃ kārayet
kośagṛhavidhānena madhye vāsagṛham gūḍhabhittisaṃcāraṃ mohanagṛhaṃ tanmadhye vā vāsagṛham bhūmigṛhaṃ vāsannacaityakāṣṭhadevatāpidhānadvāram anekasuruṅgāsaṃcāraṃ tasyopari prāsādaṃ gūḍhabhittisopānaṃ suṣirastambhapraveśāpasāraṃ vā vāsagṛhaṃ yantrabaddhatalāvapātaṃ kārayet āpatpratīkārārtham āpadi vā
ato 'nyathā vā vikalpayet sahādhyāyibhayāt
mānuṣeṇāgninā trir apasavyaṃ parigatam antaḥpuram agnir anyo na dahati na cātrānyo 'gnir jvalati vaidyutena bhasmanā mṛtsaṃyuktena karakavāriṇāvaliptaṃ ca
jīvantīśvetāmuṣkakapuṣpavandākābhir akṣīve jātasyāśvatthasya pratānena guptaṃ sarpā viṣāṇi vā na prabhavanti
mayūranakulapṛṣatotsargaḥ sarpān bhakṣayati
śukaḥ sārikā bhṛṅgarājo vā sarpaviṣaśaṅkāyāṃ krośati
krauñco viṣābhyāśe mādyati glāyati jīvaṃjīvakaḥ mriyate mattakokilaḥ cakorasyākṣiṇī virajyete
ityevam agniviṣasarpebhyaḥ pratikurvīta
pṛṣṭhataḥ kakṣyāvibhāge strīniveśo garbhavyādhisaṃsthā vṛkṣodakasthānaṃ ca
bahiḥ kanyākumārapuram
purastād alaṅkārabhūmir mantrabhūmir upasthānaṃ kumārādhyakṣasthānaṃ ca
kakṣyāntareṣvantarvaṃśikasainyaṃ tiṣṭhet
antargṛhagataḥ sthavirastrīpariśuddhāṃ devīṃ paśyet
devīgṛhe līno hi bhrātā bhadrasenaṃ jaghāna mātuḥ śayyāntargataśca putraḥ kārūṣam
lājān madhuneti viṣeṇa paryasya devī kāśirājam viṣadigdhena nūpureṇa vairantyam mekhalāmaṇinā sauvīram jālūtham ādarśena veṇyāṃ gūḍhaṃ śastraṃ kṛtvā devī vidūrathaṃ jaghāna
tasmād etānyāspadāni pariharet
muṇḍajaṭilakuhakapratisaṃsargaṃ bāhyābhiśca dāsībhiḥ pratiṣedhayet
na caināḥ kulyāḥ paśyeyuḥ anyatra garbhavyādhisaṃsthābhyaḥ
rūpājīvāḥ snānapragharṣaśuddhaśarīrāḥ parivartitavastrālaṃkārāḥ paśyeyuḥ
aśītikāḥ puruṣāḥ pañcāśatkāḥ striyo vā mātāpitṛvyañjanāḥ sthaviravarṣadharābhyāgārikāścāvarodhānāṃ śaucāśaucaṃ vidyuḥ sthāpayeyuśca svāmihite
svabhūmau ca vaset sarvaḥ parabhūmau na saṃcaret
na ca bāhyena saṃsargaṃ kaścid ābhyantaro vrajet
sarvaṃ cāvekṣitaṃ dravyaṃ nibaddhāgamanirgamam
nirgacched abhigacched vā mudrāsaṃkrāntabhūmikam
śayanād utthitaḥ strīgaṇair dhanvibhiḥ parigṛhyate dvitīyasyāṃ kakṣyāyāṃ kaṃcukoṣṇīṣibhir varṣadharābhyāgārikaiḥ tṛtīyasyāṃ kubjavāmanakirātaiḥ caturthyāṃ mantribhiḥ sambandhibhir dauvārikaiśca prāsapāṇibhiḥ
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ sambandhānubaddhaṃ śikṣitam anuraktaṃ kṛtakarmāṇaṃ ca janam āsannaṃ kurvīta nānyatodeśīyam akṛtārthamānaṃ svadeśīyaṃ vāpyapakṛtyopagṛhītam
antarvaṃśikasainyaṃ rājānam antaḥpuraṃ ca rakṣet
gupte deśe māhānasikaḥ sarvam āsvādabāhulyena karma kārayet
tad rājā tathaiva pratibhuñjīta pūrvam agnaye vayobhyaśca baliṃ kṛtvā
agner jvālādhūmanīlatā śabdasphoṭanaṃ ca viṣayuktasya vayasāṃ vipattiśca
annasya ūṣmā mayūragrīvābhaḥ śaityam āśu kliṣṭasyeva vaivarṇyaṃ saudakatvam aklinnatvaṃ ca vyañjanānām āśu śuṣkatvaṃ ca kvāthadhyāmaphenapaṭalavicchinnabhāvo gandhasparśarasavadhaśca draveṣu hīnātiriktacchāyādarśanaṃ phenapaṭalasīmantordhvarājīdarśanaṃ ca rasasya madhye nīlā rājī payasastāmrā madyatoyayoḥ kālī dadhnaḥ śyāmā madhunaḥ śvetā dravyāṇām ārdrāṇām āśu pramlānatvam utpakvabhāvaḥ kvāthanīlaśyāvatā ca śuṣkāṇām āśu śātanaṃ vaivarṇyaṃ ca kaṭhinānāṃ mṛdutvaṃ mṛdūnāṃ ca kaṭhinatvam tadabhyāśe kṣudrasattvavadhaśca āstaraṇaprāvaraṇānāṃ dhyāmamaṇḍalatā tanturomapakṣmaśātanaṃ ca lohamaṇimayānāṃ paṅkamalopadehatā sneharāgagauravaprabhāvavarṇasparśavadhaśca iti viṣayuktasya liṅgāni
viṣapradasya tu śuṣkaśyāvavaktratā vāksaṅgaḥ svedo vijṛmbhaṇaṃ cātimātraṃ vepathuḥ praskhalanaṃ vākyaviprekṣaṇam āvegaḥ karmaṇi svabhūmau cānavasthānam iti
tasmād asya jāṅgulīvido bhiṣajaścāsannāḥ syuḥ
bhiṣagbhaiṣajyāgārād āsvādaviśuddham auṣadhaṃ gṛhītvā pācakapeṣakābhyām ātmanā ca pratisvādya rājñe prayacchet
pānaṃ pānīyaṃ cauṣadhena vyākhyātam
kalpakaprasādhakāḥ snānaśuddhavastrahastāḥ samudram upakaraṇam antarvaṃśikahastād ādāya paricareyuḥ
snāpakasaṃvāhakāstarakarajakamālākārakarma dāsyaḥ prasiddhaśaucāḥ kuryuḥ tābhir adhiṣṭhitā vā śilpinaḥ
ātmacakṣuṣi niveśya vastramālyaṃ dadyuḥ snānānulepanapragharṣacūrṇavāsasnānīyāni ca svavakṣobāhuṣu ca
etena parasmād āgatakaṃ vyākhyātam
kuśīlavāḥ śastrāgnirasakrīḍāvarjaṃ narmayeyuḥ
ātodyāni caiṣām antastiṣṭheyuḥ aśvarathadvipālaṃkārāśca
āptapuruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ yānavāhanam ārohet nāvaṃ cāptanāvikādhiṣṭhitam
anyanaupratibaddhāṃ vātavegavaśāṃ ca nopeyāt
udakānte sainyam āsīta
matsyagrāhaviśuddham udakam avagāheta
vyālagrāhaviśuddham udyānaṃ gacchet
lubdhakaśvagaṇibhir apāstastenavyālaparābādhabhayaṃ calalakṣyaparicayārthaṃ mṛgāraṇyaṃ gacchet
āptaśastragrāhādhiṣṭhitaḥ siddhatāpasaṃ paśyenmantripariṣadā saha sāmantadūtam
saṃnaddho 'śvaṃ hastinaṃ vārūḍhaḥ saṃnaddham anīkaṃ paśyet
niryāṇe 'bhiyāne ca rājamārgam ubhayataḥ kṛtārakṣaṃ śastribhir daṇḍibhiścāpāstaśastrahastapravrajitavyaṅgaṃ gacchet
na puruṣasambādham avagāheta
yātrāsamājotsavapravahaṇāni ca daśavargikādhiṣṭhitāni gacchet
yathā ca yogapuruṣair anyān rājādhitiṣṭhati
tathāyam anyābādhebhyo rakṣed ātmānam ātmavān
bhūtapūrvam abhūtapūrvaṃ vā janapadaṃ paradeśāpavāhanena svadeśābhiṣyandavamanena vā niveśayet
śūdrakarṣakaprāyaṃ kulaśatāvaraṃ pañcakulaśataparaṃ grāmaṃ krośadvikrośasīmānam anyonyārakṣaṃ niveśayet
nadīśailavanabhṛṣṭidarīsetubandhaśamīśālmalīkṣīravṛkṣān anteṣu sīmnāṃ sthāpayet
aṣṭaśatagrāmyā madhye sthānīyam catuḥśatagrāmyā droṇamukham dviśatagrāmyāḥ kārvaṭikam daśagrāmīsaṃgraheṇa saṃgrahaṃ sthāpayet
anteṣvantapāladurgāṇi janapadadvārāṇyantapālādhiṣṭhitāni sthāpayet
teṣām antarāṇi vāgurikaśabarapulindacaṇḍālāraṇyacarā rakṣeyuḥ
ṛtvigācāryapurohitaśrotriyebhyo brahmadeyāny adaṇḍakarāṇy abhirūpadāyādakāni prayacchet adhyakṣasaṃkhyāyakādibhyo gopasthānikānīkasthacikitsakāśvadamakajaṅghākārikebhyaśca vikrayādhānavarjāni
karadebhyaḥ kṛtakṣetrāṇyaikapuruṣikāṇi prayacchet
akṛtāni kartṛbhyo nādeyāni
akṛṣatām ācchidyānyebhyaḥ prayacchet
grāmabhṛtakavaidehakā vā kṛṣeyuḥ
akṛṣanto vāvahīnaṃ dadyuḥ
dhānyapaśuhiraṇyaiścaitān anugṛhṇīyāt
tānyanu sukhena dadyuḥ
anugrahaparihārau caitebhyaḥ kośavṛddhikarau dadyāt kośopaghātakau varjayet
alpakośo hi rājā paurajānapadān eva grasate
niveśasamakālaṃ yathāgatakaṃ vā parihāraṃ dadyāt
nivṛttaparihārān pitevānugṛhṇīyāt
ākarakarmāntadravyahastivanavrajavaṇikpathapracārān vāristhalapathapaṇyapattanāni ca niveśayet
sahodakam āhāryodakaṃ vā setuṃ bandhayet
anyeṣāṃ vā badhnatāṃ bhūmimārgavṛkṣopakaraṇānugrahaṃ kuryāt puṇyasthānārāmāṇāṃ ca
sambhūya setubandhād apakrāmataḥ karmakarabalīvardāḥ karma kuryuḥ
vyayakarmaṇi ca bhāgī syāt na cāṃśaṃ labheta
matsyaplavaharitapaṇyānāṃ setuṣu rājā svāmyaṃ gacchet
dāsāhitakabandhūn aśṛṇvato rājā vinayaṃ grāhayet
bālavṛddhavyasanyanāthāṃśca rājā bibhṛyāt striyam aprajātāṃ prajātāyāśca putrān
bāladravyaṃ grāmavṛddhā vardhayeyur ā vyavahāraprāpaṇāt devadravyaṃ ca
apatyadāraṃ mātāpitarau bhrātṝn aprāptavyavahārān bhaginīḥ kanyā vidhavāścābibhrataḥ śaktimato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ anyatra patitebhyaḥ anyatra mātuḥ
putradāram apratividhāya pravrajataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ striyaṃ ca pravrājayataḥ
luptavyāyāmaḥ pravrajed āpṛcchya dharmasthān
anyathā niyamyeta
vānaprasthād anyaḥ pravrajitabhāvaḥ sajātād anyaḥ saṃghaḥ sāmutthāyikād anyaḥ samayānubandho vā nāsya janapadam upaniviśeta
na ca tatrārāmā vihārārthā vā śālāḥ syuḥ
naṭanartakagāyanavādakavāgjīvanakuśīlavā na karmavighnaṃ kuryuḥ
nirāśrayatvād grāmāṇāṃ kṣetrābhiratatvācca puruṣāṇāṃ kośaviṣṭidravyadhānyarasavṛddhir bhavati
paracakrāṭavīgrastaṃ vyādhidurbhikṣapīḍitam
deśaṃ parihared rājā vyayakrīḍāśca vārayet
daṇḍaviṣṭikarābādhai rakṣed upahatāṃ kṛṣim
stenavyālaviṣagrāhair vyādhibhiśca paśuvrajān
vallabhaiḥ kārmikaiḥ stenair antapālaiśca pīḍitam
śodhayet paśusaṃghaiśca kṣīyamāṇaṃ vaṇikpatham
evaṃ dravyadvipavanaṃ setubandham athākarān
rakṣet pūrvakṛtān rājā navāṃścābhipravartayet
akṛṣyāyāṃ bhūmau paśubhyo vivītāni prayacchet
pradiṣṭābhayasthāvarajaṅgamāni ca brahmasomāraṇyāni tapasvibhyo gorutaparāṇi prayacchet
tāvanmātram ekadvāraṃ khātaguptaṃ svāduphalagulmaguccham akaṇṭakidrumam uttānatoyāśayaṃ dāntamṛgacatuṣpadaṃ bhagnanakhadaṃṣṭravyālaṃ mārgayukahastihastinīkalabhaṃ mṛgavanaṃ vihārārthaṃ rājñaḥ kārayet
sarvātithimṛgaṃ pratyante cānyanmṛgavanaṃ bhūmivaśena vā niveśayet
kupyapradiṣṭānāṃ ca dravyāṇām ekaikaśo vanāni niveśayet dravyavanakarmāntān aṭavīśca dravyavanāpāśrayāḥ
pratyante hastivanam aṭavyārakṣaṃ niveśayet
nāgavanādhyakṣaḥ pārvataṃ nādeyaṃ sārasamānūpaṃ ca nāgavanaṃ viditaparyantapraveśaniṣkāsaṃ nāgavanapālaiḥ pālayet
hastighātinaṃ hanyuḥ
dantayugaṃ svayaṃmṛtasyāharataḥ sapādacatuṣpaṇo lābhaḥ
nāgavanapālā hastipakapādapāśikasaumikavanacarakapārikarmikasakhā hastimūtrapurīṣacchannagandhā bhallātakīśākhāpracchannāḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhir vā hastibandhakībhiḥ saha carantaḥ śayyāsthānapadyāleṇḍakūlaghātoddeśena hastikulaparyagraṃ vidyuḥ
yūthacaram ekacaraṃ niryūthaṃ yūthapatiṃ hastinaṃ vyālaṃ mattaṃ potaṃ bandhamuktaṃ ca nibandhena vidyuḥ
anīkasthapramāṇaiḥ praśastavyañjanācārān hastino gṛhṇīyuḥ
hastipradhānaṃ vijayo rājñaḥ
parānīkavyūhadurgaskandhāvārapramardanā hyatipramāṇaśarīrāḥ prāṇaharakarmāṇo hastinaḥ
kāliṅgāṅgagajāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prācyāścedikarūṣajāḥ
dāśārṇāścāparāntāśca dvipānāṃ madhyamā matāḥ
saurāṣṭrikāḥ pāñcanadāsteṣāṃ pratyavarāḥ smṛtāḥ
sarveṣāṃ karmaṇā vīryaṃ javastejaśca vardhate
caturdiśam janapada ante sāmparāyikam daiva kṛtam durgam kārayet antar dvīpam sthalam _ nimna avaruddham audakam prāstaram guhām _ pārvatam nirudaka stambam iriṇam _ dhānvanam khañjana udakam stamba gahanam _ vana durgam
teṣām nadī parvata durgam janapada ārakṣa sthānam dhānvana vana durgam aṭavī sthānam āpadi apasāraḥ _
janapada madhye samudaya sthānam sthānīyam niveśayet vāstuka praśaste deśe nadī saṃgame hradasya a viśoṣasya aṅke sarasaḥ taṭākasya _ vṛttam dīrgham caturaśram _ vāstu vaśena _ pradakṣiṇa udakam paṇya puṭabhedanam aṃsa patha vāri pathābhyām upetam
tasya parikhāḥ tisraḥ daṇḍa antarāḥ kārayet caturdaśa dvādaśa daśa iti daṇḍān vistīrṇāḥ vistārāt avagāḍhāḥ pāda ūnam ardham _ tri bhāga mūlāḥ mūla caturaśrāḥ _ pāṣāṇa upahitāḥ pāṣāṇa iṣṭakā baddha pārśvāḥ _ toya āntikāḥ āgantu toya pūrṇāḥ _ sa parivāhāḥ padma grāhavatīḥ ca

paruṣā śvetaprāyā mahābisī
dvādaśāṅgulāyāmam ubhayam
śyāmikā kālikā kadalī candrottarā śākulā cārohajāḥ
kapilā binducitrā vā śyāmikā
kālikā kapilā kapotavarṇā vā
tad ubhayam aṣṭāṅgulāyāmam
paruṣā kadalī hastāyatā
saiva candracitrā candrottarā
kadalītribhāgā śākulā koṭhamaṇḍalacitrā kṛtakarṇikājinacitrā vā
sāmūraṃ cīnasī sāmūlī ca bāhlaveyāḥ
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulam añjanavarṇaṃ sāmūram
cīnasī raktakālī pāṇḍukālī vā
sāmūlī godhūmavarṇā
sāṃtinā nalatūlā vṛttapṛcchā caudrāḥ
sātinā kṛṣṇā
nalatūlā nalatūlavarṇā
kapilā vṛttapucchā ca
carmaṇāṃ mṛdu snigdhaṃ bahularoma ca śreṣṭham
śuddhaṃ śuddharaktaṃ pakṣaraktaṃ cāvikam khacitaṃ vānacitraṃ khaṇḍasaṃghātyaṃ tantuvicchinnaṃ ca
kambalaḥ kaucapakaḥ kulamitikā saumitikā turagāstaraṇaṃ varṇakaṃ talicchakaṃ vāravāṇaḥ paristomaḥ samantabhadrakaṃ cāvikam
picchilam ārdram iva ca sūkṣmaṃ mṛdu ca śreṣṭham
aṣṭaprotisaṃghātyā kṛṣṇā bhiṅgisī varṣavāraṇam apasāraka iti naipālakam
sampuṭikā caturaśrikā lambarā kaṭavānakaṃ prāvarakaḥ sattaliketi mṛgaroma
vāṅgakaṃ śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ dukūlam
pauṇḍrakaṃ śyāmaṃ maṇisnigdham
sauvarṇakuḍyakaṃ sūryavarṇaṃ maṇisnigdhodakavānaṃ caturaśravānaṃ vyāmiśravānaṃ ca
eteṣām ekāṃśukam adhyardhadvitricaturaṃśukam iti
tena kāśikaṃ pauṇḍrakaṃ ca kṣaumaṃ vyākhyātam
māgadhikā pauṇḍrikā sauvarṇakuḍyakā ca pattrorṇā
nāgavṛkṣo likuco bakulo vaṭaśca yonayaḥ
pītikā nāgavṛkṣikā
godhūmavarṇā laikucī
śvetā bākulī
śeṣā navanītavarṇā
tāsāṃ sauvarṇakuḍyakā śreṣṭhā
tayā kauśeyaṃ cīnapaṭṭāśca cīnabhūmijā vyākhyātāḥ
mādhuram āparāntakaṃ kāliṅgaṃ kāśikaṃ vāṅgakaṃ vātsakaṃ māhiṣakaṃ ca kārpāsikaṃ śreṣṭham
ataḥ pareṣāṃ ratnānāṃ pramāṇaṃ mūlyalakṣaṇam
jātiṃ rūpaṃ ca jānīyān nidhānaṃ navakarma ca
purāṇapratisaṃskāraṃ karma guhyam upaskarān
deśakālaparībhogaṃ hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca pratikriyām
ākarādhyakṣaḥ śulbadhātuśāstrarasapākamaṇirāgajñas tajjñasakho vā tajjātakarmakaropakaraṇasampannaḥ kiṭṭamūṣāṅgārabhasmaliṅgaṃ vākaraṃ bhūtapūrvam abhūtapūrvaṃ vā bhūmiprastararasadhātum atyarthavarṇagauravam ugragandharasaṃ parīkṣeta
parvatānām abhijñātoddeśānāṃ bilaguhopatyakālayanagūḍhakhāteṣvantaḥ prasyandino jambūcūtatālaphalapakvaharidrābhedaguḍaharitālamanaḥśilākṣaudrahiṅgulukapuṇḍarīkaśukamayūrapattravarṇāḥ savarṇodakauṣadhiparyantāścikkaṇā viśadā bhārikāśca rasāḥ kāñcanikāḥ
apsu niṣṭhyūtāstailavadvisarpiṇaḥ paṅkamalagrāhiṇaśca tāmrarūpyayoḥ śatād upari veddhāraḥ
tatpratirūpakam ugragandharasaṃ śilājatu vidyāt
pītakās tāmrakāstāmrapītakā vā bhūmiprastaradhātavo bhinnā nīlarājīvanto mudgamāṣakṛsaravarṇā vā dadhibindupiṇḍacitrā haridrāharītakīpadmapattraśaivalayakṛtplīhānavadyavarṇā bhinnāś cuñcuvālukālekhābindusvastikavantaḥ sugulikā arciṣmantastāpyamānā na bhidyante bahuphenadhūmāśca suvarṇadhātavaḥ pratīvāpārthās tāmrarūpyavedhanāḥ
śaṅkhakarpūrasphaṭikanavanītakapotapārāvatavimalakamayūragrīvāvarṇāḥ sasyakagomedakaguḍamatsyaṇḍikāvarṇāḥ kovidārapadmapāṭalīkalāyakṣaumātasīpuṣpavarṇāḥ sasīsāḥ sāñjanā visrā bhinnāḥ śvetābhāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇābhāḥ śvetāḥ sarve vā lekhābinducitrā mṛdavo dhmāyamānā na sphuṭanti bahuphenadhūmāśca rūpyadhātavaḥ
sarvadhātūnāṃ gauravavṛddhau sattvavṛddhiḥ
teṣām aśuddhā mūḍhagarbhā vā tīkṣṇamūtrakṣārabhāvitā rājavṛkṣavaṭapīlugopittarocanāmahiṣakharakarabhamūtraleṇḍapiṇḍabaddhās tatpratīvāpāstadavalepā vā viśuddhāḥ sravanti
yavamāṣatilapalāśapīlukṣārair gokṣīrājakṣīrair vā kadalīvajrakandapratīvāpo mārdavakaraḥ
madhumadhukam ajāpayaḥ satailaṃ ghṛtaguḍakiṇvayutaṃ sakandalīkam
yad api śatasahasradhā vibhinnaṃ bhavati mṛdu tribhir eva tanniṣekaiḥ
godantaśṛṅgapratīvāpo mṛdustambhanaḥ
bhārikaḥ snigdho mṛduśca prastaradhātur bhūmibhāgo vā piṅgalo haritaḥ pāṭalo lohito vā tāmradhātuḥ
kākamecakaḥ kapotarocanāvarṇaḥ śvetarājinaddho vā visraḥ sīsadhātuḥ
ūṣarakarburaḥ pakvaloṣṭavarṇo vā trapudhātuḥ
khurumbaḥ pāṇḍurohitaḥ sinduvārapuṣpavarṇo vā tīkṣṇadhātuḥ
kākāṇḍabhujapattravarṇo vā vaikṛntakadhātuḥ
acchaḥ snigdhaḥ saprabho ghoṣavān śītastīvrastanurāgaśca maṇidhātuḥ
dhātusamutthaṃ tajjātakarmānteṣu prayojayet
kṛtabhāṇḍavyavahāram ekamukham atyayaṃ cānyatra kartṛkretṛvikretṝṇāṃ sthāpayet
ākarikam apaharantam aṣṭaguṇaṃ dāpayed anyatra ratnebhyaḥ
stenam anisṛṣṭopajīvinaṃ ca baddhaṃ karma kārayet daṇḍopakāriṇaṃ ca
vyayakriyābhārikam ākaraṃ bhāgena prakrayeṇa vā dadyāl lāghavikam ātmanā kārayet
lohādhyakṣas tāmrasīsatrapuvaikṛntakārakūṭavṛttakaṃsatālalohakarmāntān kārayet lohabhāṇḍavyavahāraṃ ca
lakṣaṇādhyakṣaścaturbhāgatāmraṃ rūpyarūpaṃ tīkṣṇatrapusīsāñjanānām anyatamamāṣabījayuktaṃ kārayet paṇam ardhapaṇaṃ pādam aṣṭabhāgam iti pādājīvaṃ tāmrarūpaṃ māṣakam ardhamāṣakaṃ kākaṇīm ardhakākaṇīm iti
rūpadarśakaḥ paṇayātrāṃ vyāvahārikīṃ kośapraveśyāṃ ca sthāpayet
rūpikam aṣṭakaṃ śataṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ vyājīm pārīkṣikam aṣṭabhāgikaṃ śatam pañcaviṃśatipaṇam atyayaṃ ca anyatrakartṛkretṛvikretṛparīkṣitṛbhyaḥ
khanyadhyakṣaḥ śaṅkhavajramaṇimuktāpravālakṣārakarmāntān kārayet paṇanavyavahāraṃ ca
lavaṇādhyakṣaḥ pākamuktaṃ lavaṇabhāgaṃ prakrayaṃ ca yathākālaṃ saṃgṛhṇīyād vikrayācca mūlyaṃ rūpaṃ vyājīṃ ca
āgantulavaṇaṃ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ dadyāt
dattabhāgavibhāgasya vikrayaḥ pañcakaṃ śataṃ vyājīṃ rūpaṃ rūpikaṃ ca
kretā śulkaṃ rājapaṇyacchedānurūpaṃ ca vaidharaṇaṃ dadyāt anyatra kretā ṣaṭchatam atyayaṃ ca
vilavaṇam uttamaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyād anisṛṣṭopajīvī cānyatra vānaprasthebhyaḥ
śrotriyāstapasvino viṣṭayaśca bhaktalavaṇaṃ hareyuḥ
ato 'nyo lavaṇakṣāravargaḥ śulkaṃ dadyāt
evaṃ mūlyaṃ ca bhāgaṃ ca vyājīṃ parigham atyayam
śulkaṃ vaidharaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ rūpaṃ rūpikam eva ca
khanibhyo dvādaśavidhaṃ dhātuṃ paṇyaṃ ca saṃharet
evaṃ sarveṣu paṇyeṣu sthāpayen mukhasaṃgraham
ākaraprabhaḥ kośaḥ kośād daṇḍaḥ prajāyate
pṛthivī kośadaṇḍābhyāṃ prāpyate kośabhūṣaṇā
suvarṇādhyakṣaḥ suvarṇarajatakarmāntānām asambandhāveśanacatuḥśālām ekadvārām akṣaśālāṃ kārayet
viśikhāmadhye sauvarṇikaṃ śilpavantam abhijātaṃ prātyayikaṃ ca sthāpayet
jāmbūnadaṃ śātakumbhaṃ hāṭakaṃ vaiṇavaṃ śṛṅgaśuktijaṃ jātarūpaṃ rasaviddham ākarodgataṃ ca suvarṇam
kiñjalkavarṇaṃ mṛdu snigdham anādi bhrājiṣṇu ca śreṣṭhaṃ raktapītakaṃ madhyamaṃ raktam avaram
śreṣṭhānāṃ pāṇḍu śvetaṃ cāprāptakam
tad yenāprāptakaṃ taccaturguṇena sīsena śodhayet
sīsānvayena bhidyamānaṃ śuṣkapaṭalair dhmāpayet
rūkṣatvād bhidyamānaṃ tailagomaye niṣecayet
ākarodgataṃ sīsānvayena bhidyamānaṃ pākapattrāṇi kṛtvā gaṇḍikāsu kuṭṭayet kadalīvajrakandakalke vā niṣecayet
tutthodgataṃ gauḍikaṃ kāmbukaṃ cākravālikaṃ ca rūpyam
śvetaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛdu ca śreṣṭham
viparyaye sphoṭanaṃ ca duṣṭam
tatsīsacaturbhāgena śodhayet
udgatacūlikam acchaṃ bhrājiṣṇu dadhivarṇaṃ ca śuddham
śuddhasyaiko hāridrasya suvarṇo varṇakaḥ
tataḥ śulbakākaṇyuttarāpasāritā ā catuḥsīmāntād iti ṣoḍaśa varṇakāḥ
suvarṇaṃ pūrvaṃ nikaṣya paścād varṇikāṃ nikaṣayet
samarāgalekham animnonnate deśe nikaṣitaṃ parimṛditaṃ parilīḍhaṃ nakhāntarād vā gairikeṇāvacūrṇitam upadhiṃ vidyāt
jātihiṅgulukena puṣpakāsīsena vā gomūtrabhāvitena digdhenāgrahastena saṃspṛṣṭaṃ suvarṇaṃ śvetībhavati
sakesaraḥ snigdho mṛdur bhrājiṣṇuśca nikaṣarāgaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ
kāliṅgakastāpīpāṣāṇo vā mudgavarṇo nikaṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ
samarāgī vikrayakrayahitaḥ
hasticchavikaḥ saharitaḥ pratirāgī vikrayahitaḥ
sthiraḥ paruṣo viṣamavarṇaścāpratirāgī krayahitaḥ
chedaścikkaṇaḥ samavarṇaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛdur bhrājiṣṇuśca śreṣṭhaḥ
tāpo bahirantaśca samaḥ kiñjalkavarṇaḥ kuraṇḍakapuṣpavarṇo vā śreṣṭhaḥ
śyāvo nīlaścāprāptakaḥ
tulāpratimānaṃ pautavādhyakṣe vakṣyāmaḥ
tenopadeśena rūpyasuvarṇaṃ dadyād ādadīta ca
akṣaśālām anāyukto nopagacchet
abhigacchann ucchedyaḥ
āyukto vā sarūpyasuvarṇastenaiva jīyeta
vicitavastrahastaguhyāḥ kāñcanapṛṣatatvaṣṭṛtapanīyakāravo dhmāyakacarakapāṃsudhāvakāḥ praviśeyur niṣkaseyuśca
sarvaṃ caiṣām upakaraṇam aniṣṭhitāśca prayogāstatraivāvatiṣṭheran
gṛhītaṃ suvarṇaṃ dhṛtaṃ ca prayogaṃ karaṇamadhye dadyāt
sāyaṃ prātaśca lakṣitaṃ kartṛkārayitṛmudrābhyāṃ nidadhyāt
kṣepaṇo guṇaḥ kṣudrakam iti karmāṇi
kṣepaṇaḥ kācārpaṇādīni
guṇaḥ sūtravānādīni
ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ pṛṣatādiyuktaṃ kṣudrakam iti
arpayet kācakarmaṇaḥ pañcabhāgaṃ kāñcanaṃ daśabhāgaṃ kaṭumānam
tāmrapādayuktaṃ rūpyaṃ rūpyapādayuktaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ saṃskṛtakaṃ tasmād rakṣet
pṛṣatakācakarmaṇaḥ trayo hi bhāgāḥ paribhāṇḍaṃ dvau vāstukaṃ catvāro vā vāstukaṃ trayaḥ paribhāṇḍam
tvaṣṭṛkarmaṇaḥ śulbabhāṇḍaṃ samasuvarṇena saṃyūhayet
rūpyabhāṇḍaṃ ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ vā suvarṇārdhenāvalepayet
caturbhāgasuvarṇaṃ vā vālukāhiṅgulukasya rasena cūrṇena vā vāsayet
tapanīyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ suvarṇaṃ surāgaṃ samasīsātikrāntaṃ pākapattrapakvaṃ saindhavikayojjvālitaṃ nīlapītaśvetaharitaśukapattravarṇānāṃ prakṛtir bhavati
tīkṣṇaṃ cāsya mayūragrīvābhaṃ śvetabhaṅgaṃ cimicimāyitaṃ pītacūrṇitaṃ kākaṇikaḥ suvarṇarāgaḥ
tāram upaśuddhaṃ vā asthitutthe catuḥ samasīse catuḥ śuṣkatutthe catuḥ kapāle trir gomaye dvir evaṃ saptadaśatutthātikrāntaṃ saindhavikayojjvālitam
etasmāt kākaṇyuttaramād vimāṣād iti suvarṇe deyaṃ paścād rāgayogaḥ śvetatāraṃ bhavati
trayo 'ṃśāstapanīyasya dvātriṃśadbhāgaśvetatāramūrchitās tat śvetalohitakaṃ bhavati
tāmraṃ pītakaṃ karoti
tapanīyam ujjvālya rāgatribhāgaṃ dadyāt pītarāgaṃ bhavati
śvetatārabhāgau dvāvekastapanīyasya mudgavarṇaṃ karoti
kālāyasasyārdhabhāgābhyaktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati
pratilepinā rasena dviguṇābhyaktaṃ tapanīyaṃ śukapattravarṇaṃ bhavati
tasyārambhe rāgaviśeṣeṣu prativarṇikāṃ gṛhṇīyāt
tīkṣṇatāmrasaṃskāraṃ ca budhyeta
tasmād vajramaṇimuktāpravālarūpāṇām apaneyimānaṃ ca rūpyasuvarṇabhāṇḍabandhapramāṇāni ca
samarāgaṃ samadvandvam asaktapṛṣataṃ sthiram
supramṛṣṭam asampītaṃ vibhaktaṃ dhāraṇe sukham
abhinītaṃ prabhāyuktaṃ saṃsthānamadhuraṃ samam
manonetrābhirāmaṃ ca tapanīyaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
sauvarṇikaḥ paurajānapadānāṃ rūpyasuvarṇam āveśanibhiḥ kārayet
nirdiṣṭakālakāryaṃ ca karma kuryur anirdiṣṭakālaṃ kāryāpadeśam
kāryasyānyathākaraṇe vetananāśas taddviguṇaśca daṇḍaḥ
kālātipātane pādahīnaṃ vetanaṃ taddviguṇaśca daṇḍaḥ
yathāvarṇapramāṇaṃ nikṣepaṃ gṛhṇīyus tathāvidham evārpayeyuḥ
kālāntarād api ca tathāvidham eva pratigṛhṇīyuḥ anyatra kṣīṇapariśīrṇābhyām
āveśanibhiḥ suvarṇapudgalalakṣaṇaprayogeṣu tattajjānīyāt
taptakaladhautakayoḥ kākaṇikaḥ suvarṇe kṣayo deyaḥ
tīkṣṇakākaṇī rūpyadviguṇaḥ rāgaprakṣepas tasya ṣaḍbhāgaḥ kṣayaḥ
varṇahīne māṣāvare pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ pramāṇahīne madhyamas tulāpratimānopadhāv uttamaḥ kṛtabhāṇḍopadhau ca
sauvarṇikenādṛṣṭam anyatra vā prayogaṃ kārayato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
kartur dviguṇaḥ sāpasāraścet
anapasāraḥ kaṇṭakaśodhanāya nīyeta
kartuśca dviśato daṇḍaḥ paṇacchedanaṃ vā
tulāpratimānabhāṇḍaṃ pautavahastāt krīṇīyuḥ
anyathā dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
ghanaṃ suṣiraṃ saṃyūhyam avalepyaṃ saṃghātyaṃ vāsitakaṃ ca kārukarma
tulāviṣamam apasāraṇaṃ visrāvaṇaṃ peṭakaḥ piṅkaśceti haraṇopāyāḥ
saṃnāminyutkīrṇikā bhinnamastakopakaṇṭhī kuśikyā sakaṭukakṣyā parivelyāyaskāntā ca duṣṭatulāḥ
rūpyasya dvau bhāgāvekaḥ śulbasya tripuṭakam
tenākarod gatam apasāryate tattripuṭakāpasāritam
śulbena śulbāpasāritaṃ vellakena vellakāpasāritaṃ śulbārdhasāreṇa hemnā hemāpasāritam
mūkamūṣā pūtikiṭṭaḥ karaṭukamukhaṃ nālī saṃdaṃśo joṅganī suvarcikālavaṇaṃ tad eva suvarṇam ityapasāraṇamārgāḥ
pūrvapraṇihitā vā piṇḍavālukā mūṣābhedād agniṣṭhād uddhriyante
paścād bandhane ācitakapattraparīkṣāyāṃ vā rūpyarūpeṇa parivartanaṃ visrāvaṇam piṇḍavālukānāṃ lohapiṇḍavālukābhir vā
gāḍhaścābhyuddhāryaśca peṭakaḥ saṃyūhyāvalepyasaṃghātyeṣu kriyate
sīsarūpaṃ suvarṇapattreṇāvaliptam abhyantaram aṣṭakena baddhaṃ gāḍhapeṭakaḥ
sa eva paṭalasampuṭeṣvabhyuddhāryaḥ
pattram āśliṣṭaṃ yamakapattraṃ vāvalepyeṣu kriyate
śulbaṃ tāraṃ vā garbhaḥ pattrāṇāṃ saṃghātyeṣu kriyate
śulbarūpaṃ suvarṇapattrasaṃhataṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ supārśvaṃ tad eva yamakapattrasaṃhataṃ pramṛṣṭaṃ tāmratārarūpaṃ cottaravarṇakaḥ
tad ubhayaṃ tāpanikaṣābhyāṃ niḥśabdollekhanābhyāṃ vā vidyāt
abhyuddhāryaṃ badarāmle lavaṇodake vā sādayanti
ghane suṣire vā rūpe suvarṇamṛnmālukāhiṅgulukakalpo vā tapto 'vatiṣṭhate
dṛḍhavāstuke vā rūpe vālukāmiśraṃ jatu gāndhārapaṅko vā tapto 'vatiṣṭhate
tayostāpanam avadhvaṃsanaṃ vā śuddhiḥ
saparibhāṇḍe vā rūpe lavaṇam ulkayā kaṭuśarkarayā taptam avatiṣṭhate
tasya kvāthanaṃ śuddhiḥ
abhrapaṭalam aṣṭakena dviguṇavāstuke vā rūpe badhyate
tasyāpihitakācakasyodake nimajjata ekadeśaḥ sīdati paṭalāntareṣu vā sūcyā bhidyate
maṇayo rūpyaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā ghanasuṣirāṇāṃ piṅkaḥ
tasya tāpanam avadhvaṃsanaṃ vā śuddhir iti piṅkaḥ
tasmād vajramaṇimuktāpravālarūpāṇāṃ jātirūpavarṇapramāṇapudgalalakṣaṇānyupalabheta
