tasya svadeśo vyākhyānaṃ kāpiśāyanaṃ hārahūrakam iti
māṣakalanīdroṇamāmaṃ siddhaṃ vā tribhāgādhikataṇḍulaṃ moraṭādīnāṃ kārṣikabhāgayuktaṃ kiṇvabandhaḥ
pāṭhālodhratejovatyelāvālukamadhukamadhurasāpriyaṅgudāruharidrāmaricapippalīnāṃ ca pañcakārṣikaḥ sambhārayogo medakasya prasannāyāśca
madhukaniryūhayuktā kaṭaśarkarā varṇaprasādanī ca
cocacitrakavilaṅgagajapippalīnāṃ ca kārṣikaḥ kramukamadhukamustālodhrāṇāṃ dvikārṣikaścāsavasambhāraḥ
daśabhāgaścaiṣāṃ bījabandhaḥ
prasannāyogaḥ śvetasurāyāḥ
sahakārasurā rasottarā bījottarā vā mahāsurā saṃbhārikī vā
tāsāṃ moraṭāpalāśapattūrameṣaśṛṅgīkarañjakṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyabhāvitaṃ dagdhakaṭaśarkarācūrṇaṃ lodhracitrakavilaṅgapāṭhāmustākaliṅgayavadāruharidrendīvaraśatapuṣpāpāmārgasaptaparṇanimbāsphotakalkārdhayuktam antarnakho muṣṭiḥ kumbhīṃ rājapeyāṃ prasādayati
phāṇitaḥ pañcapalikaścātra rasavṛddhir deyaḥ
kuṭumbinaḥ kṛtyeṣu śvetasurām auṣadhārthaṃ vāriṣṭam anyad vā kartuṃ labheran
utsavasamājayātrāsu caturahaḥ sauriko deyaḥ
teṣvananujñātānāṃ prahavanāntaṃ daivasikam atyayaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
surākiṇvavicayaṃ striyo bālāśca kuryuḥ
arājapaṇyāḥ pañcakaṃ śataṃ śulkaṃ dadyuḥ surakāmedakāriṣṭamadhuphalāmlāmlaśīdhūnāṃ ca
ahnaśca vikrayaṃ jñātvā vyājīṃ mānahiraṇyayoḥ
tathā vaidharaṇaṃ kuryād ucitaṃ cānuvartayet
pradeṣṭārastrayastrayo 'mātyāḥ kaṇṭakaśodhanaṃ kuryuḥ
arthyapratīkārāḥ kāruśāsitāraḥ saṃnikṣeptāraḥ svavittakāravaḥ śreṇīpramāṇā nikṣepaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ
vipattau śreṇī nikṣepaṃ bhajeta
nirdiṣṭadeśakālakāryaṃ ca karma kuryuḥ anirdiṣṭadeśakālaṃ kāryāpadeśam
anyatra bhreṣopanipātābhyāṃ naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vābhyāvaheyuḥ
kāryasyānyathākaraṇe vetananāśastaddviguṇaśca daṇḍaḥ
tantuvāyā daśaikādaśikaṃ sūtraṃ vardhayeyuḥ
vṛddhicchede chedadviguṇo daṇḍaḥ
sūtramūlyaṃ vānavetanaṃ kṣaumakauśeyānām adhyardhaguṇaṃ pattrorṇākambaladukūlānāṃ dviguṇam
mānahīne hīnāvahīnaṃ vetanaṃ taddviguṇaśca daṇḍas tulāhīne hīnacaturguṇo daṇḍaḥ sūtraparivartane mūlyadviguṇaḥ
tena dvipaṭavānaṃ vyākhyātam
ūrṇātulāyāḥ pañcapaliko vihananacchedo romacchedaśca
rajakāḥ kāṣṭhaphalakaślakṣṇaśilāsu vastrāṇi nenijyuḥ
anyatra nenijato vastropaghātaṃ ṣaṭpaṇaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ
mudgarāṅkād anyad vāsaḥ paridadhānāstripaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyuḥ
paravastravikrayāvakrayādhāneṣu ca dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ parivartane mūlyadviguṇo vastradānaṃ ca
mukulāvadātaṃ śilāpaṭṭaśuddhaṃ dhautasūtravarṇaṃ pramṛṣṭaśvetaṃ caikarātrottaraṃ dadyuḥ
pañcarātrikaṃ tanurāgaṃ ṣaḍrātrikaṃ nīlaṃ puṣpalākṣāmañjiṣṭhāraktaṃ guruparikarma yatnopacāryaṃ jātyaṃ vāsaḥ saptarātrikam
tataḥ paraṃ vetanahāniṃ prāpnuyuḥ
śraddheyā rāgavivādeṣu vetanaṃ kuśalāḥ kalpayeyuḥ
parārdhyānāṃ paṇo vetanaṃ madhyamānām ardhapaṇaḥ pratyavarāṇāṃ pādaḥ sthūlakānāṃ māṣakadvimāṣakaṃ dviguṇaṃ raktakānām
prathamanejane caturbhāgaḥ kṣayaḥ dvitīye pañcabhāgaḥ
rajakaistunnavāyā vyākhyātāḥ
suvarṇakārāṇām aśucihastād rūpyaṃ suvarṇam anākhyāya sarūpaṃ krīṇatāṃ dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍo virūpaṃ caturviṃśatipaṇaś corahastād aṣṭacatvāriṃśatpaṇaḥ
pracchannavirūpamūlyahīnakrayeṣu steyadaṇḍaḥ kṛtabhāṇḍopadhau ca
suvarṇān māṣakam apaharato dviśato daṇḍaḥ rūpyadharaṇān māṣakam apaharato dvādaśapaṇaḥ
varṇotkarṣam apasāraṇaṃ yogaṃ vā sādhayataḥ pañcaśato daṇḍaḥ
tayor apacaraṇe rāgasyāpahāraṃ vidyāt
māṣako vetanaṃ rūpyadharaṇasya suvarṇasyāṣṭabhāgaḥ
śikṣāviśeṣeṇa dviguṇo vetanavṛddhiḥ
tāmravṛttakaṃsavaikṛntakārakūṭakānāṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ vetanam
tāmrapiṇḍo daśabhāgakṣayaḥ
palahīne hīnadviguṇo daṇḍaḥ
sīsatrapupiṇḍo viṃśatibhāgakṣayaḥ
kākaṇī cāsya palavetanam
kālāyasapiṇḍaḥ pañcabhāgakṣayaḥ
kākaṇīdvayaṃ cāsya palavetanam
rūpadarśakasya sthitāṃ paṇayātrām akopyāṃ kopayataḥ kopyām akopayato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
vyājīpariśuddhau paṇayātrā
paṇān māṣakam upajīvato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
kūṭarūpaṃ kārayataḥ pratigṛhṇato niryāpayato vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ kośe prakṣipato vadhaḥ
carakapāṃsudhāvakāḥ sāratribhāgaṃ labheran dvau rājā ratnaṃ ca
ratnāpahāra uttamo daṇḍaḥ
khaniratnanidhinivedaneṣu ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ nivettā labheta dvādaśam aṃśaṃ bhṛtakaḥ
śatasahasrād ūrdhvaṃ rājagāmī nidhiḥ
ūne ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ dadyāt
paurvapauruṣikaṃ nidhiṃ jānapadaḥ śuciḥ svakaraṇena samagraṃ labheta
svakaraṇābhāve pañcaśato daṇḍaḥ pracchannādāne sahasram
bhiṣajaḥ prāṇābādhikam anākhyāyopakramamāṇasya vipattau pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ karmāparādhena vipattau madhyamaḥ
marmavadhavaiguṇyakaraṇe daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ vidyāt
kuśīlavā varṣārātram ekasthā vaseyuḥ
kāmadānam atimātram ekasyātivādaṃ ca varjayeyuḥ
tasyātikrame dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
kāmaṃ deśajātigotracaraṇamaithunāvahāsena narmayeyuḥ
kuśīlavaiścāraṇā bhikṣukāśca vyākhyātāḥ
teṣām ayaḥśūlena yāvataḥ paṇān abhivadeyustāvantaḥ śiphāprahārā daṇḍāḥ
śeṣāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ niṣpattivetanaṃ śilpināṃ kalpayet
evaṃ corān acorākhyān vaṇikkārukuśīlavān
bhikṣukān kuhakāṃścānyān vārayed deśapīḍanāt
saṃsthādhyakṣaḥ paṇyasaṃsthāyāṃ purāṇabhāṇḍānāṃ svakaraṇaviśuddhānām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā sthāpayet
tulāmānabhāṇḍāni cāvekṣeta pautavāpacārāt
parimāṇīdroṇayor ardhapalahīnātiriktam adoṣaḥ
palahīnātirikte dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
tena palottarā daṇḍavṛddhir vyākhyātā
tulāyāḥ karṣahīnātiriktam adoṣaḥ
dvikarṣahīnātirikte ṣaṭpaṇo daṇḍaḥ
tena karṣottarā daṇḍavṛddhir vyākhyātā
āḍhakasyārdhakarṣahīnātiriktam adoṣaḥ
karṣahīnātirikte tripaṇo daṇḍaḥ
tulāmānaviśeṣāṇām ato 'nyeṣām anumānaṃ kuryāt
tulāmānābhyām atiriktābhyāṃ krītvā hīnābhyāṃ vikrīṇānasya ta eva dviguṇā daṇḍāḥ
gaṇyapaṇyeṣvaṣṭabhāgaṃ paṇyamūlyeṣvapaharataḥ ṣaṇṇavatir daṇḍaḥ
kāṣṭhalohamaṇimayaṃ rajjucarmamṛṇmayaṃ sūtravalkaromamayaṃ vā jātyam ityajātyaṃ vikrayādhānaṃ nayato mūlyāṣṭaguṇo daṇḍaḥ
sārabhāṇḍam ityasārabhāṇḍaṃ tajjātam ityatajjātaṃ rādhāyuktam ityupadhiyuktaṃ samudgaparivartimaṃ vā vikrayādhānaṃ nayato hīnamūlyaṃ catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ paṇamūlyaṃ dviguṇo dvipaṇamūlyaṃ dviśataḥ
tenārghavṛddhau daṇḍavṛddhir vyākhyātā
kāruśilpināṃ karmaguṇāpakarṣam ājīvaṃ vikrayakrayopaghātaṃ vā sambhūya samutthāpayatāṃ sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ
vaidehakānāṃ vā sambhūya paṇyam avarundhatām anargheṇa vikrīṇatāṃ vā sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ
tulāmānāntaram arghavarṇāntaraṃ vā dharakasya māyakasya vā paṇamūlyād aṣṭabhāgaṃ hastadoṣeṇācarato dviśato daṇḍaḥ
tena dviśatottarā daṇḍavṛddhir vyākhyātā
dhānyasnehakṣāralavaṇagandhabhaiṣajyadravyāṇāṃ samavarṇopadhāne dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
yannisṛṣṭam upajīveyustad eṣāṃ divasasaṃjātaṃ saṃkhyāya vaṇik sthāpayet
kretṛvikretror antarapatitam ādāyād anyad bhavati
tena dhānyapaṇyanicayāṃścānujñātāḥ kuryuḥ
anyathānicitam eṣāṃ paṇyādhyakṣo gṛhṇīyāt
tena dhānyapaṇyavikraye vyavaharetānugraheṇa prajānām
anujñātakrayād upari caiṣāṃ svadeśīyānāṃ paṇyānāṃ pañcakaṃ śatam ājīvaṃ sthāpayet paradeśīyānāṃ daśakam
tataḥ param arghaṃ vardhayatāṃ kraye vikraye vā bhāvayatāṃ paṇaśate pañcapaṇād dviśato daṇḍaḥ
sambhūyakraye caiṣām avikrīte nānyaṃ sambhūyakrayaṃ dadyāt
paṇyopaghāte caiṣām anugrahaṃ kuryāt
paṇyabāhulyāt paṇyādhyakṣaḥ sarvapaṇyānyekamukhāni vikrīṇīta
teṣvavikrīteṣu nānye vikrīṇīran
tāni divasavetanena vikrīṇīrann anugraheṇa prajānām
deśakālāntaritānāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ prakṣepaṃ paṇyaniṣpattiṃ śulkaṃ vṛddhim avakrayam
vyayān anyāṃśca saṃkhyāya sthāpayed argham arghavit
daivāni
daivāni aṣṭau mahā bhayāni agniḥ udakam vyādhiḥ durbhikṣam mūṣikāḥ vyālāḥ sarpāḥ rakṣāṃsi iti
tebhyaḥ janapadam rakṣet
grīṣme bahis adhiśrayaṇam grāmāḥ kuryuḥ saṃgraheṇa adhiṣṭhitāḥ vā
nāgarika praṇidhau agni pratiṣedhaḥ vyākhyātaḥ niśānta praṇidhau rāja parigrahe ca
bali homa svastivācanaiḥ parvasu ca agni pūjāḥ kārayet
varṣārātram ānūpa grāmāḥ pūra velām utsṛjya vaseyuḥ
kāṣṭha veṇu nāvaḥ ca upagṛhṇīyuḥ
uhyamānam alābu dṛti plava gaṇḍikā veṇikābhiḥ tārayeyuḥ
an abhisaratām dvādaśa paṇaḥ daṇḍaḥ anyatra plava hīnebhyaḥ
parvasu ca nadī pūjāḥ kārayet
māyā yoga vidaḥ veda vidaḥ vā varṣam abhicareyuḥ
varṣa avagrahe śacī nātha gaṅgā parvata mahā kaccha pūjāḥ kārayet
vyādhi bhayam aupaniṣadikaiḥ pratīkāraiḥ pratikuryuḥ auṣadhaiḥ cikitsakāḥ śānti prāyaścittaiḥ vā siddha tāpasāḥ
tena marakaḥ vyākhyātaḥ
tīrtha abhiṣecanam mahā kaccha vardhanam gavām śmaśāna avadohanam kabandha dahanam deva rātrim ca kārayet
paśu vyādhi marake sthāna artha nīrājanam sva daivata pūjanam ca kārayet
durbhikṣe rājā bīja bhaktā upagraham kṛtvā anugraham kuryāt durga setu karma vā bhakta anugraheṇa bhakta saṃvibhāgam vā deśa nikṣepam vā
mitrāṇi vā vyapāśrayeta
karśanam vamanam vā kuryāt
niṣpanna sasyam anya viṣayam vā sa janapadaḥ yāyāt samudra saraḥ taṭākāni vā saṃśrayeta
dhānya śāka mūla phala āvāpān vā setuṣu kurvīta mṛga paśu pakṣi vyāla matsya ārambhān vā
mūṣika bhaye mārjāra nakula utsargaḥ
teṣām
teṣām grahaṇa hiṃsāyām dvādaśa paṇaḥ daṇḍaḥ śunām anigrahe ca anyatra araṇya carebhyaḥ
snuhi kṣīra liptāni dhānyāni visṛjet upaniṣad yoga yuktāni vā
mūṣika karam vā prayuñjīta
śāntim vā siddha tāpasāḥ kuryuḥ
parvasu ca mūṣika pūjāḥ kārayet
tena śalabha pakṣi krimi bhaya pratīkārāḥ vyākhyātāḥ
vyāla bhaye madana rasa yuktāni paśu śavāni prasṛjet madana kodrava pūrṇāni audaryāṇi vā
lubdhakāḥ śva gaṇinaḥ vā kūṭa pañjara avapātaiḥ careyuḥ
āvaraṇinaḥ śastra pāṇayaḥ vyālān abhihanyuḥ
an abhisartuḥ dvādaśa paṇaḥ daṇḍaḥ
saḥ eva lābhaḥ vyāla ghātinaḥ
parvasu ca parvata pūjāḥ kārayet
tena mṛga paśu pakṣi saṃgha grāha pratīkārāḥ vyākhyātāḥ
sarpa bhaye mantraiḥ oṣadhibhiḥ ca jāṅgulī vidaḥ careyuḥ
sambhūya vā api sarpān hanyuḥ
atharvaveda vidaḥ vā abhicareyuḥ
parvasu ca nāga pūjāḥ kārayet
tena udaka prāṇi bhaya pratīkārāḥ vyākhyātāḥ
rakṣaḥ bhaye rakṣaḥ ghnāni atharvaveda vidaḥ māyā yoga vidaḥ vā karmāṇi kuryuḥ
parvasu ca vitardi chatra ullopikā hasta patākā chāga upahāraiḥ caitya pūjāḥ kārayet
carum vaḥ carāmaḥ iti
carum vaḥ carāmaḥ iti evam sarva bhayeṣu ahorātram careyuḥ
sarvatra ca upahatān pitā iva anugṛhṇīyāt
māyā yoga vidaḥ tasmāt viṣaye siddha tāpasāḥ vaseyuḥ pūjitāḥ rājñā daiva āpad pratikāriṇaḥ
samāhartṛpraṇidhau janapadarakṣaṇam uktam
tasya kaṇṭakaśodhanaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ
samāhartā janapade siddhatāpasapravrajitacakracaracāraṇakuhakapracchandakakārtāntikanaimittikamauhūrtikacikitsakonmattamūkabadhirajaḍāndhavaidehakakāruśilpikuśīlavaveśaśauṇḍikāpūpikapākvamāṃsikaudanikavyañjanān praṇidadhyāt
te grāmāṇām adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca śaucāśaucaṃ vidyuḥ
yaṃ cātra gūḍhājīvinaṃ śaṅketa taṃ sattriṇāpasarpayet
dharmasthaṃ viśvāsopagataṃ sattrī brūyād asau me bandhur abhiyuktaḥ tasyāyam anarthaḥ pratikriyatām ayaṃ cārthaḥ pratigṛhyatām iti
sa cet tathā kuryād upadāgrāhaka iti pravāsyeta
tena pradeṣṭāro vyākhyātāḥ
grāmakūṭam adhyakṣaṃ vā sattrī brūyād asau jālmaḥ prabhūtadravyas tasyāyam anarthaḥ tenainam āhārayasva iti
sa cet tathā kuryād utkocaka iti pravāsyeta
kṛtakābhiyukto vā kūṭasākṣiṇo 'bhijñātānarthavaipulyenārabheta
te cet tathā kuryuḥ kūṭasākṣiṇa iti pravāsyeran
tena kūṭaśrāvaṇakārakā vyākhyātāḥ
yaṃ vā mantrayogamūlakarmabhiḥ śmāśānikair vā saṃvadanakārakaṃ manyeta taṃ sattrī brūyād amuṣya bhāryāṃ snuṣāṃ duhitaraṃ vā kāmaye sā māṃ pratikāmayatām ayaṃ cārthaḥ pratigṛhyatām iti
sa cet tathā kuryāt saṃvadanakāraka iti pravāsyeta
tena kṛtyābhicāraśīlau vyākhyātau
yaṃ vā rasasya kartāraṃ kretāraṃ vikretāraṃ bhaiṣajyāhāravyavahāriṇaṃ vā rasadaṃ manyeta taṃ sattrī brūyād asau me śatruḥ tasyopaghātaḥ kriyatām ayaṃ cārthaḥ pratigṛhyatām iti
sa cet tathā kuryād rasada iti pravāsyeta
tena madanayogavyavahārī vyākhyātaḥ
yaṃ vā nānālohakṣārāṇām aṅgārabhastrāsaṃdaṃśamuṣṭikādhikaraṇībimbaṭaṅkamūṣāṇām abhīkṣṇakretāraṃ maṣībhasmadhūmadigdhahastavastraliṅgaṃ karmāropakaraṇasaṃsargaṃ kūṭarūpakārakaṃ manyeta taṃ sattrī śiṣyatvena saṃvyavahāreṇa cānupraviśya prajñāpayet
prajñātaḥ kūṭarūpakāraka iti pravāsyeta
tena rāgasyāpahartā kūṭasuvarṇavyavahārī ca vyākhyātaḥ
ārabdhārastu hiṃsāyāṃ gūḍhājīvāstrayodaśa
pravāsyā niṣkrayārthaṃ vā dadyur doṣaviśeṣataḥ
sattriprayogād ūrdhvaṃ siddhavyañjanā māṇavān māṇavavidyābhiḥ pralobhayeyuḥ prasvāpanāntardhānadvārāpohamantreṇa pratirodhakān saṃvadanamantreṇa pāratalpikān
teṣāṃ kṛtotsāhānāṃ mahāntaṃ saṃgham ādāya rātrāvanyaṃ grāmam uddiśyānyaṃ grāmaṃ kṛtakastrīpuruṣaṃ gatvā brūyuḥ ihaiva vidyāprabhāvo dṛśyatāṃ kṛcchraḥ paragrāmo gantum iti
tato dvārāpohamantreṇa dvārāṇyapohya praviśyatām iti brūyuḥ
antardhānamantreṇa jāgratām ārakṣiṇāṃ madhyena māṇavān atikrāmayeyuḥ
prasvāpanamantreṇa prasvāpayitvā rakṣiṇaḥ śayābhir māṇavaiḥ saṃcārayeyuḥ
saṃvadanamantreṇa bhāryāvyañjanāḥ pareṣāṃ māṇavaiḥ saṃmodayeyuḥ
upalabdhavidyāprabhāvāṇāṃ puraścaraṇādyādiśeyur abhijñānārtham
kṛtalakṣaṇadravyeṣu vā veśmasu karma kārayeyuḥ
anupraviṣṭā vaikatra grāhayeyuḥ
kṛtalakṣaṇadravyakrayavikrayādhāneṣu yogasurāmattān vā grāhayeyuḥ
gṛhītān pūrvāpadānasahāyān anuyuñjīta
purāṇacoravyañjanā vā corān anupraviṣṭāstathaiva karma kārayeyur grāhayeyuśca
gṛhītān samāhartā paurajānapadānāṃ darśayet coragrahaṇīṃ vidyām adhīte rājā tasyopadeśād ime corā gṛhītāḥ bhūyaśca grahīṣyāmi vārayitavyo vaḥ svajanaḥ pāpācāra iti
yaṃ cātrāpasarpopadeśena śamyāpratodādīnām apahartāraṃ jānīyāt tam eṣāṃ pratyādiśed eṣa rājñaḥ prabhāvaḥ iti
purāṇacoragopālakavyādhaśvagaṇinaśca vanacorāṭavikān anupraviṣṭāḥ prabhūtakūṭahiraṇyakupyabhāṇḍeṣu sārthavrajagrāmeṣvenān abhiyojayeyuḥ
abhiyoge gūḍhabalair ghātayeyuḥ madanarasayuktena vā pathyadanena
gṛhītaloptrabhārān āyatagatapariśrāntān prasvapataḥ prahavaṇeṣu yogasurāmattān vā grāhayeyuḥ
pūrvavacca gṛhītvainān samāhartā prarūpayet
sarvajñakhyāpanaṃ rājñaḥ kārayan rāṣṭravāsiṣu
siddhaprayogād ūrdhvaṃ śaṅkārūpakarmābhigrahaḥ
kṣīṇadāyakuṭumbam alpanirveśaṃ viparītadeśajātigotranāmakarmāpadeśaṃ pracchannavṛttikarmāṇaṃ māṃsasurābhakṣyabhojanagandhamālyavastravibhūṣaṇeṣu prasaktam ativyayakartāraṃ puṃścalīdyūtaśauṇḍikeṣu prasaktam abhīkṣṇapravāsinam avijñātasthānagamanam ekāntāraṇyaniṣkuṭavikālacāriṇaṃ pracchanne sāmiṣe vā deśe bahumantrasaṃnipātaṃ sadyaḥkṣatavraṇānāṃ gūḍhapratīkārakārayitāram antargṛhanityam abhyadhigantāraṃ kāntāparaṃ paraparigrahāṇāṃ parastrīdravyaveśmanām abhīkṣṇapraṣṭāraṃ kutsitakarmaśāstropakaraṇasaṃsargaṃ virātre channakuḍyacchāyāsaṃcāriṇaṃ virūpadravyāṇām adeśakālavikretāraṃ jātavairāśayaṃ hīnakarmajātiṃ vigūhamānarūpaṃ liṅgenāliṅginaṃ liṅginaṃ vā bhinnācāraṃ pūrvakṛtāpadānaṃ svakarmabhir apadiṣṭaṃ nāgarikamahāmātradarśane gūhamānam apasarantam anucchvāsopaveśinam āvignaṃ śuṣkabhinnasvaramukhavarṇaṃ śastrahastamanuṣyasampātatrāsinaṃ hiṃsrastenanidhinikṣepāpahāraparaprayogagūḍhājīvinām anyatamaṃ śaṅketa
iti śaṅkābhigrahaḥ
rūpābhigrahastu naṣṭāpahṛtam avidyamānaṃ tajjātavyavahāriṣu nivedayet
taccen niveditam āsādya pracchādayeyuḥ sācivyakaradoṣam āpnuyuḥ
ajānanto 'sya dravyasyātisargeṇa mucyeran
na cānivedya saṃsthādhyakṣasya purāṇabhāṇḍānām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā kuryuḥ
taccen niveditam āsādyeta rūpābhigṛhītam āgamaṃ pṛcchet kutaste labdham iti
sa cet brūyāt dāyādyād avāptam amuṣmāllabdhaṃ krītaṃ kāritam ādhipracchannam ayam asya deśaḥ kālaścopasamprāpter ayam asyārghaḥ pramāṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mūlyaṃ ca iti tasyāgamasamādhau mucyeta
nāṣṭikaścet tad eva pratisaṃdadhyād yasya pūrvo dīrghaśca paribhogaḥ śucir vā deśas tasya dravyam iti vidyāt
catuṣpadadvipadānām api hi rūpaliṅgasāmānyaṃ bhavati kim aṅga punar ekayonidravyakartṛprasūtānāṃ kupyābharaṇabhāṇḍānām iti
sa ced brūyāt yācitakam avakrītakam āhitakaṃ nikṣepam upanidhiṃ vaiyāvṛtyakarma vāmuṣya iti tasyāpasārapratisaṃdhānena mucyeta
naivam ityapasāro vā brūyād rūpābhigṛhītaḥ parasya dānakāraṇam ātmanaḥ pratigrahakāraṇam upaliṅganaṃ vā dāyakadāpakanibandhakapratigrāhakopadraṣṭṛbhir upaśrotṛbhir vā pratisamānayet
ujhitapranaṣṭaniṣpatitopalabdhasya deśakālalābhopaliṅganena śuddhiḥ
aśuddhastacca tāvacca daṇḍaṃ dadyāt
anyathā steyadaṇḍaṃ bhajeta
iti rūpābhigrahaḥ
karmābhigrahastu muṣitaveśmanaḥ praveśaniṣkasanam advāreṇa dvārasya saṃdhinā bījena vā vedham uttamāgārasya jālavātāyananīpravedham ārohaṇāvataraṇe ca kuḍyasya vedham upakhananaṃ vā gūḍhadravyanikṣepaṇagrahaṇopāyam upadeśopalabhyam abhyantaracchedotkaraparimardopakaraṇam abhyantarakṛtaṃ vidyāt
viparyaye bāhyakṛtam ubhayata ubhayakṛtam
abhyantarakṛte puruṣam āsannaṃ vyasaninaṃ krūrasahāyaṃ taskaropakaraṇasaṃsargaṃ striyaṃ vā daridrakulām anyaprasaktāṃ vā paricārakajanaṃ vā tadvidhācāram atisvapnaṃ nidrāklāntam āvignaṃ śuṣkabhinnasvaramukhavarṇam anavasthitam atipralāpinam uccārohaṇasaṃrabdhagātraṃ vilūnanighṛṣṭabhinnapāṭitaśarīravastraṃ jātakiṇasaṃrabdhahastapādaṃ pāṃsupūrṇakeśanakhaṃ vilūnabhugnakeśanakhaṃ vā samyaksnātānuliptaṃ tailapramṛṣṭagātraṃ sadyodhautahastapādaṃ vā pāṃsupicchileṣu tulyapādapadanikṣepaṃ praveśaniṣkasanayor vā tulyamālyamadyagandhavastracchedavilepanasvedaṃ parīkṣeta
coraṃ pāradārikaṃ vā vidyāt
sagopasthāniko bāhyaṃ pradeṣṭā coramārgaṇam
kuryān nāgarikaścāntardurge nirdiṣṭahetubhiḥ
tailābhyaktam āśumṛtakaṃ parīkṣeta
niṣkīrṇamūtrapurīṣaṃ vātapūrṇakoṣṭhatvakkaṃ śūnapādapāṇim unmīlitākṣaṃ savyañjanakaṇṭhaṃ pīḍananiruddhocchvāsahataṃ vidyāt
tam eva saṃkucitabāhusakthim udbandhahataṃ vidyāt
śūnapāṇipādodaram apagatākṣam udvṛttanābhim avaropitaṃ vidyāt
nistabdhagudākṣaṃ saṃdaṣṭajihvam ādhmātodaram udakahataṃ vidyāt
śoṇitānusiktaṃ bhagnabhinnagātraṃ kāṣṭhair aśmabhir vā hataṃ vidyāt
saṃbhagnasphuṭitagātram avakṣiptaṃ vidyāt
śyāvapāṇipādadantanakhaṃ śithilamāṃsaromacarmāṇaṃ phenopadigdhamukhaṃ viṣahataṃ vidyāt
tam eva saśoṇitadaṃśaṃ sarpakīṭahataṃ vidyāt
vikṣiptavastragātram ativāntaviriktaṃ madanayogahataṃ vidyāt
ato 'nyatamena kāraṇena hataṃ hatvā vā daṇḍabhayād udbaddhanikṛttakaṇṭhaṃ vidyāt
viṣahatasya bhojanaśeṣaṃ vayobhiḥ parīkṣeta
hṛdayād uddhṛtyāgnau prakṣiptaṃ ciṭiciṭāyadindradhanurvarṇaṃ vā viṣayuktaṃ vidyāt dagdhasya hṛdayam adagdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vā
tasya paricārakajanaṃ vāgdaṇḍapāruṣyātilabdhaṃ mārgeta duḥkhopahatam anyaprasaktaṃ vā strījanaṃ dāyavṛttistrījanābhimantāraṃ vā bandhum
tad eva hatodbaddhasya parīkṣeta
svayam udbaddhasya vā viprakāram ayuktaṃ mārgeta
sarveṣāṃ vā strīdāyādyadoṣaḥ karmaspardhā pratipakṣadveṣaḥ paṇyasaṃsthāsamavāyo vā vivādapadānām anyatamad vā roṣasthānam
roṣanimitto ghātaḥ
svayamādiṣṭapuruṣair vā corair arthanimittaṃ sādṛśyād anyavairibhir vā hatasya ghātam āsannebhyaḥ parīkṣeta
yenāhūtaḥ saha sthitaḥ prasthito hatabhūmim ānīto vā tam anuyuñjīta
ye cāsya hatabhūmāvāsannacarās tān ekaikaśaḥ pṛcchet kenāyam ihānīto hato vā kaḥ saśastraḥ saṃgūhamāna udvigno vā yuṣmābhir dṛṣṭaḥ iti
te yathā brūyustathānuyuñjīta
anāthasya śarīrastham upabhogaṃ paricchadam
vastraṃ veṣaṃ vibhūṣāṃ vā dṛṣṭvā tadvyavahāriṇaḥ
anuyuñjīta saṃyogaṃ nivāsaṃ vāsakāraṇam
karma ca vyavahāraṃ ca tato mārgaṇam ācaret
rajjuśastraviṣair vāpi kāmakrodhavaśena yaḥ
ghātayet svayam ātmānaṃ strī vā pāpena mohitā
rajjunā rājamārge tāṃścaṇḍālenāpakarṣayet
na śmaśānavidhisteṣāṃ na sambandhikriyāstathā
bandhusteṣāṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt pretakāryakriyāvidhim
tadgatiṃ sa caret paścāt svajanād vā pramucyate
saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena samācaran
yājanādhyāpanād yaunāt taiścānyo 'pi samācaran
muṣitasaṃnidhau bāhyānām abhyantarāṇāṃ ca sākṣiṇām abhiśastasya deśajātigotranāmakarmasārasahāyanivāsān anuyuñjīta
tāṃścāpadeśaiḥ pratisamānayet
tataḥ pūrvasyāhnaḥ pracāraṃ rātrau nivāsaṃ ca grahaṇād ityanuyuñjīta
tasyāpasārapratisaṃdhāne śuddhaḥ syāt anyathā karmaprāptaḥ
trirātrād ūrdhvam agrāhyaḥ śaṅkitakaḥ pṛcchābhāvād anyatropakaraṇadarśanāt
acoraṃ cora ityabhivyāharataścorasamo daṇḍaś coraṃ pracchādayataśca
coreṇābhiśasto vairadveṣābhyām apadiṣṭakaḥ śuddhaḥ syāt
śuddhaṃ parivāsayataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ
śaṅkāniṣpannam upakaraṇamantrisahāyarūpavaiyāvṛtyakarān niṣpādayet
karmaṇaśca pradeśadravyādānāṃśavibhāgaiḥ pratisamānayet
eteṣāṃ kāraṇānām anabhisaṃdhāne vipralapantam acoraṃ vidyāt
dṛśyate hyacoro 'pi coramārge yadṛcchayā saṃnipāte coraveṣaśastrabhāṇḍasāmānyena gṛhyamāṇaścorabhāṇḍasyopavāsena vā yathāṇimāṇḍavyaḥ karmakleśabhayād acoraḥ coro 'smi iti bruvāṇaḥ
tasmāt samāptakaraṇaṃ niyamayet
mandāparādhaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ vyādhitaṃ mattam unmattaṃ kṣutpipāsādhvaklāntam atyāśitam āmakāśitaṃ durbalaṃ vā na karma kārayet
tulyaśīlapuṃścalīprāpāvikakathāvakāśabhojanadātṛbhir apasarpayet
evam atisaṃdadhyād yathā vā nikṣepāpahāre vyākhyātam
āptadoṣaṃ karma kārayenna tveva striyaṃ garbhiṇīṃ sūtikāṃ vā māsāvaraprajātām
striyāstvardhakarma vākyānuyogo vā
brāhmaṇasya sattriparigrahaḥ śrutavatastapasvinaśca
tasyātikrama uttamo daṇḍaḥ kartuḥ kārayituśca karmaṇā vyāpādanena ca
vyāvahārikaṃ karmacatuṣkaṃ ṣaḍ daṇḍāḥ sapta kaśāḥ dvāv uparinibandhau udakanālikā ca
paraṃ pāpakarmaṇāṃ nava vetralatāḥ dvādaśa kaśāḥ dvāv ūruveṣṭau viṃśatir naktamālalatāḥ dvātriṃśattalāḥ dvau vṛścikabandhau ullambane ca dve sūcī hastasya yavāgūpītasya ekaparvadahanam aṅgulyāḥ snehapītasya pratāpanam ekam ahaḥ śiśirarātrau balbajāgraśayyā ca
ityaṣṭādaśakaṃ karma
tasyopakaraṇaṃ pramāṇaṃ praharaṇaṃ pradhāraṇam avadhāraṇaṃ ca kharapaṭṭād āgamayet
divasāntaram ekaikaṃ ca karma kārayet
pūrvakṛtāpadānaṃ pratijñāyāpaharantam ekadeśadṛṣṭadravyaṃ karmaṇā rūpeṇa vā gṛhītaṃ rājakośam avastṛṇantaṃ karmavadhyaṃ vā rājavacanāt samastaṃ vyastam abhyastaṃ vā karma kārayet
sarvāparādheṣvapīḍanīyo brāhmaṇaḥ
tasyābhiśastāṅko lalāṭe syād vyavahārapatanāya steye śvā manuṣyavadhe kabandho gurutalpe bhagaṃ surāpāne madyadhvajaḥ
brāhmaṇaṃ pāpakarmāṇam udghuṣyāṅkakṛtavraṇam
kuryān nirviṣayaṃ rājā vāsayed ākareṣu vā
samāhartṛpradeṣṭāraḥ pūrvam adhyakṣāṇām adhyakṣapuruṣāṇāṃ ca niyamanaṃ kuryuḥ
khanisārakarmāntebhyaḥ sāraṃ ratnaṃ vāpaharataḥ śuddhavadhaḥ
phalgudravyakarmāntebhyaḥ phalgu dravyam upaskaraṃ vā pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ
paṇyabhūmibhyo vā rājapaṇyaṃ māṣamūlyād ūrdhvam ā pādamūlyād ityapaharato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ ā dvipādamūlyād iti caturviṃśatipaṇaḥ ā tripādamūlyād iti ṣaṭtriṃśatpaṇaḥ ā paṇamūlyād ityaṣṭacatvāriṃśatpaṇaḥ ā dvipaṇamūlyād iti pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ ā catuṣpaṇamūlyād iti madhyamaḥ āṣṭapaṇamūlyād ityuttamaḥ ā daśapaṇamūlyād iti vadhaḥ
koṣṭhapaṇyakupyāyudhāgārebhyaḥ kupyabhāṇḍopaskarāpahāreṣvardhamūlyeṣu eta eva daṇḍāḥ
kośabhāṇḍāgārākṣaśālābhyaś caturbhāgamūlyeṣu eta eva dviguṇā daṇḍāḥ
iti rājaparigraheṣu vyākhyātam
bāhyeṣu tu pracchannam ahani kṣetrakhalaveśmāpaṇebhyaḥ kupyabhāṇḍam upaskaraṃ vā māṣamūlyād ūrdhvam ā pādamūlyād ityapaharatastripaṇo daṇḍaḥ gomayapradehena vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam ā dvipādamūlyād iti ṣaṭpaṇaḥ gomayabhasmanā vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam ā tripādamūlyād iti navapaṇaḥ gomayabhasmanā vā pralipyāvaghoṣaṇam śarāvamekhalayā vā ā paṇamūlyād iti dvādaśapaṇaḥ muṇḍanaṃ pravrājanaṃ vā ā dvipaṇamūlyād iti caturviṃśatipaṇaḥ muṇḍasyeṣṭakāśakalena pravrājanaṃ vā ā catuṣpaṇamūlyād iti ṣaṭtriṃśatpaṇa ā pañcapaṇamūlyād ityaṣṭacatvāriṃśatpaṇaḥ ā daśapaṇamūlyād iti pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍa ā viṃśatipaṇamūlyād iti dviśata ā triṃśatpaṇamūlyād iti pañcaśata ā catvāriṃśatpaṇamūlyād iti sāhasra ā pañcāśatpaṇamūlyād iti vadhaḥ
prasahya divā rātrau vāntaryāmikam apaharato 'rdhamūlyeṣu eta eva daṇḍāḥ
prasahya divā rātrau vā saśastrasyāpaharataścaturbhāgamūlyeṣu eta eva dviguṇā daṇḍāḥ
kuṭuṃbikādhyakṣamukhyasvāmināṃ kūṭaśāsanamudrākarmasu pūrvamadhyottamavadhā daṇḍāḥ yathāparādhaṃ vā
dharmasthaśced vivadamānaṃ puruṣaṃ tarjayati bhartsayatyapasārayatyabhigrasate vā pūrvam asmai sāhasadaṇḍaṃ kuryāt vākpāruṣye dviguṇam
pṛcchyaṃ na pṛcchati apṛcchyaṃ pṛcchati pṛṣṭvā vā visṛjati śikṣayati smārayati pūrvaṃ dadāti vā iti madhyamam asmai sāhasadaṇḍaṃ kuryāt
deyaṃ deśaṃ na pṛcchati adeyaṃ deśaṃ pṛcchati kāryam adeśenātivāhayati chalenātiharati kālaharaṇena śrāntam apavāhayati mārgāpannaṃ vākyam utkramayati matisāhāyyaṃ sākṣibhyo dadāti tāritānuśiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ punar api gṛhṇāti uttamam asmai sāhasadaṇḍaṃ kuryāt
punaraparādhe dviguṇaṃ sthānād vyavaropaṇaṃ ca
lekhakaśced uktaṃ na likhati anuktaṃ likhati duruktam upalikhati sūktam ullikhati arthotpattiṃ vā vikalpayati iti pūrvam asmai sāhasadaṇḍaṃ kuryād yathāparādhaṃ vā
dharmasthaḥ pradeṣṭā vā hairaṇyadaṇḍam adaṇḍye kṣipati kṣepadviguṇam asmai daṇḍaṃ kuryāt hīnātiriktāṣṭaguṇaṃ vā
śarīradaṇḍaṃ kṣipati śārīram eva daṇḍaṃ bhajeta niṣkrayadviguṇaṃ vā
yaṃ vā bhūtam arthaṃ nāśayati abhūtam arthaṃ karoti tadaṣṭaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt
dharmasthīye cārake bandhanāgāre vā śayyāsanabhojanoccārasaṃcārarodhabandhaneṣu tripaṇottarā daṇḍāḥ kartuḥ kārayituśca
cārakād abhiyuktaṃ muñcato niṣpātayato vā madhyamaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ abhiyogadānaṃ ca bandhanāgārāt sarvasvaṃ vadhaśca
bandhanāgārādhyakṣasya saṃruddhakam anākhyāya cārayataścaturviṃśatipaṇo daṇḍaḥ karma kārayato dviguṇaḥ sthānānyatvaṃ gamayato 'nnapānaṃ vā rundhataḥ ṣaṇṇavatir daṇḍaḥ parikleśayata utkoṭayato vā madhyamaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ ghnataḥ sāhasraḥ
parigṛhītāṃ dāsīm āhitikāṃ vā saṃruddhikām adhicarataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaś coraḍāmarikabhāryāṃ madhyamaḥ saṃruddhikām āryām uttamaḥ
saṃruddhasya vā tatraiva ghātaḥ
tad evākṣaṇagṛhītāyām āryāyāṃ vidyād dāsyāṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ
cārakam abhittvā niṣpātayato madhyamaḥ bhittvā vadhaḥ bandhanāgārāt sarvasvaṃ vadhaśca
evam arthacarān pūrvaṃ rājā daṇḍena śodhayet
śodhayeyuśca śuddhāste paurajānapadān damaiḥ
tīrthaghātagranthibhedordhvakarāṇāṃ prathame 'parādhe saṃdeśacchedanaṃ catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo vā daṇḍaḥ dvitīye chedanaṃ paṇasya śatyo vā daṇḍas tṛtīye dakṣiṇahastavadhaścatuḥśato vā daṇḍaś caturthe yathākāmī vadhaḥ
pañcaviṃśatipaṇāvareṣu kukkuṭanakulamārjāraśvasūkarasteyeṣu hiṃsāyāṃ vā catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍo nāsāgracchedanaṃ vā caṇḍālāraṇyacarāṇām ardhadaṇḍāḥ
pāśajālakūṭāvapāteṣu baddhānāṃ mṛgapaśupakṣivyālamatsyānām ādāne tacca tāvacca daṇḍaḥ
mṛgadravyavanān mṛgadravyāpahāre śatyo daṇḍaḥ
biṃbavihāramṛgapakṣisteye hiṃsāyāṃ vā dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ
kāruśilpikuśīlavatapasvināṃ kṣudrakadravyāpahāre śatyo daṇḍaḥ sthūlakadravyāpahāre dviśataḥ kṛṣidravyāpahāre ca
durgam akṛtapraveśasya praviśataḥ prākāracchidrād vā nikṣepaṃ gṛhītvāpasarataḥ kāṇḍarāvadho dviśato vā daṇḍaḥ
cakrayuktaṃ nāvaṃ kṣudrapaśuṃ vāpaharata ekapādavadhaḥ triśato vā daṇḍaḥ
kūṭakākaṇyakṣārālāśalākāhastaviṣamakāriṇa ekahastavadhaḥ catuḥśato vā daṇḍaḥ
stenapāradārikayoḥ sācivyakarmaṇi striyāḥ saṃgṛhītāyāśca karṇanāsāchedanaṃ pañcaśato vā daṇḍaḥ puṃso dviguṇaḥ
mahāpaśum ekaṃ dāsaṃ dāsīṃ vāpaharataḥ pretabhāṇḍaṃ vā vikrīṇānasya dvipādavadhaḥ ṣaṭchato vā daṇḍaḥ
varṇottamānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca hastapādalaṅghane rājayānavāhanādyārohaṇe caikahastapādavadhaḥ saptaśato vā daṇḍaḥ
śūdrasya brāhmaṇavādino devadravyam avastṛṇato rājadviṣṭam ādiśato dvinetrabhedinaśca yogāñjanenāndhatvam aṣṭaśato vā daṇḍaḥ
coraṃ pāradārikaṃ vā mokṣayato rājaśāsanam ūnam atiriktaṃ vā likhataḥ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ vā sahiraṇyam apaharataḥ kūṭavyavahāriṇo vimāṃsavikrayiṇaśca vāmahastadvipādavadho navaśato vā daṇḍaḥ
mānuṣamāṃsavikraye vadhaḥ
devapaśupratimāmanuṣyakṣetragṛhahiraṇyasuvarṇaratnasasyāpahāriṇa uttamo daṇḍaḥ śuddhavadho vā
puruṣaṃ cāparādhaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ gurulāghavam
anubandhaṃ tadātvaṃ ca deśakālau samīkṣya ca
uttamāvaramadhyatvaṃ pradeṣṭā daṇḍakarmaṇi

kalahe ghnataḥ puruṣaṃ citro ghātaḥ

śastreṇa praharata uttamo daṇḍaḥ
madena hastavadhaḥ mohena dviśataḥ
vadhe vadhaḥ
prahāreṇa garbhaṃ pātayata uttamo daṇḍo bhaiṣajyena madhyamaḥ parikleśena pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ
prasabhastrīpuruṣaghātakābhisārakanigrāhakāvaghoṣakāvaskandakopavedhakān pathiveśmapratirodhakān rājahastyaśvarathānāṃ hiṃsakān stenān vā śūlān ārohayeyuḥ

yadṛcchāghāte puṃsaḥ paśuyūthasteye ca śuddhavadhaḥ
daśāvaraṃ ca yūthaṃ vidyāt

āyudhīyasyottamaḥ

mṛtāyāṃ vadhaḥ
prāptaphalāṃ prakurvato madhyamāpradeśinīvadho dviśato vā daṇḍaḥ
pituścāvahīnaṃ dadyāt
na ca prākāmyam akāmāyāṃ labheta

paraśulkāvaruddhāyāṃ hastavadhaḥ catuḥśato vā daṇḍaḥ śulkadānaṃ ca
saptārtavaprajātāṃ varaṇād ūrdhvam alabhamānaḥ prakṛtya prākāmī syānna ca pitur avahīnaṃ dadyāt
ṛtupratirodhibhiḥ svāmyād apakrāmati
trivarṣaprajātārtavāyāstulyo gantum adoṣas tataḥ param atulyo 'pyanalaṃkṛtāyāḥ
pitṛdravyādāne steyaṃ bhajeta

kanyām anyāṃ darśayitvānyāṃ prayacchataḥ śatyo daṇḍastulyāyām hīnāyāṃ dviguṇaḥ
prakarmaṇy akumāryāś catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ śulkavyayakarmaṇī ca pratidadyāt
avasthāya tajjātaṃ paścātkṛtā dviguṇaṃ dadyāt
anyaśoṇitopadhāne dviśato daṇḍo mithyābhiśaṃsinaśca puṃsaḥ
śulkavyayakarmaṇī ca jīyeta
strīprakṛtā sakāmā samānā dvādaśapaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt prakartrī dviguṇam
akāmāyāḥ śatyo daṇḍa ātmarāgārtham śulkadānaṃ ca
svayaṃ prakṛtā rājadāsyaṃ gacchet
bahirgrāmasya prakṛtāyāṃ mithyābhiśaṃsane ca dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ
prasahya kanyām apaharato dviśataḥ sasuvarṇām uttamaḥ
bahūnāṃ kanyāpahāriṇāṃ pṛthag yathoktā daṇḍāḥ
gaṇikāduhitaraṃ prakurvataścatuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ śulkaṃ mātur bhogaḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇaḥ
dāsasya dāsyā vā duhitaram adāsīṃ prakurvataścaturviṃśatipaṇo daṇḍaḥ śulkāvandhyadānaṃ ca
niṣkrayānurūpāṃ dāsīṃ prakurvato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍo vastrāvandhyadānaṃ ca
sācivyāvakāśadāne kartṛsamo daṇḍaḥ
proṣitapatikām apacarantīṃ patibandhustatpuruṣo vā saṃgṛhṇīyāt
saṃgṛhītā patim ākāṅkṣeta
patiścet kṣameta visṛjyetobhayam
akṣamāyāṃ striyāḥ karṇanāsāchedanaṃ vadhaṃ jāraśca prāpnuyāt
jāraṃ cora ityabhiharataḥ pañcaśato daṇḍo hiraṇyena muñcatastadaṣṭaguṇaḥ
keśākeśikaṃ saṃgrahaṇam upaliṅganād vā śarīropabhogānām tajjātebhyaḥ strīvacanād vā
paracakrāṭavīhṛtām oghapravyūḍhām araṇyeṣu durbhikṣe vā tyaktāṃ pretabhāvotsṛṣṭāṃ vā parastriyaṃ nistārayitvā yathāsaṃbhāṣitaṃ samupabhuñjīta
jātiviśiṣṭām akāmām apatyavatīṃ niṣkrayeṇa dadyāt
corahastānnadīvegād durbhikṣād deśavibhramāt
nistārayitvā kāntārān naṣṭāṃ tyaktāṃ mṛteti vā
bhuñjīta striyam anyeṣāṃ yathāsaṃbhāṣitaṃ naraḥ
na tu rājapratāpena pramuktāṃ svajanena vā
na cottamāṃ na cākāmāṃ pūrvāpatyavatīṃ na ca
īdṛśīṃ tvanurūpeṇa niṣkrayeṇāpavāhayet
brāhmaṇam apeyam abhakṣyaṃ vā grāsayata uttamo daṇḍaḥ kṣatriyaṃ madhyamaḥ vaiśyaṃ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ śūdraṃ catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ
svayaṃ grasitāro nirviṣayāḥ kāryāḥ
paragṛhābhigamane divā pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍo rātrau madhyamaḥ
divā rātrau vā saśastrasya praviśata uttamo daṇḍaḥ
bhikṣukavaidehakau mattonmattau balād āpadi cātisaṃnikṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttapraveśāś cādaṇḍyāḥ anyatra pratiṣedhāt
svaveśmano virātrād ūrdhvaṃ parivāram ārohataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ paraveśmano madhyamaḥ grāmārāmavāṭabhedinaśca
grāmeṣvantaḥ sārthikā jñātasārā vaseyuḥ
muṣitaṃ pravāsitaṃ caiṣām anirgataṃ rātrau grāmasvāmī dadyāt
grāmāntareṣu vā muṣitaṃ pravāsitaṃ vivītādhyakṣo dadyāt
avivītānāṃ corarajjukaḥ
tathāpyaguptānāṃ sīmāvarodhena vicayaṃ dadyuḥ
asīmāvarodhe pañcagrāmī daśagrāmī vā
durbalaṃ veśma śakaṭam anuttabdhamūrdhastaṃbhaṃ śastram anapāśrayam apraticchannaṃ śvabhraṃ kūpaṃ kūṭāvapātaṃ vā kṛtvā hiṃsāyāṃ daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ vidyāt
vṛkṣacchedane damyaraśmiharaṇe catuṣpadānām adāntasevane vāhane vā kāṣṭhaloṣṭapāṣāṇadaṇḍabāṇabāhuvikṣepaṇeṣu yāne hastinā ca saṃghaṭṭane apehi iti prakrośann adaṇḍyaḥ
hastinā roṣitena hato droṇānnaṃ madyakuṃbhaṃ mālyānulepanaṃ dantapramārjanaṃ ca paṭaṃ dadyāt
aśvamedhāvabhṛthasnānena tulyo hastinā vadha iti pādaprakṣālanam
udāsīnavadhe yātur uttamo daṇḍaḥ
śṛṅgiṇā daṃṣṭriṇā vā hiṃsyamānam amokṣayataḥ svāminaḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ pratikruṣṭasya dviguṇaḥ
śṛṅgidaṃṣṭribhyām anyonyaṃ ghātayatastacca tāvacca daṇḍaḥ
devapaśum ṛṣabham ukṣāṇaṃ gokumārīṃ vā vāhayataḥ pañcaśato daṇḍaḥ pravāsayata uttamaḥ
lomadohavāhanaprajananopakāriṇāṃ kṣudrapaśūnām ādāne tacca tāvacca daṇḍaḥ pravāsane ca anyatra devapitṛkāryebhyaḥ
chinnanasyaṃ bhagnayugaṃ tiryakpratimukhāgataṃ pratyāsarad vā cakrayuktaṃ yātā paśumanuṣyasaṃbādhe vā hiṃsāyām adaṇḍyaḥ

bāle yātari yānasthaḥ svāmī daṇḍyo 'svāmini yānasthaḥ prāptavyavahāro vā yātā
bālādhiṣṭhitam apuruṣaṃ vā yānaṃ rājā haret
kṛtyābhicārābhyāṃ yatparam āpādayet tadāpādayitavyaḥ
kāmaṃ bhāryāyām anicchantyāṃ kanyāyāṃ vā dārārthino bhartari bhāryāyā vā saṃvadanakaraṇam

śvapākasyāryāgamane vadhaḥ striyāḥ karṇanāsāchedanam
pravrajitāgamane caturviṃśatipaṇo daṇḍaḥ
sakāmā tad eva labheta
rūpājīvāyāḥ prasahyopabhoge dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ
bahūnām ekām adhicaratāṃ pṛthak caturviṃśatipaṇo daṇḍaḥ
striyam ayonau gacchataḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasadaṇḍaḥ puruṣam adhimehataśca
maithune dvādaśapaṇastiryagyoniṣvanātmanaḥ
daivatapratimānāṃ ca gamane dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
adaṇḍyadaṇḍane rājño daṇḍastriṃśadguṇo 'mbhasi

tena tat pūyate pāpaṃ rājño daṇḍāpacārajam
śāstā hi varuṇo rājñāṃ mithyā vyācaratāṃ nṛṣu
vāstukapraśaste vāstuni nāyakavardhakimauhūrtikāḥ skandhāvāram vṛttaṃ dīrghaṃ caturaśraṃ vā bhūmivaśena vā caturdvāraṃ ṣaṭpathaṃ navasaṃsthānaṃ māpayeyuḥ khātavaprasāladvārāṭṭālakasampannaṃ bhaye sthāne ca

kīṭaḥ _ anyatamaḥ taptaḥ kṛṣṇasarpa priyaṅgubhiḥ
śoṣayet eṣa saṃyogaḥ
sadyas prāṇa haraḥ mataḥ
dhāmārgava yātudhāna mūlam bhallātaka puṣpa cūrṇa yuktam ārdhamāsikaḥ
vyāghātaka mūlam bhallātaka puṣpa cūrṇa yuktam kīṭa yogaḥ māsikaḥ
kalā mātram puruṣāṇām
dviguṇam khara aśvānām
caturguṇam hasti uṣṭrāṇām
śata kardama uccidiṅga karavīra kaṭutumbī matsya dhūmaḥ madana kodrava palālena hastikarṇapalāśa palālena _ pravāta anuvāte praṇītaḥ _ carati tāvat mārayati
pūtikīṭa matsya kaṭutumbī śata kardama idhma indragopa cūrṇam pūtikīṭa kṣudrā hema vidārī cūrṇam _ basta śṛṅga khura cūrṇa yuktam andhīkaraḥ dhūmaḥ
pūtikarañja pattra haritāla manaḥśilā guñjā rakta kārpāsa palālāni āsphoṭa kāca go śakṛt rasa piṣṭam andhīkaraḥ dhūmaḥ

nety āhāśmarathyaḥ

jīved ayam ahorātrāv ity ekāhāny ekadvivāsavane sarvāṇi savanāni samāveśayet

savanāni nānātantrāṇi ced api bhavanti durgāpattau ca samāse veṣṭīnāṃ samāveśayed vakṣyakāmaḥ
yāḥ kāś caikatantrā iṣṭayaḥ syur avyavahitāḥ kāmaṃ tā ekatantre samāveśya haviṣām ānupūrvyeṇa pracaret
prāk sviṣṭakṛto mukhaṃ tu pañcājyāhutīr juhuyāt
agnaye somāya viṣṇava indrāgnibhyāṃ prajāpataya iti

varāhamārjāramāhiṣāṃ śakuno 'nyo 'vadānāni māṃsāni jāṅgalāni ca yady aśiṣaḥ syān māsi māsi ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ juhuyāt
sūryaṃ te cakṣur gacchatu vāto ātmānaṃ prāṇo dyāṃ pṛṣṭham antarikṣam ātmāṅgair yajñaṃ pṛthivīṃ śarīraiḥ vācaspate 'chidrayā vācāchidrayā juhvā devāvṛdhaṃ divi hotrām airayat svāheti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ hutvā prajāpatiḥ sarvam evedam utsṛjet

apy ekasyāṃ dhītāyām adhītā dohayet
adhītābhiḥ saṃsthāpya dhītānām vatsān apākṛtya śvaḥ sāṃnāyyena yajeta
sāyaṃdohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat sāyaṃdohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta
prātardohaṃ ced apahareyuḥ sāyaṃdohaṃ dvaidhaṃ kṛtvānyatarat prātardohasthāne kṛtvobhābhyāṃ yajeta
ubhau ced duṣyeyātām aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ nirupyāgneyena pracaryaindreṇānupracared uttarām upoṣya vobhābhyāṃ yajeta
sarvāṇi ceddhavīṃṣy apahareyur duṣyeyur vājyena ca devatā yajeta
athānyām adoṣām iṣṭiṃ tanvītām apo duṣṭam abhyavahareyuḥ
brāhmaṇair abhakṣyaṃ duṣṭaṃ haviḥ
bhūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded bhūpataye svāheti tribhiḥ prādeśair diśo mimāya tad yajamāno devāñ janam agann ity anuṣaṅgaḥ
yajñasya tvā pramayeti catasṛbhiḥ parigṛhṇīyāt
yajñasya tvā pramayonmayābhimayā pratimayā paridadema svāheti
anutpūtaṃ ced ājyaṃ skanded vittaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyāt
tathotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ dadyād athotpūtam utpūyamānaṃ ced ghṛtaṃ prāṇaṃ dadyād devatāntare ced ghṛtam
āhutilopavyatyāse
tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ na iti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt
tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḍo 'vayāsisīṣṭhāḥ yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pramumugdhy asmat
sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau
ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḍīkaṃ suhavo na edhi svāheti

yady anājñātā brahmata om bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity āhavanīya eva juhuyād ājyabhāgānte sve devatām āvāhayiṣyan yasyaiva havir niruptaṃ syāt tatontayā yajetājyasyaitāni nirupya

barhiṣi skanne nādriyeta

tatas tam eva punar nirvapet

āgneyam ekakapālaṃ nirvaped āśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ saumyaṃ catuḥkapālaṃ
naṣṭe bhinne ca bhārgavo hotā kīṭāvapannaṃ sānnāyyaṃ madhyamena parṇena mahī dyauḥ ity antaḥparidhideśe ninayet
mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatāṃ pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ svāhā iti

vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpam adābhyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyaṃ

sarvāṇi ced āhutivelāyāṃ patny anālambhukā syāt tām aparudhya yajeta

āhutiś ced bahiṣparidhi skanded āgnīdhraṃ brūyuḥ saṃkrahiṣyāṃ tvā juhudhīti
tasmai pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt

aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvāsīda sadanaṃ svam āsīda sadanaṃ svam

chāvalīdeva sāyaṃ yasya skanno homaḥ syāt prātar nāśnīyāt
prātar yasya skanno homaḥ syāt sāyaṃ nāśnīyāt
mantraskannaṃ ced abhivarṣen mitro janān yātayatīti samidham ādhāyānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt

kīṭāvapannaṃ hiraṇyagarbha iti valmīkavapāyām avanīyānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt

varo dakṣiṇā
agnīn upasamādhāya yajamānaḥ patnī vābhuñjānau vāgyatāv araṇīpāṇī sarvāhṇam upāsīyātām

yadi hy ayaṃ divā prajāsu hi manyeta sajūr jātavedo divā pṛthivyā haviṣo vīhi svāheti sajūruho vā syāt sajūr agnaye divā pṛthivyā haviṣo vīhi svāheti dvādaśarātram agnihotraṃ juhuyāt
yadi na viramayed agnaye suśīryatamo juṣasva svāhety aparaṃ dvādaśarātraṃ niśāyāḥ sāyamāhuter atipattir prātarāśe prātarāhuter āsādyāgnihotram ā tamitor āsīta

yo brāhmaṇo bahuvit syāt samuddharet

tato 'jāṃ nāśnīyāt

samūḍham asya pāṃsure
pra tad viṣṇur iti bhasmanā padam upavapet

rūpaṃ rūpaṃ vayo vayas tena tvā pari dadhmasi
śukeṣu te harimāṇaṃ prapaṇākāsu dadhmasi
atho hāridraveṣu te harimāṇaṃ ni dadhmasi
yāḥ purastāt ācaranti nīcais sūryāt adhas divaḥ etam apsarasām vrātam brahmaṇā achā ā vadāmasi
yāḥ adharāt ācaranti jihmā mukhā karikratīḥ āhatāḥ apa tāḥ itas
naśyantu atas śvanvatīḥ
yāḥ kulyāḥ yāḥ vanyāḥ yāḥ u ca unmādayiṣṇavaḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ mṛśmaśā akaram dṛṣadā khalvān iva
cetantīm aśmalām palām tāsām vaḥ namaḥ arciṣe
ārāt yakṣmam ni dhatta asmāt naḥ adhi pūruṣāt
kāmaḥ tat agre sam avartata manasaḥ retaḥ prathamam yat āsīt
sa kāma kāmena bṛhatā sayoniḥ rāyaspoṣam yajamānāya dhehi
tvam kāma sahasā asi pratiṣṭhitaḥ vibhuḥ vibhāvā su sakhā sakhīyate
tvam ugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ
sahaḥ ojaḥ yajamānāya dhehi
dūrāt cakamānāya pravipāṇāya akṣaye ā asmai aśṛṇvan āśāḥ
kāmena ajanayan svar
kāmena mā kāmaḥ āgan hṛdayāt hṛdayam pari
yat amīṣām adaḥ manaḥ tat aitu upa mām iha
yat kāma kāmayamānāḥ idam kṛṇmasi te haviḥ tat naḥ sarvam sam ṛdhyatām
atha etasya haviṣaḥ vīhi svāhā
kaḥ idam kasmai adāt
kāmaḥ kāmāya adāt
kāmaḥ dātā
kāmaḥ pratigrahītā
kāmaḥ samudram ā viveśa
kāmena tvā prati gṛhṇāmi
kāma etat te
imaṃ me kuṣṭha pūruṣaṃ tam ā vaha taṃ niṣ kṛdhi
tam u me agadaṃ kṛdhi
udaṅ jāto himavataḥ sa prācyāṃ nīyase janam
tatra kuṣṭhasya nāmāny uttamāni vi bhejire
uttamo nāmāsy uttamo nāma te pitā
yataḥ kuṣṭha prajāyase tata ehy ariṣṭatātaye
śīrṣahatyām upahatyām akṣyos tanvo rapaḥ
kuṣṭho no viśvatas pātu daivaṃ samaha vṛṣṇyam
yad agnir āpo adahat praviśya yatrākṛṇvan dharmadhṛto namāṃsi
tatra ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitraṃ sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅdhi takman
yadi śoko yady abhiśoko rudrasya prāṇo yadi vāruṇo 'si
huḍur nāmāsi haritasya deva sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅdhi takman
yady arcir yadi vāsi dhūmaḥ śakalyeṣu yadi vā te janitram
namaḥ śītāya takmane namo rūrāya kṛṇmo vayaṃ te
yo anyedyur ubhayadyuś caranti tṛtīyakāya namo astu takmane
tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandim uta hāyanam
takmānaṃ viśvaśāradaṃ graiṣmaṃ nāśaya vārṣikam
āpo adyānv acāriṣaṃ rasena sam asṛkṣmahi
payasvān agna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā
saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi
vidyur me asya devā indro vidyāt saharṣibhiḥ
idam āpaḥ pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat
yac ca dudrohānṛtaṃ yac ca śepe abhīruṇam
śivān agnīn apsuṣado havāmahe mayi kṣatraṃ varca ā dhatta devīḥ
yad āpo naktaṃ mithunaṃ cacāra yad vā dudroha duritaṃ purāṇam
hiraṇyavarṇās tata ut punantu mā pra mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt
agnir janavin mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt
somo vasuvin mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt
pūṣā jñātivin mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt
indraḥ sahīyān mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt
agnaye janavide svāhā
somāya vasuvide svāhā
pūṣṇe jñātivide svāhā
indrāya sahīyase svāhā
yāḥ purastād ācaranti yā vā paścāt sadānvāḥ
aśmānam ṛchantīr yantu yo 'yaṃ svādāv anādyaḥ
yā adharād ācaranty uttarād vā sadānvāḥ
yāḥ paścād ācaranti purastād vā sadānvāḥ
yā uttarād ācaranty adharād vā sadānvāḥ
ubhayīr aham āyatāḥ parācīr akaraṃ tvat
devebhir anyā astā bahvīr anyā atho divam
namas te rudrāsyate namaḥ pratihitābhyaḥ
namo visṛjyamānābhyo namo nipatitābhyaḥ
hiraṇyayīr ma ulbaṇyaḥ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatā
tābhiḥ pari śrayāmahe tā no rakṣantu sarvataḥ
bahv idam anyad viṣṭitaṃ tasya kāmaṃ vi vidhyata
ayasmayaṃ me vimitaṃ yuṣmad bhiyā mahat kṛtaṃ
namasā namasyenyam
tenā pari śrayāmahe tan no rakṣatu sarvataḥ
ayasmayaṃ varma kṛṇve dvāraṃ kṛṇve ayasmayam
khīlān ayasmayān kṛṇve te no rakṣantu sarvataḥ
imā yās tisraḥ pṛthivīs tāsāṃ ha bhūmir uttamā
tāsām adhi tvaco ahaṃ sam u jagrabha bheṣajam
śreṣṭham asi vairudhānāṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ bheṣajānām
yajño bhaga iva yāmeṣu deveṣu varuṇo yathā
revatīr anādhṛṣṭāḥ siṣāsantīḥ siṣāsatha
etā stha keśavardhanīr atho stha keśadṛṃhaṇīḥ
dṛṃha mūlam āgraṃ yacha vi madhyaṃ yamayauṣadhe
keśavardhanam asy ātharvaṇaṃ keśadṛṃhaṇam asy ātharvaṇam
agne gobhir na ā gahīndo rayyā sacasva naḥ
indro dhartā gṛheṣu naḥ
savitā yaḥ sahasriyaḥ sa no gṛheṣu raṇyatu
ā puṣṭam etv ā vasu
tvaṣṭā yo vṛṣabho yuvā sa no gṛheṣu rāraṇat
sahasreṇa śatena ca
dhātā dadhātu no rayim īśāno jagatas patiḥ
sa naḥ pūrṇena yachatu
mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā mamobhendrābṛhaspatī
mama tvaṣṭā ca pūṣā ca mamaiva savitā vaśe
mama viṣṇuś ca somaś ca mamaiva maruto bhuvan
sarasvāṃś ca bhagaś ca viśve devā vaśe mama
mamobhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ svar mama
mamemāḥ sarvā oṣadhīr āpaḥ sarvā vaśe mama
mama gāvo mamāśvā mamājāś cāvayaś ca mamaiva puruṣā bhuvan
mamedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad ejat prāṇad vaśe mama
agne 'bhyāvartinn abhi na ā vavṛtsva
āyuṣā varcasā sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena
agne jātavedaḥ śataṃ te santv āvṛtaḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ
adhā puṣṭasyeśānaḥ punar no rayim ā kṛdhi
saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā
viśvapsnyā viśvatas pari
punar ūrjā vavṛtsva punar agna iṣāyuṣā
punar naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ
yāḥ senā abhītvarīr āvyādhinīr ugaṇā uta
ya steno yaś ca taskaras tāṃs te agne 'pi dadhāmy āsani
jambhair malimlūn agne daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ taskarān uta
hanūbhyāṃ stenān maghavan tāṃs tvaṃ khāda sukhāditān
ye grāmeṣu malimlava stenāsas taskarā vane
ye kakṣeṣv aghāyavas tāṃs te agne 'pi dadhāmy āsani
yo asmabhyam arātīyād yaś ca no dveṣad ij janaḥ
āmādaḥ kravyādo ripūṃs tān agne saṃ dahā tvam
ā krandaya dhanapata ud enam ardayāmutaḥ
arvāñcaṃ punar ā kṛdhi yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā
parisartaḥ pari dhāvākartaḥ punar ā kṛdhi
atho ma indraś cāgniś cāmum ā nayatām iha
ekārka ekakāmāya yasmai kāmāya khāyase
tena me viśvadhāvīryāmum ā nayatād iha
yatra yatra carantaṃ nyamraug abhi sūryaḥ
tato me pathye revaty amum ā nayatād iha
asitasya taimātasya babhror apodakasya ca
sarvā viṣasya dhāmāny udnevāgnim avīvare
iṣīkādanta durlabha kiṃ me sakhāyam ātudaḥ
na mām apaśya āgataṃ satīnaṃ viṣadūṣaṇam
yat tālavye dati saṃsisikṣe viṣaṃ tvam
trayas tudā rujāmasi babhruko nakulas tvat
trayo vai smaḥ sakhāyo babhruko nakulas tvat
te sarve apy apātayann āheyam arasaṃ viṣam
sārasvataṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ babhruvakṣaṃ śītarūre tanvāv asya bhīme
anyedyukaṃ sadandiṃ tvā tṛtīyaka huve namasyaṃ sahadevam apsujam
yo apsujo aruṇo mānuṣe jane viveśa babhrur harṣayiṣṇur akṣitaḥ
śītarūrāya tarṣayiṣṇave juguśīrṣasāvayeśaṃ namo astu devāḥ
yo harṣayañ jañjabhaḥ svedano vaśī vaśaḥ prāraḥ śītarūrāśiṣe manūn
so asmabhyaṃ mṛḍayan prehi saṃśito yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tam abhi prajānan
namas te vidma te kāśanāyanaṃ yato yataḥ surabhe saṃbabhūvitha
sa no mā hiṃsīr namo astu tubhyaṃ śīrṣaktyā yakṣmād iha pārayā naḥ
asya tvaṃ dadataḥ soma rājan varmeva tanvaṃ pari pāhi viśvataḥ
yo brahmaṇe rādho viddho dadāti tasya soma pra tira dīrgham āyuḥ
asya soma pra tira dīrgham āyur ahānīva sūryo vāsarāṇi
māsyā susron nāśayā vyadhmano viṣaṃ bahiḥ śalyaś caratu rogo asmāt
dānaṃ tṛṣṇāyāḥ pari pāti viddhaṃ dānaṃ kṣudho dānam id eva mṛtyoḥ
aviṣkandho bhavatu yo dadāty ā pyāyate papurir dakṣiṇayā
ā pyāyatāṃ papurir dakṣiṇayā varmeva syūtaṃ pari pāhi viśvataḥ
bahir viṣaṃ tanvo astv asya sraṃsatāṃ śalyo adhy āre asmāt
brahmā śaravyām apa bādhatām ito nadyāḥ kūlān nāvam ivādhi śambī
tasmai dadad dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇuṣva śataṃ ca naḥ śarado jīvatād iha
yadā dadāti pradadāti yadā brahmā pratigṛhṇāti rādho asya
ād id vidyād upahatyā arātiḥ sarve yakṣmā apa tiṣṭhantu sākam
vyāghrarūpaḥ surabhiḥ siṃhasya retasā kṛtaḥ
madhye pṛthivyā niṣṭhitaḥ sam akhyad yātudhānyaḥ
abhi prehi māpa vikthāḥ pade gṛbhāya māpade
atraiva sarvā jambhaya yāḥ kāś ca yātudhānyaḥ
pratībodhaś caturakṣaḥ sraktyo aśmeva vīḍubhit
pratīcīḥ kṛtyā ākṛtyāmuṃ kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi
kṛtyākṛtaṃ valaginaṃ mūlinaṃ śapatheyyam
indras tu sarvāṃs tān hantu saptaghnena ruvām iva
arasasya śarkoṭasya nīcīnasyopasarpataḥ
viṣaṃ hi sarvam ādiṣy atho enam ajījabham
na te bāhvo raso asti na śīrṣe nota madhyataḥ
kim idaṃ pāpayāmuyā pucche bibharṣy arbhakam
yat te skandhān upatasthau vijāmni yac ca te parau
apamityam ivābhṛtaṃ malaṃ te prati dadhmasi
adanti tvā pipīlikā vi vṛścanti mayūryaḥ
sarve bhala bravātha śārkoṭam arasaṃ viṣam
kṛtaṃ me dakṣiṇe haste savye me jaya āhitaḥ
gojid bhūyāsam aśvajit kṛtaṃcayo hiraṇyajit
akṣāḥ phalavatīṃ divaṃ datta gāṃ kṣīriṇīm iva
saṃ mā kṛtasya dhārayā dhanuḥ snāvneva nahyata
ubhau hastau pratidīvno brahmaṇāpombhāmasi
kalir enaṃ yathā hanad āsya vedo bharāmahai
ā bhadraṃ dvāparam uta tretāṃ parā kalim
kṛtaṃ me hasta āhitaṃ sa hi saumanaso mahān
yad eyatha pareyatha yat te tan mana īyate
tatas tvā punar arvāñcaṃ bhūtasyājīgamat patiḥ
ā tvā nayād bhūtapatir ā devo bṛhaspatiḥ
ādityāḥ sarve tvā neṣan viśve devāḥ suvarcasaḥ
anumatiḥ sarasvatī bhago rājā ny ā nayāt
śālā mānasya patnīhaivāsya manas karat
yas tvā nināya nayakaḥ sa u tvehā nayāt punaḥ
mano hi brahmāṇo vidur viśvakarmā manīṣiṇaḥ
gātau haviḥ janayan tasthe indra
agram jyeṣṭha pari agāma iha deva
sa gātau gātau uttama āpaya āpim asmabhyam indra dadataḥ pracetaḥ
agniḥ naḥ puras etā astu añjasā
bṛhaspatiḥ sanyā astu naḥ sakhā
indram huve vṛtra haṇam puram daram
bhagena adya bhagavantaḥ syāma
tvam soma divyaḥ nṛ cakṣāḥ
sugāṁ asmabhyam pathaḥ anu khyaḥ
abhi naḥ gotram viduṣaḥ iva neṣaḥ
acchā naḥ vācam uśatīm jigāsi
imām agne śaraṇim mīmṛṣaḥ naḥ imam adhvānam yam agāma dūram
āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānām bhṛmiḥ asi ṛṣi kṛt martyānām
ye purastāt āsyandete gāvau sva ṛṣabhe iva kṛṇomi aham aśva vārāt aṇīyasī
ye adharāt āsyandete gāvau sva ṛṣabhe iva kṛṇomi aham aśva vārāt aṇīyasī
ye paścāt āsyandete gāvau sva ṛṣabhe iva kṛṇomi aham aśva vārāt aṇīyasī
ye uttarāt āsyandete gāvau sva ṛṣabhe iva kṛṇomi aham aśva vārāt aṇīyasī
agne yaśasvin yaśasā vardhayemam indrāvatīm upacitim ihā vaha
ayaṃ mūrdhā parameṣṭhī suvarcāḥ samānānām uttamaśloko astu
dhātā vidhartā paramota saṃdṛk prajāpatiḥ parameṣṭhī virāṭ
stomāś chandāṃsi nivido ma āhus te asmai rāṣṭram upa saṃ namantu
bhadram icchanta ṛṣayaḥ svarvidas tapo dīkṣām upa ni ṣedur agre
tato rāṣṭraṃ balam ojaś ca jātaṃ tad asmai devā upa saṃ namantu
upā vartadhvam upa na eta sarve ayaṃ cettādhipatir vo astu
samānaṃ mantram abhi mantrayādhvā imaṃ paścād upa jīvātha sarve
tvam agne pramatiḥ
tvam pitā asi naḥ
tvam sakhā yujyaḥ asi jātavedaḥ
tvam viśva vid gātu vid kaviḥ
viśvāḥ āśāḥ abhayāḥ santu asme
idam varcaḥ agninā dattam āgan bhargaḥ yaśaḥ sahaḥ ojaḥ vayaḥ balam
trayastriṃśat yāni vīryāṇi tāni agniḥ pra dadātu me
varcaḥ ā dhehi me tanvām sahaḥ ojaḥ vayaḥ balam
indriyāya tvā karmaṇe vīryāya prati gṛhṇāmi śata śāradāya
ūrje tvā balāya tvā ojase sahase tvā abhibhūyāya tvā rāṣṭra bhṛtyāya pari ūhāmi śata śāradāya
ṛtubhiḥ tvā ārtavaiḥ āyuṣe varcase tvā saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena saṃhanu kṛṇmasi
idam āñjanam ānaje ākanikradam
abhi mā cakranda bhagaḥ ṛṣabhaḥ vāśitām iva
aśvaḥ kanikradat yathā pratyaṅ mā bhagaḥ āgamat
tam aham putram iva upasthe ādhiṣi
akṣyau me madhu saṃkāśe
jihvā me madhu vādinī
nasoḥ adhi pramandanam
datsu me sāragham madhu
madhumat mama niṃsanam
jaghanam madhumat mama
mām id kila tvam vāvanaḥ śākhām madhumatīm iva
pretā jayatā nara ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ
indro vaḥ śarma yacchatv anādhṛṣyā yathāsatha
ud dharṣantāṃ maghavann āyudhāny ut satvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi
ud dharṣantāṃ vājināṃ vājināny ud vīrāṇāṃ jayatām etu ghoṣaḥ
pṛthag ghoṣā ululayaḥ ketumanta ud īratām
devā indrajyeṣṭhā maruto yantu senayā
avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite
jayāmitrān pra padyasva māmīṣāṃ kaṃ canoc chiṣaḥ
dūṣyā dūṣir asi hetyā hetir asi menyā menir asi
sraktyo 'si pratisaro 'si punaḥsaro 'si pratyabhicaraṇo 'si
prati tam abhi cara yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
sūrir asi varcodhās tanūpāna āyuṣyaḥ kṛtyādūṣaṇaḥ
śukro 'si bhrājo 'si jyotir asi svar asi
āpnuhi śreyāṃsam ati samaṃ krāma
viṣkandhasya kābavasya kardamasya ulūkyāḥ apasthānasya kṛtyāḥ yāḥ teṣām tvam khṛgale jahi
pra mṛṇīhi upahatyām kardamam nīlaśākyam
adha sāram iva dāruṇaḥ āyuḥ kṛṇomi antaram
vividdhasya avatṛṇṇasya hrutasya ca a hrutasya ca tri parṇī viśva bheṣajī idam kṛṇotu bheṣajam
kābavasya viṣkandhasya apasthāpana bheṣajam idam kṛṇomi bheṣajam yathā ayam agadaḥ asati
yasmāt aṅgāt saṃsusrāva yat babhūva galantaśas gāvaḥ vatsam iva jānānāḥ tat paraitu yathāyatham
na asṛj asti pataṅgasya tardasya maśakādyāḥ
veṇoḥ pūtudroḥ na asti
mā asya glauḥ mā apacit bhuvat
aham veda yathā āsitha
gurvikā nāma vai asi
amum tvam tam itas gaccha yam aham dveṣmi pūruṣam
tasya api madhye ā sīda
nīla grīvāsu sīdata vātasya anu pravām maśakasya anu saṃvidam
pra itas yantu agruvaḥ
niḥ itas yantu agruvaḥ adharācīm itas paras
pra aham glāvam adhmāsam
niḥ aham glāvam adhmāsam adharācīm itas paras
abhi tvām aham ojasā indraḥ dasyūn iva abhuvam
sapatni naśyatāt itas
dūram gaccha adhi okasaḥ
sāsahai id aham patim
sāsahai śvaśurau ubhau
atha u sapatnīm sāsahai yathā naśyāti okasaḥ
abhibhūḥ aham āgamam viśva karmā mahā vadā
aham kalpayantī eṣu gṛheṣu duṣṭarā
ud tiṣṭha
mama vai idam
na tava iha api kim cana
māṃ caiva paśyann āyaty amuṃ ca divi sūryam
yas tvā mṛtyur abhyadhatta jāyamānaṃ supāśayā
taṃ te satyasya hastābhyām ud amuñcad bṛhaspatiḥ
abhi tvā jarimāhita gām ukṣaṇam iva rajjvā
vy anye yantu mṛtyavo yān āhur itarāñ chatam
pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāv anaḍvāhāv iva vrajam
śarīram asyāṅgāni jarimṇe nayataṃ yuvam
ihaiva staṃ prāṇāpānau memaṃ hāsiṣṭaṃ mṛtyave
ayaṃ jarimṇaḥ śevadhir ariṣṭa iha vardhatām
jarase tvā pari dadmo jarase ni dhuvāmasi
jarā tvā bhadrayā neṣad vy anye yantu mṛtyavo yān āhur itarāñ chatam
muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kam ajñātayakṣmād uta rājayakṣmāt
grāhyā gṛbhīto yady eṣa etat tata indrāgnī pra mumuktam enam
yadi kṣitāyur yadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyor antikaṃ nīta eva

āgan rātrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ vasv āveśayantī

puruṣaḥ riṣat
hai hai kalyāṇi subhage pṛśniparṇi an āture imam me adya pūruṣam dīrgha āyu tvāya ud naya
yābhyaḥ varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ yābhiḥ jīvanti aghnyāḥ tāḥ me viṣasya dūṣaṇīḥ savitā vi akāśayat
prajāpatiḥ tvā abadhnāt prathamam astṛtam vīryāya kam
tam te badhnāmi āyuṣe varcase ojase ca balāya ca
astṛtaḥ tvā abhi rakṣatu
ūrdhvaḥ tiṣṭha rakṣan a pramādam astṛta imam
mā tvā dabhan paṇayaḥ yātudhānāḥ
indraḥ iva dasyūn ava dhūnuṣva pṛtanyataḥ
sarvān śatrūn vi sahasva
śatam cana praharantaḥ abhighnantaḥ na tastrire
tasmin indraḥ pari adatta cakṣuḥ prāṇam atha u balam
indrasya tvā varmaṇā pari dhāpayāmaḥ yaḥ devānām adhirājaḥ babhūva
punar tvā devāḥ pra nayantu sarve
tvā abhi rakṣatu
asmin maṇau eka śatam vīryāṇi
sahasram prāṇāḥ asmin astṛte
vyāghraḥ śatrūn abhi tiṣṭha sarvān
yaḥ tvā pṛtanyāt adharaḥ saḥ astu
ghṛtāt ulluptaḥ madhumān payasvān sahasra prāṇaḥ śata yoniḥ vayaḥ dhāḥ
śaṃbhūḥ ca mayobhūḥ ca ūrjasvān ca payasvān ca astṛtaḥ tvā abhi rakṣatu
yathā tvam uttaraḥ asaḥ a sapatnaḥ sapatna hā sajātānām asaḥ vaśī tathā tvā savitā karat
apaḥ ca rapaḥ ca ūṣmā ca bāṣpaḥ ca śokaḥ ca abhiśokaḥ ca tṛtīyekaḥ ca pareparaḥ ca te takmānaḥ itas naśyata
veda vai te takman nāma
agniḥ tvam nāma asi
tam tvā itas vi nayāmaḥ
vṛtrasya haraḥ asi nabhasaḥ napāt
dyauḥ ca asmat pṛthivī ca takmānam nāśayatām itas
pañcapsniḥ nāma te mātā
saḥ u ekapsniḥ ucyase
tasya aham veda te nāma
sa takman niḥ atas drava
audumbaraḥ ca nāma asi priyātithiḥ ca
tam tvā itas nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryāvatā
yaḥ asi jalpan ca lapan ca āvān ca tapan ca tṛtīyekaḥ ca te takmānaḥ itas naśyata
vikilīda vilohita vikāśakraṃdarajjana
girim gaccha dhūma keto
namāṃsi santu te
bṛhat tvam agne rakṣaḥ adhamam jahi
madhyamam ni uttamam śṛṇīhi
śam naḥ agniḥ jyotiḥ anīkaḥ astu śam dyāvā pṛthivī anehasā
mātā iva pitā iva abhi rakṣata enam
muñcata enam pari aṃhasaḥ
vātāj jāto antarikṣād vidyuto jyotiṣas pari
sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ
hiraṇyānām eko asi somād adhi jajñiṣe
rathe asi darśata iṣudhau rocanas tvam
yo agrato rocanāvān samudrād adhi jajñiṣe
śaṅkhena hatvā rakṣāṃsy atriṇo vi ṣahāmahe
ye atriṇo yātudhānā rakṣaso ye kimīdinaḥ
sarvāñ chaṅkha tvayā vayaṃ viṣūco vi ṣahāmahe
śaṅkhenāmīvām amatiṃ śaṅkhenota sadānvāḥ
śaṅkho no viśvabheṣajaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ
divi jātaḥ samudrataḥ sindhutas pary ābhṛtaḥ
sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkha āyuṣprataraṇo maṇiḥ
devānām asthi kṛśanaṃ babhūva tad ātmanvac caraty apsv antaḥ
taṃ te badhnāmy āyuṣe varcasa ojase ca balāya ca kārśanas tvābhi rakṣatu
kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat
astaṃ bharanty abravīd indrāya sunomi tvā śakrāya sunomi tvā
asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ vicākaśat
imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam
kuvic chakat kuvit karat kuvin no vasyasas karat
kuvit patidviṣo yatīr indreṇa saṃ gamāmahai
ā cana tvā cikitsāmo 'dhi cana tvā nemasi
śanair iva śanakair ivendrāyendo pari srava
imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya
śiras tatasyorvarām ād idaṃ ma upodare
asau ca yā na urvarād imāṃ tanvaṃ mama
atho tatasya yac chiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi
khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato
apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam
ānujāvaram anu rakṣante ugrāḥ yeṣām indram vīryāya airayanta
purohitaḥ parameṣṭhī sva rājyāya abhīvardham asmai akṛṇot bṛhaspatiḥ
tena sapatnān adharān kṛṇuṣva
kṣeme paśūn bahulān vardhayitvā jaitrāya ud yātu rathavāhanam te
go bhājam aṃśam tava ye samānāḥ sarve samagrāḥ dadhṛṣ ā bharanta
abhi vardhasva bhrātṛvyān abhi ye tvā pṛtanyataḥ
ni piṇḍhi sarvān dhūrvataḥ abhīvardhaḥ yathā asasi
abhīvardham abhībhavam abhīṣeṇam mahā gaṇam viśaḥ tvā sarvāḥ ā yantu āpaḥ divyāḥ payasvatīḥ
abhi vardhasva prajayā vāvṛdhānaḥ
abhi anīkaiḥ paśubhiḥ bhavāsi
brahma rājanyaiḥ viśyaiḥ vāvṛdhānaḥ śūdraiḥ ati ihi sabhayā pṛtanyataḥ
vardhasva kṣetraiḥ
prathasva prajayā
vardhasva vīraiḥ
paśubhiḥ bahuḥ bhava
śriyā śulkaiḥ yatamaḥ tvā pṛtanyāt āptaḥ tubhyam sa bali hṛtyāya tiṣṭhatu
indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇam agnim ūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe
rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana
ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śaṃbhuvaḥ
avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā
narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayantaṃ kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnair īmahe
bṛhaspate sadam in naḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yor yat te manurhitaṃ tad īmahe
indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāḍha ṛṣir ahvad ūtaye
devair no devy aditir ni pātu devas trātā trāyatām aprayuchan
tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
apa naḥ śośucad agham
agne śuśugdhy ā rayim
sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe
pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaś ca sūrayaḥ
pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam
pra yad agneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ
tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūr asi
dviṣo no viśvatomukhāti nāveva pāraya
devāḥ śaraṇa kṛtaḥ śaraṇāḥ me bhavata prācyāḥ diśaḥ agninā rājñā adhyakṣeṇa
yaśāḥ bhūyāsam
yaśasam mā kṛṇuta cārum anna adam
parā dviṣantam śṛṇīta
bhavata dakṣiṇāyāḥ diśaḥ indreṇa rājñā
bhavata pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ varuṇena rājñā
bhavata udīcyāḥ diśaḥ somena rājñā
bhavata dhruvāyāḥ diśaḥ viṣṇuṇā rājñā
bhavata ūrdhvāyāḥ diśaḥ bṛhaspatinā rājñā
bhavata uttamāyāḥ diśaḥ prajāpatinā rājñā
bhavata paramāyāḥ diśaḥ parameṣṭhinā rājñā
devāḥ śaraṇa kṛtaḥ śaraṇāḥ me bhavata sarvābhyaḥ digbhyaḥ īśānena rājñā adhyakṣeṇa
prātar agniṃ prātar indraṃ havāmahe prātar mitrāvaruṇā prātar aśvinā
prātar bhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somam uta rudraṃ huvema
prātarjitaṃ bhagam ugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putram aditer yo vidhartā
ādhraś cid yaṃ manyamānas turaś cid rājā cid yaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣīty āha
bhaga praṇetar bhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyam ud avā dadan naḥ
bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhir aśvair bhaga pra nṛbhir nṛvantaḥ syāma
utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām
utodite maghavan sūrye vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma
bhaga eva bhagavāṁ astu devās tena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma
taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ij johavīti sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha
sam adhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya
arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no ratham ivāśvā vājina ā vahantu
aśvāvatīr gomatīr na uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadam uchantu bhadrāḥ
ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
yas te manyo 'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvam mānuṣam
sāhyāma dāsam āryaṃ tvayā yujā vayaṃ sahaskṛtena sahasā sahīyasā
manyur indro manyur evāsa devo manyur hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ
manyur viśa īḍate mānuṣīr yāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ
abhīhi manyo tavasas tavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn
amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūny ā bharā tvaṃ naḥ
tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayaṃbhūr bhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ
viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahīyāṁ asmāsv ojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi
abhāgaḥ sann apa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ
taṃ tvā manyo akratur jihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūr baladāvā na ehi
ayaṃ te asmy upa na ehy arvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadāvan
manyo vajrinn upa na ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṁ uta bodhy āpeḥ
abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā no adhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri
juhomi te dharuṇo madhvo agram ubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibeva
agner manve prathamasya pracetasaḥ pāñcajanyasya bahudhā yam indhate
viśo viśaḥ praviśivāṃsam īmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
sujātaṃ jātavedasam agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vibhum
havyavāhaṃ havāmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yathā havyaṃ vahasi jātavedo yathā yajñaṃ kalpayasi prajānan
evā devebhyaḥ sumatim ihā vaha sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yāman yāmann upayuktaṃ vahiṣṭhaṃ karman karmann ābhagam agnim īḍe
rakṣohaṇaṃ yajñavṛdhaṃ ghṛtāhutaṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yena ṛṣayo balam adyotayan yujā yenāsurāṇām ayuvanta māyāḥ
yenāgninā paṇīn indro jigāya sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yena devā amṛtam anvavindan yenauṣadhīr madhumatīr akṛṇvan
yenedaṃ svar ābharan sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate yaj jātaṃ janitavyaṃ ca kevalam
staumy agniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
vāyoḥ savitur vidathāni manmahe yāv ātmanvad viśatho yau ca rakṣathaḥ
yau viśvasya paribhū babhūvathus tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayoḥ saṃkhyātā varimāṇi pārthivā yābhyāṃ rajo gupitam antarikṣam
yayoḥ prayāṃ nānu kaś canānaśe tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
tava vrate ni viśante janāsas tvayy udite prerate citrabhāno
yuvaṃ vāyo savitā ca bhuvanāni rakṣathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
pra sumatiṃ savitar vāya ūtaye mahasvantaṃ matsaraṃ mādayethām
arvāg vāmasya pravatā ni yacchathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
rayiṃ me poṣaṃ savitota vāyus tanū dakṣam ā suvatāṃ suśevam
ayakṣmatāṃ maho asmāsu dhattaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
apeto vāyo savitā ca duṣkṛtam apa yakṣmaṃ śimidāṃ sedhataṃ paraḥ
saṃ hy ūrjā sṛjathaḥ saṃ balena tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
upa śreṣṭhā na āśiṣo devayor dhāmann asthiran
staumi devaṃ savitāraṃ ca vāyuṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
marutāṃ manve adhi me bruvantu premaṃ vājaṃ vājasātā avantu
āśūn iva suyamān ahva ūtaye te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
utsam akṣitaṃ vyacanti ye sadā ye vā siñcanti rasam oṣadhīṣu
puro dadhe marutaḥ pṛśnimātṝṃs te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
payo dhenūnāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ javam arvatāṃ kavayo ya invatha
śagmā bhavantu marutaḥ syonās te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
apaḥ samudrād divam ud vahanti divas pṛthivīm abhi ye sṛjanti
ye 'dbhir īśānā marutaś caranti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
ye kīlālais tarpayanti ye ghṛtena ye vā vayo medasā saṃsṛjanti
ya īśānā maruto varṣayanti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
yadīd idaṃ maruto mārutena yadi devā daivyenedṛg āra
yūyam īśidhve vasavas tasya niṣkṛtes te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
tigmam anīkaṃ viditaṃ sahasvan mārutaṃ śardhaḥ pṛtanāsūgram
staumi maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau ye aprathethām amitā yojanāni
pratiṣṭhe hy abhavataṃ vasūnāṃ te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
pratiṣṭhe hi babhūvathur vasūnāṃ pravṛddhe devī subhage urūcī
dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
ye srotyā bibhṛtho ye manuṣyān ye amṛtaṃ bibhṛtho ye havīṃṣi
ye usriyā bibhṛtho ye vanaspatīn yayor vāṃ viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ
ye kīlālais tarpayatho ye ghṛtena yābhyāṃ narte kiṃcana śaknuvanti
asantāpe sutapasā huve vām urvī gabhīre kavibhir namasye
yan medam abhiśocati yena vā yena vā kṛtaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ na daivyam
staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ tasya vittaṃ yayor vāṃ viśvaṃ yad idaṃ vitiṣṭhate
yāv īśāte dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayor abhyadhva uta yad dūre cid yau viditāv iṣubhṛtām asiṣṭhau
bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayor vadhān nāpapadyate kiṃcanāntar deveṣūta mānuṣeṣu
yāv ārebhāthe bahu sākam ugrau pra ced asrāṣṭam abhibhāṃ janeṣu
sahasrākṣau vṛtrahaṇā huve vāṃ dūrehetī svanannemī ugrau
yaḥ kṛtyākṛd yātudhāno mahālo ni tasmin hatam adhi vajram ugrau
adhi me brūtaṃ pṛtanāsūgrau saṃ vajreṇa sṛjataṃ yaḥ kimīdī
staumi bhavāśarvau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
manve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvṛdhau satyaujasau druhvāṇaṃ yau nudethe
yau satyāvānam avatho haveṣu tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
satyaujasau druhvāṇaṃ yau nudethe pra satyāvānam avatho haveṣu
yau gachatho nṛcakṣasā babhruṇā sutaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yāv aṅgiraso 'vatho yāv agastiṃ mitrāvaruṇā jamadagnim atrim
yau kaśyapam avatho yau vasiṣṭhaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau bharadvājam avatho vadhryaśvaṃ viśvāmitraṃ varuṇa mitra kutsam
yau kakṣīvantam avathaḥ prota kaṇvaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau śyāvāśvam avatho yau gaviṣṭhiraṃ mitrāvaruṇā purumīḍham atrim
yau vimadam avathaḥ saptavadhriṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau medhātithim avatho yau triśokaṃ mitrāvaruṇā uśanāṃ kāvyaṃ yau
yau mudgalam avatho gotamaṃ ca tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayo rathaḥ satyavartmarjuraśmir mithuyā carantam abhiyāti dūṣayan
staumi mitrāvaruṇā nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
indrasya manve śaśvad yasya manvire vṛtraghna stomā upa mema āguḥ
yo dāśuṣaḥ sukṛto havam etā sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yaś carṣaṇipro vṛṣabhaḥ svarvid yasya grāvāṇaḥ pravadanti nṛmṇe
yasyādhvaraḥ saptahotā madacyut sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
ya ugrāṇām ugrabāhur yajur yo dānavānāṃ balam āsasāda
yena jitāḥ sindhavo yena gāvaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasya vaśāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo yasmai mīyante svaravaḥ svarvide
yasmai śukraḥ pavate brahmaśumbhitaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasya juṣṭiṃ sominaḥ kāmayante yaṃ havanta iṣuvantaṃ gaviṣṭau
yasminn arkaḥ śiśriye yasminn ojaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
ya uttamaḥ karmakṛtyāya jajñe yasya vīryaṃ prathamasyānubuddham
yenodyato vajro 'bhyāyatāhiṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yaḥ saṃgrāmān nayati saṃ yudhe vaśī yaḥ puṣṭāni saṃsṛjati dvayāni
staumīndraṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
śunam vatsān apa ā karomi śunam badhnāmi tantyām
āgrayaṇam brahmaṇām haviḥ
tasmin jāgāra kaśyapaḥ
bāhum vatsam upanayan pātre gām duhan abravīt a riṣṭam brahmabhyaḥ haviḥ śivam kṛṇotu kaśyapaḥ
trayaḥ tiṣṭhanti su kṛtasya loke
trayaḥ atīkāśāḥ
trīṇi śīrṣāṇi eṣām
trayaḥ tiṣṭhanti parigṛhya kumbhīm yathā haviḥ kaśyapa na vyathātai
satyāt sambhūtaḥ vadati taṇḍulān kṣīre āvapan ṛṣiḥ brahmabhyaḥ āgrayaṇam ni vedayatu kaśyapaḥ
ṛtu mukhe candrabhāgaḥ pātre odanam ud dharāt
pra aśnantu brahmāṇaḥ haviḥ yathā vedena kaśyapaḥ
ye bhūtāni asṛjanta ye bhūtāni akalpayan sarvasya vidvān adhvaryuḥ ṣaṇṇām bhavatu kaśyapaḥ
śivāḥ āpaḥ vatsebhyaḥ śivāḥ bhavantu oṣadhīḥ
vātaḥ vatsebhyaḥ kaśyapaḥ śivaḥ
śivam tapatu sūryaḥ
namaḥ piśaṅgabāhvai sindhau jātāyā ugrāyai
yo asyai nama it karad aped asya gṛhād ayat
apehi no gṛhebhyo apehi vatsatantyāḥ
ātmānam atra rotsyasy ava roha mahānasāt
hā amba suhūtale atho hai sāmanantame
putro yas te pṛśnibāhus tam u tvaṃ sāmanaṃ kṛdhi
atho duhitaraṃ naptrīm atho tvaṃ sāmanā bhava
bhūtapatir nir ajatv indraś cetaḥ sadānvāḥ
gṛhasya budhna āsīnās tā vajreṇādhi tiṣṭhatu

punar yamaḥ punar yamasya dūtās te tvā muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
jīvātave na martave 'tho ariṣṭatātaye
uta devā avahitaṃ devā ud dharatā punaḥ
uto mariṣyantaṃ devā daivāḥ kṛṇutha jīvase
ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhir atho ariṣṭatātibhiḥ
dakṣaṃ te bhadram āhārṣaṃ parā suvāmy āmayat
dvāv imau vātau vāta ā sindhor ā parāvataḥ
dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yad rapaḥ
ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yad rapaḥ
tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase
trāyantām imaṃ devās trāyantāṃ maruto gaṇaiḥ
trāyantāṃ viśvā bhūtāni yathāyam agado 'sati
ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ghṛtenāpaḥ sam ukṣata
ghṛtena mucyasvainaso yad ātmakṛtam āritha
ayaṃ me hasto bhagavān ayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ
ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo 'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ
hastābhyāṃ daśaśākhābhyāṃ jihvā vācaḥ purogavī
anāmayitnubhyāṃ śaṃbhubhyāṃ tābhyāṃ tvābhi mṛśāmasi
āpa id vā u bheṣajīr āpo amīvacātanīḥ
āpo viśvasya bheṣajīs tās te kṛṇvantu bheṣajam
sahṛdayaṃ sāṃmanasyam avidveṣaṃ kṛṇomi vaḥ
anyo anyam abhi haryata vatsaṃ jātam ivāghnyā
anuvrataḥ pituḥ putro mātrā bhavatu savrataḥ
jāyā patye madhumatīṃ vācaṃ vadatu śantivām
mā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ dvikṣan mā svasāram uta svasā
samyañcaḥ savratā bhūtvā vācaṃ vadata bhadrayā
yena devā na viyanti no ca vidviṣate mithaḥ
tat kṛṇmo brahma vo gṛhe saṃjñānaṃ puruṣebhyaḥ
jyāyasvantaś cittino mā vi yauṣṭa saṃrādhayantaḥ sadhurāś carantaḥ
anyo anyasmai valgu vadanta eta samagrā stha sadhrīcīnāḥ
samānī prapā saha vo 'nnabhāgaḥ samāne yoktre saha vo yunajmi
samyañco 'gniṃ saparyatārā nābhim ivābhitaḥ
yena devā haviṣā yajatrā apa pāpmānam aghnata
krodhaṃ manyum anṛtaṃ bhāmaṃ duruktam abhiśocanam āre yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi
sadhrīcīnān vaḥ saṃmanasaḥ kṛṇomy ekaśnuṣṭīn saṃvananena saṃhṛdaḥ
devā ived amṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇāḥ sāyaṃ prātaḥ susamitir vo astu
paro 'pehi paraś cara paras tarda parastaram
agner vātasya dhrājyā apa bādhe ahaṃ tvām
udakasyedam ayanaṃ vātasyedaṃ nibhañjanam
agner dhūmasyāyaṃ panthā neha tardāyanaṃ tava
pari tvā kṛṣṇavartanir agnir dhūmenārciṣā
sa tvaṃ tarda paraś carānyat tarddhi tṛṇaṃ yavāt
ye tardā asureṣitā devebhir iṣitāś ca ye
sarvāṃs tān brahmaṇā vayaṃ śalabhāñ jambhayāmasi
śalabhasya śalabhyās tardasyo patatriṇaḥ
agner vātasya dhrājyāpi nahyāma āsyam
idaṃ yad gavi bheṣajaṃ viśvād rūpāt samābhṛtam
ākhor ghuṇasya tardasya teṣāṃ snāvnāpi nahyata
dṛṣṭā tvam asi gandhenauṣadhir ghuṇajambhanī
ākhor ghuṇasya jātāni tāni jambhaya tejasā
tūlaṃ tardas tṛṇasyāttu mūlam ākhur dhiyeṣitaḥ
atho vṛkṣasya phalgu yad ghuṇā adantu mā yavam
dyauś ca naḥ pitā pṛthivī ca mātāgniś ca nṛcakṣā jātavedāḥ
te takmānam adharāñcaṃ nyañcaṃ daśāhnam asyantv adhi dūram asmat
takman yaṃ te kṣetrabhāgam apābhajaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pūrve ardhe
atihāya tam atha no hinassi grāhiḥ kila tvā grahīṣyati kilāsaśīrṣaḥ
takman parvatā ime himavantaḥ somapṛṣṭhāḥ
vātaṃ dūtaṃ bhiṣajaṃ no akran naśyeto maraṭāṁ abhi
na tvā striyaḥ kāmayante na pumāṃsaḥ katame cana
neha takmakāmyālpo roditi no mahān
mā no hiṃsīr mahato mā hiṃsīr mahyas tvam
kumārān babhro mā hiṃsīr mā no hiṃsīḥ kumāryaḥ
yaḥ sākam utpātayasi balāsaṃ kāsam udrajam
bhīmās te takman hetayas tābhi ṣma pari vṛṅdhi naḥ
anyakṣetre na ramate sahasrākṣo 'martyaḥ
abhūd u prārthas takmā sa u no mṛḍayiṣyati
takman na ta ihāśvā na gāvo neha te gṛhāḥ
śakambharasya muṣṭihā punar gacha mahāvṛṣān
yau hemantaṃ svāpayatho balenārvāg devebhya uta yau paro divaḥ
bhavārudrayoḥ sumatiṃ vṛṇīmahe 'nyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
yo dyām ātanoti yo 'ntarikṣaṃ stabhnāty ojaso jāyamānaḥ
tasmai rudrāya haviṣā vidhemānyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
yayor vadhān nāpapadyate kiṃ canāntar deveṣūta mānuṣeṣu
tābhyāṃ rudrābhyāṃ haviṣā vidhemānyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
yāv īśāte paśūnāṃ pārthivānāṃ catuṣpadām uta vā ye dvipādaḥ
yasya pratihitāyāḥ saṃ viśanta āraṇyāḥ paśava uta grāmyāsaḥ
yasmād oṣadhayo barbhriyamāṇā yanti yasmād vṛkṣāso na viyanti viśve
vayāṃsi yasmāt pracaranti bhīṣā tasmai rudrāya haviṣā vidhemānyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
yaḥ parvatān vidadhe 'ti vidvān yo bhūtāni kalpayati prajānan
yāv īśānau carato dvipado 'sya catuṣpadaḥ
yā ugrau kṣipradhanvānau tābhyāṃ rudrābhyāṃ haviṣā vidhemānyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
punaś cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇaṃ punar āyur dhehi no jātavedaḥ
rudra jalāṣabheṣaja vidvāṃsas ta enā haviṣā vidhemānyatrāsmad aghaviṣā vy etu
īśānaṃ tvā bheṣajānāṃ vijeṣāya vṛṇīmahe
cakre sahasravīryaṃ sarasvān oṣadhe tvā
satyajitaṃ śapathayāvanīṃ sahamānāṃ punaḥsarām
sarvāḥ sam ahvy oṣadhīr ito mā pārayān iti
yā śaśāpa śapanena yā vā gha mūram ādadhe
yā vā rasasya prāśāyārebhe tokam attu sā
pratīcīnaphalo hi tvam apāmārga babhūvitha
sarvān mac chapathāṁ adhi varīyo yāvayā tvam
yac ca bhrātṛvyaḥ śapati yac ca jāmiḥ śapāti naḥ
brahmā yan manyutaḥ śapāt sarvaṃ tan no adhaspadam
yāṃ te cakrur āme pātre yāṃ sūtre nīlalohite
āme māṃse kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrus tayā kṛtyākṛto jahi
duḥsvapnyaṃ durjīvitaṃ rakṣo abhvam arāyyaḥ
durvācaḥ sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ tad ito nāśayāmasi
kṣudhāmāraṃ tṛṣṇāmāram agotām anapatyatām
apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tad apa mṛjmahe
samā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇāhnā rātrī samāvatī
kṛṇomi satyam ūtaye arasāḥ santu kṛtvarīḥ
yo devāḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtvā harād aviduṣo gṛham
vatso dhārur iva mātaraṃ taṃ pratyag upa padyatām
amā kṛtvā pāpmānaṃ yas tayānyaṃ jighāṃsati
aśmānas tasyāṃ dagdhāyāṃ bahulāḥ phaṭ karikratu
sahasradhāman viśikhān vigrīvāñ chāyayā tvam
prati sma cakruṣe kṛtyāṃ priyāṃ priyāvate hara
yā cakāra na śaśāka śaśre pādam aṅgulim
cakāra bhadram asmabhyam abhagā bhagavadbhyaḥ
anayāham oṣadhyā sarvāḥ kṛtyā adūṣayam
yāṃ kṣetre cakrur yāṃ gobhyo yāṃ vā te puruṣebhyaḥ
apāmārgo 'pa mārṣṭu kṣetriyaṃ śapathāṃś ca mat
apāha yātudhānyo 'pa sarvā arāyyaḥ
apamṛjya yātudhānān apa sarvā arāyyaḥ
apāmārga prajayā tvaṃ rayyā sacasva naḥ
utevāsy abandhukṛd utāsy anujāmikaḥ
uto kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajāṃ naḍam ivā chinddhi vārṣikam
brāhmaṇena paryukto 'si kaṇvena nārṣadena
senevaiṣi tviṣīmatī na tatra bhayam asti yatra prāpnoṣy oṣadhe
agre 'sy oṣadhīnāṃ jyotiṣevābhidīpayan
uta pākasya trātāsy uta hantāsi rakṣasaḥ
yad ado devā asurāṃs tvayāgre nirakṛṇvata
tasmād adhi tvam oṣadhe apāmārgo ajāyathāḥ
vibhindatī śataśākhā vibhindan nāma te pitā
pratyag vi bhinddhi taṃ tvaṃ yo asmāṁ abhidāsati
asad bhūmyāḥ sam abhavat tad dyām eti bṛhad vacaḥ
tad it tato vidhūmayat pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu
pratyaṅ hi saṃbabhūvitha pratīcīnaphalas tvam
śatena mā pari pāhi sahasreṇābhi rakṣa mā
indras te vīrudhāṃ pata ugra ojmānam ā dadhau
arātyā dyāvāpṛthivī chinttaṃ mūlam atho śiraḥ
vicchidya madhyataḥ pṛṣṭīs tāṃ kṛṇvāthām adhaspadam
idaṃ śṛṇu jātavedo yad amuṣyā vaco mama
arātyāḥ sarvam ic chiraḥ praśnaṃ vṛhatam aśvinā
yā svapnayā carati gaur bhūtvā janāṁ anu
arātim indra tvaṃ jahi tām agnir ivasā dahāt
śreṣṭho me rājā varuṇo havaṃ satyena gacchatu
arātiṃ hatvā santokām ugro devo 'bhi dāsatu
deṣṭrī ca yā sinīvālī sapta ca srotyā yāḥ
arātiṃ viśvā bhūtāni ghnantu dāsīm ivāgasi
somo rājauṣadhībhiḥ sūryācandramasā ubhā
arātiṃ sarve gandharvā ghnantv apsarasaś ca yāḥ
bhavo rājā bhavāśarvāv indro vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ
tvaṣṭā me adhyakṣaḥ pūṣā te 'rātiṃ ghnantu sarvadā
ye ca devā bhūmicarā ye cāmī divy āsate
ye antarikṣasyeśate te 'rātiṃ ghnantu savratāḥ
yā ceṣitāsurair devebhir iṣitā ca yā
atho yā manyor jāyate 'rātiṃ hanmi brahmaṇā
tad in nu me acacchadan mahad yakṣaṃ bṛhad vapuḥ
viśvair yad devair nirṛtis tanā yujā saṃ mṛtyor iha jāyate
amamriś cit sāprathovadadahim ahirājantam ojasā
āyuṃ cit kutsam atithigvam ardaya vi nikilbindam ojasā
yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad vā sapta sindhavo mahitvā
tāvatī nirṛtir viśvavārā viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda
viśvasya hi jāyamānasya devi puṣṭasya vā puṣṭapatir babhūvitha
namo 'stu te nirṛte mā tv asmān parā bhujo nāparaṃ hātayāsi
devīm ahaṃ nirṛtiṃ manyamānaḥ piteva putraṃ na sace vacobhiḥ
viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda śiraḥ śiraḥ prati sūro 'nu tasthe
asunvantam ayajamānam iccha stenasyetyāṃ taskarasyānu śikṣa
svapantam iccha sā ta ityā namas tu te nirṛte 'haṃ kṛṇomi
asunvakān nirṛtiḥ saṃjighatsur nāsyāḥ pitā vidyate nota mātā
madhyāt svasrām anu jaghāna sarvaṃ na devānām asuryaṃ sam āpa
yad asya pāre tamasaḥ śukraṃ jyotir ajāyata
tan naḥ parṣad ati dviṣo 'gne vaiśvānara dyumat
pramucyamānaṃ bhuvanasya gopaḥ paśuṃ no atra prati bhāgam etu
agnir yajñaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantuṃ devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
yau te daṃṣṭrau sudihau ropayiṣṇū nir hvayete dakṣiṇāḥ saṃ ca paśyataḥ
anāṣṭraṃ naḥ pitaras tat kṛṇotu yūpe baddhaṃ pramumucimā yad annam
ahrastas tvam aviduṣṭaḥ parehīndrasya goṣṭham api dhāva vidvān
dhīrāsas tvā kavayaḥ saṃ mṛjantv iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya matsva
ṛṣibhiṣ ṭvā saptabhir atriṇāhaṃ prati gṛhṇāmi bhuvane syonam
jamadagniḥ kaśyapaḥ svādv etad bharadvājo madhv annaṃ kṛṇotu
pratigrahītre gotamo vasiṣṭho viśvāmitro daduṣe śarma yacchāt
yan no agraṃ haviṣa ājagāmānnasya pātram uta sarpiṣo vā
yad vā dhanaṃ vahator ājagāmāgniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
yad ājyaṃ pratijagrabha yāṃś ca vrīhīn ajaṃ candreṇa saha yaj jaghāsa
bṛhaspatir haviṣo no vidhartā mā no hiṃsīc chāgo aśvo vaśā ca
agnir na etat prati gṛhṇātu vidvān bṛhaspatiḥ praty etu prajānan
indro marutvān suhutaṃ kṛṇotv ayakṣmam anamīvaṃ te astu
yan no dadur varāham akṣitaṃ vasu yad vā talpam upadhānena naḥ saha
yad vāviyūthaṃ saha vṛṣṇyā no agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
yan naḥ śālāṃ viśvabhogām imāṃ dadur gṛhaṃ vā yoktraṃ saha kṛttyota
yad vā hara upanāhena devā agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
sūrye varca iti yac chuśravāhaṃ yena prajā jyotiragrāś caranti
some varco yad goṣu varco mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
yajñe varco maruto yad adṛṃhan vāyuḥ paśūn asṛjat saṃ bhagena
gandharvāṇām apsarasāṃ yad apsu mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
yajñe varco yajamāne ca varca udābhiṣikte rājani yac ca varcaḥ
dakṣiṇāyāṃ varco adhi yan mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
rathe varco rathavāhane ca varca iṣudhau varcaḥ kavace ca varcaḥ
aśveṣu varco adhi yan mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
sabhāyāṃ varcaḥ samityāṃ ca varco vadhvāṃ varca uta varco vareṣu
surāyāṃ varco adhi yan mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
siṃhe varca uta varco vyāghre vṛke varco madhuhāre ca varcaḥ
śyene varcaḥ patvanāṃ yad babhūva mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
hiraṇyavarcasam uta hastivarcasaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ yaj jajñuṣāṃ varca āhuḥ
kṛṣyāṃ kṣetra ṛṣayo janyānajur mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
mayi varco mayi śravo mayi dyumnaṃ mayi tviṣiḥ
adhaspadaṃ pṛtanyavo 'haṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ
payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ vacaḥ
atho payasvatāṃ paya ā harāmi sahasraśaḥ
ahaṃ veda yathā payaś cakāra dhānyaṃ bahu

yathā dyauś ca pṛthivī ca tasthatur dharuṇāya kam
evā sphātiṃ ni tanomi mayāreṣu khaleṣu ca
yathā kūpaḥ śatadhāraḥ sahasradhāro akṣitaḥ
evā me astu dhānyaṃ sahasradhāram akṣitam
śatahasta samāhara sahasrahasta saṃ kira
yatheha sphātir āyati kṛtasya kāryasya ca
imā yāḥ pañca pradiśo mānavīḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ
sarvāḥ śaṃbhūr mayobhuvo vṛṣṭe śāpaṃ nadīr iveha sphātiṃ samāvahān

ihaivāśvinor astu dvāparāśvoruhat

tāsāṃ yā sphātir uttamā tayā tvābhi mṛśāmasi

badhāna vatsam abhi dhehi bhuñjatīṃ ni dya godhug upa sīda dugdhi
