tava ā yantu havam devāḥ
tvam priyaḥ bṛhaspateḥ
agni somā pavamānaḥ virāj devī payasvatī atandram sarve rakṣantu rāṣṭram te
agniḥ iva tṛṇam pra daha
oghaḥ kūlam iva ā ruja
śriyam bhrātṛvyāṇām ā datsva āṇḍīkam iva adhi puṣkarāt
aśvaḥ iva ratham ā datsva
siṃhaḥ iva puruṣam hara
hastī iva naḍvalān bhaṅdhi
bhrātṛvyāṇām śriyam vṛha
tat te kṛṇotu kaśyapaḥ brahma devaiḥ abhiṣṭutam āprītam a virādhukam
etam khadiram ā hara atha u tejanam ā hara
uta etam parṇam ā hara
ā hara anaḍuhaḥ balam
idhmān devaiḥ samābhṛtān tān te pra adāt bṛhaspatiḥ
tān ā dhehi samāhite agnau sūrya abhicakṣaṇe
tebhiḥ tvam uttaraḥ bhava
atha u eṣām payaḥ hara
ādityāḥ rudrāḥ vasavaḥ ṛṣayaḥ bhūta kṛtaḥ ca ye śriyam ca kṣatram ojaḥ ca tubhyam devāḥ asāviṣuḥ
vasuḥ asi indra nāmā āyuṣmān śata śāradaḥ
saḥ indraḥ iva deveṣu tviṣīmān viśaḥ ā vada
idam rāṣṭram prathatām gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ idam rāṣṭram annena irayā rasena
asmai ṣaḍ urvīḥ upa sam namantu
sapta hotrā hata śatrūn sa cittāḥ
ime rājānaḥ iṣubhiḥ ghnantu śatrūn
ime rājānaḥ samitya anyān vadheyuḥ
ime rājānaḥ pṛtanāḥ sahantām
aham brahmā
vi mṛdhaḥ hanmi sarvāḥ
idam rāṣṭram kratumat vīravat jiṣṇu ugram
idam rāṣṭram gardnumat citra ghoṣam
asmai rāṣṭrāya balim anye harantu
aham devebhyaḥ haviṣā vidheyam
yadi yuddhaṃ yady ṛtitaṃ vo asti devainasād yadi vā pitryeṇa
aham devebhyaḥ haviṣā juhomi
yat vaḥ krūram manasaḥ yat ca vācaḥ deva enasāt yadi vā pitryeṇa āpaḥ iva duḥṣvapnyam apa tat svapadhvam
atha ānandinaḥ sumanasaḥ sam ā ita
apām iva vegaḥ pra śṛṇīta śatrūn
diśaḥ diśaḥ rabhamāṇāḥ sam ā ita
eka vratāḥ vi dhanam bhajadhvam
purohitena vaḥ rāṣṭram prathayantu devāḥ
samyak vaḥ rāṣṭram
saha vaḥ manāṃsi
samīcīnāḥ paśavaḥ viśva rūpāḥ
samīcīnānām vaḥ aham asmi brahmā
samyañcaḥ devāḥ havam ā yantu me imam
yathā āpaḥ samudrāya samīcīḥ vahatha śriyam eva rāṣṭrāya me devāḥ samyañcaḥ vahata śriyam
saṃsṛṣṭam vaḥ rāṣṭram paśubhiḥ gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭam annena irayā rasena
mayā brahmaṇā vasīyāṃsaḥ sadam ugrāḥ bhavātha
bahuḥ yuvā pramṛṇaḥ dhṛṣṇuḥ astu
bahuḥ kumāraḥ pratirūpaḥ pitṝṇām
satyam vadantaḥ samitim carantaḥ mitram gṛhṇānāḥ jarasaḥ yantu sakhyam
iha kṣatram dyumnam uta rāṣṭram sam ā etu iha indriyam paśubhiḥ saṃvidānam
avadhūnvānāḥ apriyān yān ca dviṣmaḥ idam rāṣṭram prathatām sarvadā eva
idam rāṣṭram iṣumat vīravat jiṣṇu ugram
idam rāṣṭram paśumat brahma vṛddham
idam rāṣṭram hata śatru jiṣṇu
sapatna sāham pramṛṇam idam rāṣṭram dṛḍham ugram
sāḍha amitram abhimāti sāham sarvāḥ jigāya pṛtanāḥ abhiṣṭi
audumbareṇa maṇinā puṣṭi kāmāya vedhasā paśūnām sarveṣām sphātim goṣṭhe me savitā karat
yaḥ naḥ agniḥ gārhapatyaḥ paśūnām adhipāḥ asat audumbaraḥ vṛṣā maṇiḥ sam mā sṛjatu puṣṭyā
karīṣiṇīm phalavatīm svadhām irām ca naḥ gṛhe audumbarasya tejasā dhātā puṣṭim dadhātu me
yat dvipād ca catuṣpād ca yāni annāni ye rasāḥ gṛhṇe aham teṣām bhūmānam
puṣṭim paśūnām pari jagrabhā aham catuṣpadām dvipadām yat ca dhānyam
payaḥ paśūnām rasam oṣadhīnām bṛhaspatiḥ savitā me ni yacchāt
aham paśūnām adhipāḥ asāni
mayi puṣṭam puṣṭa patiḥ dadhātu
mahyam audumbaraḥ maṇiḥ draviṇāni ni yacchatu
upa mā audumbaraḥ maṇiḥ prajayā ca dhanena ca indreṇa jinvataḥ maṇiḥ ā mā agan saha varcasā
devaḥ maṇiḥ sapatna hā dhana sāḥ dhana sātaye paśoḥ annasya bhūmānam gavām sphātim ni yacchatu
yathā agre tvam vanaspate puṣṭyā saha jajñiṣe eva dhanasya me sphātim ā dadhātu sarasvatī
ā me dhanam sarasvatī payaḥ sphātim ca dhānyam sinīvālī uta ā vahāt ayam ca audumbaraḥ maṇiḥ
tvam maṇīnām adhipāḥ vṛṣā asi
tvayi puṣṭam puṣṭa patiḥ jajāna
tvayi ime vājāḥ draviṇāni sarvā audumbara
sa tvam asmat sahasva ārāt arātim amatim kṣudham ca
grāmaṇīḥ asi grāmaṇīthyāya
abhiṣiktaḥ abhi mā siñca varcasā
tejaḥ asi
tejaḥ mayi dhāraya adhi
rayiḥ asi
rayim mayi dhehi
puṣṭiḥ asi
puṣṭyā mā sam aṅdhi
gṛhamedhī gṛha patim mā kṛṇu
audumbara sa tvam asmāsu rayim sarva vīram ni yaccha
rāyaḥ poṣāya prati muñce aham tvām
ayam audumbaraḥ maṇiḥ vīraḥ vīrāya badhyate
sa naḥ sanim madhumatīm kṛṇotu
rayim ca naḥ sarva vīram ni yacchāt
bhagasya rājñaḥ sumatim gamema yam havante bahudhā mānuṣāsaḥ
karma kṛṇvānaḥ bhagam ā vṛṇīte
sa naḥ janeṣu subhagāṁ kṛṇotu
bhagam purastāt pratibudhyamānāḥ paśyema devīm uṣasam vibhātīm
pratīcī śubhrā draviṇena sākam bhagam vahantī aditiḥ naḥ ā etu
bhagaḥ naḥ adya svite dadhātu
devānām panthām abhi naḥ naya iha
arvācī bhadrā sumatiḥ naḥ ā etu
adha bhagena samithaḥ naḥ astu
bhagena vācam iṣitām vadāni sarasvatīm madhumatīm su varcāḥ
bhagena dattam upa mā idam ā agan yathā varcasvān samitim āvadāni
bhagaḥ mā goṣu avatu
bhagaḥ mā avatu dhānye
akṣeṣu strīṣu mā bhagaḥ bhagaḥ mā avatu varcasā
bhagaḥ mā sāyam avatu
bhagaḥ mā avatu rātryā bhagaḥ nipadyamāneṣu
prātar mā bhagaḥ ā agamat
bhagaḥ mā prātar avatu bhagaḥ madhyandinam pari
aparāhṇe vayam bhagam vāsaḥ iva pari dadhmahe
bhagam devebhyaḥ pari bhagam manuṣyebhyaḥ divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ aham antarikṣāt bhagam vṛṇe
saḥ agne ramatām mayi
sa mā pra avatu varcasā
bhagam vṛṇānāḥ vadhvam vahanti
vanim prayantaḥ bhagam id havante
bhagena dattam upa mā idam ā agan viśvam subhūtam draviṇāni bhadrā
bhagena devāḥ sam aganmahi yaḥ imā viśvā bhuvanā abhivaste
prayacchan eti bahudhā vasūni
sa naḥ dadhātu yatamat vasiṣṭham
vātaḥ bhagaḥ varuṇaḥ vāyuḥ agniḥ kṣetrasya patnī su havā naḥ astu
hiraṇya akṣaḥ atipaśyaḥ nṛ cakṣāḥ sarvaiḥ sākam sacamānaḥ naḥ ā ihi
ud ehi deva sūrya saha saubhāgyena saha ṛṣabhasya vājena saha āvataṃkaraṇena
hiraṇyayenety ekā
gobhiḥ tvā pātu ṛṣabhaḥ
vṛṣā tvā pātu vājibhiḥ
vāyuḥ tvā brahmaṇā pātu
indraḥ tvā pātu indriyaiḥ
somaḥ tvā pātu oṣadhībhiḥ
nakṣatraiḥ pātu sūryaḥ
mādbhiḥ tvā candraḥ vṛtra hā vātaḥ prāṇena rakṣatu
tisraḥ divaḥ tisraḥ pṛthivīḥ trīṇi antarikṣāṇi caturaḥ samudrān trivṛtam stomam trivṛtaḥ āpaḥ āhuḥ
tāḥ tvā rakṣantu trivṛtā trivṛdbhiḥ
trīn nākān trīn samudrān trīn bradhnān trīn vaiṣṭapān trīn mātariśvanaḥ trīn sūryān goptṝn kalpayāmi te
ghṛtena tvā sam ukṣāmi agne ājyena vardhayan
agneḥ candrasya sūryasya mā prāṇam māyinaḥ dabhan
mā vaḥ prāṇam mā vaḥ apānam mā haraḥ māyinaḥ dabhan
bhrājantaḥ viśva vedasaḥ devāḥ daivyena mā avata
prāṇena agnim sam dadhati
vātaḥ prāṇena saṃhitaḥ
prāṇena viśvatas mukham sūryam devāḥ ajanayan
āyuṣā āyuḥ kṛtām jīva
āyuṣmāṁ jīva
mā mṛthāḥ
prāṇena ātmanvatām jīva
mā mṛtyoḥ upa gāḥ vaśam
devānām nihitam nidhim yam indra anvavindan pathibhiḥ deva yānaiḥ āpaḥ hiraṇyam jugupuḥ trivṛdbhiḥ
trayastriṃśat devatāḥ trīṇi ca vīryāṇi priyāyamāṇāḥ jugupuḥ apsu antar
asmin candre adhi yat hiraṇyam tena ayam kṛṇavat vīryāṇi
ye devāḥ divi ekādaśa stha te devāsaḥ haviḥ idam juṣadhvam
ye devāḥ antarikṣe ekādaśa stha te devāsaḥ haviḥ idam juṣadhvam
ye devāḥ pṛthivyām ekādaśa stha te devāsaḥ haviḥ idam juṣadhvam
a sapatnam purastāt paścāt naḥ abhayam kṛtam
savitā mā dakṣiṇataḥ uttarāt mā śacī patiḥ
divaḥ mā ādityāḥ rakṣantu bhūmyāḥ rakṣantu agnayaḥ
indra agnī rakṣatām mā purastāt
aśvinau abhitas śarma yacchatām
rakṣatu jātavedāḥ
bhūta kṛtaḥ me sarvatas santu varma
ye apsu antar agnayaḥ praviṣṭāḥ mrokaḥ manaḥ hā khanaḥ nirdāhaḥ ātma dūṣiḥ tana dūṣiḥ idam tān ati sṛjāmi
niḥ enaḥ niḥ anṛtam sṛjāmi
niḥ duḥṣvapnyam sṛjāmi
vasiṣṭha arundhatī mā pātām prajāpateḥ prastaraḥ bṛhaspateḥ keśāḥ
a dabdham cakṣuḥ
su śrutau karṇau
a kṣitau me prāṇa apānau
hṛdaya ā jarasam mā mā hāsīḥ
madhya mā riṣam
āpaḥ mā śundhantu duṣkṛtāt duritā yāni cakṛma
ayāma śuddhāḥ ud itas tanūbhiḥ
vaiśvānaraḥ raśmibhiḥ naḥ punātu vātaḥ prāṇena iṣiraḥ nabhobhiḥ
dyāvā pṛthivī payasā payasvatī ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām
punantu mā agnayaḥ gārhapatyāḥ
punantu mā dhiṣṇyāḥ deva hūtāḥ
punantu mā śakvarīḥ soma pṛṣṭhāḥ
yaḥ potā sa punātu mā bṛhadbhiḥ deva savitar varṣiṣṭhaiḥ dyām iva upari
brahma savaiḥ punātu mā
rāja savaiḥ punātu mā
śatam pavitrā vitatā tiraścā
tebhiḥ mā devaḥ savitā punātu
śatam ca mā pavitāraḥ punantu sahasram ca prasravaṇeṣu āpaḥ
āpaḥ iva pūtaḥ asmi agniḥ iva su varcāḥ sūryaḥ iva su cakṣāḥ
uru nasau asu tṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carataḥ janāṁ anu
tau asmabhyam dṛśaye sūryāya punar dātām asum adya iha bhadram
aganma devāḥ svar
svar aganma
aganma jyotiḥ
jyotiḥ aganma
mahā indraḥ asi parameṣṭhī
su mitra viśvatas mukha mā te yuyoma saṃdṛśaḥ
udyan adya mitra mahaḥ sapatnān me ava jahi
divā enān raśmibhiḥ jahi
rātryā enān tamasā vadhīḥ
te yantu adhamam tamaḥ
sūryasya āvṛtam anvāvarte dakṣiṇām anu āvṛtam
agneḥ tejasā tejasvī bhūyāsam
indrasya indriyeṇa indriyāvān bhūyāsam
idam aham agneḥ tejasā indrasya indriyeṇa somasya dyumnena viśveṣām devānām kratūnām amuṣya āmuṣyāyaṇasya amuṣyāḥ putrasya varcaḥ tejaḥ indriyam prāṇam āyuḥ ni veṣṭayāmi
idam aham agnes tejasendrasyendriyeṇa somasya dyumnena viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ kratūnām
amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya varcas teja indriyaṃ prāṇam āyur ni yacchet
amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya varcas teja indriyaṃ prāṇam āyur ādāya
abhūtyāḥ enam pāśe sitvā duḥṣvapnyena saṃsṛjya mṛtyoḥ vyātte āsan api dadhāmi
yaḥ naḥ svaḥ yaḥ araṇaḥ bhrātṛvyaḥ ca jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca marma skandheṣu vindatām
yaḥ mā śayānam jāgratam yaḥ ca suptam jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca bāhū marmaṇi vṛścatām
yaḥ mā carantam tiṣṭhantam āsīnam ca jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmin agniḥ ca duritam prati muñcatām
yaḥ mā cakṣuṣā manasā yaḥ ca vācā jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca enāṃsi vahatām itas
yaḥ piśācaḥ yātudhānaḥ kravya ad yaḥ mā jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca mūrdhānam prati vidhyatām
yaḥ mā brahmaṇā tapasā yaḥ ca yajñaiḥ jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca hṛdaye adhi ni vidhyatām
yaḥ me brahma yaḥ me tapaḥ balam śreṣṭham jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca kruddhau digdhābhiḥ asyatām
yaḥ me annam yaḥ me rasam vācam śreṣṭhām jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca a chambaṭkāram asyatām
yaḥ me tantum yaḥ me prajām cakṣuḥ śrotram jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca hetim deveṣu vindatām
yaḥ me gobhyaḥ irasyati aśvebhyaḥ puruṣebhyaḥ indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca jyānim deveṣu vindatām
yaḥ me bhūtim an āmayat vittam āyuḥ jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasmai agniḥ ca divaḥ aśmānam asyatām
yaḥ me veśma yaḥ me sabhām śriyam śreṣṭhām jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca kṛtyām vi tanutām gṛhe
yaḥ me mṛtyum a samṛddhim ahnā rātryā ca icchati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca arciṣā dahatām svam
yaḥ me prāṇam yaḥ me apānam vyānam śreṣṭham jighāṃsati indraḥ ca tasya agniḥ ca prāṇam prāṇa hanau hatām
yaḥ mā deva janaiḥ sarpaiḥ vidyutā brahmaṇā abhyamāt agastyena medinā indraḥ ca agniḥ ca tam hatām
tam satya ojāḥ pra dahatu agniḥ vaiśvānaraḥ vṛṣā yaḥ mā durasyan īkṣātai yaḥ ca dipsati vidvalaḥ
yaḥ mā dipsāt a dipsantam yaḥ ca dipsati dipsantam vaiśvānarasya daṃṣṭrayoḥ agneḥ api dadhāmi tam
abhi tam dyāvā pṛthivī sam tapatām
tapte gharme ni ucyatām
nirṛtyāḥ badhyatām pāśe yaḥ naḥ pāpam cikitsati
pratyak vadhena pracyutān bhrātṛvyān ghora cakṣasaḥ indra agnī enān vṛścatām
mā ud śeṣi kaḥ cana
pratyak vadha pratyak jahi bhrātṛvyān dviṣataḥ mama
apānān prāṇān saṃchidya dviṣataḥ pātaya adharān
agne ye mā jighāṃsanti agne ye ca dviṣanti mā agne ye mā upatapyante teṣām priyatamam jahi
etam dviṣantam avadhiṣam andhena tamasā āvṛtam
etam mṛtyo abhi padyasva
mā te moci mahā udara
dyāvā pṛthivī sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantī amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantī
vāta pavamānau sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
indra agnī sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
mitra varuṇā sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
bhava śarvā sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
aśvinā sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
marutaḥ sam nahyadhvam mama rāṣṭrāya jayantaḥ amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantaḥ
pitaraḥ sam nahyadhvam mama rāṣṭrāya jayantaḥ amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantaḥ
sūrya candramasau sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantau amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantau
ahar rātre sam nahyethām mama rāṣṭrāya jayantī amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantī
gandharva apsarasaḥ sam nahyadhvam mama rāṣṭrāya jayantaḥ amitrebhyaḥ hetim asyantaḥ
sarpapuṇyajanāḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanto 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantaḥ
vanaspatayaḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanto 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantaḥ
vānaspatyāḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanto 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantaḥ
oṣadhayaḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayantyo 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantyaḥ
vīrudhaḥ saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayantyo 'mitrebhyo hetim asyantyaḥ
bṛhaspate saṃ nahyasva mama rāṣṭrāya jayann amitrebhyo hetim asyan
prajāpate saṃ nahyasva mama rāṣṭrāya jayann amitrebhyo hetim asyan
parameṣṭhin saṃ nahyasva mama rāṣṭrāya jayann amitrebhyo hetim asyan
udārā ud īrdhvaṃ viśvāni bhūtāni saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mama rāṣṭrāya jayanty amitrebhyo hetim asyanti

sarve vīrāḥ bhavantu me

śaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śam antarikṣaṃ dṛśaye no astu
śaṃ na oṣadhīr vanino bhavantu śaṃ no rajasaḥ patir astu jiṣṇuḥ
śaṃ na indro vasubhir devo astu śam ādityebhir varuṇaḥ suśaṃsaḥ
śaṃ no rudro rudrebhir jalāṣaḥ śaṃ nas tvaṣṭā gnābhir iha śṛṇotu
śaṃ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṃ naḥ śaṃ no grāvāṇaḥ śam u santu yajñāḥ
śaṃ naḥ svarūṇāṃ mitayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ prasvaḥ śam v astu vediḥ
śaṃ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā ud etu śaṃ no bhavantu pradiśaś catasraḥ
śaṃ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṃ naḥ sindhavaḥ śam u santv āpaḥ
śaṃ no aditir bhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṃ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ
śaṃ no viṣṇuḥ śam u pūṣā no astu śaṃ no bhavitraṃ śam v astu vāyuḥ
śaṃ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ
śaṃ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṃ naḥ kṣetrasya patir astu śambhuḥ
śaṃ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṃ no arvantaḥ śam u santu gāvaḥ
śaṃ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṃ no bhavantu pitaro haveṣu
śaṃ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṃ sarasvatī saha dhībhir astu
śam abhiṣācaḥ śam u rātiṣācaḥ śaṃ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṃ no apyāḥ
śaṃ no aja ekapād devo astu śam ahir budhnyaḥ śaṃ samudraḥ
śaṃ no apāṃ napāt perur astu śaṃ naḥ pṛśnir bhavatu devagopāḥ
ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantām idaṃ brahma kriyamāṇaṃ navīyaḥ
śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ
ye devānām ṛtvijo yajñiyāso manor yajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ
te no rāsantām urugāyam adya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
tad astu mitrāvaruṇā tad agne śaṃ yor asmabhyam idam astu śastam
aśīmahi gātum uta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya
agnāv agniś carati praviṣṭa ṛṣīṇāṃ putro adhirāja eṣaḥ
tasmai juhomi haviṣā ghṛtena mā devānāṃ yūyavad bhāgadheyam
yukto vaha jātavedaḥ purastād agne viddhi kriyamāṇaṃ yathedam
tvaṃ bhiṣag bheṣajasyāpi kartā tvayā gām aśvaṃ puruṣaṃ sanema
tathā tvam agne kṛṇu jātavedo anena vidvān haviṣā yaviṣṭha
piśāco asya yatamo jaghāsa yathā so asya paridhiṣ patāti
yo 'sya dideva yatamo jaghāsa yathā so asya paridhiṣ patāti
tathā tvam agne kṛṇu jātavedo viśvebhir devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ
akṣyau ni vidhya hṛdayaṃ ni vidhya jihvāṃ ni tṛndhi pra dataḥ śṛṇīhi
piśāco asya yatamo jaghāsāgne yaviṣṭha prati taṃ śṛṇīhi
yad asya hṛtaṃ vihṛtaṃ yat parābhṛtam ātmano jagdham uta yat piśācaiḥ
tad agne vidvān punar ā bhara tvaṃ śarīre prāṇam asum erayāsya
apāṃ tvā pāne yatamo dadambhaudane manthe yadi vota lehe
tad ātmanā prajayā piśācā vi yātayantām agado 'yam astu
kṣīre tvā māṃse yatamo dadambhākṛṣṭapacye aśane dhānye yaḥ
āme supakve śabale vipakve ya imaṃ piśāco aśane dadambha
tam indro vājī vajreṇa hantu bhinattu somaḥ śiro asya dhṛṣṇuḥ
divā tvā naktaṃ yatamo dadambha kravyād yātuḥ śayane piśācaḥ
tam agne vidvān pra daha kṣiṇīhy apy enaṃ dhehi nirṛter upasthe
somasyendrasya varuṇasya rājño viṣṇor balena savituḥ savena
agner hotreṇa pra ṇude piśācān yaviṣṭhasya brahmaṇā jātavedasaḥ
kravyādam agne rudhiraṃ piśācaṃ manohanaṃ jahi jātavedaḥ sahobhiḥ
śraddhemaṃ brahma juṣatāṃ dakṣiṇāyur yathā jīvāty agado bhavāti
punas tvā prāṇaḥ punar aitv āyuḥ punaś cakṣuḥ punar aitu śrotram
apaghnā no duritāni viśvā śataṃ himāḥ sarvavīrā madema
punar asmai mano dhehi punar āyuḥ punar balam
apānam asya prāṇaṃ cāgne vardhaya jīvase
cakṣuḥ sūrya punar dehi vāta prāṇaṃ sam īraya
śarīram asya māṃsāny agne saṃ bhārayā tvam
sam ā bhara jātavedo yaj jagdhaṃ yat parābhṛtam
gātrāṇy asya kalpaya punar ā pyāyatām ayam
somasyeva jātavedo aṃśur ā pyāyatām ayam
agne virapśinaṃ medhyam ayakṣmaṃ kṛṇu jīvase
saṃ mā siñcantu maruta ity ekā
vi muñcāmi brahmaṇā jātavedasam agniṃ hotāram ajaram rathaspṛtam
sarvā devānāṃ janimāni vidvān yathābhāgaṃ vahatu havyam agniḥ
ye pumāṃso yātudhānā yā striyo yātudhānyaḥ
balavad indrasya vajreṇāvācīnān ava hanmi tān
yam śapāmaḥ yaḥ u naḥ śapāti yam dviṣmaḥ yaḥ u dveṣat piśācaḥ kravya adam agne mahatā vadhena tam atra api pra daha jātavedaḥ
yaḥ ārebhe yasya vā gha asi apsarāḥ yaḥ yātumāvān ulūka yātum tam atra api pra daha jātavedaḥ
yaḥ ādade yasya vā gha asi pitryā stenaḥ śva yātuḥ uta yaḥ patāt rodhanasya adhidevanam kravya ad piśācaḥ kraviṣaḥ titṛpsan ulūka yātum tam atra api pra daha jātavedaḥ
yaḥ puruṣeṇa īyate rathena kravya ad yātuḥ piśunaḥ piśācaḥ vaiśvānareṇa sayujā sūryeṇa tam atra api pra daha jātavedaḥ
yaḥ naḥ vanim mṛgayām yaḥ ca naḥ kṛṣim paritiṣṭhāt yātubhiḥ yaḥ ca naḥ śapāt astā rudraḥ śrathayatu āyuḥ asya
tam atra api pra daha jātavedaḥ
mā yātumān vidata mṛḍitāram
a lokāḥ asmai pradiśaḥ bhavantu
sam enam tapatām rodasī ubhe
jyotiṣmatīḥ tapanāḥ yāḥ ca rocanāḥ pratyoṣantīḥ tanvaḥ yāḥ te agne tābhiḥ me marmāṇi abhitas dadasva
mā tvā dabhan yātudhānāḥ nṛ cakṣaḥ
āpaḥ devīḥ piśācānām api nahyantu āsyam yathā imam mama ātmānam an ādhṛṣya punar patān
sadam puṣpe sadam phale sadam indra abhirakṣite sadā piśācāḥ mriyantām
mā eṣām ud śeṣi kaścana
ye patantaḥ yātudhānāḥ divā naktam upācarān rātrī mā tebhyaḥ rakṣatu
ahne ātmānam pari dade
imam badhnāmi te maṇim dīrgha āyu tvāya tejase darbham sapatna jambhanam dviṣataḥ tapanam hṛdaḥ
dviṣataḥ tāpayan hṛdaḥ śatrūṇām tāpayan manaḥ durhārdaḥ sarvān tvam darbha gharmaḥ iva abhi id sam tāpaya
gharmaḥ iva abhitapan darbha dviṣataḥ nitapan maṇe hṛdaḥ sapatnānām bhinddhi indraḥ iva virujan valam
bhinddhi darbha sapatnānām hṛdayam dviṣatām maṇe
udyan tvacam iva bhūmyāḥ śiraḥ eṣām vi pātaya
bhinddhi darbha sapatnān me
bhinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ
bhinddhi me sarvān durhārdaḥ
bhinddhi me dviṣataḥ maṇe
chinddhi darbha sapatnān me
chinddhi me pṛtanāyataḥ
chinddhi me sarvān durhārdaḥ
chinddhi me dviṣataḥ maṇe
vṛśca darbha sapatnān me
vṛśca me pṛtanāyataḥ
vṛśca me sarvān durhārdaḥ
vṛśca me dviṣataḥ maṇe
kṛnta darbha sapatnān me
kṛnta me pṛtanāyataḥ
kṛnta me sarvān durhārdaḥ
kṛnta me dviṣataḥ maṇe
piṃśa darbha sapatnān me

tṛndhi darbha sapatnān me

bhaṅdhi darbha sapatnān me

bhaṅdhi me sarvān durhārdaḥ
bhaṅdhi me dviṣataḥ maṇe
mṛṇa darbha sapatnān me
mṛṇa me pṛtanāyataḥ
mṛṇa me sarvān durhārdaḥ
mṛṇa me dviṣataḥ maṇe
mantha darbha sapatnān me
mantha me pṛtanāyataḥ
mantha me sarvān durhārdaḥ
mantha me dviṣataḥ maṇe
piṇḍhi darbha sapatnān me
piṇḍhi me pṛtanāyataḥ
piṇḍhi me sarvān durhārdaḥ
piṇḍhi me dviṣataḥ maṇe
oṣa darbha sapatnān me
oṣa me pṛtanāyataḥ
oṣa me sarvān durhārdaḥ
oṣa me dviṣataḥ maṇe
daha darbha sapatnān me daha me pṛtanāyataḥ
daha me sarvān durhārdo daha me dviṣato maṇe
jahi darbha sapatnān me jahi me pṛtanāyataḥ
jahi me sarvān durhārdo jahi me dviṣato maṇe
yat te darbha jarāmṛtyu śate varmasu varma te
tenemaṃ varmiṇaṃ kṛtvā sapatnāñ jahi vīryaiḥ
śataṃ te darbha varmāṇi sahasraṃ vīryāṇi te
tam asmai viśve tvāṃ devā jarase bhartavā aduḥ
tvām āhur devavarma tvāṃ darbha brahmaṇaspatim
tvām indrasyāhur varma tvaṃ rāṣṭrāṇi rakṣasi
sapatnakṣayaṇaṃ darbhaṃ dviṣatas tapanaṃ hṛdaḥ
maṇiṃ kṣatrasya vardhanaṃ tanūpānaṃ kṛṇomi te
yat samudro abhyakrandat parjanyo vidyutā saha
tato hiraṇyayo bindus tato darbho ajāyata
doṣo gāya bṛhad gāya dyumad gāyātharvaṇa
stuhi devaṃ savitāram
tam u stuhy antaḥsindhuṃ sūnuṃ satyasya yuvānam
adroghavācaṃ suśevam
sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣad vasupatir vasūni
ubhe suṣṭutī sugātum
indrāya somam ṛtvijaḥ sunotanā ca dhāvata
stotur yo havaṃ śṛṇavad dhavaṃ ca naḥ
sunotā somapāvne somam indrāya vajriṇe
yuvā jeteśānaḥ sa puruṣṭutaḥ
ā tvā viśantv indavo vayo na vṛkṣam andhasā
virapśin vi mṛdho jahi rakṣasvinīḥ
āre asāv asmad astu hetir devāso asat
āre martānām aśastiḥ
sakhaiva no rātir astu sakhendraḥ sakhā savitā
sakhā bhagaḥ satyadharmā no astu
abhi no devīr avasā mahā śarmaṇā nṛpatnīḥ
acchinnapatrāḥ sacantām
īḍe agniṃ bhavaṃ sarvaṃ rakṣa ubjad ahiṃ balāsam uta sedim ugrām
āre asmad adite daivyaṃ bhayaṃ suvīryaṃ marutaḥ śarma yacchata
īḍe dyāvāpṛthivī parvatāṁ apaḥ svaḥ sūryam urv antarikṣam
vanaspatīn oṣadhīr gā utarca ṛtasya naḥ patayo mṛḍayantu
huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāram ūtaye
iha somo varuṇo vāyur agnir bhaga ugrā avase no gamantu
pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā varuṇaḥ pāntu marutaḥ
apāṃ napāt sindhavaḥ sapta pātana pātu viṣṇur uta dyauḥ
pātāṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī abhiṣṭaye pātu grāvā pātu somo no aṃhasaḥ
pātu no devī suhavā sarasvatī pātv agnir ye śivā asya pāyavaḥ
pātāṃ no devāśvinā sudaṃsasoṣāsānaktota na uruṣyatām
apāṃ napād avihrutī kayasya cid divo mūrdhann adite śarma yaccha naḥ
tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ parjanyo brahmaṇaspatiḥ
putrair bhrātṛbhir aditir nu pātu no duṣṭaraṃ trāmaṇe śavaḥ
aṃśo bhago varuṇo mitro aryamāditiḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ
apa tasya dveṣo gamed abhihruto yāvayāc chatrum antitam
deva tvaṣṭar vardhaya sarvatātaye dhiye sam u śriye prāvatān naḥ
uruṣyā ṇa urutaraḥ prayucchan dyauṣ pitar yāvaya ducchunām itaḥ
ye no vacobhir uta daṃsanābhis tanvaṃ soma paritāpayante
nīcais tān vṛśca na yathā virukṣan mā te dṛśan sūryam uccarantam
tvayeṣvā tvayā soma dhanvanā tvayā muṣṭighnā śāśadmahe vayam
tvaṃ tān vṛśca ya idaṃ na ādṛśā karan hanāma daṇḍair uta daṃsanābhiḥ
padena tān padavyo nayantu vadhair enān pitaro daṃsayantu
yathā na jīvāt katamaś canaiṣām
yena somāditiḥ pathā mitrā vā yanty adruhaḥ
tenā no 'vitā bhuvaḥ
yo naḥ soma suśaṃsino duḥśaṃso abhidāsati
vajreṇāsya mukhe jahi sa sampiṣṭo apāyati
yo naḥ somābhidāsati sanābhir yaś ca niṣṭyaḥ
ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyaur vadha tmanā
punar agham aghakṛtam etu devāḥ punar ena enaskṛtaṃ vijānat
punaḥ putraḥ pitaram etu vidvān hatām uta yad asya svam asti
yena cāsau śapati yena cainaṃ śapāmasi
ubhau saṃbṛhya tau tasmād antikād dhetim asyatām
ye pārthivāsaḥ śapathā ya urāv antarikṣe
ye vātasya prabharmaṇi tebhiṣ ṭaṃ vartayāmasi yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayam
ye asmān parisāsṛpuḥ kulīpayāni bibhrataḥ
ud devās teṣāṃ vṛścata mūlam urvārvo yathā
yad devā aghadhā agham anyasminn āsisaṅkṣati
bhāro aghasya duḥsahaḥ pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu
punar evāghadhām aghaṃ nimnam ivaitur arṣatu
ādityā duryā māhiṣā mahī sindhor ivāvaniḥ
śaśvad didyut kriyamāṇā pratīcī nahi paptata
pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu
śaśvantam ic chāśadānam anyasmā iṣūr dihānam
pratīcī śarur ṛcchatu
yad etad bhūri śāśadaḥ pratīcīnam apohase
viṣād iva viṣam addhi tat
namas te pravato napād yatas tapaḥ samūhase
mṛḍā nas tanūbhyaḥ śaṃ nas tokebhyas kṛdhi
pravato napān namo astu tubhyaṃ namas te hetaye tapuṣyai
vidma te dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat samudre antar nihitāsi nābhiḥ
yāṃ tvā devā ajanayanta viśva iṣuṃ kṛṇvānā asanāya tṛṣvīm
sā no mṛḍa vidathe gṛṇānā mitrasya ca varuṇasya praśiṣṭau
yūyaṃ naḥ pravato napān marutaḥ sūryatvacaḥ
śarma yacchātha saprathāḥ
mamṛḍatā suṣūdatā mṛḍā no aghnyābhyaḥ
tokāya tanve ca
namas te astu vidyute namas te stanayitnave
namas te astv aśmane yenā dūḍāśe asyasi
yo asmān brahmaṇaspate 'devo abhidāsati
sarvaṃ taṃ rīradhāsi naḥ
yebhiḥ soma sāhantyāsurān randhayāsai
tebhir no 'vitā bhuvaḥ
yāni devā asurāṇām ojāṃsy avṛṇīdhvam
tebhir no adhi vocata
ud enam uttaraṃ nayāgne ghṛtebhir āhutaḥ
sam enaṃ varcasā sṛja devānāṃ bhāgadhā asat
indremaṃ prataraṃ kṛdhi sajātānām asad vaśī
rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi
yasya kṛṇmo gṛhe havis tam agne vardhayā tvam
tasmai somo adhi bruvad ayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ
ṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaram ṛtasya jyotiṣas patim
ajasraṃ gharmam īmahe
sa idaṃ prati paprathad yajñasya svar uttiran
ṛtūn ut sṛjate vaśī
agniḥ priyeṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya
samrāḍ eko vi rājati
pari dyām iva sūryo ahīnāṃ janimāgamam
rātrī jagad ivānyad dhaṃsād avārīramaṃ viṣam
yad brahmabhir yad ṛṣibhir yad devair uditaṃ purā
yad bhūtaṃ bhavyam āsanvat tena te vāraye viṣam
madhunāpṛkṣi nadyaḥ parvatā girayo madhu
madhu paruṣṇī śīpālā śam āsne astu śaṃ hṛde
yatheyam urvī pṛthivī dādhāra viṣṭhitaṃ jagat
evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave
yatheyam urvī pṛthivī dādhāremān vanaspatīn
yatheyam urvī pṛthivī dādhāra parvatāṁ apaḥ
sasruṣīs tadapaso divā naktaṃ ca sasruṣīḥ
vareṇyakratur aham apo devīr upa bruve
oktā āpaḥ karmaṇyā muñcantv itaḥ praṇītaye
sadyo bhavantv etave
devasya savituḥ save karma kṛṇvanti mānuṣāḥ
śaṃ no bhavantv apa oṣadhīr imāḥ
śatasya te dhamanīnāṃ sahasrasya hirāṇām
asthur madhyamā yāḥ sākam antā araṃsata
pari vaḥ sikatāmayīr dhanūs tiraś cid asthiran
tiṣṭhatelayatā su kam
amūr yā yanti jāmayaḥ sarvā lohitavāsasaḥ
abhrātara iva yoṣās tiṣṭhanti hatavarcasaḥ
tiṣṭhāvare tiṣṭha para uta tvaṃ tiṣṭha madhyame
kaniṣṭhikā ca tiṣṭhāt tiṣṭhād id dhamanir mahī
namo devavadhebhyo namo rājavadhebhyaḥ
atho ye viśyānāṃ vadhās tebhyo mṛtyo namāṃsi te
namas te adhivākāya parāvākāya te namaḥ
sumatyai mṛtyo te namo durmatyai ta idaṃ namaḥ
namas te yātudhānebhyo namas te bheṣajebhyaḥ
mūlebhyo mṛtyo te namo brāhmaṇebhya idaṃ namaḥ
nava ca yā navatiś ca saṃyanti manyā abhi
itas tāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitām iva
sapta ca yāḥ saptatiś ca saṃyanti skandhyā abhi
pañca ca yāḥ pañcāśac ca saṃyanti graivyā abhi
āvayo anāvayo rasas ta ugra āvayo
ā te karambham adimahi sa hi na tvam asi yas tvam ātmānam āvayaḥ
babhruś ca babhrukarṇaś ca nīlāgalasālā śivaḥ paśya
tauvilike 'velayāvāyam ailaba ailayīt
vīhi svām āhutiṃ juṣāṇo manasā svāhā
svāhā manasā yad idaṃ kṛṇomi yasyās ta āsañ juhomi ghore
eṣāṃ baddhānām avasarjanāya kam
bhūmir iti tvābhi pra manvate janā nirṛtir iti tvāhaṃ pari veda viśvataḥ

trāyadhvaṃ no aghaviṣābhyo vadhād agnīṣomā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ
viśve devā maruto vaiśvadevā vātāparjanyayoḥ sumatau syāma
saṃ jānatāṃ manasā saṃ cikitrāṃ mā yutsata manyunā daivyena
mā ghoṣa ut thād bahule vinirhate meṣuḥ paptad indrasyāhany āgate
saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃ vratā sam ākūtīr nayāmasi
ime ye vivratā stha tān vaḥ saṃ jñapayāmasi
saṃjñapanaṃ vo manaso atho saṃjñapanaṃ hṛdaḥ
atho bhagasya yac chrāntaṃ tena saṃ jñapayāti vaḥ
saṃ vaḥ pṛcyantāṃ tanvaḥ saṃ manāṃsi sam u tvacaḥ
saṃ vo brahmaṇaspatiḥ somaḥ saṃ jñapayāti vaḥ
saṃjñānaṃ naḥ svebhyaḥ saṃjñānam araṇebhyaḥ
saṃjñānam aśvinā yuvam ihāsmāsu ni yacchatam
yathādityā vasubhiḥ saṃbabhūvur marudbhir ugrā ahṛṇīyamānāḥ
evā triṇāmann ahṛṇīyamāna imaṃ janaṃ saṃmanasaṃ kṛṇu tvam
nir amuṃ nuda okasaḥ sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati
nirbādhyena haviṣendra enaṃ parāśarīt
ihi tisraḥ parāvata ihi pañca janāṁ ati
ihi saptāti rocanā yāvat sūryo asad divi
paramāṃ tvā parāvatam indro devo ajīgamat
yato na punar āyasi śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ
pratīcīnaphala ity āṣṭarcikyau
aghadviṣṭā devajūtā vīruc chapathayāvanī
udnā malam ivāvānaik sarvān mac chapathāṁ adhi
yad enaṃ pariṣīdanti samādadhati cakṣase
saṃpreddho agnir jihvābhir ud eti hṛdayād adhi
agneḥ sāṃtapanasyāham āyuṣe padam ā rabhe
addhātir yasya paśyati dhūmam udyantam āsyataḥ
yo asya samidhaṃ veda kṣatriyeṇa samāhitām
nābhihvāre padaṃ ni dadhāti sa mṛtyave
nainaṃ ghnanti paryāyiṇo na sannāṁ ava gacchati
agner yaḥ kṣatriyo vidvān nāma gṛhṇāty āyuṣe
asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād viśvam idaṃ jagat
tiṣṭhanti parvatā ime sthāmann aśvā araṃsata
ya udānaḍ vyayane ya udānaṭ parāyaṇe
āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve
āvṛto nyāvṛto 'bhyāvartanam āyanam
agneś catasra āvṛtas tābhiṣ ṭvā tarpayāmasi
jātavedo ni vartaya śataṃ te santv āvṛtaḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ
tābhir enaṃ ni vartaya
adārasṛd bhavatu deva somāyam asmin yajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ
mā no vidad abhibhā mo aśastir mā naḥ prāpad ducchunā dveṣyā yā
yo adya daivyo vadho jighāṃsan na upāyati
yuvaṃ taṃ mitrāvaruṇāv asmad yāvayataṃ pari
itaś cāmutaś cāghaṃ varuṇa yāvaya
vi mahac charma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham
apendra prāco maghavann amitrān apāpāco abhibhūte nudasva
apodīco apa śūrādharāca urau yathā tava śarman madema
tena bhūtasya haviṣā punar ā pyāyatām ayam
jāyāṃ yām asmā avidan sā rasenābhi vardhatām
abhi vardhatāṃ prajayābhi rāṣṭreṇa vardhatām
iṣā sahasravīryāv imau stām anupakṣitau
tvaṣṭā jāyām ajanayat tvaṣṭāsyai tvāṃ patiṃ dadhau
tvaṣṭā sahasram āyūṃṣi dīrgham āyuṣ kṛṇotu vām
antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā bhūtāvacākaśat
śuno divyasyaitan mahas tasmā etena haviṣā juhomi
apsu te janma divi te sadhasthaṃ samudra ātmā mahimā te pṛthivyām
ye trayaḥ kālakāñjā divi devā iva śritāḥ
tān sarvān ahva ūtaye 'smā ariṣṭatātaye
yaḥ puruṣaṃ hūrcchayasi śvā divyo avīrahā
taṃ tvāhaṃ brahmaṇā nude puruṣaṃ mā parā vadhīḥ
yaḥ piśaṅgo ayodaṃṣṭraḥ śvā divyaḥ pariplavaḥ
tasyāhaṃ nāma jagrabhāsmā ariṣṭatātaye ayaṃ no jīvatād iti
ayaṃ no nabhasas patiḥ saṃsphāno abhi rakṣatu
asamātiṃ gṛheṣu naḥ
tvaṃ no nabhasas pata ūrjaṃ gṛheṣu dhāraya
deva saṃsphāna sahasrāpoṣasyeśiṣe
tasya no dhehi tasya te bhakṣīmahi tasya te bhaktivāṃso bhūyāsma svāhā
yantāsi yacchase hastam apa rakṣāṃsi sedhasi
prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca gṛhṇānaḥ parihasto abhūd ayam
parihasta vi dhāraya yoniṃ garbhāya kartave
maryāde putram ā dhehi taṃ tvam ā gamayāgama
yaṃ parihastam abibhar aditiḥ putrakāmyā
tvaṣṭā tam asyā ābadhnād yathā putraṃ suvād iti
āgacchata āgatasya nāma gṛhṇāmy āyataḥ
indrasya vṛtraghno rājño vāsavasya śatakratoḥ
yena sūryāṃ sāvitrīm aśvinohatuḥ pathā
tena mām abravīd bhago jāyām ā vahatād iti
yas te 'ṅkuśo vasudāno bṛhann indra hiraṇyayaḥ
tenā janīyate jāyāṃ tvaṃ dhehi śatakrato
tvaṃ no medhe prathamā gobhir aśvebhir ā gahi
tvaṃ sūryasya raśmiṣu tvaṃ no asi yajñiyā
medhām ahaṃ prathamāṃ brahmaṇvatīm ṛṣiṣṭutāṃ prapītāṃ brahmacāribhiḥ
devānām avasā vṛṇe
medhāṃ sāyaṃ medhāṃ prātar medhāṃ madhyandinaṃ pari
medhāṃ sūryeṇodyatodīrāṇā utastamaḥ
pārthivasya rase devā bhagasya tanvo bale
āyur asmai somo varca ā dhād bṛhaspatiḥ
āyur asmā ity ekā
āśīr ṇa ūrjam uta suprajāstvaṃ dakṣaṃ dadhātu draviṇaṃ suvarcasam
saṃjayan kṣetrāṇi sahasāham indra kṛṇvāno anyān adharān sapatnān
āyam agan savitā kṣureṇoṣṇena vāya udakenehi
ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sacetasaḥ somasya rājño 'vapan pracetasaḥ
yenāvapat savitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān
tena brahmāṇo vapatedam asyāsrāmo dīrghāyur ayam astu vīraḥ
aditiḥ śmaśru vapatv āpa undantu varcasā
dhārayatu prajāpatiḥ punaḥpunaḥ suvaptave
yās te hirā dhamanayo aṅgāny anu viṣṭhitāḥ
tāsāṃ te sarvāsāṃ sākaṃ nir viṣāṇi hvayāmasi
yāṃ te rudra iṣum āsthad aṅgebhyo hṛdayāya ca
imāṃ tām adya te vayaṃ viṣūcīṃ vi vṛhāmasi
namo visṛjyamānābhyo namas ta āyatābhyaḥ
avācīḥ pari mūrdhno yās te dhamanayaḥ śatam
tās te pra bhidyantāṃ pṛthag anu tyaṃ lohitāvaṭam
syandantāṃ rocanāvatīr anu tyaṃ lohitāvaṭam
yathāsyām antar na raṃsantā anukūla ivodakam
pratīcīnaḥ sūrya eti pratīcīḥ sravataḥ kṛtāḥ
avācīs te asnaḥ kulyā iyaṃ pṛṇaktv oṣadhīḥ
imaṃ yavam aṣṭāyogaiḥ ṣaḍyogebhir acarkṛṣuḥ
sa ghā te tanvo rapaḥ pratīcīnam apa vyayat
nīcīnam aghnyā duhe nyag bhavatu te rapaḥ
āpaḥ samudrārthā yatīḥ parā vahantu te rapaḥ
amī ye yudham āyanti ketūn kṛtvānīkaśaḥ
indras tān pary ahār dāmnā tān agne saṃ dyā tvam
yāvatīḥ sica āyanty anīkāni yati ṣṭhana
saṃ paramān sam avamān atho saṃ dyāmi madhyamān
saṃdānaṃ vo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃdānaṃ savitā karat
saṃdānam indraś cāgniś ca saṃdānaṃ bhago aśvinā
yās te ruco deva sūryodyato divy ātatāḥ
tābhir mām adya sarvābhir manuṣyebhyo ruce kṛṇu
ruce mā dhehi brahmasu ruce rājasu dhehi mā
ruce viśyeṣu śūdreṣu mayi dhehi ruce rucim
yā ruco hiraṇye yā agnau yāś ca sūrye
indrāgnī mayi tā ruco ruco dhehi bṛhaspate
ava mā pāpman sṛja vaśī san mṛḍayāsi naḥ
ā mā bhadreṣu dhāmasu tvaṃ dhehy avihrutam
yo mā pāpman na jahāsi tam u tvā jahimo vayam
anyatrāsman ny ucya sahasrākṣāmartya
pathor vayaṃ vyāvartane niṣ pāpmānaṃ suvāmasi
yo no dveṣṭi taṃ gaccha yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ jahi
śava ivāsi saṃnaddho na bhogam avidaṃ tvayi
śiro bhinadmi te pāpman yathā na punar āyasi
indro asmān divā pātu mṛtyoḥ pāśāt svastaye
dyaur no madhyataḥ pātu bhūmī rājñī svastaye
sūryo asmān divā pātu mṛtyoḥ pāśāt svastaye
vāto no madhyataḥ pātv ahā rātrī svastaye
somo asmān divā pātu mṛtyoḥ pāśāt svastaye
āpo no madhyataḥ pāntu mā no nirṛtir īśata
saṃ vāṃ cakṣuḥ saṃ hṛdayaṃ manasāvīvanaṃ manaḥ
asyāḥ sarūpavatsāyā ghṛte homena sarpiṣā
yat kakṣīvān saṃvananaṃ putro aṅgirasām avet
tena vām adya devāḥ saṃpriyau sam avīvanan
saṃvananaṃ vāṃ manaso atho saṃvananaṃ hṛdaḥ
atho bhagasya yac chrāntaṃ tena saṃ vānayāmi vām
ahaṃ te manasā manaś cakṣur gṛhṇāmi cakṣuṣā
evā pari ṣvajasva mā yathāsan mayi te manaḥ
ā rathasyeva cakre abhi mā vartatām asau
reṣmacchinnaṃ yathā tṛṇaṃ veṣṭāsau manasā mayi
pari tvā yātur asaraṃ pari mātuḥ pari svasuḥ
pari tvānyābhya strībhyo 'nayauṣadhyāsaram
ya indrasya sabhādhāno yasmin samitim āsate
hiraṇyaṃ yasya parṇāni tasmā aśvattha te namaḥ
yaḥ śākhābhir antarikṣam āpūrayati niṣṭhayā
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni tasmā aśvattha te namaḥ
yaṃ mṛgo na samāpnoti pakṣābhyāṃ śakuniḥ patan
divaṃ yaḥ sarvāṃ stabhnāti tasmā aśvattha te namaḥ
jyeṣṭhaghnyāṃ jāto vicṛtor yamasya māyaṃ hiṃsīt pitarau vardhamānaḥ
syonau vyāghrā uta te śivau stām ati tvā neṣan duritāni viśvā
vyāghre ahny ajaniṣṭa vīro nakṣatrajāḥ sarvavīraḥ suvīraḥ
sa mā hiṃsīḥ pitarau vardhamānas tasya te devāḥ prati gṛhṇantu homam
yā rohiṇī devatyā pra dhenur iva pinvate
tatra tisro vyaṣṭakāḥ sarvā adhi bruvantu prajāyai jagate ca vām
yad ārdrābhyām araṇibhyāṃ devāḥ śakrā amanthan puruṣeṇa puruṣam
atrā puṣyataṃ mithunā sayonī jīvāṃ prajāṃ jaradaṣṭiṃ sutejasā
hataṃ pataṅgam uta tardam ākhum aśvinā bhintaṃ śiro mṛṇataṃ hanū dataḥ
yathā naḥ sasyaṃ na ghasan vyadvarā evābhayaṃ kṛṇutaṃ dhānyāya naḥ
tarda hai pataṅga hai jabhya hā upakvasa
anadanta idaṃ dhānyam ahiṃsanto apodita
tardapate vaghāpate tṛṣṭadaṃśmā śṛṇota naḥ
hotrevāprāśitaṃ havir vṛkṇajihvā upādhvam
tarda jabhyāpi jihvayā ya imaṃ divyaṃ pīyūṣaṃ prathamas titṛpsāt
taṃ pratyañcam arciṣā vidhya marman
ye abhrajā ye vātajā ye divas pari jajñire
marīcyāḥ putrāṇāṃ vayam api nahyāma āsyam
ye arjunā ye haritā ye kṛṣṇā ye ca rohitāḥ
kabandhasya praśāsane śalabhāñ jambhayāmasi
antarikṣeṇa patata mā sasyam abhi paddhvam
girīṇāṃ sānuṣu sīdata tṛṇaṃ kapālam attana śalabhās tad viśām iva
yathāśvāso yathādhuraṃ yuktā vahanti sādhuyā
evā mūtra pra bhidyasva vi vaster āsyaṃ sṛja
viṣitaṃ te vastibilaṃ samudrasyodadher iva
yāḥ samudrād uccaranti jaratīr upajihvikāḥ
pramehaṇasya tā vidur ubhayor mehanasya ca
śīrṣṇo valīr āsno valīr aṅgādaṅgān mukhād valīḥ
sarvās tā indrāṇī valīr apa mārṣṭv adhi tvacaḥ
yās tvaci valayo jātā yā jātās tanvas pari
sarvās tā indrāṇī valīḥ śamīśākhāsv ā sajāt
ā śamīṃ māmakī valī rurohāti jahāti mām
etām indrasya jāyā validhānīm akṛṇvata
yathā sūryo nakṣatrāṇāṃ varcāṃsi yuvate divaḥ
evā sapatnānām ahaṃ varca indriyam ā dade
yac ca varcaḥ sapatnānāṃ bhrātṛvyeṣu ca yad yaśaḥ
tad indro vṛtrahā dhātā savitādīdharan mayi
yāś ca gāvaḥ sapatnānāṃ bhrātṛvyeṣu ca yad vasu
tan nirjyeyam iva jītvā savitādīdharan mayi
satyam eva jayatu mānṛtaṃ satyasya panthā ṛjur astu sādhuḥ
satyaṃ vadantaḥ samidhe vidhema satyena dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām
vāgbhāgasya ca satyena rudrasya sumanasyayā
indreṇādhibruvatā vayaṃ viśaṃ prāśi videmahi
yā te rudreṣur āyatā vāci vā te araṃkṛtā
yenedaṃ vivadāmahe tasya prāśaṃ tvaṃ jahi
jahi tvaṃ tasya prāśam uta satyām utānṛtām
yo asmān indra vṛtrahan vācā prāśaṃ jigīṣati
utpam ut pṛṇa bahvīha sīdedaṃ pṛṇa
uto divaḥ sma siñcatāt samudrasyeva madhyataḥ
samudraś ca śatadhāraḥ sahasradhāro akṣitaḥ
purastād indra ācarat pūrṇagoṣṭha idaṃ pṛṇa
ihopa pṛṇa saṃ pṛṇa vṛṣaprajananāḥ kṛdhi
iha gāvaḥ pra jāyadhvam ihāśvā iha pūruṣāḥ
iho sahasradakṣiṇo abhi prātā ni ṣīdatu
jyeṣṭhaghnyai nakṣatrāṇām ahne rātryā idaṃ namaḥ
juhomi viśvakarmaṇe sa śivo mṛḍayāti naḥ
mā jyeṣṭhaṃ vadhīd ayam agna eṣāṃ mūlabarhaṇaṃ pari vṛṇakty enam
grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan pitāputrau mātaraṃ muñca sarvān
un muñca pāśāṃs tvam agna eṣāṃ trayas tribhir utsitā yebhir āsan
māyaṃ hiṃsīt pitaraṃ vardhamāno mā mātaraṃ pra minīd yā janitrī
grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta ye sinanti yān brahmaṇā parivṛñjanti vedhasaḥ
un muñca pāśāṃs tvam agna eṣāṃ taj jātasyān aharahar astu bhadram
ni vartadhvaṃ mānu gātāsmān siṣakta revatīḥ
agnīṣomā punarvasū asya vardhayataṃ rayim
punar enā ni vartaya punar enā upākuru
indra enā ni yacchatv agnir enā upājatu
pari vo viśvato dadha ūrjā ghṛtena payasā
ye devāḥ ke ca yajñiyās te rayyā saṃ sṛjantu mā
namo astu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīm anu
ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
ye cāmī rocane divo ye ca sūryasya raśmiṣu
yeṣām apsu sadas kṛtaṃ tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
yā iṣavo yātudhānānāṃ yā vanaspatīnām
ye 'vaṭeṣu śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ
yavocchiṣṭaṃ haviṣā vardhayemaṃ yathā dyumnī kṛṇavad vīryāṇi
sajūr devebhir abhi bhūḥ sapatnān āyuṣmat kṣatram ajaraṃ te astu
puṃsā yavena haviṣā payasvatocchiṣṭasyāyū rakṣantu devāḥ
devā hy asmin nidadhan nṛmṇaṃ bṛhad asmā indro vayo dadhātu
sam ucchiṣṭasya haviṣā sam ukthaiḥ sam āyuṣā varcasā payo dadhāmi
vāyur enāḥ samākarat tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām
indra ābhyo adhi bruvad rudro bhūmne cikitsatu
yathā cakrur devāsurā yathā manuṣyā uta
evā sahasrapoṣāya kṛṇutaṃ lakṣmāśvinā
lohitena svadhitinā mithunaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛdhi
akartām aśvinā lakṣma tad astu prajayā bahu
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divam ut patanti
ā ca vartante sadanād ṛtasyād id ghṛtena pṛthivī vy udyate
payasvatīḥ kṛṇuthāpa oṣadhīr imā yad ejatha maruto rukmavakṣasaḥ
ūrjaṃ ca tatra sumatiṃ ca pinvatha yatrā naro marutaḥ siñcathā madhu
udapluto marutas tāṁ iyarta vṛṣṭyā yad viśvā nivatas pṛṇātha
ejāti galhā kanyeva tunnairuṃ tundānā patyeva jāyā
tvaṣṭreva pūṣeryo damūnā mahī svastir vṛṣaṇā na āgan
viśvā āśāḥ sūyavasāḥ saṃrarāṇo 'syā rayyāḥ puraetā na edhi
eha yantu madhumad duhānā anamīvā uśatīr viśvarūpāḥ
bahvīr bhavantīr upajāyamānā ihendro vo ramayatu gāvaḥ
prajāpatir janayatu prajā imās tvaṣṭā dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ
saṃvatsara ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidāno mayi puṣṭaṃ puṣṭapatir dadhātu
sāhasī nāma vā asi sahasas pari jajñiṣe
sahasvān indro deveṣu sahase tvā khanāmasi
sahasyena bheṣajena divyena śataparvaṇā
tena sahasrakāṇḍena kṛṇomi punarābhṛtim
sahaso 'haṃ bheṣajasya divyasya nāma jagrabha
vy āśiṣaiva tasthire yakṣmāsaḥ puruṣād adhi
apeta etu nirṛtir nehāsyā api kiṃ cana
apāsyāḥ satvanaḥ pāśān mṛtyūn ekaśataṃ nude
ye te pāśā ekaśataṃ mṛtyo martyāya hantave
tāṃs te yajñasya māyayā sarvāṁ apa yajāmasi
nir ito yantu nairṛtā mṛtyava ekaśataṃ paraḥ
sedhāma eṣāṃ yat tamaḥ prāṇaṃ jyotiś ca dadhmahe
triṣaptā vāraṇā imās tābhir mām indro abravīt
viṣaṃ vārayatām iti viṣaṃ dūṣayatād iti
apa brūtedaṃ maruto mahīndrasyāpavācanī
eṣā sahasram arhaty eṣā vārayate viṣam
asthur viṣasyābhītayaḥ pratikūla ivābalaḥ
yathā bāṇaḥ susaṃśitaḥ parāpataty āśumat
evā kāse parā pata sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā
yathā cakṣuś cakṣuṣmataḥ parāpatati ketumat
evā kāse parā pata sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
yathā mano manyuketuṃ parāpatati yojanā
evā kāse parā pata samudrasyānu vikṣaram
ita evāva gacchatogrā bhavata mābalāḥ
hvayantu sarve vo devāḥ sarvā vo vṛṇatāṃ viśaḥ
yad avagamena haviṣāva vo gamayāmasi
indraḥ kaśyapa ād agnir iḍā turīyā vaḥ sakhā
yad bhūtaṃ bhavyam āsanvat tenāva gamayāmi vaḥ
na taṃ yakṣmā ā rundhate nainaṃ śapatho aśnute
yaṃ bheṣajasya gulguloḥ surabhir gandho aśnute
yaṃ gulgulor bheṣajasya surabhir gandho aśnute
viṣvañcas tasmād yakṣmā mṛgā iṣvā iverate
yad gulgulu saindhavaṃ yad vā ghāsi samudriyam
ubhayor agrabhaṃ nāmāsmā ariṣṭatātaye
devā etam ity ekā
bṛhatpalāśe subhaga ūrdhvasvapna ṛtāvari
māteva putrebhyo mṛḍa keśebhyo naḥ śami
yas te mado 'vikeśo yo vikeśo yenābhihasyaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṇoṣi
bhrūṇaghno viruvārācara tvaṃ tasya te prajāyāḥ pra suvāmi keśān
ākūtiṃ devīṃ subhagāṃ puro dadhe cittasya mātā suhavā no astu
yām āśām emi kevalī sā me astu videyam enāṃ manasi praviṣṭām
ākūtyā no bṛhaspata ākūtyā na upā gahi
atho bhagasya no dhehy atho naḥ suhavo bhava
bṛhaspatir ma ākūtim āṅgirasaḥ prati jānātu vācam etām
yasya devā devatāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ sa supraṇīḥ kāmo anv etv asmān
mano nv ā hvāmahi nārāśaṃsena stomena
pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ
ā na etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase
punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ
jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi
vayaṃ soma vrate tava manas tanūṣu bibhrataḥ
prajāvantaḥ sacemahi
varco me mitrāvaruṇā varco devī sarasvatī
varco me aśvinobhā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā
yac ca varco yajamāne yac ca yajñe 'dhy āhitam
surāyāṃ babhru yad varcas tasya bhakṣīya varcasaḥ
yā utsebhyaḥ prasravanti divo dhārā nadībhyaḥ
tāsāṃ mā sarvāsām apām abhi ṣiñcāmi varcasā
yad rājānaṃ śakadhūmaṃ nakṣatrāṇy akṛṇvata
bhadrāham asmai prāyacchan tato rāṣṭram ajāyata
bhadrāham astu naḥ sāyaṃ bhadrāhaṃ prātar astu naḥ
bhadrāham asmabhyaṃ tvaṃ śakadhūma sadā kṛṇu
yo no bhadrāham akaraḥ sāyaṃ prātar atho divā
tasmai te nakṣatrarāja śakadhūma sadā namaḥ
yad āhuḥ śakadhūmāhaṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prathamajaṃ jyotir agre
tan naḥ saniṃ madhumatīṃ kṛṇotu rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchāt
yūpe garte vidveṣaṇaṃ devānāṃ vacasā kṛtam
agnir vām astv antarā yathā vāṃ na sahāsati
yathāhiṃ dveṣṭi puruṣo ahir vā dveṣṭi puruṣam
girir vām astv antarā yathā vāṃ na sahāsati
nānāni vām ākūtāni nānā cittāni santu vām
viṣvañcau pary ā vartethāṃ yathā vāṃ na sahāsati
etad yat te yad vā yad vā na cāsan no ca te bhuvat
svapne vittaṃ yathā dhanaṃ naśyād id etad etataḥ
ā gilo gilāpāpacito gila
naśyād bradhnakam arbhakam
dīrghāyutvāya sahase mahyā ariṣṭatātaye
suparṇo mahyam abravīd etad āśliṣṭabheṣajam
saktūn iva titaunā punanto vidvāṃso vācam akrata
aṅgebhyo viśvāṅgebhyaḥ pra te cchinadmy āśliṣṭam
ava cchindhy āśliṣṭaṃ ruvā hy asi bheṣajī
divyaḥ suparṇo abravīd etad āśliṣṭabheṣajam
abhibhūr aham āgamaṃ viśvakarmā svāyudhaḥ
ahaṃ mitrasya kalpayann āsv āśāsu duṣṭaraḥ
ahaṃ samityayano ahaṃ viśāṃ purohitaḥ
ahaṃ mitrāṇi kalpayan mayi vāg astu dharṇasī
ā vaś cakṣur ā vo vācam ā vaḥ samitiṃ dade
yogakṣemaṃ va ādāyāhaṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ
brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidāno rakṣohā nudatām itaḥ
arāyo yas te tanvaṃ durṇāmā yonim āśaye
yas te 'rāyas tanvaṃ durṇāmā yonim āśaye
agniṣ ṭaṃ brahmaṇā yujā rakṣohā nudatām itaḥ
yāny abhvāni rakṣāṃsi ye 'rāyā yātudhānyaḥ
agniṣ ṭvā śagmayā tanvā rakṣohā pātu tebhyaḥ
agniś ca deva savitar iṣam ūrjaṃ dadhānau
pātaṃ mā duścaritād ā mā sucarite bhajataṃ yuvayor avasā sumnam aśīya
idaṃ tad upa yuva idaṃ tad upa hvaye yac chuśrumā tvat pari
vācaspatir ni yacchatu mayy evāstu mama śrutam
māpatyāya steyaṃ karaṃ mā śrutena vi rādhiṣi
amogham asmākaṃ śrāntam agne draviṇavat kṛdhi
madhyameṣṭhā varcasvaty āyuṣe varcase kṛtam
vanuṣva viśvadeveṣu vanuṣva tvaṃ bṛhaspatau
ghṛtena prajāṃ vanute ghṛtena rayim aśnute
ghṛtenāyuṣyaṃ varcasyaṃ devebhyo vanute pari
parjanyapippalās tubhyaṃ nadyo garbhaṃ svastaye
maryādā brahmadevīr āyuṣyaṃ varca āsican
yathā hastī hastinyāḥ padena padam anvagāt
evā tvam aghnye vatsasya padena padam anv ihi
yathā rathasya cakre vi pathaḥ pāṃsum asyathaḥ
evā mano vy asyāmi hṛdayaṃ vananāya kam
indrasya prathamaṃ vaco devānām aparaṃ vacaḥ
tṛtīyam aśvinor vacas tena gāṃ vānayāmasi
ud itaḥ śyāvau vithurau divaṃ gṛdhrāv iveyathuḥ
śocanāv abhiśocanāv asyocchocanau hṛdaḥ
śocayābhi śocayā dīpayopa dīpaya
aher agne viṣaṃ tvaṃ tṛṇam iva kalvalaṃ daha
sīdataṃ niṣattārāv avetaṃ mod gatam
kṛṣṇā vāṃ gauḥ sārasvatī
yathā rātrī kṛṣṇatamā gauḥ kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇavartaniḥ
śācīḥpyavo yathā rūpam evedaṃ māmakaṃ śiraḥ
yathāṅgāro abhiṣikto darvidāko yathāsitaḥ
anuṣyandasya kalmaṣam evedaṃ māmakaṃ śiraḥ
yathā dāvād dahyamānāt kṛṣṇo jvālo 'padhvaṃsate
naiṣādasya yathā mukham evedaṃ māmakaṃ śiraḥ
yat kiṃ cāsau manasā yac ca vācā yajñair juhoti yajuṣā havirbhiḥ
tan mṛtyunā nirṛtiḥ saṃvidānā purā diṣṭād ājyaṃ hantv asya
yātudhānā nirṛtir ād u rakṣas te asya ghnantv anṛtena satyam
indreṣitā ājyam asya mathnantu mā tat saṃ pādi yad asau juhoti
pari tvāgna ity ekā
svajjid adhirājau śyenau saṃpātināv iva
ājyaṃ pṛtanyato hataṃ yo asmān pṛtanāyati
pṛthivyai vanaspatibhya oṣadhībhyo agnaye adhipataye svāhā
antarikṣāya prāṇāya vayobhyo vāyave adhipataye svāhā
dive cakṣuṣe nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryāyādhipataye svāhā
pippalyaḥ sam avadantāyatīr jananād adhi
yaṃ jīvam aśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ
pippalī kṣiptabheṣajy utātividdhabheṣajī
tāṃ devāḥ sam akalpayann alaṃ jīvātavā iti
asurās tvā ny akhanan devās tvod avapan punaḥ
vātīkṛtasya bheṣajī pippalī kṣiptabheṣajī
yad ulūko vadati mogham etad yat kapotaḥ padam agnau kṛṇoti
yasya dūtau prahitāv idam eyathus tasmai yamāya namo 'stu mṛtyave
yas te dūto nirṛta ājagāmāprahitaḥ prahito vā gṛhaṃ naḥ
kapotolūkāv apadaṃ tad astv avairahatyam idam ā jagantha suvīratāyā idam ā sasattha
yaḥ prathamaḥ pravata āsasāda bahubhyaḥ panthām anupaspaśānaḥ
ya īśe asya dvipado yaś catuṣpadas tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave
yathāsitaḥ prathayate vaśāṁ anu vapūṃṣi kṛṇvann asurasya māyayā
evā me śepaḥ sahasāyam arka enāṅgena saṃsamakaṃ kṛṇotu
yāvadaṅgīnaṃ pārṣataṃ hāstinaṃ gārdabhaṃ ca yat
yāvad aśvasya vājinas tāvan me vardhatāṃ pasaḥ
yathā pasas tāyādaraṃ vātena sthūlabhaṃ kṛtam
yāvat parasvataḥ pasas tāvan me vardhatāṃ pasaḥ
yasyedam ā rajo yujas tuje janaṃ vanaṃ svaḥ
indrasya nādhṛṣe śavaḥ
dhṛṣāṇaṃ dhṛṣataḥ śavaḥ purā yathā yatiṣṭhan
indrasya rantyaṃ mahat
sa no dadhātu taṃ rayiṃ puruṃ piśaṅgapeśasam
indraḥ patis tuviṣṭamo janeṣv ā
āyur agna ihā vaha jātavedas tanūvaśin
yathāhaṃ jyog ihāsāni prajānām adhipā vaśī
āyur indro dadhātu ma āyur devo bṛhaspatiḥ
āyur me viśve devā ahorātre ca cakratuḥ
āyur āyuṣyā pavatāṃ prāṇaṃ prāṇo dadhātu me
devā yac cakrur devebhyaḥ svar yanto yathāyatham
ut patantu nabhasvatīḥ samudrād adhi ghoṣiṇīḥ
utsyāḥ samudriyā apas tābhiṣ ṭvā tarpayāmasi
yā āpo divyā yā vātāt pari jajñire
indro marutvāṃs tṛptātmā tābhiṣ ṭvā tarpayāmasi
yāḥ śuṣkā yā hariṇīr yā bhūmim anu vāvṛdhuḥ
sarvāḥ samagrā oṣadhīs tābhiṣ ṭvā tarpayāmasi
ā no medhā sumatir viśvarūpā giro bṛhatīr āveśayantī
ruco me bahvīr ny anaktu gā iva yathāsāma bhuvaneṣu karṇinaḥ
dīkṣā tapo manaso mātariśvā bṛhaspatir vāco asyāḥ sa yoniḥ
vedāṃsi vidyā mayi santu bahvīr agnīṣomā yaśo asmāsu dhattam
yad agne tapasā tapa upaprekṣāmahe vayam
priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsmāyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ
yas tvā mātur uta vā pituḥ pari jāyamānam abhisaṃbabhūva
taṃ tvad yakṣmam adhi nāśayāmaḥ so 'nyasmiñ chrayātai praviṣṭaḥ
yas te yakṣmo hṛdayeṣṭho nābhiṣṭhā udaraṃgamaḥ
atho yaḥ śiśriye parau taṃ tvad yakṣmam adhi nāśayāmaḥ so 'nyasmiñ chrayātai praviṣṭaḥ
śīrṣarogam aṅgarogaṃ snāvavarham abhiśāciṃ visalpakam
yas te yakṣmo majjasu paruḥsu yo gudāsu taṃ tvad yakṣmam adhi nāśayāmaḥ so 'nyasmiñ chrayātai praviṣṭaḥ
agnī rakṣohā tigmas tigmaśṛṅgo hantu rakṣo nudatām arātim
apāghaśaṃsam asyatu
ā ta etu parāvato balam ojo divas pari
ā giribhyaḥ parvatebhya āyuṣ ṭe viśvato dadhat
punas te 'suṃ pṛthivī dadātu punar dyaur devī punar antarikṣam
punas te somas tanvaṃ dadhātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ yā svastiḥ
kaṣkiṣāḥ kaṣapiṣā yevāṣā yeṣāḥ
iṣṭargava iṣayantaḥ saikatāḥ pāṃsavāḥ
adṛṣṭān na dṛṣṭān
dṛṣṭāṁ adṛṣṭān dhanapate jahīndrasya vadhena
etāś ca viśvarūpāś ca gṛdhrāḥ kokāś ca te hatāḥ
kāme kāmayasva mā pratīcī prati mā bhava
mām anu pra te mano vatsā pākeva dhāvatu
abhīle abhimādany asau mām abhi mādyatu
vidma patatriṇyā vayam iṣuke nāmakaṃ tava
ahaṃ te mana ā dade mano manomuṣir yathā
mayi te mana āhitaṃ ratha iva rathavāhane
ud asau sūryo agān mahyam avatunā saha
ahaṃ viśāṃ purohito madhuhasto madhujihvo mayi vāg astu dharṇasī
ahaṃ viśyena ketunā sam akhye mānuṣeṣv ā
asmākam astu kevalaṃ bṛhad yaśo adhi viśveṣu rājasu
svādoś cin mā svādīyāṃsaṃ madhoś cin madhumattaram
priyāc cit sakhyur antaram ādityāsaḥ kṛṇota mā
agne brahma tvaṃ brahmāsi viddhi tvaṃ prāsmabhyaṃ brūhi
yadīdaṃ tathā bhaviṣyasi yadi vā nāthaitasya haviṣo vīhi svāhā
vi pṛcche dyāvāpṛthivī vīndraṃ vi bṛhaspatim
vi devān yajñiyān pṛcche vy asuṃ jīvanāya kam
vijñānāyodyatā prasthitā srug iyaṃ yama rājan havir idaṃ juṣasva
agatāsor haviṣo mādayasva nirṛtiṃ gacchatu yad gatāsoḥ
yat tvā māṃse apavavau yan manthe yad odane
agniṣ ṭvā viśvabheṣajas tasmāt pātv aṃhasaḥ
yas tvā vāta āvāty adharād uttarād uta
āpo yā viśvaśaṃbhuvas tās tvā pāntv aṃhasaḥ
apa tvan mṛtyuṃ nirṛtim apa yakṣmaṃ ni dadhmasi
yathā tvam arapā asa udojā uttaro bhuvaḥ
vaiśvānaro raśmibhir ity ekā
prajāpatir ṛtubhiḥ pañcabhiḥ saṃvatsaro dhāmabhiḥ pātu viśvaiḥ
ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakhye no astu tam ātmani punar ā veśayāmi
vaiśvadevīṃ sūnṛtām ā rabhadhvaṃ śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
tayā gṛṇantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
vaiśvānarīṃ varcasa ā rabhadhvaṃ yasyā āśās tanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ
iḍayeha sadhamādaṃ madanto jyok paśyema sūryam uccarantam
avatkaṃ mama bheṣajam avatkaṃ parivācanam
narācy asi mā tudo vanvānā rogabheṣajam
śambhuleham ihā hara tam u kṣīra udaśviti
nadīṣu naḍvalāsu kumbheṣu kalaśeṣu ca pratīṣecanabheṣajam
tat te kṛṇomi bheṣajam addhi māṃsaṃ pibodakaṃ paṭpaṭiṅgaṃ vipaśyalaṃ vi paśya
avidāma yad aicchāma piśācakṣayaṇaṃ haviḥ
tena kravyādo hanmaḥ sarvāś ca yātudhānyaḥ
icchanti tvā padātaya icchanti rathinas tvā
krīṇanti gobhir aśvair amṛtasyeva vā asi
amamri nāma bheṣajaṃ pṛthivyā adhy udbhṛtam
vaktā tan mahyam abravīd idaṃ gha pārayād iti
cakṣur asi puruṣasya cakṣur goś cakṣur arvataḥ
cakṣur bhūtasya bhavyasya cakṣur apsarasām asi
cakṣur asi suparṇasya cakṣur aher atho śunaḥ
cakṣuḥ sarvasya paśyato atho yad viśvam ejati
ādadānaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ pratispāśanam abruvam
darśaya mā yātudhānān darśaya yātudhānyaḥ
atīmām akhyaṃ pṛthivīm ati dyām ati sūryam
ati viśvam idaṃ bhūtam aty akhyaṃ yātudhānyaḥ
aghāyūn sarvān darśayeti tvauṣadha ā rabhe
evā sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāsy āyataḥ
saho 'si yātudhānajambhanam
imāḥ pāre pṛdākvas triṣaptā nirjarāyavaḥ
tāsāṃ jarāyuṇā vayam akṣyāv api vyayāmasy aghāyoḥ paripanthinaḥ
viṣūcy etu kṛntatī pinākam iva bibhratī
viṣvak punarbhuvā mano asamṛddhā aghāyavaḥ
apetaḥ paripanthino 'po aghāyur arṣatu
na bahavaḥ saṃ śaknavan nārbhakā abhi dhṛṣṇavan
pretaṃ pādau pra sphurataṃ vahataṃ pṛṇato gṛham
indrāṇy etu prathamājītāmuṣitā pathā
āyam agan phālgumaṇir balena baladāḥ saha
yenendro dasyūnāṃ vīrāṁ asurāṇām avātirat
varcasā māṃ payasokṣantu devā varcasā dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe
varco me devaḥ savitā dadhātu varco vipraḥ kaśyapo me dadhātu
varco ma āpo dadhatu varco me vīrudho dadhan
bhūtāni sarvā saṃgatya varca ā dhur mukhe mama
yāḥ purastād vitiṣṭhante gāvaḥ pravrājinīr iva
vātīkṛtasya bheṣajīḥ pippalīḥ pārayiṣṇavaḥ
rudrasya mūtram asy amṛtasya nābhiḥ
pṛthivyāṃ mūlaṃ niṣṭhitam asi viṣāṇā nāma vātīkṛtabheṣajī
śaṃ te astu matasnābhyāṃ śaṃ yakne śaṃ talīdyai
nahi te agne tanvaḥ krūram ānaṃśa martyam
kapir babhasti tejanaṃ svaṃ jarāyu gaur iva
tveṣa iva saṃ ca vi ca roravaṇyate yad uttaradrā uparasya khādati
śīrṣṇā śiro apsasāpso ardayann aṃśūn babhasti haritebhir āśubhiḥ
suparṇā vācam akratopa dyavy ākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ
ni yan niyanty uparasya niṣkṛtiṃ purū reto dadhire sūryasyutaḥ
bhagena mā śāṃśapena sākam indreṇa medinā
kṛṇomi bhaginaṃ māpa drāntv arātayaḥ
yo andho yaḥ puraḥsaro bhago vṛkṣeṣv ārpitaḥ
bhago me astu śāṃśapo apa drāntv arātayaḥ
yathā vṛkṣāṁ abhyabhavaḥ sākam indreṇa medinā
evā mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇv apa drāntv arātayaḥ
apeto nīlalohitaṃ jātaṃ himavatas pari
kīśmīlam urvarābhyo divo jātam anīnaśam
abhrāj jātaṃ varṣāj jātam atho jātaṃ divas pari
atho samudrāj jātaṃ kīśmīlaṃ nāśayāmasi
yo nīhārād yaḥ pruṣvāyā yo adbhyas pari jāyase
garbho yo vidyutām asi sa naḥ kīśmīla mṛḍaya
nādeyīḥ sikatā imāḥ sindhutas pary ābhṛtāḥ
tābhir yamasya kīśmīlaṃ saṃbhṛtābhir anīnaśam
tvayā pūrvaṃ vibhīdaka saṃjitā asurā hatāḥ
tvaṃ sapatnacātano bhrātṛvyāṁ ava dhūnuṣva
vi bhinattu vibhīdakas tīkṣṇaśṛṅga ivarṣabhaḥ
atho sapatnān ā dattām atho hantu durasyataḥ
vy avadhīt sahamānaḥ sapatnān dviṣato me 'dharāṁ akaḥ
abhy abhūd bhūtyobhayān
ya āskandaḥ parāskanda ākhuḥ kakubha āt krimiḥ
upajīkā upakvasān tān sarvāñ jambhayāmasi
api nahyāmy ākhor muñjena mukham āsyam
anadan yathā carād apaitum urvarābhyaḥ
apinaddhamukha ākhuḥ paroktaḥ prāṭ parājataḥ
śṛṇāmy asya dantān nir akṣyau pātayāmasi
aśvinā sāragheṇa mety ekā
yaśā ahaṃ nimiṣate pratikhyātre yaśā aham
atraimi tad yaśā aham uta tatra yaśā aham
asmai ca sarvasmai bhūtāya sarvasmai ca vipaśyate
sarvasmā id ahaṃ yaśāḥ
apottaraporṇahi yadīdam asti vā na vā
vyandhyaṃ vyalgaṇaṃ cakṣur akṣībhyāṃ kṛdhi
aṅkaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ kṛtvā laṅgalāṣam armaṃ ca
tad devā apa lumpata
cakṣuṣman me mano astu cakṣuṣmad dhṛdayaṃ mama
cakṣuṣmac cittam astu me cakṣuś cakṣuṣmad astu me cakṣur ā dhehi me akṣyoḥ
somo rājā savitā ca rājā bhavo rājā bhuvanaṃ ca rājā
śarvo rājā śarma ca rājā ta u naḥ śarma yacchantu devāḥ
ādityair no bṛhaspatir bhagaḥ somena naḥ saha
viśve devā urv antarikṣaṃ ta u naḥ śarma yacchantu devāḥ
utāviddhāṃ niṣ khidatātho śrathnīthāyatām
mā no viśve devā maruto hetim asthata
apām idaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam
madhye hradasya no gṛhāḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi
āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohatu puṣpiṇī
utso vātra jāyatāṃ hrado vā puṇḍarīkavān
himasya tvā jarāyuṇā śāle pari vyayāmasi
śītahradā hi no bhuvo 'gnir dadātu bheṣajam
ayaṃ darbho vimanyukaḥ svāya cāraṇāya ca
manyor vimanyuko manyuśamano astu te
ayaṃ yo bhūrimūlaḥ samudram avagacchati
darbhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ niṣṭhitaḥ sa te astu vimanyukaḥ
vi te hanavyāṃ śaraṇiṃ vi te mukhyāṃ nayāmasi
yathāvaśo na vādiṣo mama cittam upāsāsai
yebhiḥ pāśaiḥ parivitto vibaddhaḥ parauparāv ārpito aṅgeaṅge
vi te cṛtyantāṃ vicṛto hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛṣṭā
trite devā amṛjataina etat trita enan manuṣyeṣv amṛṣṭa
tato yadi tvā madhye na ārat tad ahaṃ tvad brahmaṇāpākaromi
marīcīr dhūmaṃ pra viśānu vātam udārān gacchota vā nīhāram
nadīnāṃ phenam anu tad vi naśyatu bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛṣṭā
agne rakṣaḥ prati daha yat kumbhyābhir ābhṛtam
anādhṛṣyasya pāsyaty abhūj jīvātave 'yam
yan nakhavad yac chaphavat prasūmat kiṃ ca puṣpavat
ṛvāmatsyo madhūdakaṃ tasya pāsyaty ayam anāsrāvam arogaṇam
yāḥ samudrāt prasravanti devīr himavatas pari
āpo yā viśvaśaṃbhuvas tā ihā yantu bheṣajīḥ
tvacāpidhāne subhage datparistaraṇe kave
ekām iva vraje gāṃ pari tvā varcasāsicam
agreṇīr iva haṃsānāṃ prapaśyantī puraspatham
jihve mā vivyatho mā yathāpūrvaṃ tvaṃ vada
varcasvad aham udyāsaṃ brahmarājanyābhyāṃ śūdrāya cāryāya ca
yasmai ca kāmayāmahe sarvasmai ca vipaśyate
arvāñcau pādau pra harārvācīnaṃ manas tava
arvācīnasya te yataḥ parāṅ manyur ni vartatām
chāgalāde bhagavo 'rvāg jyote parastamaḥ
ā tvā khalajñakād asmāt punar ā vartayāmasi
yathā vrīhīn vrīhikhale samākurvanti tūlibhiḥ
evā te viṣṭhitaṃ manaḥ samākaromi mām abhi
tvam uttamaṃ surabhiṣāṃ mādhyamaṃ vahator asi
tvayā vadhūr vi jaṅgahe taṃ tvā varcasa ā dade
mūrdhnas te mūrdhanyebhyo agruvāḥ pativatyāḥ
aukṣaṃ śīrṣata ā dade
yaś ca svādmā te aṅgeṣu yaḥ premā hṛdaye ca te
taṃ tvad ā veśayāmahe mayi bhrājāti dīdyat
vātaraṃhā vājin bhava yujyamāna indrasya yāhi prasave manojavāḥ
yuñjantu tvā maruto daivyāsa ā te tvaṣṭā patsu javaṃ dadhātu
javas te arvan nihito guhā yaḥ śyene carati yaś ca vāte
tena tvaṃ vājin balavān balenājiṃ jaya samane pārayiṣṇuḥ
āśīyān edhi manasa āśīyān edhi cakṣuṣaḥ
āśīyān aśva vātād bhūtvājiṃ jaya samane pārayiṣṇuḥ
tanūs te vājin tanvaṃ vahantī vāmam asmabhyaṃ dhātu śarma tubhyam
ahruto maho dharuṇāya devā divyam iva jyotiḥ svar ā mimīyāḥ
indro mā vakṣad akṣataṃ vṛtrahā yo vṛtaṃjayaḥ
sa me rathaṃ sa sārathiṃ so aśvān sādhu me nayāt
indro mā tena nayatu panthā yo abhayaḥ sugaḥ
dakṣiṇā pārayāti mā mā riṣaṃ samare yudhām
hṛtsuke pari ṇo nama pārigaṃ tanve kṛdhi
yuyuta parṇinaṃ śaram utāparṇaṃ riśāditi
viśve devā idaṃ havir ādityāsaḥ saparyata
asmin yajñe mā vyathiṣy amṛtāya haviṣ kṛtam
avyasaś ca vyacasaś ca bilaṃ vi ṣyāmi māyayā
tābhyām udbhṛtya vedam atha karmāṇi kṛṇmahe
yasmāt kośād udabharāma vedaṃ tasminn antar ava dadhma enam
kṛtam iṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo vīryeṇa tena mā devās tapasāvateha
vaiśvānaro ajījanad agnir no navyāṃ sumatim
kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā
sa naḥ pāvaka dīdihy agne vaiśvānara dyumat
jamadagnibhir āhutaḥ
diva spṛṣṭo arocatāgnir vaiśvānaro bṛhan
jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ
hariṇasya patatriṇaḥ śīrṣṇo bheṣajam ābhṛtam
tan nīlavad vilokavat tad u kṣetriyanāśanam
anv amaṃstānumatir anv amaṃsta vṛṣāyavaḥ
kīnāśā anv amaṃsatānu gāvo amaṃsata
namo astv āyāmibhyo nīvibhyo hṛdayāya ca
namaḥ kṣetrasya pataye namaḥ kṣetrasya patnyai
ut te hārdiṃ śocayāmi hastenābhimarīmṛśat
keśin vṛṣaṇyayā tava muṣkau mūrdhā ca śuṣyatām
agniṣ ṭvā tapatu sūryas tvā tapatu vātas tvā yuṅktāṃ marutaś ca yuñjatām
mṛgān marīcīr apy etu te manaḥ
ut tvā hanmi nipadanād ut tvā hanmi gṛhebhyaḥ
mā spṛkṣathā niṣadanāya sādhava ut tiṣṭha prehi sabhām
ut tuda śimidāvaty atho ulkāvatīṃ kuru
patye ca śvaśurāya ca
vivarhaṃ harāṃsayor asaṃjñānam atibhṛvo
sākam ṛṣe vi nāśaya
sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
sākaṃ sūryeṇodyatā sapatnīṃ nāśayāmasi
dīrghajihvā bṛhadvāco yābhir ārdrāṇi vāsāṃsi
gāvo ghṛtasya mātaro divi bheṣajam akrata
arjunīnām apacitāṃ kṛṣṇā māteti śuśrava
muner devasya mūlena sarvāś chinadmi tā aham
chinadmy āsāṃ prathamāṃ chinadmy uta madhyamām
atho jaghanyām āsām ā cchinadmi stukām iva
apehi manasas pate kim aśastāni śaṃsasi
parehi na tvā kāmaye vṛkṣān vanāni saṃ cara
avaśasā niḥśasā yat parāśasopārima yaj jāgrato yat svapantaḥ
agnir viśvāny apa duṣkṛtāny ajuṣṭāny āre asmad dadhātu
yad indra brahmaṇaspata uta mṛṣā carāmasi
pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatas pātu tebhyaḥ
ehi mām uttaraṃ kṛdhi sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ
vy asmat kṛtyā vy asmac chapathāṁ aja
yo no dudhūrṣān manasā yaś ca pāpena no 'bhyamāt
ākūtiṃ tasya devā hṛdaś cittāni vi ṣyata
aśva iva dhuri duryogaḥ pratīhāyavahe daśa
kṛtvānaṃ brahmaṇaspate daṃṣṭrābhyām abhi saṃ jahi
yonyā adhi prājāyathā mūrdhno 'dhy ud avardhathāḥ
bahur ayaṃ saṃgaruṣṭo niyukto bhūmyām adhi
tenāham asya kartsyāmi yathā sthāma gamiṣyati
sthāmāgan bṛhad akṣatra sthāman tākṣṇo 'va syati
antaṣṭhyasya yo rājā sa ut thāma gamiṣyati
agamad rājā sadanam agamat sūryo divam
udayan vṛtrahan plīhā aṅgarājo avīrahā
yathā panthāṃ kavāpatho apyeti mahāpatham
evā tvaṃ plīhan na plīhi yato 'sy abhyāgataḥ
indreṇa dattaṃ balam āsurābhyāṃ śitaṅgaitac chālvatāyai ca tubhyam
tau nudethāṃ kaṇvā aśivā ajuṣṭā adhā gṛhāṇāṃ gṛhapā stam eṣām
tvam agne gṛhapatir gṛhāṇāṃ tvaṃ prajānāṃ janitāsi dātā
tvaṃ nudasva kaṇvā aśivā ajuṣṭāḥ sadānvā nir itaḥ sedha pāpīḥ
carmābhyaḥ krūram ānahya hariṇasya bhiyaṃ kṛdhi
mṛgāṁ anu pra pātaya marīcīr anu nāśaya
yady asy apsarāvīr yadi tvā rakṣo agrabhīt
tasmā apaplavaṃ havir manasā juhomi te
abhi tvā śatapāśayātho sahasrapāśayā
dāśo matsyam iva tīdena mayi badhnāmi te manaḥ
ā hi te dakṣiṇaṃ padaṃ hṛdayyaṃ dade
upasthe padam opi ni tvām akri sve vaśe
pari tvā gām ivāsaraṃ mama patto nipattave
tan mārutaṃ ha vairudham āvataṃkaraṇaṃ kṛtam
ā nayāmi te mano aśvam ivāśvābhidhānyā
upa te muñce manaḥ pador upānahau yathā
yathā surety ekā
evā kṛṇuṣva mā priyām antaḥ kṛṇuṣva mā hṛdi
yathā man nāpacetayā nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāś cana
yasyedaṃ vaiṣṭapaṃ havir bhagasya hastayor hitam
tenā tvābhi mṛśāmasi saubhāgyāya svastaye
bhaga memāṃ chambaṭ karo mā paścān mā puro daghaḥ
adhā bhagasya yo bhagas tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjā bhaga
bhagena tvā saṃ sṛjāmi māsareṇa surām iva
yathāsasi priyā patyur devṛbhyaḥ subhagāsasi
ud ito daivyaṃ vaca iṣum iva tūṇyaḥ khide
tenā sapatnān māmakān sāsahāni jahāni ca
agnir mā pātu vasubhiḥ purastāt savitādityair abhi pātu dakṣiṇāt
indro marudbhir abhi pātu paścād viśve devā abhi rakṣantu mottarāt
devarakṣasān mā pāhi manuṣyarakṣasān mā pāhi
viśvasmān mā rakṣasas pāhi
asau yas trikakud giriḥ śṛṅgābhyām abhitiṣṭhati
sa saṃpatatram udyugaṃ balāsam ava tiṣṭhatu
divyaḥ suparṇa āpatad ayodaṃṣṭro ayomukhaḥ
sa saṃpatatram udyugam ito yakṣmaṃ parābharat
sākaṃ balāsa pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvyā
sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā saha naśya nihākayā
mābhi gāyaḥ śābaleyaṃ śauṇeyaṃ sādhuvāhinam
namas te bhadrayā kṛṇmo vihrutā cakṣuṣā tvaṃ śamakā śamayāti tvā
tṛndhi vi kṣiṇīhi peśaḥ kurvāṇikā tvam
jāreṇa patyā jakṣatī gṛhān gopāyamānikā śamakā śamayāti tvā
āṅkṣvābhy aṅkṣvābhyaktā samanaṃ gamaḥ
atho pitṛbhyo gā iccha vijñānena bhagena ca śamakā śamayāti tvā
apehi manasas pāpāpa krāma parastaram
paro nirṛtyā ā cakṣva bahutrā jīvato manaḥ
bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam
bhadraṃ vaivasvataṃ cakṣur bahutrā jīvato manaḥ
yan me cchidraṃ manaso yac ca vācaḥ sarasvatīṃ manyucittaṃ jagāma
viśvais tad devaiḥ saha saṃvidānaḥ saṃ dadhātu bṛhaspatiḥ
sphirā sphirataraṃ sphirā āttāraḥ
ihaivā kira saṃ kirehaiva sphātim asphiram
sphireyam astv oṣadhiḥ samudrasyeva saṃsravaḥ
vṛṣṭe śāpaṃ nadīr iveha sphātiṃ samāvahān
vi mayūkhā ā yacchantu gardabhā iva duryujaḥ
muhyantu sarve tantavo vṛtā nāḍī vitantike
pra vām īṣve patatāṃ pra taṭā pra niveṣṭanam
muhyantu sarve tantavo andhe vitatavāyyau
āyavanī niveṣṭanaṃ vratā tasaram īṣve
mayārakārī prathamorṇavābhir atho śakā
devānāṃ patnīḥ kṛttikā imaṃ tantum amūmuhan
agnir na etu prathamaḥ puraetā bṛhaspatiḥ
adhā bhaga pra ṇo yaccha tvaṃ hi dhanadā asi
pra ṇaḥ śūdra utāryaḥ pra ṇo rājota vṛtrahā
atho yat sarvam ātmanvat pra ṇo yacchatu dakṣiṇām
kavir yajñasya vi tanoṣi panthām ṛtasya pṛṣṭhe adhi dīdhyānaḥ
yena havyaṃ vahasi deva dūta itaḥ pracetā amuto vanīyān
madhuhasto madhujihvo madhuvarṇo madhuvrataḥ
atho madhupraśāsano bhago mā varcasāvatu
ye triṣaptāḥ pariyanti viśvā rūpāṇi bibhrataḥ vācaspatiḥ balā teṣām tanvaḥ adya dadhātu me
punar ehi vācaspate devena manasā saha
vasoḥ pate ni ramaya
mayi eva astu mayi śrutam
iha eva abhi vi tanu ubhe ārtnī iva jyayā
vācaspatiḥ ni yacchatu
astu
upahūtaḥ vācaspatiḥ
upa asmān vācaspatiḥ hvayatām
sam śrutena gamemahi
mā śrutena vi rādhiṣi
vidma śarasya pitaram parjanyam bhūri dhāyasam
vidma u su asya mātaram pṛthivīm bhūri varpasam
jyāke pari naḥ nama
aśmānam tanvam kṛdhi
vīḍuḥ varīyaḥ arātīḥ apa dveṣāṃsi ā kṛdhi
vṛkṣam yat gāvaḥ pariṣasvajānāḥ anusphuram śaram arcanti ṛbhum śarum asmat yāvaya didyum indra
yathā dyām ca pṛthivīm ca antar tiṣṭhati tejanam evā rogam ca āsrāvam ca antar tiṣṭhatu muñjaḥ id
vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ parjanyaṃ śatavṛṣṇyaṃ
vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ mitraṃ śatavṛṣṇyaṃ
vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ śatavṛṣṇyaṃ
vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ candraṃ śatavṛṣṇyaṃ
vidmā śarasya pitaraṃ sūryaṃ śatavṛṣṇyaṃ
yad āntreṣu gavīnyor yad vastāv adhi saṃśritam
ambayaḥ yanti adhvabhiḥ jāmayaḥ adhvarīyatām pṛñcatīḥ madhunā payaḥ
amūḥ yāḥ upa sūrye yābhiḥ vā sūryaḥ saha tāḥ naḥ hinvantu adhvaram
apaḥ devīḥ upa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ
sindhubhyaḥ kartvam haviḥ
apsu antar amṛtam
apsu bheṣajam
apām uta praśastibhiḥ aśvāḥ bhavatha vājinaḥ gāvaḥ bhavatha vājinīḥ
āpaḥ hi ṣṭhā mayaḥ bhuvaḥ
tāḥ naḥ ūrje dadhātana mahe raṇāya cakṣase
yaḥ vaḥ śivatamaḥ rasaḥ tasya bhājayata iha naḥ uśatīḥ iva mātaraḥ
tasmai aram gamāma vaḥ yasya kṣayāya jinvatha āpaḥ janayatha ca naḥ
śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye
śaṃ yor abhi sravantu naḥ
apsu me somo abravīd antar viśvāni bheṣajā
agniṃ ca viśvaśaṃbhuvam
āpaḥ pṛṇīta bheṣajaṃ varūthaṃ tanve mama
jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe
śaṃ na āpo dhanvanyāḥ śam u santv anūpyāḥ
śaṃ naḥ khanitrimā āpaḥ śam u yāḥ kumbha ābhṛtāḥ
śivā naḥ santu vārṣikīḥ
stuvānam agna ā vaha yātudhānaṃ kimīdinam
tvaṃ hi deva vandito hantā dasyor babhūvitha
vi lapantu yātudhānā attriṇo ye kimīdinaḥ
agniḥ pūrva ā rabhatāṃ prendro nudatu bāhumān
paśyāma te vīryaṃ jātavedaḥ pra ṇo brūhi yātudhānān nṛcakṣaḥ
tvayā sarve paritaptāḥ purastāt ta ā yantu prabruvāṇā upedam
ā rabhasva jātavedo 'smākārthāya jajñiṣe
dūto no agne bhūtvā yātudhānān vi lāpaya
tvam agne yātudhānān upabaddhāṁ ihā vaha
idam haviḥ yātudhānān nadī phenam iva ā vahat
yaḥ idam strī pumān akaḥ iha sa stuvatām janaḥ
ayam stuvānaḥ āgamat
imam sma prati haryata
bṛhaspate vaśe labdhvā agnīṣomāḥ vi vidhyatam
yātudhānasya somapa jahi prajām nayasva ca
ni stuvānasya pātaya param akṣi uta avaram
yatra eṣām agne janimāni vettha guhā satām attriṇām jātavedaḥ tān tvam brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānaḥ jahi eṣām śatatarham agne
asmin vasu vasavaḥ dhārayantu indraḥ pūṣā varuṇaḥ mitraḥ agniḥ
imam ādityāḥ uta viśve ca devāḥ uttarasmin jyotiṣi dhārayantu
asya devāḥ pradiśi jyotiḥ astu sūryaḥ agniḥ uta vā hiraṇyam
sapatnāḥ asmat adhare bhavantu
uttamam nākam adhi rohaya imam
yena indrāya samabharaḥ payāṃsi uttamena brahmaṇā jātavedaḥ tena tvam agne iha vardhaya imam
sajātānām śraiṣṭhye ā dhehi enam
ā eṣām yajñam uta varcaḥ dade aham rāyaḥ poṣam uta cittāni agne
ayam devānām asuraḥ vi rājati
vaśāḥ hi satyāḥ varuṇasya rājñaḥ
tatas pari brahmaṇā śāśadānaḥ ugrasya manyoḥ ud imam nayāmi
namas te rājan varuṇāstu manyave viśvaṃ hy ugra nicikeṣi drugdham
sahasram anyān pra suvāmi sākaṃ śataṃ jīvāti śaradas tavāyam
yad uvakthānṛtam jihvayā vṛjinaṃ bahu
muñcāmi tvā vaiśvānarād arṇavān mahatas pari
sajātān ugrehā vada brahma cāpa cikīhi naḥ
vaṣaṭ te pūṣann asmint sūtāv aryamā hotā kṛṇotu vedhāḥ
catasro divaḥ pradiśaś catasro bhūmyā uta
devā garbhaṃ sam airayan taṃ vy ūrṇuvantu sūtave
sūṣā vy ūrṇotu vi yoniṃ hāpayāmasi
neva māṃse na pīvasi neva majjasv āhatam
avaitu pṛśni śevalaṃ śune jarāyv attave 'va jarāyu padyatām
vi te bhinadmi mehanaṃ vi yoniṃ vi gavīnike
vi mātaraṃ ca putraṃ ca vi kumāraṃ jarāyuṇāva jarāyu padyatām
yathā vāto yathā mano yathā patanti pakṣiṇaḥ
evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sākaṃ jarāyuṇā patāva jarāyu padyatām
jarāyu jaḥ prathamaḥ usriyaḥ vṛṣā vāta abhra jāḥ stanayan eti vṛṣṭyā
sa naḥ mṛḍāti tanve ṛju gaḥ rujan yaḥ ekam ojaḥ tredhā vicakrame
aṅge aṅge śociṣā śiśriyāṇam namasyantaḥ tvā haviṣā vidhema
aṅkān samaṅkān haviṣā vidhema yaḥ agrabhīt parva asya grabhītā
muñca śīrṣaktyāḥ uta kāsaḥ enam paruḥ paruḥ āviveśa yaḥ asya
yaḥ abhra jāḥ vāta jāḥ yaḥ ca śuṣmaḥ vanaspatīn sacatām parvatān ca
śam me parasmai gātrāya śam astu avarāya me
śam me caturbhyaḥ aṅgebhyaḥ śam astu tanve mama
namaḥ te astu vidyute namaḥ te stanayitnave
namaḥ te astu aśmane yena ā dūḍāśe asyasi
namaḥ te pravataḥ napāt yatas tapaḥ samūhasi
mṛḍayā naḥ tanūbhyaḥ
mayaḥ tokebhyaḥ kṛdhi
pravataḥ napāt namaḥ eva astu tubhyam
namaḥ te hetaye tapuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ
vidma te dhāma paramam guhā yat
samudre antar nihitā asi nābhiḥ
yām tvā devāḥ asṛjanta viśve iṣum kṛṇvānāḥ asanāya dhṛṣṇum sā naḥ mṛḍa vidathe gṛṇānā
tasyai te namaḥ astu devi
bhagam asyāḥ varcaḥ ādiṣi adhi vṛkṣāt iva srajam
mahā budhnaḥ iva parvataḥ jyok pitṛṣu āstām
eṣā te rājan kanyā vadhūḥ ni dhūyatām yama
sā mātuḥ badhyatām gṛhe atha u bhrātuḥ atha u pituḥ
eṣā te kula pāḥ rājan
tām u te pari dadmasi
jyok pitṛṣu āsātai ā śīrṣṇaḥ śamopyāt
asitasya te brahmaṇā kaśyapasya gayasya ca antar kośam iva jāmayaḥ api nahyāmi te bhagam
saṃ saṃ sravantu sindhavaḥ saṃ vātāḥ saṃ patatriṇaḥ
imaṃ yajñaṃ pradivo me juṣantāṃ saṃsrāvyeṇa haviṣā juhomi
ihaiva havam ā yāta ma iha saṃsrāvaṇā utemaṃ vardhayatā giraḥ
ihaitu sarvo yaḥ paśur asmin tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ
ye nadīnāṃ saṃsravanty utsāsaḥ sadam akṣitāḥ
ye sarpiṣaḥ saṃsravanti kṣīrasya codakasya ca
ye amāvāsyām rātrim udasthuḥ vrājam attriṇaḥ agniḥ turīyaḥ yātu hā saḥ asmabhyam adhi bravat
sīsāya adhi āha varuṇaḥ
sīsāya agniḥ upāvati
sīsam me indraḥ prāyacchat
tat aṅga yātu cātanam
idam viṣkandham sahate
idam bādhate attriṇaḥ
anena viśvā sasahe yā jātāni piśācyāḥ
yadi naḥ gām haṃsi yadi aśvam yadi pūruṣam tam tvā sīsena vidhyāmaḥ yathā naḥ asaḥ a vīra hā
amūḥ yāḥ yanti yoṣitaḥ hirāḥ lohita vāsasaḥ a bhrātaraḥ iva jāmayaḥ tiṣṭhantu hata varcasaḥ
tiṣṭha avare
tiṣṭha pare
uta tvam tiṣṭha madhyame
kaniṣṭhikā ca tiṣṭhati
tiṣṭhāt id dhamaniḥ mahī
śatasya dhamanīnām sahasrasya hirāṇām asthuḥ id madhyamāḥ imāḥ
sākam antāḥ araṃsata
pari vaḥ sikatāvatī dhanūḥ bṛhatī akramīt
tiṣṭhata ilayata su kam
nir lakṣmyaṃ lalāmyaṃ nir arātiṃ suvāmasi
atha yā bhadrā tāni naḥ prajāyā arātiṃ nayāmasi
nir araṇiṃ savitā sāviṣak pador nir hastayor varuṇo mitro aryamā
nir asmabhyam anumatī rarāṇā premāṃ devā asāviṣuḥ saubhagāya
yat ta ātmani tanvāṃ ghoram asti yad vā keśeṣu praticakṣaṇe vā
sarvaṃ tad vācāpa hanmo vayaṃ devas tvā savitā sūdayatu
riśyapadīṃ vṛṣadatīṃ goṣedhāṃ vidhamām uta
vilīḍhyaṃ lalāmyaṃ tā asman nāśayāmasi
mā naḥ vidan vivyādhinaḥ
mā u abhivyādhinaḥ vidan
ārāt śaravyāḥ asmat viṣūcīḥ indra pātaya
viṣvañcaḥ asmat śaravaḥ patantu ye astāḥ ye ca asyāḥ
daivīḥ manuṣya iṣavaḥ mama amitrān vi vidhyata
yaḥ naḥ svaḥ yaḥ araṇaḥ sajātaḥ uta niṣṭyaḥ yaḥ asmāṁ abhidāsati rudraḥ śaravyayā etān mama amitrān vi vidhyatu
yaḥ sapatnaḥ yaḥ a sapatnaḥ yaḥ ca dviṣan śapāti naḥ devāḥ tam sarve dhūrvantu
brahma varma mama antaram
a dāra sṛt bhavatu deva soma
asmin yajñe marutaḥ mṛḍata naḥ
mā naḥ vidat abhibhā mā u aśastiḥ
mā naḥ vidat vṛjinā dveṣyā yā
yuvam tam mitrāvaruṇau asmat yāvayatam pari
itas ca yat amutas ca yat vadham varuṇa yāvaya
vi mahat śarma yaccha
varīyaḥ yāvaya vadham
śāsaḥ itthā mahāṁ asi amitra sāhaḥ astṛtaḥ na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīyate kadācana
svastidā viśāṃ patir vṛtrahā vimṛdho vaśī
vṛṣendraḥ pura etu naḥ somapā abhayaṃkaraḥ
vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ
adhamaṃ gamayā tamo yo asmāṁ abhidāsati
vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja
vi manyum indra vṛtrahann amitrasyābhidāsataḥ
apendra dviṣato mano 'pa jijyāsato vadham
vi mahaccharma yaccha varīyo yāvayā vadham
anu sūryam ud ayatām hṛddyotaḥ harimā ca te
goḥ rohitasya varṇena tena tvā paridadhmasi
pari tvā rohitaiḥ varṇaiḥ dīrgha āyu tvāya dadhmasi yathā ayam arapāḥ asat atha u a haritaḥ bhuvat
yāḥ rohiṇīḥ devatyāḥ gāvaḥ yāḥ uta rohiṇīḥ rūpam rūpam vayaḥ vayaḥ tābhiḥ tvā paridadhmasi
śukeṣu te harimāṇam ropaṇākāsu dadhmasi
atha u hāridraveṣu te harimāṇam nidadhmasi
naktaṃjātā asi oṣadhe rāme kṛṣṇe asikni ca
idam rajani rajaya kilāsam palitam ca yat
kilāsam ca palitam ca niḥ itas nāśaya pṛṣat
ā tvā svaḥ viśatām varṇaḥ
parā śuklāni pātaya
asitam te pralayanam
āsthānam asitam tava
asiknī asi oṣadhe
niḥ itas nāśaya pṛṣat
asthi jasya kilāsasya tanū jasya ca yat tvaci dūṣyā kṛtasya brahmaṇā lakṣma śvetam anīnaśam
suparṇaḥ jātaḥ prathamaḥ
tasya tvam pittam āsitha
tat āsurī yudhā jitā rūpam cakre vanaspatīn
āsurī cakre prathamā idam kilāsa bheṣajam idam kilāsa nāśanam
anīnaśat kilāsam
sarūpām akarat tvacam
sarūpā nāma te mātā
sarūpaḥ nāma te pitā
sarūpa kṛt tvam oṣadhe
sā sarūpam idam kṛdhi
śyāmā sarūpaṃkaraṇī pṛthivyāḥ adhi udbhṛtā
idam u su pra sādhaya
punar rūpāṇi kalpaya
yat agniḥ āpaḥ adahat praviśya yatra akṛṇvan dharma dhṛtaḥ namāṃsi tatra te āhuḥ paramam janitram
sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅgdhi takman
yadi arciḥ yadi vā asi śociḥ śakali eṣi yadi vā te janitram hrūḍuḥ nāma asi haritasya deva
yadi śokaḥ yadi vā abhiśokaḥ yadi vā rājñaḥ varuṇasya asi putraḥ hrūḍuḥ nāma asi haritasya deva
namaḥ śītāya takmane namaḥ rūrāya śociṣe kṛṇomi
yaḥ anyedyus ubhayadyus abhyeti tṛtīyakāya namaḥ astu takmane
āre 'sāv asmad astu hetir devāso asat
āre aśmā yam asyatha
sakhāsāv asmabhyam astu rātiḥ sakhendro bhagaḥ
savitā citrarādhāḥ
yūyam naḥ pravato napān marutaḥ sūryatvacasaḥ
śarma yacchatha saprathāḥ
suṣūdata mṛḍata mṛḍayā nas tanūbhyo
mayas tokebhyas kṛdhi
amūḥ pāre pṛdākvas triṣaptā nirjarāyavaḥ
tāsām jarāyubhir vayam akṣyāv api vyayāmasy aghāyoḥ paripanthinaḥ
viṣvak punarbhuvā mano 'samṛddhā aghāyavaḥ
na bahavaḥ sam aśakan nārbhakā abhi dādhṛṣuḥ
veṇor adgā ivābhito 'samṛddhā aghāyavaḥ
pretaṃ pādau pra sphurataṃ vahataṃ pṛṇato gṛhān
indrāny etu prathamājītāmuṣitā puraḥ
upa prāgād devo agnī rakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ
dahann apa dvayāvino yātudhānān kimīdinaḥ
prati daha yātudhānān prati deva kimīdinaḥ
pratīcīḥ kṛṣṇavartane saṃ daha yātudhānyaḥ
yā śaśāpa śapanena yāghaṃ mūram ādadhe
yā rasasya haraṇāya jātam ārebhe tokam attu sā
putram attu yātudhānīḥ svasāram uta naptyam
adhā mitho vikeśyo vi ghnatāṃ yātudhānyo vi tṛhyantām arāyyaḥ
abhīvartena maṇinā yena indraḥ abhivavṛdhe tena asmān brahmaṇaspate abhi rāṣṭrāya vardhaya
abhivṛtya sapatnān abhi yāḥ naḥ arātayaḥ abhi pṛtanyantam tiṣṭha abhi yaḥ naḥ durasyati
abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi ṣomo avīvṛdhat
abhīvarto abhibhavaḥ sapatnakṣayaṇo maṇiḥ
rāṣṭrāya mahyaṃ badhyatāṃ sapatnebhyaḥ parābhuve
ud asau sūryo agād ud idaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ
yathāhaṃ śatruho 'sāny asapatnaḥ sapatnahā
viśve devāḥ vasavaḥ rakṣata imam
uta ādityāḥ jāgṛta yūyam asmin
mā imam sanābhiḥ uta vā anya nābhiḥ mā imam prāpat pauruṣeyaḥ vadhaḥ yaḥ
ye vaḥ devāḥ pitaraḥ ye ca putrāḥ sacetasaḥ me śṛṇutā idam uktam
sarvebhyaḥ vaḥ pari dadāmi etam
svasti enam jarase vahātha
ye devāḥ divi ṣṭha ye pṛthivyām ye antarikṣe oṣadhīṣu paśuṣu apsu antar te kṛṇuta jarasam āyuḥ asmai
śatam anyān pari vṛṇaktu mṛtyūn
yeṣām prayājāḥ uta vā anuyājāḥ huta bhāgāḥ a huta adaḥ ca devāḥ yeṣām vaḥ pañca pradiśaḥ vibhaktāḥ tān vaḥ asmai satra sadaḥ kṛṇomi
te no nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo muñcatāṃhaso aṃhasaḥ
asrāmas tvā haviṣā yajāmy aśloṇas tvā ghṛtena juhomi
svasti mātra uta pitre no astu svasti gobhyo jagate puruṣebhyaḥ
viśvam subhūtam suvidatraṃ no astu jyog eva dṛśema sūryam
idam janāsaḥ vidatha
mahat brahma vadiṣyati
na tat pṛthivyām na u divi yena prāṇanti vīrudhaḥ
antarikṣe āsām sthāma śrānta sadām iva
āsthānam asya bhūtasya viduḥ tat vedhasaḥ na vā
yat rodasī rejamāne bhūmiḥ ca niratakṣatam ārdram tat adya sarvadā samudrasya iva srotyāḥ
tat anyasyām adhi śritam
dive ca viśva vedase pṛthivyai ca akaram namaḥ
hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ savitā yāsv agniḥ
yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyan janānām
iyam vīrudh madhu jātā
madhunā tvā khanāmasi
madhoḥ adhi prajātā asi
sā naḥ madhumataḥ kṛdhi
jihvāyāḥ agre madhu me
jihvā mūle madhūlakam
mama id aha kratau asaḥ
mama cittam upāyasi
madhumat me nikramaṇam
madhumat me parāyaṇam
vācā vadāmi madhumat
bhūyāsam madhu saṃdṛśaḥ
madhoḥ asmi madhutaraḥ madughāt madhumattaraḥ
mām id kila tvam vanāḥ śākhām madhumatīm iva
pari tvā paritatnunā ikṣuṇā agām a vidviṣe yathā mām kāminī asaḥ yathā mat na apagā asaḥ
tat te badhnāmy āyuṣe varcase balāya dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
nainaṃ rakṣāṃsi na piśācāḥ sahante devānām ojaḥ prathamajam hy etat
apāṃ tejo jyotir ojo balaṃ ca vanaspatīnām uta vīryāṇi
indra ivendriyāṇy adhi dhārayāmo asmin tad dakṣamāṇo bibharaddhiraṇyam
samānāṃ māsām ṛtubhiṣ ṭvā vayaṃ saṃvatsarasya payasā piparmi
indrāgnī viśve devās te 'nu manyantām ahṛṇīyamānāḥ
venas tat paśyat paramaṃ guhā yad yatra viśvaṃ bhavaty ekarūpam
idaṃ pṛśnir aduhaj jāyamānāḥ svarvido abhy anūṣata vrāḥ
pra tad voced amṛtasya vidvān gandharvo dhāma paramaṃ guhā yat
trīṇi padāni nihitā guhāsya yas tāni veda sa pituṣ pitāsat
sa naḥ pitā janitā sa uta bandhur dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā
yo devānāṃ nāmadha eka eva taṃ saṃpraśnaṃ bhuvanā yanti sarvā
pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya āyam upātiṣṭhe prathamajām ṛtasya
vācam iva vaktari bhuvaneṣṭhā dhāsyur eṣa nanv eṣo agniḥ
pari viśvā bhuvanāny āyam ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ dṛśe kam
yatra devā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ samāne yonāv adhy airayanta
divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya yas patir eka eva namasyo vikṣv īḍyaḥ
taṃ tvā yaumi brahmaṇā divya deva namas te astu divi te sadhastham
divi spṛṣṭo yajataḥ sūryatvag avayātā haraso daivyasya
mṛḍāt gandharvo bhuvanasya yas patir eka eva namasyaḥ suśevāḥ
anavadyābhiḥ sam u jagma ābhir apsarāsv api gandharva āsīt
yāḥ klandās tamiṣīcayo 'kṣakāmā manomuhaḥ
tābhyo gandharvapatnībhyo 'psarābhyo 'karam namaḥ
adaḥ yat avadhāvati avatkam adhi parvatāt tat te kṛṇomi bheṣajam su bheṣajam yathā asasi
āt aṅga kuvid aṅga śatam yā bheṣajāni te teṣām asi tvam uttamam an āsrāvam arogaṇam
nīcais khananti asurāḥ arusrāṇam idam mahat
tat āsrāvasya bheṣajam
tat u rogam anīnaśat
upajīkāḥ ud bharanti samudrāt adhi bheṣajam
tat u rogam aśīśamat
arusrāṇam idam mahat pṛthivyāḥ adhi udbhṛtam
śam naḥ bhavantu apaḥ oṣadhayaḥ śivāḥ
indrasya vajraḥ apa hantu rakṣasaḥ
ārāt visṛṣṭāḥ iṣavaḥ patantu rakṣasām
dīrgha āyu tvāya bṛhate raṇāya a riṣyantaḥ dakṣamāṇāḥ sadā eva maṇim viṣkandha dūṣaṇam jaṅgiḍam bibhṛmaḥ vayam
jaṅgiḍaḥ jambhāt viśarāt viṣkandhāt abhiśocanāt maṇiḥ sahasra vīryaḥ pari naḥ pātu viśvatas
ayam viṣkandham sahate
ayam bādhate attriṇaḥ
ayam naḥ viśva bheṣajaḥ jaṅgiḍaḥ pātu aṃhasaḥ
devaiḥ dattena maṇinā jaṅgiḍena mayobhuvā viṣkandham sarvā rakṣāṃsi vyāyāme sahāmahe
śaṇaḥ ca mā jaṅgiḍaḥ ca viṣkandhāt abhi rakṣatām
araṇyāt anyaḥ ābhṛtaḥ kṛṣyāḥ anyaḥ rasebhyaḥ
kṛtyā dūṣiḥ ayam maṇiḥ atha u arāti dūṣiḥ
atha u sahasvān jaṅgiḍaḥ pra naḥ āyūṃṣi tāriṣat
indra juṣasva pra vahā yāhi śūra haribhyām
pibā sutasya mater iha madhoś cakānaś cārur madāya
indra jaṭharaṃ navyo na pṛṇasva madhor divo na
asya sutasya svar ṇopa tvā madāḥ suvāco aguḥ
indras turāṣāṇ mitro vṛtraṃ yo jaghāna yatīr na
bibheda valaṃ bhṛgur na sasahe śatrūn made somasya

śrudhī havaṃ giro me juṣasvendra svayugbhir matsveha mahe raṇāya
indrasya nu pra vocaṃ vīryāṇi yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī
ahann ahim anu apas tatarda pra vakṣaṇā abhinat parvatānām
vṛṣāyamāṇo avṛṇīta somaṃ trikadrukeṣu apibat sutasya
samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsarā ṛṣayo yāni satyā

sapatnahāgne abhimātijid bhava sve gaye jāgṛhy aprayucchan

aghadviṣṭā devajātā vīrucchapathayopanī

yaḥ suhārd tena naḥ saha saha

babhror arjunakāṇḍasya yavasya te palālyā tilasya tilapiñjyā

namaḥ sanisrasākṣebhyo namaḥ saṃdeśyebhyaḥ

atha u enam vanaspate jīvānām lokam ud naya
āgāt ud agāt ayam

abhūt u putrāṇām pitā nṛṇām ca bhagavattamaḥ
adhītīḥ adhi agāt ayam
adhi jīva purā agan

devāḥ te cītim avidan brahmāṇaḥ uta vīrudhaḥ
cītim te viśve devāḥ avidan bhūmyām adhi
yaḥ cakāra sa niḥ karat
saḥ eva su bhiṣaktamaḥ

evāhaṃ tvāṃ kṣetriyān nirṛtyā jāmiśaṃsād druho muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśāt
