sukhaṃ sūrya ratham aṃśumantaṃ syonaṃ suvahnim adhitiṣṭha vājinam
sapta sūryo harito yātave rathe hiraṇyatvacaso bṛhatīr ayukta
amoci śukro rajasaḥ parastād vidhūya devas tamo divam āruhat
ut ketunā bṛhatā deva āgann apāvṛk tamo 'bhi jyotir aśrait
divyaḥ suparṇaḥ sa vīro vyakhyad aditeḥ putro bhuvanāni viśvā
udyan raśmīn ātanuṣe viśvā rūpāṇi puṣyasi
ubhā samudrau kratunā vibhāsi sarvāṃllokān paribhūr bhrājamānaḥ
pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau śiśū krīḍantau pariyāto 'rṇavam
viśvānyo bhuvanā vicaṣṭe hairaṇyair anyaṃ harito vahanti
divi tvāttrir adhārayat sūryā māsāya kartave
sa eṣi sudhṛtas tapan viśvā bhūtāvacākaśat
ubhāv antau samarṣasi vatsaḥ saṃmātarāv iva
nanv etad itaḥ purā brahma devā amī viduḥ
yat samudram anu śritaṃ tat siṣāsati sūryaḥ
adhvāsya vitato mahān pūrvaś cāparaś ca yaḥ
taṃ samāpnoti jūtibhis tato nāpacikitsati
tenāmṛtasya bhakṣaṃ devānāṃ nāvarundhate
ud u tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ
dṛśe viśvāya sūryam
apa tye tāyavo yathā nakṣatrā yanty aktubhiḥ
sūrāya viśvacakṣase
adṛśrann asya ketavo vi raśmayo janāṁ anu
bhrājanto agnayo yathā
taraṇir viśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛd asi sūrya
viśvam ābhāsi rocana
pratyaṅ devānāṃ viśaḥ pratyaṅṅ udeṣi mānuṣīḥ
pratyaṅ viśvaṃ svar dṛśe
yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janāṁ anu
tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi
vi dyām eṣi rajas pṛthv ahar mimāno aktubhiḥ
paśyan janmāni sūrya
sapta tvā harito rathe vahanti deva sūrya
śociṣkeśaṃ vicakṣaṇam
ayukta sapta śundhyuvaḥ sūro rathasya naptyaḥ
tābhir yāti svayuktibhiḥ
rohito divam āruhat tapasā tapasvī
sa yonim aiti sa u jāyate punaḥ sa devānām adhipatir babhūva
yo viśvacarṣaṇir uta viśvatomukho yo viśvataspāṇir uta viśvataspṛthaḥ
saṃ bāhubhyāṃ bharati saṃ patatrair dyāvāpṛthivī janayan deva ekaḥ
ekapād dvipado bhūyo vicakrame dvipāt tripādam abhyeti paścāt
dvipāddha ṣaṭpado bhūyo vicakrame ta ekapadas tanvaṃ samāsate
atandro yāsyan harito yad āsthād dve rūpe kṛṇute rocamānaḥ
ketumān udyant sahamāno rajāṃsi viśvā āditya pravato vibhāsi
baṇ mahāṁ asi sūrya baḍ āditya mahāṁ asi
mahāṃs te mahato mahimā tvam āditya mahāṁ asi
rocase divi rocase antarikṣe pataṅga pṛthivyāṃ rocase rocase apsv antaḥ
ubhā samudrau rucyā vyāpitha devo devāsi mahiṣaḥ svarjit
arvāṅ parastāt prayato vyadhva āśur vipaścit patayan pataṅgaḥ
viṣṇur vicittaḥ śavasādhitiṣṭhan pra ketunā sahate viśvam ejat
citraś cikitvān mahiṣaḥ suparṇa ārocayan rodasī antarikṣam
ahorātre pari sūryaṃ vasāne prāsya viśvā tirato vīryāṇi
tigmo vibhrājan tanvaṃ śiśāno 'raṃgamāsaḥ pravato rarāṇaḥ
jyotiṣmān pakṣī mahiṣo vayodhā viśvā āsthāt pradiśaḥ kalpamānaḥ
citraṃ devānām ketur anīkaṃ jyotiṣmān pradiśaḥ sūrya udyan
divākaro 'ti dyumnais tamāṃsi viśvātārīd duritāni śukraḥ
citraṃ devānām udagād anīkaṃ cakṣur mitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ
āprād dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatas tasthuṣaś ca
uccā patantam aruṇaṃ suparṇaṃ madhye divas taraṇiṃ bhrājamānam
paśyāma tvā savitāraṃ yam āhur ajasraṃ jyotir yad avindad attriḥ
divas pṛṣṭhe dhāvamānaṃ suparṇam adityāḥ putraṃ nāthakāma upayāmi bhītaḥ
sa naḥ sūrya pratira dīrgham āyur mā riṣāma sumatau te syāma
rohitaḥ kālo abhavad rohito 'gre prajāpatiḥ
rohito yajñānāṃ mukhaṃ rohitaḥ svar ābharat
rohito loko abhavad rohito 'tyatapad divam
rohito raśmibhir bhūmiṃ samudram anusaṃcarat
sarvā diśaḥ samacarad rohito 'dhipatir divaḥ
divaṃ samudram ād bhūmiṃ sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ virakṣati
ārohañchukro bṛhatīr atandro dve rūpe kṛṇute rocamānaḥ
citraś cikitvān mahiṣo vātamāyā yāvato lokān abhi yad vibhāti
abhy anyad eti pary anyad asyate 'horātrābhyāṃ mahiṣaḥ kalpamānaḥ
sūryaṃ vayaṃ rajasi kṣiyantaṃ gātuvidaṃ havāmahe nādhamānāḥ
pṛthivīpro mahiṣo nādhamānasya gātur adabdhacakṣuḥ pari viśvaṃ babhūva
viśvaṃ saṃpaśyant suvidatro yajatra idaṃ śṛṇotu yad ahaṃ bravīmi
pary asya mahimā pṛthivīṃ samudraṃ jyotiṣā vibhrājan pari dyām antarikṣam
sarvaṃ saṃpaśyant suvidatro yajatra idaṃ śṛṇotu yad ahaṃ bravīmi
abodhy agniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenum ivāyatīm uṣasam
yahvā iva pra vayām ujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākam accha
ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī jajāna yo drāpim kṛtvā bhuvanāni vaste
yasmin kṣiyanti pradiśaḥ ṣaḍ urvīr yāḥ pataṅgo anu vicākaśīti
tasya devasya kruddhasyaitad āgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jināti
udvepaya rohita prakṣiṇīhi brahmajyasya pratimuñca pāśān
yasmād vātā ṛtuthā pavante yasmāt samudrā adhi vikṣaranti
yo mārayati prāṇayati yasmāt prāṇanti bhuvanāni viśvā
yaḥ prāṇena dyāvāpṛthivī tarpayaty apānena samudrasya jaṭharaṃ yaḥ piparti
yasmin virāṭ parameṣṭhī prajāpatir agnir vaiśvānaraḥ saha paṅktyā śritaḥ
yaḥ parasya prāṇaṃ paramasya teja ādade
yasmin ṣaḍ urvīḥ pañca diśo adhiśritāś catasra āpo yajñasya trayo 'kṣarāḥ
yo antarā rodasī kruddhaś cakṣuṣaikṣata
tasya devasya kruddhasyaitad āgo ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇam jināti
yo annādo annapatir babhūva brahmaṇaspatir uta yaḥ
bhūto bhaviṣyat bhuvanasya yas patiḥ
ahorātrair vimitaṃ triṃśadaṅgaṃ trayodaśaṃ māsaṃ yo nirmimīte
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divam utpatanti
ta āvavṛtrant sadanād ṛtasya
yat te candraṃ kaśyapa rocanāvad yat saṃhitaṃ puṣkalaṃ citrabhānu yasmint sūryā ārpitāḥ sapta sākam
bṛhad enam anuvaste purastād rathaṃtaraṃ pratigṛhṇāti paścāt
jyotir vasāne sadam apramādam
bṛhad anyataḥ pakṣa āsīd rathaṃtaram anyataḥ sabale sadhrīcī
yad rohitam ajanayanta devāḥ
sa varuṇaḥ sāyam agnir bhavati sa mitro bhavati prātar udyan
sa savitā bhūtvāntarikṣeṇa yāti sa indro bhūtvā tapati madhyato divam
ayaṃ sa devo apsv antaḥ sahasramūlaḥ paruśāko attriḥ
ya idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna
śukraṃ vahanti harayo raghuṣyado devaṃ divi varcasā bhrājamānam
yasyordhvā divaṃ tanvas tapanty arvāṅ suvarṇaiḥ paṭarair vibhāti
yenādityān haritaḥ saṃvahanti yena yajñena bahavo yanti prajānantaḥ
yad ekaṃ jyotir bahudhā vibhāti
trinābhi cakram ajaram anarvaṃ yatremā viśvā bhuvanādhitasthuḥ
aṣṭadhā yukto vahati vahnir ugraḥ pitā devānāṃ janitā matīnām
ṛtasya tantuṃ manasā mimānaḥ sarvā diśaḥ pavate mātariśvā
samyañcaṃ tantuṃ pradiśo 'nu sarvā antar gāyatryām amṛtasya garbhe
nimrucas tisro vyuṣo ha tisras trīṇi rajāṃsi divo aṅga tisraḥ
vidmā te agne tredhā janitraṃ tredhā devānāṃ janimāni vidma
vi ya aurṇot pṛthivīṃ jāyamāna ā samudram adadhāt antarikṣe
tvam agne kratubhiḥ ketubhir hito 'rkaḥ samiddha udarocathā divi
kim abhyārcan marutaḥ pṛśnimātaro yad rohitam ajanayanta devāḥ
yo 'syeśe dvipado yaś catuṣpadaḥ
catuṣpāc cakre dvipadām abhisvare saṃpaśyan paṅktim upatiṣṭhamānaḥ
kṛṣṇāyāḥ putro arjuno rātryā vatso 'jāyata
sa ha dyām adhirohati ruho ruroha rohitaḥ
sa eti savitā svar divas pṛṣṭhe 'vacākaśat
raśmibhir nabha ābhṛtaṃ mahendra ety āvṛtaḥ
sa dhātā sa vidhartā sa vāyur nabha ucchritam
so 'ryamā sa varuṇaḥ sa rudraḥ sa mahādevaḥ
so agniḥ sa u sūryaḥ sa u eva mahāyamaḥ
taṃ vatsā upatiṣṭhanty ekaśīrṣāṇo yutā daśa
paścāt prāñca ātanvanti yad udeti vibhāsati
tasyaiṣa māruto gaṇaḥ sa eti śikyākṛtaḥ
tasyeme nava kośā viṣṭambhā navadhā hitāḥ
sa prajābhyo vipaśyati yac ca prāṇati yac ca na
tam idaṃ nigataṃ sahaḥ sa eṣa eka ekavṛd eka eva
ete asmin devā ekavṛto bhavanti
kīrtiś ca yaśaś cāmbhaś ca nabhaś ca brāhmaṇavarcasaṃ cānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ ca
ya etaṃ devam ekavṛtaṃ veda
na dvitīyo na tṛtīyaś caturtho nāpy ucyate
na pañcamo na ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamo nāpy ucyate
nāṣṭamo na navamo daśamo nāpy ucyate
sa sarvasmai vipaśyati yac ca prāṇati yac ca na
sarve asmin devā ekavṛto bhavanti
brahma ca tapaś ca kīrtiś ca yaśaś cāmbhaś ca nabhaś ca brāhmaṇavarcasaṃ cānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ ca
bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca śraddhā ca ruciś ca svargaś ca svadhā ca
sa eva mṛtyuḥ so 'mṛtaṃ so 'bhvaṃ sa rakṣaḥ
sa rudro vasuvanir vasudeye namovāke vaṣaṭkāro 'nu saṃhitaḥ
tasyeme sarve yātava upa praśiṣam āsate
tasyāmū sarvā nakṣatrā vaśe candramasā saha
sa vā ahno 'jāyata tasmād ahar ajāyata
sa vai rātryā ajāyata tasmād rātrir ajāyata
sa vā antarikṣād ajāyata tasmād antarikṣam ajāyata
sa vai vāyor ajāyata tasmād vāyur ajāyata
sa vai divo 'jāyata tasmād dyaur adhi ajāyata
sa vai digbhyo 'jāyata tasmād diśo 'jāyanta
sa vai bhūmer ajāyata tasmād bhūmir ajāyata
sa vā agner ajāyata tasmād agnir ajāyata
sa vā adbhyo 'jāyata tasmād āpo 'jāyanta
sa vā ṛgbhyo 'jāyata tasmād ṛco 'jāyanta
sa vai yajñād ajāyata tasmād yajño 'jāyata
sa yajñas tasya yajñaḥ sa yajñasya śiraḥ kṛtam
sa stanayati sa vidyotate sa u aśmānam asyati
pāpāya vā bhadrāya vā puruṣāyāsurāya vā
yad vā kṛṇoṣy oṣadhīr yad vā varṣasi bhadrayā yad vā janyam avīvṛdhaḥ
tāvāṃs te maghavan mahimopo te tanvaḥ śatam
upo te baddhe baddhāni yadi vāsi nyarbudam
bhūyān indro namurād bhūyān indrāsi mṛtyubhyaḥ
bhūyān arātyāḥ śacyāḥ patis tvam indrāsi vibhūḥ prabhūr iti tvopāsmahe vayam
namas te astu paśyata paśya mā paśyata
annādyena yaśasā tejasā brāhmaṇavarcasena
ambho amo mahaḥ saha iti tvopāsmahe vayam
ambho aruṇaṃ rajataṃ rajaḥ saha iti tvopāsmahe vayam
uruḥ pṛthuḥ subhūr bhuva iti tvopāsmahe vayam
pratho varo vyaco loka iti tvopāsmahe vayam
bhavadvasur idadvasuḥ saṃyadvasur āyadvasur iti tvopāsmahe vayam
satyenottabhitā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇottabhitā dyauḥ
ṛtenādityās tiṣṭhanti divi somo adhiśritaḥ
somenādityā balinaḥ somena pṛthivī mahī
atho nakṣatrāṇām eṣām upasthe soma āhitaḥ
somaṃ manyate papivān yat sampiṃṣanty oṣadhim
somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidur na tasyāśnāti pārthivaḥ
yat tvā soma prapibanti tata āpyāyase punaḥ
vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ
āchadvidhānair gupito bārhataiḥ soma rakṣitaḥ
grāvṇām icchṛṇvan tiṣṭhasi na te aśnāti pārthivaḥ
cittir ā upabarhaṇaṃ cakṣur ā abhyañjanam
dyaur bhūmiḥ kośa āsīd yad ayāt sūryā patim
raibhy āsīd anudeyī nārāśaṃsī nyocanī
sūryāyā bhadram id vāso gāthayaiti pariṣkṛtā
stomā āsan pratidhayaḥ kurīraṃ chanda opaśaḥ
sūryāyā aśvinā varāgnir āsīt purogavaḥ
somo vadhūyur abhavad aśvināstām ubhā varā
sūryāṃ yat patye śaṃsantīṃ manasā savitādadāt
mano asyā ana āsīd dyaur āsīd uta chadiḥ
śukrāv anaḍvāhāv āstāṃ yad ayāt sūryā patim
ṛksāmābhyām abhihitau gāvau te sāmanāv aitām
śrotre te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāś carācaraḥ
śucī te cakre yātyā vyāno akṣa āhataḥ
ano manasmayaṃ sūryārohat prayatī patim
sūryāyā vahatuḥ prāgāt savitā yam avāsṛjat
maghāsu hanyante gāvaḥ phalgunīṣu vyuhyate
yad aśvinā pṛcchamānāv ayātaṃ tricakreṇa vahatuṃ sūryāyāḥ
kvaikaṃ cakraṃ vām āsīt kva deṣṭrāya tasthathuḥ
yad ayātaṃ śubhas patī vareyaṃ sūryām upa
viśve devā anu tad vām ajānan putraḥ pitaram avṛṇīta pūṣā
dve te cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viduḥ
athaikaṃ cakraṃ yad guhā tad addhātaya id viduḥ
aryamaṇaṃ yajāmahe subandhuṃ pativedanam
urvārukam iva bandhanāt preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ
preto muñcāmi nāmutaḥ subaddhām amutas karam
yatheyam indra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati
pra tvā muñcāmi varuṇasya pāśād yena tvābadhnāt savitā suśevāḥ
ṛtasya yonau sukṛtasya loke syonaṃ te astu sahasaṃbhalāyai
bhagas tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinā tvā pravahatāṃ rathena
gṛhān gaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidatham āvadāsi
iha priyaṃ prajāyai te samṛdhyatām asmin gṛhe gārhapatyāya jāgṛhi
enā patyā tanvaṃ saṃspṛśasvātha jivrir vidatham āvadāsi
ihaiva staṃ mā viyauṣṭaṃ viśvam āyur vyaśnutam
krīḍantau putrair naptṛbhir modamānau svastakau
pūrvāparaṃ carato māyaitau śiśū krīḍantau pariyāto 'rṇavam
navo navo bhavasi jāyamāno 'hnāṃ ketur uṣasām eṣy agram
bhāgaṃ devebhyo vidadhāsy āyan pra candramas tirase dīrgham āyuḥ
parā dehi śāmulyaṃ brahmabhyo vibhajā vasu
kṛtyaiṣā padvatī bhūtvā jāyā viśate patim
nīlalohitaṃ bhavati kṛtyāsaktir vyajyate
edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patir bandheṣu badhyate
aślīlā tanūr bhavati ruśatī pāpayāmuyā
patir yad vadhvo vāsasaḥ svam aṅgam abhyūrṇute
āśasanaṃ viśasanam atho adhivikartanam
sūryāyāḥ paśya rūpāṇi tāni brahmota śumbhati
tṛṣṭam etat kaṭukam apāṣṭhavad viṣavan naitad attave
sūryāṃ yo brahmā veda sa id vādhūyam arhati
sa it tat syonaṃ harati brahmā vāsaḥ sumaṅgalam
prāyaścittiṃ yo adhyeti yena jāyā na riṣyati
yuvaṃ bhagaṃ saṃbharataṃ samṛddham ṛtaṃ vadantāv ṛtodyeṣu
brahmaṇaspate patim asyai rocaya cāru saṃbhalo vadatu vācam etām
ihed asātha na paro gamāthemaṃ gāvaḥ prajayā vardhayātha
śubhaṃ yatīr usriyāḥ somavarcaso viśve devāḥ krann iha vo manāṃsi
imaṃ gāvaḥ prajayā saṃviśāthāyaṃ devānāṃ na mināti bhāgam
asmai vaḥ pūṣā marutaś ca sarve asmai vo dhātā savitā suvāti
anṛkṣarā ṛjavaḥ santu panthāno yebhiḥ sakhāyo yanti no vareyam
saṃ bhagena sam aryamṇā saṃ dhātā sṛjatu varcasā
yac ca varco akṣeṣu surāyāṃ ca yad āhitam
yad goṣv aśvinā varcas tenemāṃ varcasāvatam
yena mahānagnyā jaghanam aśvinā yena vā surā
yenākṣā abhyaṣicyanta tenemāṃ varcasāvatam
yo anidhmo dīdayad apsv antar yaṃ viprāsa īḍate adhvareṣu
apāṃ napān madhumatīr apo dā yābhir indro vāvṛdhe vīryāvān
idam ahaṃ ruśantaṃ grābhaṃ tanūdūṣim apohāmi
yo bhadro rocanas tam udacāmi
āsyai brāhmaṇāḥ snapanīr harantv avīraghnīr udajantv āpaḥ
aryamṇo agniṃ paryetu pūṣan pratīkṣante śvaśuro devaraś ca
śaṃ te hiraṇyaṃ śam u santv āpaḥ śaṃ methir bhavatu śaṃ yugasya tardma
śaṃ ta āpaḥ śatapavitrā bhavantu śam u patyā tanvaṃ saṃspṛśasva
apālām indra triṣ pūtvākṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam
āśāsānā saumanasaṃ prajāṃ saubhāgyaṃ rayim
patyur anuvratā bhūtvā saṃnahyasvāmṛtāya kam
yathā sindhur nadīnāṃ sāmrājyaṃ suṣuve vṛṣā
evā tvaṃ samrājñy edhi patyur astaṃ paretya
samrājñy edhi śvaśureṣu samrājñy uta devṛṣu
nanānduḥ samrājñy edhi samrājñy uta śvaśrvāḥ
yā akṛntann avayan yāś ca tatnire yā devīr antāṁ abhito 'dadanta
tās tvā jarase saṃvyayantv āyuṣmatīdaṃ paridhatsva vāsaḥ
jīvaṃ rudanti vinayanty adhvaraṃ dīrghām anu prasitiṃ dīdhyur naraḥ
vāmaṃ pitṛbhyo ya idaṃ samīrire mayaḥ patibhyo janaye pariṣvaje
syonaṃ dhruvaṃ prajāyai dhārayāmi te 'śmānaṃ devyāḥ pṛthivyā upasthe
tam ātiṣṭhānumādyā suvarcā dīrghaṃ ta āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
yenāgnir asyā bhūmyā hastaṃ jagrāha dakṣiṇam
tena gṛhṇāmi te hastaṃ mā vyathiṣṭhā mayā saha prajayā ca dhanena ca
devas te savitā hastaṃ gṛhṇātu somo rājā suprajasaṃ kṛṇotu
agniḥ subhagāṃ jātavedāḥ patye patnīṃ jaradaṣṭim kṛṇotu
gṛhṇāmi te saubhagatvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭir yathāsaḥ
bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhir mahyaṃ tvādur gārhapatyāya devāḥ
bhagas te hastam agrahīt savitā hastam agrahīt
patnī tvam asi dharmaṇāhaṃ gṛhapatis tava
mameyam astu poṣyā mahyaṃ tvādād bṛhaspatiḥ
mayā patyā prajāvati saṃjīva śaradaḥ śatam
tvaṣṭā vāso vyadadhāc chubhe kaṃ bṛhaspateḥ praśiṣā kavīnām
tenemāṃ nārīṃ savitā bhagaś ca sūryām iva paridhattāṃ prajayā
indrāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī mātariśvā mitrāvaruṇā bhago aśvinobhā
bṛhaspatir maruto brahma soma imāṃ nāriṃ prajayā vardhayantu
bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaḥ sūryāyāḥ śīrṣe keśāṁ akalpayat
tena imām aśvinā nārīm patye saṃśobhayāmasi
idaṃ tad rūpaṃ yad avasta yoṣā jāyāṃ jijñāse manasā carantīm
tām anvartiṣye sakhibhir navagvaiḥ ka imān vidvān vicacarta pāśān
ahaṃ viṣyāmi mayi rūpam asyā vedad it paśyan manasaḥ kulāyam
na steyam admi manasodamucye svayaṃ śrathnāno varuṇasya pāśān
uruṃ lokaṃ sugam atra panthāṃ kṛṇomi tubhyaṃ sahapatnyai vadhu
udyacchadhvam apa rakṣo hanāthemāṃ nārīṃ sukṛte dadhāta
dhātā vipaścit patim asyai viveda bhago rājā pura etu prajānan
bhagas tatakṣa caturaḥ pādān bhagas tatakṣa catvāry uṣyalāni
tvaṣṭā pipeśa madhyato 'nu vardhrānt sā no astu sumaṅgalī
sukiṃśukaṃ vahatuṃ viśvarūpaṃ hiraṇyavarṇaṃ suvṛtaṃ sucakram
āroha sūrye amṛtasya lokaṃ syonaṃ patibhyo vahatuṃ kṛṇu tvam
abhrātṛghnīṃ varuṇāpaśughnīṃ bṛhaspate
indrāpatighnīm putriṇīm āsmabhyaṃ savitar vaha
mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ kumāryaṃ sthūṇe devakṛte pathi
śālāyā devyā dvāraṃ syonaṃ kṛṇmo vadhūpatham
brahmāparaṃ yujyatāṃ brahma pūrvaṃ brahmāntato madhyato brahma sarvataḥ
anāvyādhāṃ devapurāṃ prapadya śivā syonā patiloke virāja
tubhyam agre paryavahant sūryāṃ vahatunā saha
sa naḥ patibhyo jāyāṃ dā agne prajayā saha
punaḥ patnīm agnir adād āyuṣā saha varcasā
dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
somasya jāyā prathamaṃ gandharvas te 'paraḥ patiḥ
tṛtīyo agniṣ ṭe patis turīyas te manuṣyajāḥ
somo dadad gandharvāya gandharvo dadad agnaye
rayiṃ ca putrāṃś cādād agnir mahyam atho imām
ā vām agant sumatir vājinīvasū ny aśvinā hṛtsu kāmā araṃsata
abhūtaṃ gopā mithunā śubhas patī priyā aryamṇo duryāṃ aśīmahi
sā mandasānā manasā śivena rayiṃ dhehi sarvavīraṃ vacasyam
sugaṃ tīrthaṃ suprapāṇaṃ śubhas patī sthāṇuṃ pathiṣṭhām apa durmatiṃ hatam
yā oṣadhayo yā nadyo yāni kṣetrāṇi yā vanā
tās tvā vadhu prajāvatīṃ patye rakṣantu rakṣasaḥ
emaṃ panthām arukṣāma sugaṃ svastivāhanam
yasmin vīro na riṣyaty anyeṣāṃ vindate vasu
idaṃ su me naraḥ śṛṇuta yayāśiṣā daṃpatī vāmam aśnutaḥ
ye gandharvā apsarasaś ca devīr eṣu vānaspatyeṣu ye 'dhitasthuḥ
syonās te asyai vadhvai bhavantu mā hiṃsiṣur vahatum uhyamānam
ye vadhvaś candraṃ vahatuṃ yakṣmā yanti janāṁ anu
punas tān yajñiyā devā nayantu yata āgatāḥ
mā vidan paripanthino ya āsīdanti daṃpatī
sugena durgam atītām apadrāntv arātayaḥ
saṃkāśayāmi vahatuṃ brahmaṇā gṛhair aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa
paryāṇaddhaṃ viśvarūpaṃ yad asti syonaṃ patibhyaḥ savitā tat kṛṇotu
śivā nārīyam astam āgann imaṃ dhātā lokam asyai dideśa
tām aryamā bhago aśvinobhā prajāpatiḥ prajayā vardhayantu
ātmanvaty urvarā nārīyam āgan tasyāṃ naro vapata bījam asyām
sā vaḥ prajāṃ janayad vakṣaṇābhyo bibhratī dugdham ṛṣabhasya retaḥ
pratitiṣṭha virāḍ asi viṣṇur iveha sarasvati
sinīvāli prajāyatāṃ bhagasya sumatāv asat
ud va ūrmiḥ śamyā hantv āpo yoktrāṇi muñcata
māduṣkṛtau vyenasāv aghnyāv aśunam āratām
aghoracakṣur apatighnī syonā śagmā suśevā suyamā gṛhebhyaḥ
vīrasūr devṛkāmā saṃ tvayaidhiṣīmahi sumanasyamānā
adevṛghny apatighnīhaidhi śivā paśubhyaḥ suyamā suvarcāḥ
prajāvatī vīrasūr devṛkāmā syonemam agniṃ gārhapatyaṃ saparya
uttiṣṭhetaḥ kim icchantīdam āgā ahaṃ tveḍe abhibhūḥ svād gṛhāt
śūnyaiṣī nirṛte yājaganthottiṣṭhārāte prapata meha raṃsthāḥ
yadā gārhapatyam asaparyait pūrvam agniṃ vadhūr iyam
adhā sarasvatyai nāri pitṛbhyaś ca namas kuru
śarma varmaitad āharāsyai nāryā upastire
yaṃ balbajaṃ nyasyatha carma copastṛṇīthana
tad ārohatu suprajā yā kanyā vindate patim
upastṛṇīhi balbajam adhi carmaṇi rohite
tatropaviśya suprajā imam agniṃ saparyatu
āroha carmopasīdāgnim eṣa devo hanti rakṣāṃsi sarvā
iha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai sujyaiṣṭhyo bhavat putras ta eṣaḥ
vitiṣṭhantāṃ mātur asyā upasthān nānārūpāḥ paśavo jāyamānāḥ
sumaṅgaly upasīdemam agniṃ saṃpatnī pratibhūṣeha devān
sumaṅgalī prataraṇī gṛhāṇāṃ suśevā patye śvaśurāya śaṃbhūḥ
syonā śvaśrvai pra gṛhān viśemān
syonā bhava śvaśurebhyaḥ syonā patye gṛhebhyaḥ
syonāsyai sarvasyai viśe syonā puṣṭāyaiṣāṃ bhava
sumaṅgalīr iyaṃ vadhūr imāṃ sameta paśyata
saubhāgyam asyai dattvā daurbhāgyair viparetana
yā durhārdo yuvatayo yāś ceha jaratīr api
varco nv asyai saṃdattāthāstaṃ viparetana
rukmaprastaraṇaṃ vahyaṃ viśvā rūpāṇi bibhratam
ārohat sūryā sāvitrī bṛhate saubhagāya kam
āroha talpaṃ sumanasyamāneha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai
indrāṇīva subudhā budhyamānā jyotiragrā uṣasaḥ pratijāgarāsi
devā agre nyapadyanta patnīḥ samaspṛśanta tanvas tanūbhiḥ
sūryeva nāri viśvarūpā mahitvā prajāvatī patyā saṃbhaveha
uttiṣṭheto viśvāvaso namaseḍāmahe tvā
jāmim iccha pitṛṣadaṃ nyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi
tās te janitram abhi tāḥ parehi namas te gandharvartunā kṛṇomi
namo gandharvasya namase namo bhāmāya cakṣuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ
viśvāvaso brahmaṇā te namo 'bhi jāyā apsarasaḥ parehi
rāyā vayaṃ sumanasaḥ syāmod ito gandharvam āvīvṛtāma
agant sa devaḥ paramaṃ sadhastham aganma yatra pratiranta āyuḥ
saṃ pitarāv ṛtviye sṛjethāṃ mātā pitā ca retaso bhavāthaḥ
marya iva yoṣām adhirohayaināṃ prajāṃ kṛṇvāthām iha puṣyataṃ rayim
tāṃ pūṣañchivatamām erayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā vapanti
yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāti yasyām uśantaḥ praharema śepaḥ
ārohorum upadhatsva hastaṃ pariṣvajasva jāyāṃ sumanasyamānaḥ
prajāṃ kṛṇvāthām iha modamānau dīrghaṃ vām āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
ā vāṃ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir ahorātrābhyāṃ samanaktv aryamā
adurmaṅgalī patilokam āviśemaṃ śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
devair dattaṃ manunā sākam etad vādhūyaṃ vāso vadhvaś ca vastram
yo brahmaṇe cikituṣe dadāti sa id rakṣāṃsi talpāni hanti
yaṃ me datto brahmabhāgaṃ vadhūyor vādhūyaṃ vāso vadhvaś ca vastram
yuvaṃ brahmaṇe 'numanyamānau bṛhaspate sākam indraś ca dattam
syonād yoner adhi budhyamānau hasāmudau mahasā modamānau
sugū suputrau sugṛhau tarātho jīvāv uṣaso vibhātīḥ
navaṃ vasānaḥ surabhiḥ suvāsā udāgāṃ jīva uṣaso vibhātīḥ
āṇḍāt patatrīvāmukṣi viśvasmād enasaḥ pari
sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca
ye bhūtasya pracetasas tebhya idam akaraṃ namaḥ
ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ
saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasur niṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
apāsmat tama ucchatu nīlaṃ piśaṅgam uta lohitaṃ yat
nirdahanī yā pṛṣātaky asmin tāṃ sthāṇāv adhy āsajāmi
yāvatīḥ kṛtyā upavāsane yāvanto rājño varuṇasya pāśāḥ
vyṛddhayo yā asamṛddhayo yā asmin tā sthāṇāv adhi sādayāmi
yā me priyatamā tanūḥ sā me bibhāya vāsasaḥ
tasyāgre tvaṃ vanaspate nīviṃ kṛṇuṣva mā vayaṃ riṣāma
ye antā yāvatīḥ sico ya otavo ye ca tantavaḥ
vāso yat patnībhir utaṃ tan naḥ syonam upaspṛśāt
uśatīḥ kanyalā imāḥ pitṛlokāt patiṃ yatīḥ
ava dīkṣām asṛkṣata svāhā
bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan
varco goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
tejo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
bhago goṣu praviṣṭo yas tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
yaśo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
payo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
raso goṣu praviṣṭo yas tenemāṃ saṃsṛjāmasi
yadīme keśino janā gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvanto 'gham
agniṣ ṭvā tasmād enasaḥ savitā ca pramuñcatām
yadīyaṃ duhitā tava vikeśy arudad gṛhe rodena kṛṇvaty agham
yaj jāmayo yad yuvatayo gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvatīr agham
yat te prajāyāṃ paśuṣu yad vā gṛheṣu niṣṭhitam aghakṛdbhir aghaṃ kṛtam
iyaṃ nāry upabrūte pūlyāny āvapantikā
dīrghāyur astu me patir jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam
ihemāv indra saṃnuda cakravākeva daṃpatī
prajayainau svastakau viśvam āyur vyaśnutām
yad āsandyām upadhāne yad vopavāsane kṛtam
vivāhe kṛtyāṃ yāṃ cakrur āsnāne tāṃ nidadhmasi
yad duṣkṛtaṃ yac chamalaṃ vivāhe vahatau ca yat
tat saṃbhalasya kambale mṛjmahe duritaṃ vayam
saṃbhale malaṃ sādayitvā kambale duritaṃ vayam
kṛtrimaḥ kaṇṭakaḥ śatadan ya eṣaḥ
apāsyāḥ keśyaṃ malam apa śīrṣaṇyaṃ likhāt
aṅgādaṅgād vayam asyā apa yakṣmaṃ nidadhmasi
tan mā prāpat pṛthivīṃ mota devān divaṃ mā prāpad urv antarikṣam
apo mā prāpan malam etad agne yamam mā prāpat pitṝṃś ca sarvān
saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ tvā nahyāmi payasauṣadhīnām
saṃ tvā nahyāmi prajayā dhanena sā saṃnaddhā sanuhi vājam emam
amo 'ham asmi sā tvaṃ sāmāham asmy ṛk tvaṃ dyaur ahaṃ pṛthivī tvam
tāv iha saṃbhavāva prajām ājanayāvahai
janiyanti nāv agravaḥ putriyanti sudānavaḥ
ariṣṭāsū sacevahi bṛhate vājasātaye
ye pitaro vadhūdarśā imaṃ vahatum āgaman
te asyai vadhvai saṃpatnyai prajāvaccharma yacchantu
yedaṃ pūrvāgan raśanāyamānā prajām asyai draviṇaṃ ceha dattvā
tāṃ vahantv agatasyānu panthāṃ virāḍ iyaṃ suprajā atyajaiṣīt
prabudhyasva subudhā budhyamānā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
gṛhān gaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso dīrghaṃ ta āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
vrātyaḥ āsīt īyamānaḥ eva
sa prajāpatim samairayat
sa prajāpatiḥ suvarṇam ātman apaśyat
tat prājanayat

tat lalāmam abhavat
tat mahat abhavat
tat jyeṣṭham abhavat
tat brahma abhavat

tena prājāyata
saḥ avardhata
sa mahān abhavat
sa mahādevaḥ abhavat
sa devānām īśām paryait
saḥ īśānaḥ abhavat
saḥ eka vrātyaḥ abhavat
sa dhanuḥ ādatta
tat eva indra dhanuḥ
nīlam asya udaram
lohitam pṛṣṭham
nīlena eva apriyam bhrātṛvyam prorṇoti lohitena dviṣantam vidhyati iti brahma vādinaḥ vadanti
saḥ udatiṣṭhat
sa prācīm diśam anuvyacalat
tam bṛhat ca rathantaram ca ādityāḥ ca viśve ca devāḥ anuvyacalan
bṛhate ca vai sa rathantarāya ca ādityebhyaḥ ca viśvebhyaḥ ca devebhyaḥ āvṛścate yaḥ evam vidvāṃsam vrātyam upavadati
bṛhataḥ ca vai sa rathantarasya ca ādityānām ca viśveṣām ca devānām priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
śraddhā
tasya prācyām diśi śraddhā puṃścalī mitraḥ māgadhaḥ vijñānam vāsaḥ ahar uṣṇīṣam rātrī keśāḥ haritau pravartau kalmaliḥ maṇiḥ bhūtam ca bhaviṣyat ca pariṣkandau manaḥ vipatham mātariśvā ca pavamānaḥ ca vipatha vāhau vātaḥ sārathiḥ reṣmā pratodaḥ kīrtiḥ ca yaśaḥ ca puraḥsarau
ā enam kīrtiḥ gacchati ā yaśaḥ gacchati yaḥ evam veda
sa dakṣiṇām diśam anuvyacalat
tam yajñāyajñiyam ca vāmadevyam ca yajñaḥ ca yajamānaḥ ca paśavaḥ ca anuvyacalan
yajñāyajñiyāya ca sa vāmadevyāya ca yajñāya ca yajamānāya ca paśubhyaḥ ca āvṛścate yaḥ evam vidvāṃsam vrātyam upavadati
yajñāyajñiyasya ca vai sa vāmadevyasya ca yajñasya ca yajamānasya ca paśūnām ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
uṣāḥ
tasya dakṣiṇāyām diśi uṣāḥ puṃścalī mantraḥ māgadhaḥ vijñānam vāsaḥ ahar uṣṇīṣam rātrī keśāḥ haritau pravartau kalmaliḥ maṇiḥ amāvāsyā ca paurṇamāsī ca pariṣkandau manaḥ vipatham mātariśvā ca pavamānaḥ ca vipatha vāhau vātaḥ sārathiḥ reṣmā pratodaḥ kīrtiḥ ca yaśaḥ ca puraḥsarau
sa pratīcīm diśam anuvyacalat
tam anuvyacalan
vairūpāya ca vai sa vairājāya ca adbhyaḥ ca varuṇāya ca rājñe āvṛścate yaḥ evam vidvāṃsam vrātyam upavadati
vairūpasya ca vai sa vairājasya ca apām ca varuṇasya ca rājñaḥ priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
irā
tasya pratīcyām diśi irā puṃścalī hasaḥ māgadhaḥ vijñānam vāsaḥ ahar uṣṇīṣam rātrī keśāḥ haritau pravartau kalmaliḥ maṇiḥ ahar ca rātrī ca pariṣkandau manaḥ vipatham mātariśvā ca pavamānaḥ ca vipatha vāhau vātaḥ sārathiḥ reṣmā pratodaḥ kīrtiḥ ca yaśaḥ ca puraḥsarau
saḥ udīcīm diśam anuvyacalat
tam śyaitam ca naudhasam ca saptarṣayaḥ ca somaḥ ca rājā anuvyacalan
śyaitāya ca vai sa naudhasāya ca saptarṣibhyaḥ ca somāya ca rājñe āvṛścate yaḥ evam vidvāṃsam vrātyam upavadati
śyaitasya ca vai sa naudhasasya ca saptarṣīṇām ca somasya ca rājñaḥ priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
vidyut
tasya udīcyām diśi vidyut puṃścalī stanayitnuḥ māgadhaḥ vijñānam vāsaḥ ahar uṣṇīṣam rātrī keśāḥ haritau pravartau kalmaliḥ maṇiḥ śrutam ca viśrutam ca pariṣkandau manaḥ vipatham mātariśvā ca pavamānaḥ ca vipatha vāhau vātaḥ sārathiḥ reṣmā pratodaḥ kīrtiḥ ca yaśaḥ ca puraḥsarau
sa saṃvatsaram ūrdhvaḥ atiṣṭhat
tam devāḥ abruvan vrātya kim nu tiṣṭhasi iti
saḥ abravīt āsandīm me saṃbharantu iti
tasmai vrātyāya āsandīm samabharan
tasyāḥ grīṣmaḥ ca vasantaḥ ca dvau pādau āstām śarad ca varṣāḥ ca dvau
bṛhat ca rathantaram ca anūcye āstām yajñāyajñiyam ca vāmadevyam ca tiraścye
ṛcaḥ prāñcaḥ tantavaḥ yajūṃṣi tiryañcaḥ
vedaḥ āstaraṇam brahma upabarhaṇam
sāma āsādaḥ udgīthaḥ apaśrayaḥ
tām āsandīm vrātyaḥ ārohat
tasya deva janāḥ pariṣkandāḥ āsan saṃkalpāḥ prahāyyāḥ viśvāni bhūtāni upasadaḥ
viśvāni eva asya bhūtāni upasadaḥ bhavanti yaḥ evam veda
tasmai prācyāḥ diśaḥ vāsantau māsau goptārau akurvan bṛhat ca rathantaram ca anuṣṭhātārau
vāsantau enam māsau prācyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ bṛhat ca rathantaram ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai dakṣiṇāyāḥ diśaḥ graiṣmau māsau goptārau akurvan yajñāyajñiyam ca vāmadevyam ca anuṣṭhātārau
graiṣmau enam māsau dakṣiṇāyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ yajñāyajñiyam ca vāmadevyam ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ vārṣikau māsau goptārau akurvan vairūpam ca vairājam ca anuṣṭhātārau
vārṣikau enam māsau pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ vairūpam ca vairājam ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai udīcyāḥ diśaḥ śāradau māsau goptārau akurvan śyaitam ca naudhasam ca anuṣṭhātārau
śāradau enam māsau udīcyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ śyaitam ca naudhasam ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai dhruvāyāḥ diśaḥ haimanau māsau goptārau akurvan bhūmim ca agnim ca anuṣṭhātārau
haimanau enam māsau dhruvāyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ bhūmiḥ ca agniḥ ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai ūrdhvāyāḥ diśaḥ śaiśirau māsau goptārau akurvan divam ca ādityam ca anuṣṭhātārau
śaiśirau enam māsau ūrdhvāyāḥ diśaḥ gopāyataḥ dyauḥ ca ādityaḥ ca anutiṣṭhataḥ yaḥ evam veda
tasmai prācyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt bhavam iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
bhavaḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ prācyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
na enam śarvaḥ na bhavaḥ na īśānaḥ na asya paśūn na samānān hinasti yaḥ evam veda
tasmai dakṣiṇāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt śarvam iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
śarvaḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
tasmai pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt paśupatim iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
paśupatiḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
tasmai udīcyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt ugram devam iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
ugraḥ enam devaḥ iṣvāsaḥ udīcyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
tasmai dhruvāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt rudram iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
rudraḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ dhruvāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
tasmai ūrdhvāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt mahādevam iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
mahādevaḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ ūrdhvāyāḥ diśaḥ antardeśāt anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
tasmai sarvebhyaḥ antardeśebhyaḥ īśānam iṣvāsam anuṣṭhātāram akurvan
īśānaḥ enam iṣvāsaḥ sarvebhyaḥ antardeśebhyaḥ anuṣṭhātā anutiṣṭhati
sa dhruvām diśam anuvyacalat
tam bhūmiḥ ca agniḥ ca oṣadhayaḥ ca vanaspatayaḥ ca vānaspatyāḥ ca vīrudhaḥ ca anuvyacalan
bhūmeḥ ca vai saḥ agneḥ ca oṣadhīnām ca vanaspatīnām ca vānaspatyānām ca vīrudhām ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
saḥ ūrdhvām diśam anuvyacalat
tam ṛtam ca satyam ca sūryaḥ ca candraḥ ca nakṣatrāṇi ca anuvyacalan
ṛtasya ca vai sa satyasya ca sūryasya ca candrasya ca nakṣatrāṇām ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
saḥ uttamām diśam anuvyacalat
tam ṛcaḥ ca sāmāni ca yajūṃṣi ca brahma ca anuvyacalan
ṛcām ca vai sa sāmnām ca yajuṣām ca brahmaṇaḥ ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa bṛhatīm diśam anuvyacalat
tam itihāsaḥ ca purāṇam ca gāthāḥ ca nārāśaṃsīḥ ca anuvyacalan
itihāsasya ca vai sa purāṇasya ca gāthānām ca nārāśaṃsīnām ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa paramām diśam anuvyacalat
tam āhavanīyaḥ ca gārhapatyaḥ ca dakṣiṇāgniḥ ca yajñaḥ ca yajamānaḥ ca paśavaḥ ca anuvyacalan
āhavanīyasya ca vai sa gārhapatyasya ca dakṣiṇāgneḥ ca yajñasya ca yajamānasya ca paśūnām ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
saḥ an ādiṣṭām diśam anuvyacalat
tam ṛtavaḥ ca ārtavāḥ ca lokāḥ ca laukyāḥ ca māsāḥ ca ardha māsāḥ ca ahorātre ca anuvyacalan
ṛtūnām ca vai saḥ ārtavānām ca lokānām ca laukyānām ca māsānām ca ardha māsānām ca ahorātrayoḥ ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
saḥ an āvṛttām diśam anuvyacalat
tatas na āvartsyan amanyata
tam ditiḥ ca aditiḥ ca iḍā ca indrāṇī ca anuvyacalan
diteḥ ca vai saḥ aditeḥ ca iḍāyāḥ ca indrāṇyāḥ ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa diśaḥ anuvyacalat
tam virāj anuvyacalat sarve ca devāḥ sarvāḥ ca devatāḥ
virājaḥ ca vai sa sarveṣām ca devānām sarvāsām ca devatānām priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa sarvān antardeśān anuvyacalat
tam prajāpatiḥ ca parameṣṭhī ca pitā ca pitāmahaḥ ca anuvyacalan
prajāpateḥ ca vai sa parameṣṭhinaḥ ca pituḥ ca pitāmahasya ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa mahimā sadruḥ bhūtvā antam pṛthivyāḥ agacchat
samudraḥ abhavat
tam prajāpatiḥ ca parameṣṭhī ca pitā ca pitāmahaḥ ca apaḥ ca śraddhā ca varṣam bhūtvā anuvyavartayanta
ā enam āpaḥ gacchanti ā enam śraddhā gacchati ā enam varṣam gacchati yaḥ evam veda
tam śraddhā ca yajñaḥ ca lokaḥ ca annam ca annādyam ca bhūtvā abhiparyāvartanta
ā enam śraddhā gacchati ā enam yajñaḥ gacchati ā enam lokaḥ gacchati ā enam annam gacchati ā enam annādyam gacchati yaḥ evam veda
saḥ arajyata
tatas rājanyaḥ ajāyata
sa viśaḥ sabandhūn annam annādyam abhyudatiṣṭhat
viśām ca vai sa sabandhūnām ca annasya ca annādyasya ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa viśaḥ anuvyacalat
tam sabhā ca samitiḥ ca senā ca surā ca anuvyacalan
sabhāyāḥ ca vai sa samiteḥ ca senāyāḥ ca surāyāḥ ca priyam dhāma bhavati yaḥ evam veda
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ rājñaḥ atithiḥ gṛhān āgacchet śreyāṃsam enam ātmanaḥ mānayet
tathā kṣatrāya na āvṛścate
tathā rāṣṭrāya na āvṛścate
atas vai brahma ca kṣatram ca udatiṣṭhatām
te abrūtām kam praviśāva iti
bṛhaspatim eva brahma praviśatu indram kṣatram
tathā vai iti
atas vai bṛhaspatim eva brahma prāviśat indram kṣatram
iyam vai u pṛthivī bṛhaspatiḥ
dyauḥ eva indraḥ
ayam vai u agniḥ brahma
asau ādityaḥ kṣatram
ā enam brahma gacchati brahmavarcasī bhavati yaḥ pṛthivīm bṛhaspatim agnim brahma veda
ā enam indriyam gacchati indriyavān bhavati yaḥ ādityam kṣatram divam indram veda
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ atithiḥ gṛhān āgacchet svayam enam abhyudetya brūyāt vrātya kva avātsīḥ vrātya udakam vrātya tarpayantu vrātya yathā te priyam tathā astu vrātya yathā te vaśaḥ tathā astu vrātya yathā te nikāmaḥ tathā astu iti
yat enam āha vrātya kva avātsīḥ iti pathaḥ eva tena deva yānān avarunddhe
yat enam āha vrātya udakam iti apaḥ eva tena avarunddhe
yat enam āha vrātya tarpayantu iti prāṇam eva tena varṣīyāṃsam kurute
yat enam āha vrātya yathā te priyam tathā astu iti priyam eva tena avarunddhe
ā enam priyam gacchati priyaḥ priyasya bhavati yaḥ evam veda
yat enam āha vrātya yathā te vaśaḥ tathā astu iti vaśam eva tena avarunddhe
ā enam vaśaḥ gacchati vaśī vaśinām bhavati yaḥ evam veda
yat enam āha vrātya yathā te nikāmaḥ tathā astu iti nikāmam eva tena avarunddhe
ā enam nikāmaḥ gacchati nikāme nikāmasya bhavati yaḥ evam veda
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ uddhṛteṣu agniṣu adhiśrite agnihotre atithiḥ gṛhān āgacchet svayam enam abhyudetya brūyāt vrātya atisṛja hoṣyāmi iti
sa ca atisṛjet juhuyāt
na ca atisṛjet na juhuyāt
sa yaḥ evam viduṣā vrātyena atisṛṣṭaḥ juhoti pra pitṛyāṇam panthām jānāti pra deva yānam
na deveṣu āvṛścate
hutam asya bhavati
pari asya asmin loke āyatanam śiṣyate yaḥ evam viduṣā vrātyena atisṛṣṭaḥ juhoti
atha yaḥ evam viduṣā vrātyena an atisṛṣṭaḥ juhoti na pitṛyāṇam panthām jānāti na deva yānam
ā deveṣu vṛścate
ahutam asya bhavati
na asya asmin loke āyatanam śiṣyate yaḥ evam viduṣā vrātyena an atisṛṣṭaḥ juhoti
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ ekām rātrim atithiḥ gṛhe vasati ye pṛthivyām puṇyāḥ lokāḥ tān eva tena avarunddhe
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ dvitīyām rātrim atithiḥ gṛhe vasati ye antarikṣe puṇyāḥ lokāḥ tān eva tena avarunddhe
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ tṛtīyām rātrim atithiḥ gṛhe vasati ye divi puṇyāḥ lokāḥ tān eva tena avarunddhe
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ caturthīm rātrim atithiḥ gṛhe vasati ye puṇyānām puṇyāḥ lokāḥ tān eva tena avarunddhe
tat yasya evam vidvān vrātyaḥ aparimitāḥ rātrīḥ atithiḥ gṛhe vasati ye eva aparimitāḥ puṇyāḥ lokāḥ tān eva tena avarunddhe
atha yasya avrātyaḥ vrātya bruvaḥ nāmabibhratī atithiḥ gṛhān āgacchet karṣet enam na ca enam karṣet
asyai devatāyai udakam yācāmi imām devatām vāsaye imām imām devatām pariveveṣmi iti enam pariveviṣyāt
tasyām eva asya tat devatāyām hutam bhavati yaḥ evam veda
sa yat prācīm diśam anuvyacalat mārutam śardhaḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat manaḥ anna ādam kṛtvā
manasā anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat dakṣiṇām diśam anuvyacalat indraḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat balam anna ādam kṛtvā
balena anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat pratīcīm diśam anuvyacalat varuṇaḥ rājā bhūtvā anuvyacalat apaḥ annādīḥ kṛtvā
adbhiḥ annādībhiḥ annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat udīcīm diśam anuvyacalat somaḥ rājā bhūtvā anuvyacalat saptarṣibhiḥ hute āhutim annādīm kṛtvā
āhutyā annādyā annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat dhruvām diśam anuvyacalat viṣṇuḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat virājam annādīm kṛtvā
virājā annādyā annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat paśūn anuvyacalat rudraḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat oṣadhīḥ annādīḥ kṛtvā
oṣadhībhiḥ annādībhiḥ annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat pitṝn anuvyacalat yamaḥ rājā bhūtvā anuvyacalat svadhākāram anna ādam kṛtvā
svadhākāreṇa annādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat manuṣyān anuvyacalat agniḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat svāhākāram anna ādam kṛtvā
svāhākāreṇa anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat ūrdhvām diśam anuvyacalat bṛhaspatiḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat vaṣaṭkāram anna ādam kṛtvā
vaṣaṭkāreṇa anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat devān anuvyacalat īśānaḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat manyum anna ādam kṛtvā
manyunā anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat prajāḥ anuvyacalat prajāpatiḥ bhūtvā anuvyacalat prāṇam anna ādam kṛtvā
prāṇena anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
sa yat sarvān antardeśān anuvyacalat parameṣṭhī bhūtvā anuvyacalat brahma anna ādam kṛtvā
brahmaṇā anna ādena annam atti yaḥ evam veda
tasya vrātyasya sapta prāṇāḥ sapta apānāḥ sapta vyānāḥ
yaḥ asya prathamaḥ prāṇaḥ ūrdhvaḥ nāma ayam saḥ agniḥ
yaḥ asya dvitīyaḥ prāṇaḥ prauḍhaḥ nāma asau saḥ ādityaḥ
yaḥ asya tṛtīyaḥ prāṇaḥ abhyūḍhaḥ nāma asau sa candramāḥ
yaḥ asya caturthaḥ prāṇaḥ vibhūḥ nāma ayam sa pavamānaḥ
yaḥ asya pañcamaḥ prāṇaḥ yoniḥ nāma tāḥ imāḥ āpaḥ
yaḥ asya ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāṇaḥ priyaḥ nāma te ime paśavaḥ
yaḥ asya saptamaḥ prāṇaḥ aparimitaḥ nāma tāḥ imāḥ prajāḥ
yaḥ asya prathamaḥ apānaḥ sā paurṇamāsī
yaḥ asya dvitīyaḥ apānaḥ sā aṣṭakā
yaḥ asya tṛtīyaḥ apānaḥ sā amāvāsyā
yaḥ asya caturthaḥ apānaḥ sā śraddhā
yaḥ asya pañcamaḥ apānaḥ sā dīkṣā
yaḥ asya ṣaṣṭhaḥ apānaḥ sa yajñaḥ
yaḥ asya saptamaḥ apānaḥ tāḥ imāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ
yaḥ asya prathamaḥ vyānaḥ sā iyam bhūmiḥ
yaḥ asya dvitīyaḥ vyānaḥ tat antarikṣam
yaḥ asya tṛtīyaḥ vyānaḥ sā dyauḥ
yaḥ asya caturthaḥ vyānaḥ tāni nakṣatrāṇi
yaḥ asya pañcamaḥ vyānaḥ te ṛtavaḥ
yaḥ asya ṣaṣṭhaḥ vyānaḥ te ārtavāḥ
yaḥ asya saptamaḥ vyānaḥ sa saṃvatsaraḥ
samānam artham pariyanti devāḥ
saṃvatsaram vai etat ṛtavaḥ anupariyanti vrātyam ca
yat ādityam abhisaṃviśanti amāvāsyām ca eva tat paurṇamāsīm ca
tat
ekam tat eṣām amṛta tvam
iti āhutiḥ eva
tasya vrātyasya
yat asya dakṣiṇam akṣi asau saḥ ādityaḥ
yat asya savyam akṣi asau sa candramāḥ
yaḥ asya dakṣiṇaḥ karṇaḥ ayam saḥ agniḥ
yaḥ asya savyaḥ karṇaḥ ayam sa pavamānaḥ
ahorātre nāsike
ditiḥ ca aditiḥ ca śīrṣa kapāle
saṃvatsaraḥ śiraḥ
ahnā pratyaṅ vrātyaḥ rātryā prāṅ
namaḥ vrātyāya
atisṛṣṭaḥ apām vṛṣabhaḥ
atisṛṣṭāḥ agnayaḥ divyāḥ rujan parirujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan mrokaḥ manaḥ hā khanaḥ nirdāhaḥ ātma dūṣiḥ tanū dūṣiḥ
idam tam atisṛjāmi
tam mā abhyavanikṣi
tena tam abhyatisṛjāmaḥ yaḥ asmān dveṣṭi yam vayam dviṣmaḥ
apām agram asi
samudram vaḥ abhyavasṛjāmi
yaḥ apsu agniḥ ati tam sṛjāmi mrokam khanim tanū dūṣim
yaḥ vaḥ āpaḥ agniḥ āviveśa saḥ eṣa
yat vaḥ ghoram tat etat
indrasya vaḥ indriyeṇa abhiṣiñcet
ariprāḥ āpaḥ
apa ripram asmat
pra asmat enaḥ vahantu
pra duṣvapnyam vahantu
śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyata apaḥ
śivayā tanvā upaspṛśata tvacam me
śivān agnīn apsuṣadaḥ havāmahe
mayi kṣatram varcaḥ ādhatta devīḥ
nir durarmaṇya ūrjā madhumatī vāk
madhumatī stha madhumatīṃ vācam udeyam
upahūto me gopāḥ upahūto gopīthaḥ
suśrutau karṇau bhadraśrutau karṇau bhadraṃ ślokaṃ śrūyāsam
suśrutiś ca mopaśrutiś ca mā hāsiṣṭāṃ sauparṇaṃ cakṣur ajasraṃ jyotiḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro 'si namo 'stu daivāya prastarāya
mūrdhā aham rayīṇām mūrdhā samānānām bhūyāsam
rujaḥ ca mā venaḥ ca mā hāsiṣṭām
mūrdhā ca mā vidharmā ca mā hāsiṣṭām
urvaḥ ca mā camasaḥ ca mā hāsiṣṭām
dhartā ca mā dharuṇaḥ ca mā hāsiṣṭām
vimokaḥ ca mā ārdra paviḥ ca mā hāsiṣṭām
ārdra dānuḥ ca mā mātariśvā ca mā hāsiṣṭām
bṛhaspatiḥ me ātmā nṛmaṇāḥ nāma hṛdyaḥ
a saṃtāpam me hṛdayam
urvī gavyūtiḥ
samudraḥ asmi vidharmaṇā
nābhiḥ aham rayīṇām nābhiḥ samānānām bhūyāsam
svāsad asi sūṣāḥ amṛtaḥ martyeṣu ā
mā mām prāṇaḥ hāsīt mā u apānaḥ avahāya parāgāt
sūryaḥ mā ahnaḥ pātu agniḥ pṛthivyāḥ vāyuḥ antarikṣāt yamaḥ manuṣyebhyaḥ sarasvatī pārthivebhyaḥ
prāṇa apānau mā mā hāsiṣṭam
mā jane prameṣi
svasti adya uṣasaḥ ca sarvaḥ āpaḥ sarva gaṇaḥ aśīya
śakvarīḥ stha
paśavaḥ mā upastheṣuḥ
mitrāvaruṇau me prāṇa apānau agniḥ me dakṣam dadhātu
vidma te svapna janitraṃ grāhyāḥ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
antako 'si mṛtyur asi
taṃ tvā svapna tathā saṃvidma sa naḥ svapna duṣvapnyāt pāhi
vidma te svapna janitraṃ nirṛtyāḥ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
vidma te svapna janitraṃ abhūtyāḥ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
vidma te svapna janitraṃ nirbhūtyāḥ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
vidma te svapna janitraṃ parābhūtyāḥ putro 'si yamasya karaṇaḥ
ajaiṣmādyāsanāmādyābhūmānāgaso vayam
uṣo yasmād duṣvapnyād abhaiṣmāpa tad ucchatu
dviṣate tat parāvaha śapate tat parāvaha
yaṃ dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tasmā enad gamayāmaḥ
uṣā devī vācā saṃvidānā vāg devy uṣasā saṃvidānā
uṣaspatir vācaspatinā saṃvidāno vācaspatir uṣaspatinā saṃvidānaḥ
te 'muṣmai parāvahantv arāyān durṇāmnaḥ sadānvāḥ
kumbhīkāḥ dūṣīkāḥ pīyakān
jāgradduṣvapnyaṃ svapne duṣvapnyam
anāgamiṣyato varān avitteḥ saṃkalpān amucyā druhaḥ pāśān
tad amuṣmā agne devāḥ parāvahantu vadhrir yathāsad vithuro na sādhuḥ
tenainaṃ vidhyāmy abhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi nirbhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi parābhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmi grāhyainaṃ vidhyāmi tamasainaṃ vidhyāmi
devānām enaṃ ghoraiḥ krūraiḥ praiṣair abhipreṣyāmi
vaiśvānarasyainaṃ daṃṣṭrayor apidadhāmi
evānevāva sā garat
yo 'smān dveṣṭi tam ātmā dveṣṭu yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ sa ātmānaṃ dveṣṭu
nir dviṣantaṃ divo niḥ pṛthivyā nir antarikṣād bhajāma
suyāmaṃś cākṣuṣa
idam aham āmuṣyāyaṇe 'muṣyāḥ putre duṣvapnyaṃ mṛje
yad ado ado abhyagacchaṃ yad doṣā yat pūrvāṃ rātrim
yaj jāgrad yat supto yad divā yan naktam
yad aharahar abhigacchāmi tasmād enam avadaye

mā te mano māsor māṅgānāṃ mā rasasya te
mā te hāsta tanvaḥ kiṃcaneha
mā tvā vṛkṣaḥ saṃ bādhiṣṭa mā devī pṛthivī mahī
lokaṃ pitṛṣu vittvaidhasva yamarājasu
yat te aṅgam atihitaṃ parācair apānaḥ prāṇo ya u vā te paretaḥ
tat te saṃgatya pitaraḥ sanīḍā ghāsād ghāsaṃ punar ā veśayantu
apemaṃ jīvā arudhan gṛhebhyas taṃ nir vahata pari grāmād itaḥ
mṛtyur yamasyāsīd dūtaḥ pracetā asūn pitṛbhyo gamayāṃcakāra
ye dasyavaḥ pitṛṣu praviṣṭā jñātimukhā ahutādaś caranti
parāpuro nipuro ye bharanty agniṣ ṭān asmāt pra dhamāti yajñāt
saṃ viśantv iha pitaraḥ svā naḥ syonaṃ kṛṇvantaḥ pratiranta āyuḥ
tebhyaḥ śakema haviṣā nakṣamāṇā jyog jīvantaḥ śaradaḥ purūcīḥ
yāṃ te dhenuṃ nipṛṇāmi yam u kṣīraudanam
tenā janasyāso bhartā yo 'trāsad ajīvanaḥ
aśvāvatīṃ pra tara yā suśevarkṣākaṃ vā prataraṃ navīyaḥ
yas tvā jaghāna vadhyaḥ so astu mā so anyad vidata bhāgadheyam
yamaḥ paro 'varo vivasvān tataḥ paraṃ nāti paśyāmi kiṃcana
yame adhvaro adhi me niviṣṭo bhuvo vivasvān anvātatāna
apāgūhann amṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvā savarṇām adadhur vivasvate
utāśvināv abharad yat tad āsīd ajahād u dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ
ye nikhātā ye paroptā ye dagdhā ye coddhitāḥ
sarvāṃs tān agna ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante
tvaṃ tān vettha yadi te jātavedaḥ svadhayā yajñaṃ svadhitiṃ juṣantām
śaṃ tapa māti tapo agne mā tanvaṃ tapaḥ
vaneṣu śuṣmo astu te pṛthivyām astu yaddharaḥ
dadāmy asmā avasānam etad ya eṣa āgan mama ced abhūd iha
yamaś cikitvān praty etad āha mamaiṣa rāya upa tiṣṭhatām iha
imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
śate śaratsu no purā
premāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
apemāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
vīmāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
nir imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
ud imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
sam imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai
amāsi mātrāṃ svar agām āyuṣmān bhūyāsam
yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
prāṇo apāno vyāna āyuś cakṣur dṛśaye sūryāya
aparipareṇa pathā yamarājñaḥ pitṝn gaccha
ye agravaḥ śaśamānāḥ pareyur hitvā dveṣāṃsy anapatyavantaḥ
te dyām udityāvidanta lokaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi dīdhyānāḥ
udanvatī dyaur avamā pīlumatīti madhyamā
tṛtīyā ha pradyaur iti yasyāṃ pitara āsate
ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā ya āviviśur urv antarikṣam
ya ākṣiyanti pṛthivīm uta dyāṃ tebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo namasā vidhema
idam id vā u nāparaṃ divi paśyasi sūryam
mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhy enaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
idam id vā u nāparaṃ jarasy anyad ito 'param
jāyā patim iva vāsasābhy enaṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
abhi tvorṇomi pṛthivyā mātur vastreṇa bhadrayā
jīveṣu bhadraṃ tan mayi svadhā pitṛṣu sā tvayi
agnīṣomā pathikṛtā syonaṃ devebhyo ratnaṃ dadhathur vi lokam
upa preṣyantaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ yo vahāty añjoyānaiḥ pathibhis tatra gacchatam
pūṣā tvetaś cyāvayatu pra vidvān anaṣṭapaśur bhuvanasya gopāḥ
sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadat pitṛbhyo 'gnir devebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ
āyur viśvāyuḥ pari pātu tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt
yatrāsate sukṛto yatra ta īyus tatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
imau yunajmi te vahnī asunītāya voḍhave
tābhyāṃ yamasya sādanaṃ samitīś cāva gacchatāt
etat tvā vāsaḥ prathamaṃ nv āgann apaitad ūha yad ihābibhaḥ purā
iṣṭāpūrtam anusaṃkrāma vidvān yatra te dattaṃ bahudhā vibandhuṣu
agner varma pari gobhir vyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva medasā pīvasā ca
net tvā dhṛṣṇur harasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛg vidhakṣan parīṅkhayātai
daṇḍaṃ hastād ādadāno gatāsoḥ saha śrotreṇa varcasā balena
atraiva tvam iha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā mṛdho abhimātīr jayema
dhanuḥ hastāt ādadānaḥ mṛtasya saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena samāgṛbhāya vasu bhūri puṣṭam
arvāṅ tvam ehi upa jīva lokam
iyaṃ nārī patilokaṃ vṛṇānā ni padyata upa tvā martya pretam
dharmaṃ purāṇam anupālayantī tasyai prajāṃ draviṇaṃ ceha dhehi
ud īrṣva nāry abhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsum etam upa śeṣa ehi
hastagrābhasya dadhiṣos tavedaṃ patyur janitvam abhi saṃ babhūtha
apaśyaṃ yuvatiṃ nīyamānāṃ jīvāṃ mṛtebhyaḥ pariṇīyamānām
andhena yat tamasā prāvṛtāsīt prākto apācīm anayaṃ tad enām
prajānaty aghnye jīvalokaṃ devānāṃ panthām anusaṃcarantī
ayaṃ te gopatis taṃ juṣasva svargaṃ lokam adhi rohayainam
upa dyām upa vetasam avattaro nadīnām
agne pittam apām asi
yaṃ tvam agne samadahas tam u nir vāpaya punaḥ
kyāmbūr atra rohatu śāṇḍadūrvā vyalkaśā
idaṃ ta ekam pura ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva
saṃveśane tanvā cārur edhi priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe
ut tiṣṭha prehi pra dravaukaḥ kṛṇuṣva salile sadhasthe
tatra tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ saṃ somena madasva saṃ svadhābhiḥ
pra cyavasva tanvaṃ saṃ bharasva mā te gātrā vi hāyi mo śarīram
mano niviṣṭam anusaṃviśasva yatra bhūmer juṣase tatra gaccha
varcasā māṃ pitaraḥ somyāso añjantu devā madhunā ghṛtena
cakṣuṣe mā prataraṃ tārayanto jarase mā jaradaṣṭiṃ vardhantu
varcasā māṃ sam anaktv agnir medhāṃ me viṣṇur ny anaktv āsan
rayiṃ me viśve ni yacchantu devāḥ syonā māpaḥ pavanaiḥ punantu
mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām ādityā mā svaravo vardhayantu
varco ma indro ny anaktu hastayor jaradaṣṭiṃ mā savitā kṛṇotu
yo mamāra prathamo martyānāṃ yaḥ preyāya prathamo lokam etam
parā yāta pitara ā ca yātāyaṃ vo yajño madhunā samaktaḥ
datto asmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta
kaṇvaḥ kakṣīvān purumīḍho agastyaḥ śyāvāśvaḥ sobhary arcanānāḥ
viśvāmitro 'yaṃ jamadagnir atrir avantu naḥ kaśyapo vāmadevaḥ
viśvāmitra jamadagne vasiṣṭha bharadvāja gotama vāmadeva
śardir no atrir agrabhīn namobhiḥ susaṃśāsaḥ pitaro mṛḍatā naḥ
kasye mṛjānā ati yanti ripram āyur dadhānāḥ prataraṃ navīyaḥ
āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanenādha syāma surabhayo gṛheṣu
añjate vy añjate sam añjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhy añjate
sindhor ucchvāse patayantam ukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśum āsu gṛhṇate
yad vo mudraṃ pitaraḥ somyaṃ ca teno sacadhvaṃ svayaśaso hi bhūta
te arvāṇaḥ kavaya ā śṛṇota suvidatrā vidathe hūyamānāḥ
ye atrayo aṅgiraso navagvā iṣṭāvanto rātiṣāco dadhānāḥ
dakṣiṇāvantaḥ sukṛto ya u sthāsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam
adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtam āśaśānāḥ
śucīd ayan dīdhyata ukthaśasaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīr apa vran
sukarmānaḥ suruco devayanto ayo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ
śucanto agniṃ vāvṛdhanta indram urvīm gavyāṃ pariṣadaṃ no akran
ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyad devānāṃ janimānty ugraḥ
martāsaś cid urvaśīr akṛpran vṛdhe cid arya uparasyāyoḥ
akarma te svapaso abhūma ṛtam avasrann uṣaso vibhātīḥ
viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yad avanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
indro mā marutvān prācyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
dhātā mā nirṛtyā dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāṃ ivopari
aditir mādityaiḥ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
somo mā viśvair devair udīcyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
dhartā ha tvā dharuṇo dhārayātā ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā dyām ivopari
prācyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
dakṣiṇāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
pratīcyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
udīcyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
dhruvāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
ūrdhvāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyām ā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyām ivopari
dhartāsi dharuṇo 'si vaṃsago 'si
udapūr asi madhupūr asi vātapūr asi
itaś ca māmutaś cāvatāṃ yame iva yatamāne yad aitam
pra vāṃ bharan mānuṣā devayanto ā sīdatāṃ svam u lokaṃ vidāne
svāsasthe bhavatam indave no yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhiḥ
vi śloka eti pathyeva sūriḥ śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtāsa etat
trīṇi padāni rūpo anv arohac catuṣpadīm anv etad vratena
akṣareṇa prati mimīte arkam ṛtasya nābhāv abhi saṃ punāti
devebhyaḥ kam avṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kim amṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta
bṛhaspatir yajñam atanuta ṛṣiḥ priyāṃ yamas tanvam ā rireca
tvam agna īḍito jātavedo 'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā
prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣann addhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi
āsīnāso aruṇīnām upasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya
putrebhyaḥ pitaras tasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta
agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ
atto havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣi rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta
upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu
ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantv adhi bruvantu te 'vantv asmān
ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā anūjahire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ
tebhir yamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣy uśann uśadbhiḥ pratikāmam attu
ye tātṛṣur devatrā jehamānā hotrāvidaḥ stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ
āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ satyaiḥ kavibhir ṛṣibhir gharmasadbhiḥ
ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ tureṇa
āgne yāhi suvidatrebhir arvāṅ paraiḥ pūrvair ṛṣibhir gharmasadbhiḥ
upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmim etām uruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām
ūrṇamradāḥ pṛthivī dakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt
ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpasarpaṇā
ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām
te gṛhāso ghṛtaścutaḥ syonā viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santv atra
ut te stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvat parīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhan mo aham riṣam
etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayanti te tatra yamaḥ sādanā te kṛṇotu
imam agne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānām uta somyānām
ayaṃ yaś camaso devapānas tasmin devā amṛtā mādayantām
atharvā pūrṇam camasam yam indrāyābibhar vājinīvate
tasmin kṛṇoti sukṛtasya bhakṣaṃ tasmin induḥ pavate viśvadānim
yat te kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ
agniṣ ṭad viśvād agadaṃ kṛṇotu somaś ca yo brāhmaṇāṁ āviveśa
payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ payaḥ
apāṃ payaso yat payas tena mā saha śumbhatu
imā nārīr avidhavāḥ supatnīr āñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ spṛśantām
anaśravo anamīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonim agre
saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman
hitvāvadyaṃ punar astam ehi saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā suvarcāḥ
tebhyaḥ svarāḍ asunītir no adya yathāvaśaṃ tanvaḥ kalpayāti
śaṃ te nīhāro bhavatu śaṃ te pruṣvāva śīyatām
śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati
maṇḍūky apsu śaṃ bhuva imaṃ sv agniṃ śamaya
vivasvān no abhayaṃ kṛṇotu yaḥ sutrāmā jīradānuḥ sudānuḥ
iheme vīrā bahavo bhavantu gomad aśvavan mayy astu puṣṭam
vivasvān no amṛtatve dadhātu paraitu mṛtyur amṛtaṃ na aitu
imān rakṣatu puruṣān ā jarimṇo mo sv eṣām asavo yamaṃ guḥ
yo dadhre antarikṣe na mahnā pitṝṇāṃ kaviḥ pramatir matīnām
tam arcata viśvamitrā havirbhiḥ sa no yamaḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhāt
ā rohata divam uttamām ṛṣayo mā bibhītana
somapāḥ somapāyina idaṃ vaḥ kriyate havir aganma jyotir uttamam
pra ketunā bṛhatā bhāty agnir ā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti
divaś cid antād upa mām ud ānaḍ apām upasthe mahiṣo vavardha
nāke suparṇam upa yat patantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā
hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yonau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum
indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā
śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotir aśīmahi
apūpāpihitān kumbhān yāṃs te devā adhārayan
te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ
yās te dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ
tās te santu vibhvīḥ prabhvīs tās te yamo rājānu manyatām
punar dehi vanaspate ya eṣa nihitas tvayi
yathā yamasya sādana āsātai vidathā vadan
ā rabhasva jātavedas tejasvaddharo astu te
śarīram asya saṃ dahāthainaṃ dhehi sukṛtām u loke
ye te pūrve parāgatā apare pitaraś ca ye
tebhyo ghṛtasya kulyaitu śatadhārā vyundatī
etad ā roha vaya unmṛjānaḥ svā iha bṛhad u dīdayante
abhi prehi madhyato māpa hāsthāḥ pitṝṇāṃ lokaṃ prathamo yo atra
ā rohata janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ pitṛyānaiḥ saṃ va ā rohayāmi
avāḍḍhavyeṣito havyavāha ījānaṃ yuktāḥ sukṛtāṃ dhatta loke
devā yajñam ṛtavaḥ kalpayanti haviḥ puroḍāśaṃ sruco yajñāyudhāni
tebhir yāhi pathibhir devayānair yair ījānāḥ svargaṃ yanti lokam
ṛtasya panthām anu paśya sādhv aṅgirasaḥ sukṛto yena yanti
tebhir yāhi pathibhiḥ svargaṃ yatrādityā madhu bhakṣayanti tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayasva
trayaḥ suparṇā uparasya māyū nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi viṣṭapi śritāḥ
svargā lokā amṛtena viṣṭhā iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya duhrām
juhūr dādhāra dyām upabhṛd antarikṣaṃ dhruvā dādhāra pṛthivīṃ pratiṣṭhām
pratīmāṃ lokā ghṛtapṛṣṭhāḥ svargāḥ kāmaṃ kāmaṃ yajamānāya duhrām
dhruva ā roha pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasam antarikṣam upabhṛd ā kramasva
juhu dyāṃ gaccha yajamānena sākaṃ sruveṇa vatsena diśaḥ prapīnāḥ sarvā dhukṣvāhṛṇīyamānaḥ
tīrthais taranti pravato mahīr iti yajñakṛtaḥ sukṛto yena yanti
atrādadhur yajamānāya lokaṃ diśo bhūtāni yad akalpayanta
aṅgirasām ayanaṃ pūrvo agnir ādityānām ayanaṃ gārhapatyo dakṣiṇānām ayanaṃ dakṣiṇāgniḥ
mahimānam agner vihitasya brahmaṇā samaṅgaḥ sarva upa yāhi śagmaḥ
pūrvo agniṣ ṭvā tapatu śaṃ purastāc chaṃ paścāt tapatu gārhapatyaḥ
dakṣiṇāgniṣ ṭe tapatu śarma varmottarato madhyato antarikṣād diśodiśo agne pari pāhi ghorāt
yūyam agne śaṃtamābhis tanūbhir ījānam abhi lokaṃ svargam
aśvā bhūtvā pṛṣṭivāho vahātha yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti
śam agne paścāt tapa śaṃ purastāc cham uttarāc cham adharāt tapainam
ekas tredhā vihito jātavedaḥ samyag enaṃ dhehi sukṛtām u loke
śam agnayaḥ samiddhā ā rabhantāṃ prājāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ
śṛtaṃ kṛṇvanta iha māva cikṣipan
yajña eti vitataḥ kalpamāna ījānam abhi lokaṃ svargam
tam agnayaḥ sarvahutaṃ juṣantāṃ prājāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ
ījānaś citam ārukṣad agniṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhād divam utpatiṣyan
tasmai pra bhāti nabhaso jyotiṣīmānt svargaḥ panthāḥ sukṛte devayānaḥ
agnir hotādhvaryuṣ ṭe bṛhaspatir indro brahmā dakṣiṇatas te astu
huto 'yaṃ saṃsthito yajña eti yatra pūrvam ayanaṃ hutānām

tāsām api ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ patanaṃ doṣakārakam
yatoyato vikārāḥ syur nipatanty atimātraśaḥ
tatastato nṛpo yāyād daivo mārgaḥ sa ucyate
nimitteṣu mahāśāntim ulkāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
kṛtvā siddhim avāpnoti ulkādoṣāc ca mucyate
oṃ puruṣaḥ putradāraṃ vā dhanadhānyam athāpi vā
nimittair yair vinaśyeta śāntiṃ tatra nibodhata
indrāyudhaṃ bhavet rātrau dṛśyate yasya kasya cit
darvī kare vā bhidyeta maṇiḥ kumbhas tathaiva ca
chattraṃ śayyāsanaṃ caivānyat vāpi svayaṃ kva cit
strī hanyāc ca striyaṃ vāpi gaur avaghret ulūkhalam
śvā pibet gām anaḍvāhaṃ kaliḥ saṃpadyate kule
gajavājino mriyante vivādo rājakīyakaḥ
kuṭumbam aśubhaṃ sarvam aindrāṇy etāni nirdiśet
śāmyanti yena sarvāṇi nirvapet pāyasaṃ carum
samāvapya ghṛtaṃ tatrāhutiṃ juhuyād imām
indram id devatātaye sthālīpākasya homayet
indraḥ śacīpatiḥ śakro vajrapāṇiḥ sureśvaraḥ
sarvādbhutānāṃ śamano mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā
hutvā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ caiva carutantraṃ samāpayet
vimuktotpātadoṣas tu jīvet tu śaradaḥ śatam
uddīpikā gṛhe yasya valmīkā madhujālakam
abjānāṃ maṇike śabde tailaṃ sthīyata eva vā
aśubhā vikṛtir dadhnāṃ dugdhānāṃ vā yadā bhavet
akasmāt ca praroheyur bījāni kṛmayas tathā
kāryo varuṇayāgas tu vāruṇīvidhipūrvakaḥ
ud uttamaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt pañcājyāhutayas tathā
varuṇaḥ pāśapāṇiś ca yādasāṃ patir eva ca
śeṣaṃ tu pūrvavac caiva carutantraṃ samāpayet
gṛhe yasya pated gṛdhra ulūko vā kathaṃcana
kapotaḥ praviśet caiva jīvā vāraṇyasaṃbhavāḥ
dhuryau ca patato yuktau gostrījanma ca vaikṛtam
jāyante yamalāny eva ghoraḥ svapnaś ca dṛśyate
abhidravanti rakṣāṃsi yatra caiva kumārakān
unnidrako 'tinidro vātyalpam atibhojanam
ālasyaṃ caivam eteṣāṃ devatā yama ucyate
nāke suparṇam iti etat sthālīpākasya homayet
yamaḥ pretapatiś caiva daṇḍapāṇis tatheśvaraḥ
śamanaḥ sarvādbhutānām ...
anagnir utthito yasya dhūmo vāpi gṛhe kvacit
āmaṃ vā jvalate māṃsaṃ bhaveyur visphuliṅgakāḥ
chattradhvajapatākāś ca jvalante toraṇāni ca
āsanaṃ caiva śayyā ca vastrāṇi kusumāni ca
hastyaśvānāṃ ca pucchāni varṣaty aṅgāravarṣaṇam
akāle ca diśāṃ dāha oṣadhīnāṃ ca pācanam
hastinyaś caiva madyante agnirūpaṃ tad adbhutam
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe sthālīpākasya homayet
agnir hiraṇyapatiś ca arciṣpāṇis tatheśvaraḥ
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vajraṃ vaiḍūryaṃ mauktikāni ca
pravālavastranāśaś ca mitrāṇāṃ ca viparyayaḥ
ārambhāś ca vipadyante na siddhiḥ karmaṇām api
carur vaiśravaṇas tatra abhi tyaṃ devam ṛk smṛtā
vaiśravaṇo yakṣapatir arthapāṇis tatheśvaraḥ
atha yasya svanakṣatra ulkā nirghāta eva vā
rāhur grasati candrārkau kabandhaṃ darpaṇe bhavet
patet svayaṃ vā musalaṃ devatā vā kathaṃcana
unmīlate caiva yadā tathā cāpi nimīlate
pracchidyate ca yadi vā tathā vāpi prakampate
prayāto vāpi dṛśyeta pratisroto nadī vahet
vimale naiva arkachāyā pratīpā vāpi tu sāyakāḥ
pariveṣas tv anabhreṣu dṛśyate candrasūryayoḥ
kośāt khaḍgā nirgirante tūṇāc caiva tu sāyakāḥ
anāhatāni vādyante nadante śabdam āturam
caruṇā vaiṣṇavenaiṣāṃ yāgaḥ kartavya eva tu
idaṃ viṣṇuḥ pradhānaṃ syāt pañcājyāhutayas tathā
sarvabhūtapatir viṣṇuś cakrapāṇis tatheśvaraḥ
ativāto yatra bhavet rūpaṃ vā yatra vaikṛtam
kharakarabhamahiṣā varāhā vyāghrasiṃhakāḥ
gṛdhrāś ca tathā gomāyuḥ kṛkalāsā vadanti ca
māṃsapeśaṃ ca rudhiraṃ pāṃsuvṛṣṭis tathaiva ca
vāyurūpam idaṃ sarvam adbhutaṃ parikīrtitam
vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ vāyav ā yāhi darśata iti sthālīpākasya homayet
vāyur mahān nabhapatir vajrapāṇis tatheśvaraḥ
śamanaḥ sarvādbhutānāṃ mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā
atha ced anyaśākhāsu kartā bhavati vedavit
japtvā sa ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śatamātraṃ samāhitaḥ
gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ
vācayet tam upādhyāyaṃ vastreṇa kanakena vā
dṛṣṭaṃ caivādbhutaṃ yasmiṃs tac cāpi pratipādayet
etās tu dakṣiṇāḥ sarvāḥ śaktiyukto na hāpayet
yajamānas tatsuto vā yaḥ svayaṃ kartum arhati
brāhmaṇāya viśeṣeṇa dadyāt tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām
japtvātharvaśiraś caiva kuryād vipreṣu pūjanam
śaktyātha bhojanaṃ caiva kuryād vipreṣu pūjanam
etad evaṃ samākhyātam adbhutānāṃ viśodhanam
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ yaḥ kuryāt śraddhayānvitaḥ
maraṇaṃ na bhavet tasya na duḥkhaṃ na daridratā
sidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi dharme cāsya matir bhavet
etat puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca devatāyāgapūjanam
sarvaśāntikaṃ caiva pratipuruṣaṃ nibodhata
buddho bhagavān satkṛto gurukṛto mānitaḥ pūjito rājabhī rājamātrair dhanibhiḥ pauraiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ sārthavāhair devair nāgair yakṣair asurair garuḍaiḥ kinnarair mahoragair iti devanāgayakṣāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragābhyarcito buddho bhagavān jñāto mahāpuṇyo lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārāṇāṃ saśrāvakasaṃgho rājagṛham upaniśritya viharati veṇuvane kalandakanivāpe
tatra bhagavato 'cirābhisaṃbuddhabodher yaśasā ca sarvaloka āpūrṇaḥ
atha dakṣiṇāgiriṣu janapade saṃpūrṇo nāma brāhmaṇamahāśālaḥ prativasati āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogo vistīrṇaviśālaparigraho vaiśravaṇadhanasamudito vaiśravaṇadhanapratispardhī
sa ca śrāddho bhadraḥ kalyāṇāśaya ātmahitaparahitapratipannaḥ kāruṇiko mahātmā dharmakāmaḥ prajāvatsalas tyāgaruciḥ pradānaruciḥ pradānābhirato mahati tyāge vartate
yāvad asau sarvapāṣaṇḍikaṃ yajñam ārabdho yaṣṭum yatrānekāni tīrthikaśatasahasrāṇi bhuñjate sma
yadā bhagavatā rājā bimbisāraḥ saparivāro vinītaḥ tasya ca vinayād bahūni prāṇiśatasahasrāṇi vinayam upagatāni tadā rājagṛhāt pūrṇasya jñātayo 'bhyāgatya pūrṇasya purastād buddhasya varṇaṃ bhāṣayituṃ pravṛttā dharmasya saṃghasya ca
atha pūrṇo brāhmaṇamahāśālo bhagavato guṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ pratiśrutya mahāntaṃ prasādaṃ pratilabdhavān
tataḥ śaraṇam abhiruhya rājagṛhābhimukhaḥ sthitvā ubhau jānumaṇḍale pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya puṣpāṇi kṣipan dhūpam udakaṃ ca bhagavantam āyācituṃ pravṛttaḥ āgacchatu bhagavān yajñaṃ me anubhavituṃ yajñavāṭam iti
atha tāni puṣpāṇi buddhānāṃ buddhānubhāvena devatānāṃ ca devatānubhāvenopari bhagavataḥ puṣpamaṇḍapaṃ kṣiptvā tasthuḥ dhūpo 'bhrakūṭavad udakaṃ vaiḍūryaśalākavat
athāyuṣmān ānandaḥ kṛtakarapuṭo bhagavantaṃ papraccha kuta idaṃ bhadanta nimantraṇam āyātam iti
bhagavān āha dakṣiṇāgiriṣv ānanda janapade saṃpūrṇo nāma brāhmaṇamahāśālaḥ prativasati tatrāsmābhir gantavyam sajjībhavantu bhikṣava iti
bhagavān bhikṣusahasraparivṛtto dakṣiṇāgiriṣu janapade cārikāṃ caritvā pūrṇasya brāhmaṇamahāśālasya yajñavāṭasamīpe sthitvā cintām āpede yannvahaṃ pūrṇabrāhmaṇam ṛddhiprātihāryeṇāvarjayeyam iti
atha bhagavāṃs taṃ bhikṣusahasram antardhāpya ekaḥ pātracarakavyagrahastaḥ pūrṇasamīpe sthitaḥ
atha pūrṇo brāhmaṇamahāśālo bhagavantaṃ dadarśa dvātriṃśatā mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam aśītyā cānuvyañjanair virājitagātraṃ vyāmaprabhālaṃkṛtaṃ sūryasahasrātirekaprabhaṃ jaṅgamam iva ratnaparvataṃ samantato bhadrakam
dṛṣṭvā ca punas tvaritatvaritaṃ bhagavataḥ samīpam upasaṃkramya bhagavantam uvāca svāgataṃ bhagavan niṣīdatu bhagavān kriyatāṃ āsanaparigraho mamānugrahārtham iti
bhagavān āha yadi te parityaktaṃ dīyatām asmin pātra iti
atha pūrṇo brāhmaṇamahāśālaḥ pañcamāṇavakaśataparivṛto bhagavato vividhabhakṣyabhojyakhādyalehyapeyacoṣyādibhir āhārair ārabdhaḥ pātraṃ paripūrayitum
bhagavān api svakāt pātrād bhikṣupātreṣv āhāraṃ saṃkramayati
yadā bhagavato viditaṃ pūrṇāni bhikṣusahasrasya pātrāṇīti tadā svapātraṃ pūrṇam ādarśitam
tato bhikṣusahasraṃ pūrṇapātram ardhacandrākāreṇa darśitavān
devatābhir apy ākāśasthābhiḥ śabdam udīritam pūrṇāni bhagavato bhikṣusahasrasya ca pātrāṇīti
tataḥ prātihāryadarśanāt pūrṇaḥ prasādajāto mūlanikṛtta iva drumo hṛṣṭatuṣṭapramuditaḥ udagraprītisaumanasyajāto bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatya praṇidhiṃ kartum ārabdhaḥ anenāhaṃ kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca andhe loke anāyake apariṇāyake buddho bhūyāsam atīrṇānāṃ sattvānāṃ tārayitā amuktānāṃ mocayitā anāśvastānām āśvāsayitā aparinirvṛtānāṃ parinirvāpayiteti
atha bhagavān pūrṇasya brāhmaṇamahāśālasya hetuparaṃparāṃ karmaparaṃparāṃ ca jñātvā smitaṃ prāvirakārṣīt
dharmatā khalu yasmin samaye buddhā bhagavantaḥ smitaṃ prāviṣkurvanti tasmin samaye nīlapītalohitāvadātā arciṣo mukhān niścārya kāścid adhastād gacchanti kāścid upariṣṭād gacchanti
yā adhastād gacchanti tāḥ saṃjīvaṃ kālasūtraṃ saṃghātaṃ rauravaṃ mahārauravaṃ tapanaṃ pratāpanam avīcim arbudaṃ nirarbudaṃ aṭaṭaṃ hahavaṃ huhuvam utpalaṃ padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ narakān gatvā ye uṣṇanarakās teṣu śītībhūtā nipatanti ye śītanarakās teṣu uṣṇībhūtā nipatanti
tena teṣāṃ sattvānāṃ kāraṇāviśeṣāḥ pratiprasrabhyante
teṣām evaṃ bhavati kiṃ nu vayaṃ bhavanta itaś cyutāḥ āhosvid anyatropapannā iti
teṣāṃ prasādasaṃjananārthaṃ bhagavān nirmitaṃ visarjayati
teṣāṃ nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhavati na hyeva vayaṃ bhavantaḥ itaś cyutāḥ nāpy anyatropapannāḥ api tv ayam apūrvadarśanaḥ sattvaḥ asyānubhāvenāsmākaṃ kāraṇāviśeṣāḥ pratiprasrabdhā iti
te nirmite cittam abhiprasādya tan narakavedanīyaṃ karma kṣapayitvā devamanuṣyeṣu pratisandhiṃ gṛhṇanti yatra satyānāṃ bhājanabhūtā bhavanti
yā upariṣṭād gacchanti tāś cāturmahārājikāṃs trayastriṃśān yāmāṃs tuṣitān nirmāṇaratīn paranirmitavaśavartino brahmakāyikān brahmapurohitān mahābrahmaṇaḥ parīttābhān apramāṇābhān ābhāsvarān parīttaśubhān apramāṇaśubhāñ śubhakṛtsnān anabhrakān puṇyaprasavān bṛhatphalān abṛhān atapān sudṛśān sudarśanān akaniṣṭhān devān gatvā anityaṃ duḥkhaṃ śūnyam anātmety udghoṣayanti gāthādvayaṃ ca bhāṣante
ārabhadhvaṃ niṣkrāmata yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane
dhunīta mṛtyunaḥ sainyaṃ naḍāgāram iva kuñjaraḥ
yo hy asmin dharmavinaye apramattaś cariṣyati
prahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ kariṣyati
atha tā arciṣas trisāhasramahāsāhasraṃ lokadhātum anvāhiṇḍya bhagavantam eva pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ samanugacchanti
tad yadi bhagavān atītaṃ karma vyākartukāmo bhavati bhagavataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'ntardhīyante
anāgataṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati purastād antardhīyante
narakopapattiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati pādatale 'ntardhīyante
tiryagupapattiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati pārṣṇyām antardhīyante
pretopapattiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati pādāṅguṣṭhe 'ntardhīyante
manuṣyopapattiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati jānunor antardhīyante
balacakravartirājyaṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati vāme karatale 'ntardhīyante
cakravartirājyaṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati dakṣiṇe karatale 'ntardhīyante
devopapattiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati nābhyām antardhīyante
śrāvakabodhiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati āsye 'ntardhīyante
pratyekabodhiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati ūrṇāyām antardhīyante
anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhiṃ vyākartukāmo bhavati uṣṇīṣe antardhīyante
atha tā arciṣo bhagavantaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavata uṣṇīṣe 'ntarhitāḥ
athāyuṣmān ānandaḥ kṛtakarapuṭo bhagavantaṃ papraccha
nānāvidho raṅgasahasracitro vaktrāntarān niṣkasitaḥ kalāpaḥ
avabhāsitā yena diśaḥ samantād divākareṇodayatā yathaiva
gāthāḥ ca bhāṣate
vigatodbhavā dainyamadaprahīṇā buddhā jagaty uttamahetubhūtāḥ
nākāraṇaṃ śaṅkhamṛṇālagauraṃ smitam upadarśayanti jinā jitārayaḥ
tatkālaṃ svayam adhigamya vīra buddhyā śrotṝṇāṃ śramaṇa jinendra kāṅkṣitānām
dhīrābhir munivṛṣa vāgbhir uttamābhir utpannaṃ vyapanaya saṃśayaṃ śubhābhiḥ
nākasmāllavaṇajalādrirājadhairyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ smitam upadarśayanti nāthāḥ
yasya arthe smitam upadarśayanti dhīrāḥ tam śrotum samabhilaṣanti te jana oghāḥ
bhagavān āha evam etad ānanda evam etat
nāhetvapratyayam ānanda tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāḥ smitaṃ prāviṣkurvanti
eṣa ānanda pūrṇo brāhmaṇamahāśālaḥ
anena kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca trikalpāsaṃkhyeyasamudānītāṃ bodhiṃ samudānīya mahākaruṇāparibhāvitāḥ ṣaṭ pāramitāḥ paripūrya pūrṇabhadro nāma samyaksaṃbuddho bhaviṣyati daśabhir balaiś caturbhir vaiśāradyais tribhir āveṇikaiḥ smṛtyupasthānair mahākaruṇayā ca
ayam asya deyadharmo yo mamāntike cittaprasāda iti
bhūyas ca anena citrāṇi kuśala mūlāni samavaropitāni
tasmāt tarhi bhikṣava evaṃ śikṣitavyaṃ yacchāstāraṃ satkariṣyāmo gurukariṣyāmo mānayiṣyāmaḥ pūjayiṣyāmaḥ śāstāraṃ satkṛtya gurukṛtya mānayitvā pūjayitvopaniśritya vihariṣyāmaḥ
ity evaṃ vo bhikṣavaḥ śikṣitavyam
idam avocat bhagavān
ātta manasaḥ te bhikṣavaḥ bhagavataḥ bhāṣitam abhyanandan
buddho bhagavān satkṛto gurukṛto mānitaḥ pūjito rājabhī rājamātrair dhanibhiḥ pauraiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ sārthavāhair devair nāgair yakṣair asurair garuḍaiḥ kinnarair mahoragair iti devanāgayakṣāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragābhyarcito buddho bhagavān jñāto mahāpuṇyo lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārāṇāṃ saśrāvakasaṃgho vaiśālīm upaniśritya viharati markaṭahradatīre kūṭāgāraśālāyām
atha pūrvāhṇe nivāsya pātracīvaram ādāya bhikṣugaṇaparivṛto bhikṣusaṃghapuraskṛto vaiśālīṃ piṇḍāya prāvikṣat
sāvadānīṃ vaiśālīṃ piṇḍāya caritvā yena siṃhasya senāpater niveśanaṃ tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
upasaṃkramya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ
atha siṃhasya senāpateḥ snuṣā yaśomatī nāma abhirūpā darśanīyā prāsādikā
sā bhagavato vicitralakṣaṇojjvalakāyaṃ dṛṣṭvā atyarthaṃ prasādaṃ labdhavatī
sā śvaśuraṃ papraccha asti kaścid upāyo yenāham apy evaṃguṇayuktā syām iti
atha siṃhasya senāpater etad abhavat udārādhimuktā bateyaṃ dārikā
yadi punar iyaṃ pratyayam āsādayet kuryād anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau praṇidhānam iti viditvoktavān dārike yadi hetuṃ samādāya vartiṣyasi tvam apy evaṃvidhā bhaviṣyasi yādṛśo bhagavān iti
tataḥ siṃhena senāpatinā yaśomatyāḥ prasādābhivṛddhyarthaṃ prabhūtaṃ hiraṇyasuvarṇaṃ ratnāni ca dattāni
tato yaśomatyā dārikayā bhagavān saśrāvakasaṃghaḥ śvo 'ntargṛhe bhaktenopanimantritaḥ
adhivāsitaṃ ca bhagavatā tasyā anugrahārtham
atha yaśomatī dārikā suvarṇamayāni puṣpāṇi kārayitvā rūpyamayāṇi ratnamayāni prabhūtagandhamālyavilepanasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā śatarasam āhāraṃ sajjīkṛtya bhagavato dūtena kālam ārocayati samayo bhadanta sajjaṃ bhaktaṃ yasyedānīṃ bhagavān kālaṃ manyata iti
atha bhagavān bhikṣugaṇaparivṛto bhikṣusaṃghapuraskṛto yena siṃhasya senāpater niveśanaṃ tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
upasaṃkramya purastād bhikṣusaṃghasya prajñapta evāsane niṣaṇṇaḥ
atha yaśomatī dārikā sukhopaniṣaṇṇaṃ buddhapramukhaṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ viditvā śatarasenāhāreṇa svahastaṃ saṃtarpya puṣpāṇi bhagavati kṣeptum ārabdhā
atha tāni puṣpāṇi upari bhagavato ratnakūṭāgāro ratnacchatraṃ ratnamaṇḍapa ivāvasthitam yanna śakyaṃ suśikṣitena karmakāreṇa karmāntevāsinā vā kartum yathāpi tad buddhānāṃ buddhānubhāvena devatānāṃ ca devānubhāvena
atha yaśomatī dārikā tad atyadbhutaṃ devamanuṣyāvarjanakaraṃ prātihāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūlanikṛtta iva drumaḥ sarvaśarīreṇa bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatya praṇidhānaṃ kartum ārabdhā anenāhaṃ kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca andhe loke anāyake apariṇāyake buddho bhūyāsam atīrṇānāṃ sattvānāṃ tārayitā amuktānāṃ mocayitā anāśvastānām āśvāsayitā aparinirvṛtānāṃ parinirvāpayiteti
atha bhagavān yaśomatyā dārikāyā hetuparaṃparāṃ karmaparaṃparāṃ ca jñātvā smitaṃ prāvirakārṣīt
yā adhastād gacchanti tāḥ saṃjīvaṃ kālasūtraṃ saṃghātaṃ rauravaṃ mahārauravaṃ tapanaṃ pratāpanam avīcim arbudaṃ nirarbudaṃ aṭaṭaṃ hahavaṃ huhuvam utpalaṃ padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ narakān gatvā ye uṣṇanarakāsteṣu śītībhūtā nipatanti ye śītanarakās teṣu uṣṇībhūtā nipatanti
teṣāṃ nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhavati na hy eva vayaṃ bhavantaḥ itaś cyutāḥ nāpy anyatropapannāḥ api tv ayam apūrvadarśanaḥ sattvaḥ asyānubhāvenāsmākaṃ kāraṇāviśeṣāḥ pratiprasrabdhā iti
gāthāś ca bhāṣate
nākasmāl lavaṇajalādrirājadhairyāḥ saṃbuddhāḥ smitam upadarśayanti nāthāḥ
yasyārthe smitam upadarśayanti dhīrāḥ taṃ śrotuṃ samabhilaṣanti te janaughāḥ
paśyasy ānanda anayā yaśomatyā dārikayā mamaivaṃvidhaṃ satkāraṃ kṛtam
evaṃ bhadanta
eṣā ānanda yaśomatī dārikā anena kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca trikalpāsaṃkhyeyasamudānītāṃ bodhiṃ samudānīya mahākaruṇāparibhāvitāḥ ṣaṭ pāramitāḥ paripūrya ratnamatir nāma samyaksaṃbuddho bhaviṣyati daśabhir balaiś caturbhir vaiśāradyais tribhir āveṇikaiḥ smṛtyupasthānair mahākaruṇayā ca
ayam asya deyadharmo yo mamāntike cittasyābhiprasāda iti
idam avocad bhagavān
āttamanasas te bhikṣavo bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandan
buddho bhagavān satkṛto gurukṛto mānitaḥ pūjito rājabhī rājamātrair dhanibhiḥ pauraiḥ śreṣṭhibhiḥ sārthavāhair devair nāgair yakṣair asurair garuḍaiḥ kinnarair mahoragair iti devanāgayakṣāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragābhyarcito buddho bhagavān jñāto mahāpuṇyo lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārāṇāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghaḥ śrāvastyāṃ viharati jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme
śrāvastyām anyatamaḥ śreṣṭhī prativasati āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogo vistīrṇaviśālaparigraho vaiśravaṇadhanasamudito vaiśravaṇadhanapratispardhī
tena sadṛśāt kulāt kalatram ānītam
sa tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati
tasya krīḍato ramamāṇasya paricārayato na putro na duhitā
sa kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparo vyavasthitaḥ anekadhanasamuditaṃ me gṛham
na me putro na duhitā
mamātyayāt sarvasvāpateyam aputrakam iti kṛtvā rājavidheyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
sa śramaṇabrāhmaṇanaimittikasuhṛtsaṃbandhibāndhavair ucyate devatāyācanaṃ kuruṣveti
asti caiṣa loke pravādo yadāyācanahetoḥ putrā jāyante duhitaraś ceti
tacca naivam
yady evam abhaviṣyat ekaikasya putrasahasram abhaviṣyat tadyathā rājñaś cakravartinaḥ
api tu trayāṇāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃmukhībhāvāt putrā jāyante duhitaraś ca
katameṣāṃ trayāṇām
mātāpitarau raktau bhavataḥ saṃnipatitau
mātā kalyā bhavati ṛtumatī
gandharvaś ca pratyupasthito bhavati
eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃmukhībhāvāt putrā jāyante duhitaraś ca
tathā hy asau śramaṇabrāhmaṇanaimittikasuhṛtsaṃbandhibāndhavavipralabdho 'putraḥ putrābhinandī śivavaruṇakuberaśakrabrahmādīn anyāṃś ca devatāviśeṣān āyācate sma
tadyathā ārāmadevatā vanadevatāś catvaradevatāḥ śṛṅgāṭakadevatā balipratigrāhikā devatāḥ
sahajāḥ sahadharmikā nityānubandhā api devatā āyācate sma
sa caivam āyācanaparas tiṣṭhati
anyatamaś ca sattvo 'nyatamasmāt sattvanikāyāc cyutvā tasyāḥ prajāpatyāḥ kukṣim avakrāntaḥ
pañcāveṇikā dharmā ekatye paṇḍitajātīye mātṛgrāme
katame pañca
raktaṃ puruṣaṃ jānāti viraktaṃ puruṣaṃ jānāti
kālaṃ jānāti ṛtuṃ jānāti
garbham avakrāntaṃ jānāti
yasya sakāśād garbho 'vakrāmati taṃ jānāti
dārakaṃ jānāti
dārikāṃ jānāti
saced dārako bhavati dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati
saced dārikā bhavati vāmaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati
sā āttamanāttamanāḥ svāmina ārocayati diṣṭyā āryaputra vardhase
āpannasattvāsmi saṃvṛttā
yathā ca me dakṣiṇaṃ kukṣiṃ niśritya tiṣṭhati niyataṃ dārako bhaviṣyatīti
so 'py āttamanāttamanāḥ pūrvakāyam atyunnamayya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum abhiprasārya udānam udānayati apy evāhaṃ cirakālābhilaṣitaṃ putramukhaṃ paśyeyam
jāto me syān nāvajātaḥ
kṛtyāni me kurvīta
bhṛtaḥ pratibibhṛyāt
dāyād yaṃ pratipadyeta
kulavaṃśo me cirasthitikaḥ syāt
asmākaṃ cāpy atītakālagatānām alpaṃ vā prabhūtaṃ vā dānāni dattvā kṛtyāni kṛtvā asmākaṃ nāmnā dakṣiṇām ādekṣyati idaṃ tayor yatratatropapannayor gacchator anugacchatviti
āpannasattvāṃ caināṃ viditvopariprāsādatalagatām ayantritāṃ dhārayati
śīte śītopakaraṇair uṣṇe uṣṇopakaraṇair vaidyaprajñaptair āhārair nātitiktair nātyamlair nātilavaṇair nātimadhurair nātikaṭukair nātikaṣāyais tiktāmlalavaṇamadhurakaṭukakaṣāyavivarjitair āhārair hārārdhahāravibhūṣitagātrīm apsarasam iva nandanavanavicāriṇīṃ mañcān mañcaṃ pīṭhāt pīṭham anavatarantīmadharimāṃ bhūmim
na cāsyāḥ kiṃcid amanojñaśabdaśravaṇaṃ yāvad eva garbhasya paripākāya
sā aṣṭānāṃ vā navānāṃ vā māsānām atyayāt prasūtā
dārako jātaḥ
abhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādikaḥ
janmani cāsya tat kulaṃ nanditam
tasya jātau jātimahaṃ kṛtvā nāmadheyaṃ vyavasthāpyate kiṃ bhavatu dārakasya nāmeti
jñātayaḥ ūcuḥ yasmād asya janmani sarvakulaṃ nanditam tasmād bhavatu dārakasya nanda iti nāmeti
tasya nanda iti nāma vyavasthāpitam
so 'ṣṭābhir dhātrībhir unnīyate vardhyate kṣīreṇa dadhnā navanītena sarpiṣā sarpimaṇḍenānyaiś cottaptottaptair upakaraṇaviśeṣaiḥ
āśu vardhate hradastham iva paṅkajam
yadā mahān saṃvṛttaḥ pañcavarṣaḥ ṣaḍvarṣo vā tadā kusīdaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ paramakusīdaḥ
necchati śayanāsanād apy utthātum
tena tīkṣṇaniśitabuddhitayā antargṛhasthenaiva śāstrāṇy adhītāni
atha śreṣṭhina etad abhavat so 'pi me kadācit karhicid devatārādhanayā putro jātaḥ so 'pi kusīdaḥ paramakusīdaḥ
śayanāsanād api nottiṣṭhate
tat kiṃ mamānenedṛgjātīyena putreṇa yo nāma svasthaśarīro bhūtvā paśur iva saṃtiṣṭhatīti
sa ca śreṣṭhī pūraṇābhiprasannaḥ
tena ṣaṭ tīrthikāḥ śāstāraḥ svagṛham āhūtāḥ api nāmāyaṃ dārakas teṣāṃ darśanād gauravajātaḥ śayanāsanād api tāvad uttiṣṭhet
atha kusīdo dārakas tāñśāstṝn dṛṣṭvā cakṣuḥsaṃprekṣaṇām api na kṛtavān kaḥ punar vāda utthāsyati vā abhivādayiṣyati vā āsanena vā upanimantrayiṣyati
atha sa gṛhapatis tām evāvasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā suṣṭhutaram utkaṇṭhitaḥ kare kapolaṃ dattvā cintāparo vyavasthitaḥ
atrāntare nāsti kiṃcid buddhānāṃ bhagavatām ajñātam adṛṣṭam aviditam avijñātam
dharmatā khalu buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ mahākāruṇikānāṃ lokānugrahapravṛttakānām ekārakṣāṇāṃ śamathavipaśyanāvihāriṇāṃ tridamathavastukuśalānāṃ caturoghottīrṇānāṃ caturṛddhipādacaraṇatalasupratiṣṭhitānāṃ caturṣu saṃgrahavastuṣu dīrgharātrakṛtaparicayānāṃ pañcāṅgaviprahīṇānāṃ pañcagatisamatikrāntānāṃ ṣaḍaṅgasamanvāgatānāṃ ṣaṭpāramitāparipūrṇānāṃ saptabodhyaṅgakusumāḍhyānām aṣṭāṅgamārgadeśikānāṃ navānupūrvavihārasamāpattikuśalānāṃ daśabalabalināṃ daśadiksamāpūrṇayaśasāṃ daśaśatavaśavartiprativiśiṣṭānāṃ trī rātres trir divasasya ca buddhacakṣuṣā lokaṃ vyavalokya jñānadarśanaṃ pravartate ko hīyate ko vardhate kaḥ kṛcchraprāptaḥ kaḥ saṃkaṭaprāptaḥ kaḥ saṃbādhaprāptaḥ kaḥ kṛcchrasaṃkaṭasaṃbādhaprāptaḥ ko 'pāyanimnaḥ ko 'pāyapravaṇaḥ ko 'pāyaprāgbhāraḥ kam aham apāyād uddhṛtya svarge mokṣe ca pratiṣṭhāpayeyam
kasya kāmapaṅkanimagnasya hastoddhāram anupradadyām
kam āryadhanavirahitam āryadhanaiśvaryādhipatye pratiṣṭhāpayeyam
kasyājñānatimirapaṭalaparyavanaddhanetrasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā cakṣur viśodhayāmi
kasyānavaropitāni kuśalamūlānyavaropayeyam
kasyāvaropitāni paripācayeyam
kasya paripakvāni vimocayeyam
āha ca
apyevātikramed velāṃ sāgaro makarālayaḥ
na tu vaineyavatsānāṃ buddho velām atikramet
paśyati bhagavān ayaṃ dārakaḥ kusīdo maddarśanād vīryam ārapsyate yāvad anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau cittaṃ pariṇāmayiṣyatīti
tato bhagavatā tīrthyānāṃ madadarpacchittyarthaṃ dārakasya ca kuśalamūlasaṃjananārthaṃ sūryasahasrātirekaprabhāḥ kanakavarṇamarīcaya utsṛṣṭāḥ yais tad gṛhaṃ samantād avabhāsitam
kalpasahasraparibhāvitāś ca maitryaṃśava utsṛṣṭāḥ yair asya spṛṣṭamātraṃ śarīraṃ prahlāditam
sa itaś cāmutaś ca prekṣitum ārabdhaḥ kasya prabhāvān mama śarīraṃ prahlāditam iti
tato bhagavān bhikṣugaṇaparivṛtas tad gṛhaṃ praviveśa
dadarśa kusīdo buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dvātriṃśatā mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtamaśītyā cānuvyañjanair virājitagātraṃ vyāmaprabhālaṃkṛtaṃ sūryasahasrātirekaprabhaṃ jaṅgamam iva ratnaparvataṃ samantato bhadrakam
dṛṣṭvā ca punaḥ paraṃ prasādam āpannaḥ
sahasā svayam evotthāya bhagavato 'rthe āsanaṃ prajñapayati
evaṃ cāha etu bhagavān svāgataṃ bhagavataḥ niṣīdatu bhagavān prajñapta evāsana iti
athāsya mātāpitarāv antarjanaś cādṛṣṭapūrvaprabhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ vismayam āpannāḥ
tataḥ kusīdo dārako harṣavikasitābhyāṃ nayanābhyāṃ bhagavataḥ pādābhivandanaṃ kṛtvā purastān niṣaṇṇo dharmaśravaṇāya
tasmai bhagavatā anekaprakāraṃ kausīdyasyāvarṇo bhāṣitaḥ vīryārambhasya cānuśaṃsaḥ
candanamayīṃ cāsya yaṣṭim anuprayacchati imāṃ dāraka yaṣṭim ākoṭayeti
sa tām ākoṭayitum ārabdhaḥ
athāsau yaṣṭir ākoṭyamānā manojñaśabdaśravaṇaṃ karoti vividhāni ca ratnanidhānāni paśyati
tasyaitad abhavat mahān batāyaṃ vīryārambhe viśeṣo yannvahaṃ bhūyasyā mātrayā vīryam ārabheyeti
sa śrāvastyāṃ ghaṇṭāvaghoṣaṇaṃ sārthavāham ātmānam udghoṣya ṣaḍvārān mahāsamudram avatīrṇaḥ
tataḥ siddhayānapātreṇa mahāratnasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā bhagavān antarniveśane saśrāvakasaṃgho bhojitaḥ
anuttarāyāṃ ca samyaksaṃbodhau praṇidhānaṃ kṛtam
atha bhagavān kusīdasya dārakasya hetuparaṃparāṃ karmaparaṃparāṃ ca jñātvā smitaṃ prāvirakārṣīt
yā adhastād gacchanti tāḥ saṃjīvaṃ kālasūtraṃ saṃghātaṃ rauravaṃ mahārauravaṃ tapanaṃ pratāpanam avīcim arbudaṃ nirarbudaṃ aṭaṭaṃ hahavaṃ huhuvam utpalaṃ padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ narakān gatvā ye uṣṇanarakās teṣu śītībhūtā nipatanti ye śītanarakās teṣu uṣṇībhūtā nipatanti tena teṣāṃ sattvānāṃ kāraṇāviśeṣāḥ pratiprasrabhyante
teṣāṃ nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhavati na hy eva vayaṃ bhavantaḥ itaś cyutāḥ nāpyanyatropapannāḥ
api tv ayam apūrvadarśanaḥ sattvaḥ asyānubhāvenāsmākaṃ kāraṇāviśeṣāḥ pratiprasrabdhā iti
atha ca tā arciṣo bhagavantaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavata uṣṇīṣe 'ntarhitāḥ
paśyasy ānanda anena kusīdena dārakeṇa mamaivaṃvidhaṃ satkāraṃ kṛtam
eṣa ānanda kusīdo dārako 'nena kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca trikalpāsaṃkhyeyasamudānītāṃ bodhiṃ samudānīya mahākaruṇāparibhāvitāḥ ṣaṭpāramitāḥ paripūrya atibalavīryaparākramo nāma samyaksaṃbuddho bhaviṣyati daśabhir balaiś caturbhir vaiśāradyais tribhir āveṇikaiḥ smṛtyupasthānair mahākaruṇayā ca
āttamanasas te ca bhikṣavo bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandan
śrāvastyām anyatamo mahāsārthavāho mahāsamudrād bhagnayānapātra āgataḥ
sa dvir api trir api svadevatāyācanaṃ kṛtvā mahāsamudram avatīrṇo bhagnayānapātra evāgataḥ
tato 'sya mahān kheda utpannaḥ
sa imāṃ cintām āpede ko me upāyaḥ syādyena dhanārjanaṃ kuryām iti
tasyaitad abhavat ayaṃ buddho bhagavān sarvadevaprativiśiṣṭataraḥ ātmahitaparahitapratipannaḥ kāruṇiko mahādharmakāmaḥ prajāvatsalaḥ yannvaham idānīm asya nāmnā punar api mahāsamudram avatareyam
siddhayānapātras tv āgaccheyaṃ ced upārdhena dhanenāsya pūjāṃ kuryām iti
sa evaṃ kṛtavyavasāyaḥ punar api mahāsamudram avatīrṇaḥ
buddhānubhāvena ca ratnadvīpaṃ samprāpya mahāratnasaṃgrahaṃ kṛtvā kuśalasvastinā svagṛham anuprāptaḥ
sa mārgaśramaṃ prativinodya bhāṇḍaṃ pratyavekṣitum ārabdhaḥ
tasya nānāvicitrāṇi ratnāni dṛṣṭvā mahāṃllābha utpannaḥ
cintayati ca mayā īdṛśānāṃ ratnānāṃ śramaṇasya gautamasya upārdhaṃ dātavyaṃ bhaviṣyati
yannvaham etāni svasyāḥ patnyā āyaḥ
tena kārṣāpaṇadvayena vikrīya bhagavato gandhaṃ dadyām iti
sa kārṣāpaṇadvayenāgaruṃ krītvā jetavanaṃ gataḥ
tato 'patrapamāṇarūpo dvārakoṣṭhake sthitvāgaruṃ dhūpitavān
atha bhagavāṃstad rūpam ṛddhyabhisaṃskāram abhisaṃskṛtavān yena sa dhūpa upari vihāyasam abhyudgamya sarvāṃ ca śrāvastīṃ sphuritvā mahadabhrakūṭavad avasthitaḥ
tasya tad atyadbhutaṃ devamanuṣyāvarjanakaraṃ prātihāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahān prasāda utpannaḥ
sa svacittaṃ paribhāṣitavān naitan mama pratirūpaṃ syād yad ahaṃ bhagavantaṃ ratnair nābhyarcayeyam iti
atha tena sārthavāhena bhagavān saśrāvakasaṃgho 'ntarniveśane bhaktenopanimantritaḥ
tataḥ praṇītenāhāreṇa saṃtarpya mahāratnair avakīrṇaḥ
tatas tāni ratnāni upari vihāyasam abhyudgamya mūrdhni bhagavato ratnakūṭāgāro ratnacchatraṃ ratnamaṇḍapaś cāvasthitaḥ yan na śakyaṃ suśikṣitena karmakāreṇa karmāntevāsinā vā kartum yathāpi tad buddhasya buddhānubhāvena devatānāṃ ca devatānubhāvena
atha sārthavāho dviguṇajātaprasādas tatpratihāryadarśanān mūlanikṛtta iva drumo bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatya praṇidhānaṃ kartum ārabdhaḥ anenāhaṃ kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca andhe loke anāyake apariṇāyake buddho bhūyāsam atīrṇānāṃ sattvānāṃ tārayitā amuktānāṃ mocayitā anāśvastānām āśvāsayitā aparinirvṛtānāṃ parinirvāpayiteti
atha bhagavāṃs tasya sārthavāhasya hetuparaṃparāṃ karmaparaṃparāṃ ca jñātvā smitaṃ prāviṣkārṣīt
yā adhastād gacchanti tāḥ saṃjīvaṃ kālasūtraṃ saṃghātaṃ rauravaṃ mahārauravaṃ tapanaṃ pratāpanam avīcim arbudaṃ nirarbudaṃ aṭaṭaṃ hahavaṃ huhuvam utpalaṃ padmaṃ mahāpadmaṃ narakān gatvā ye uṣṇanarakās teṣu śītībhūtā nipatanti ye śītanarakās teṣūṣṇībhūtā nipatanti
teṣāṃ nirmitaṃ dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bhavati na hy eva vayaṃ bhavantaḥ itaś cyutā nāpy anyatropapannāḥ
paśyasy ānanda anena sārthavāhena mamaivaṃvidhaṃ satkāraṃ kṛtam
eṣa ānanda sārthavāho 'nena kuśalamūlena cittotpādena deyadharmaparityāgena ca trikalpāsaṃkhyeyasamudānītāṃ bodhiṃ samudānīya mahākaruṇāparibhāvitāḥ ṣaṭ pāramitāḥ paripūrya ratnottamo nāma samyaksaṃbuddho bhaviṣyati daśabhir balaiś caturbhir vaiśāradyais tribhir āveṇikaiḥ smṛtyupasthānair mahākaruṇayā ca
ayam asya deyadharmo yo mamāntike cittasyābhiprasādaḥ
